Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reportingto Store Manager
SkipLevel Areas Operations Manager
AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Role & responsibilities
The Sales Executive shall be responsible for promoting and selling solar power solutions offered by Gibbon Infrastructures Pvt. Ltd., with a primary focus on residential rooftop solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana, along with commercial and industrial solar projects.

A minimum Class XII pass candidate with good communication skills, a positive attitude, and the ability to generate leads and develop customer relationships in the solar power sector.

Position Details:

Job Title: Compliance Manager Airport Cities
Location: Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra / Ahmedabad / Mumbai / Guwahati

Job Link: https://eibd.fa.em2.oraclecloud.com/hcmUI/CandidateExperience/en/sites/CX_1/job/58573/?utm_medium=jobshare&utm_source=External+Job+Share

At Adani Airports Holdings Limited (AAHL), we are creating some of Indias most ambitious airport-led urban developments. This role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to projects that will redefine the country's aviation and real estate landscape.

Mega-Scale Developments:
Be part of the development of over 22 million sq. ft. of integrated Airport City projects across Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, Lucknow, and Guwahati. Iconic Mixed-Use Portfolio.

Lead the compliance framework and statutory governance of premium developments including:
5-Star Hotels
Grade-A Business Parks
Retail & Entertainment Destinations
Convention & Exhibition Centers
Arenas and Mixed-Use Urban Precincts

Global Exposure
Collaborate closely with project teams, contractors, consultants, regulatory authorities, legal teams, and business stakeholders.

Strategic Leadership Impact
Acting as the central compliance custodian, you will play a pivotal role in ensuring timely identification, tracking, and closure of compliance obligations while mitigating organizational risks.

Role Requirements:
Bachelor's Degree in Law, Engineering, Management, Commerce, or related discipline (MBA in Infrastructure/Business Management is an added advantage)
12-15 years of experience in compliance, governance, risk management, audit, legal compliance, or regulatory affairs
Experience in infrastructure, airport, real estate, construction, utilities, or large-scale project environments is preferred
Proven experience managing multi-stakeholder compliance requirements across project lifecycles, with expertise in Statutory, Labour Law, Environmental, and Contractual Compliance.

Role Overview:
The Territory Executive will be responsible for driving sales growth within the assigned territory by identifying new business opportunities, developing strong customer relationships, and promoting the company's product portfolio.

Ensure consistent follow-up with existing customers to strengthen business

Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and relationship management skills.

The role is responsible for driving sales of Spare Parts by increasing penetration in assigned territory. Job Responsibility
Sales Execution and Planning
Drive sales strategy through innovative activities and relationship building to garner maximum market share of Tata Genuine Parts.
Drive achievement of retail sales, institutional sales, product range and total sales targets by demand generating schemes and initiatives
Achieve distributor targets for primary and secondary sales by driving order generation activites
Develop and plan appropriate stock levels with distributers and execute plans for order generations. Monitor fulfilment of orders to ensure targets are achieved. Ensure distributers have the proper funding to support sales
Ensure the timely handling of channel partners and customer complaints including resolving payment issues, claims settlements and product availability

Actively explore growth opportunities to increase market share and expanded the network to meet business objectives

Financial Management

Ensure competitive customer pricing by negotiating with channel partners to creating a win-win distribution pricing.
Monitor over dues of dealers and distributers in assigned area and take actions when required
Relationship Management
Deliver sales targets by working collaboratively with channel partners, participate in customer contact programs to capture voice of the customers, and providing timely solutions to the market, dealers, distributors and customers
People Management
Maintain up to date product knowledge and actively provide training and educate to the retailers, mechanics, fleet operators and channel partners regarding product and the usage of genuine spare parts.
Instilling the importance of resolving customer complaints received by distributors and guiding them on best practices for handling tricky situations in a timely manner. Also training them on importance of stock keeping and timely ordering of parts

Tracking shipments

Joint Audits of workshops.

For order planning, Payments, DPM review on regular basis
Transporter
For claims and timely delivery of consignments.

About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan & SOP adherence

Storeupkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pickup, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority.

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager

With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers. Backed by IDG Ventures, Unilazer Ventures and TPG Capital, Lenskart has grown its array of services exponentially.

About the Role
Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling
services to Lenskart customers. He/she plays a pivotal role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities Area Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus
Sales Associate is expected to greet and welcome all walk-in customers and guide them toward the clinic, promoting the free eye check-up
He/she will be involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
He/she must possess a basic understanding of the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
He/she must be dedicated to customer satisfaction and must go beyond his means to resolve any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
With the information received from the Optometrist and the customer, he/she will present the customer with an optimal selection of products. This opportunity may be used to strike a
conversation and convert it into sales
He/she is expected to understand the unstated needs of the customer, ask relevant questions, and pick the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales targets & SOP adherence
Sales Associate is expected to achieve the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, and
returns. He/she must follow all assigned SOPs diligently
Post making the sale, he/she is responsible for coordinating with the customer for product pick up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. He/she will verify the accuracy of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage
Store upkeep & maintenance
He/she is expected to maintain Lenskart standards of hygiene in the store with respect to the overall display, frames, instruments, and other store equipment by cleaning them regularly
He/she must ensure the security of all Lenskart equipment and ensure there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear articulation and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Greet customers warmly as they enter the store, engaging them in conversation and understanding their eyewear needs.
Assist customers in selecting eyeglasses, sunglasses, and contact lenses, providing product information, recommendations, and demonstrations as needed.
Use product knowledge and sales techniques to upsell and cross-sell products, maximizing sales opportunities.
Process customer transactions accurately and efficiently, including cash handling, credit card transactions, and billing inquiries.
Maintain a clean, organized, and visually appealing store environment, ensuring that merchandise is properly displayed and priced.
Perform regular inventory checks, restock shelves, and assist with merchandise deliveries as needed.
Address customer concerns and resolve issues in a timely and professional manner, escalating to management as necessary.

Collaborate with team members to achieve sales targets, meet customer service goals, and ensure the overall success of the store.

Qualifications:
High school diploma or equivalent.
Previous retail or customer service experience is preferred but not required.
Friendly and outgoing personality with excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Customer-focused mindset with a willingness to go above and beyond to meet customer needs.
Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment and multitask with attention to detail.
Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to handle challenging situations with professionalism and tact.
Flexible availability, including evenings, weekends, and holidays, as needed.

Function Summary
The Bancassurance Department within Axis Max Life Insurance plays a critical role in driving the distribution of life insurance products through our strategic partnership with Yes Bank. This department leverages Yes Bank s existing customer base and infrastructure to offer insurance solutions.
Bancassurance Department serves as a bridge between Axis Max Life Insurance Company and Yes Bank, ensuring that insurance products are effectively marketed and sold to a wide customer base, while maintaining high standards of customer service, compliance, and performance.
Job Summary
This role involves establishing and strengthening relationships with branch managers and staff to generate leads, the candidate will actively participate in branch activities. The incumbent will be responsible for closing sales and ensuring follow-up on issuance.
A key aspect of the role is to increase the bank s customer awareness about life insurance solutions and achieve targeted penetration of cross-sell within the branch s customer base. The candidate will effectively drive reward and recognition programs for bank staff and regularly train them on life insurance concepts and new product introductions.
Key Responsibilities
Establishing strengthening relationship with branch manager staff to gain leads from them.
Involvement in work site activities (putting up stalls and making presentations in corporate.
Closing sale and following up on issuance.
Increasing bank s customer awareness about Life Insurance solutions and achieve the targeted penetration on cross sell within the branch s customer base.
Drive effectively the Reward and recognition programs launched for the bank staff.
Train the bank staff regularly on concepts in life insurance and new product introductions.
Key Skills
Communication skills
Strategic thinking
Product Knowledge
Problem solving
Time management
Customer relationship management
Deal closing skills
Goal oriented
Customer centricity
Qualifications & Experience
Graduate/ Post Graduate in any discipline
2 to 4 years of experience in sales
Good communication skills - English regional language (preferred)
Age group: 22-28 years
Preferably has own conveyance

Description:
.Role & responsibilities:
Inpatient and Outpatient Care: Conduct daily hospital rounds in general wards and Intensive Care Units (ICUs) to manage acutely or chronically ill patients.
Diagnosis and Evaluation: Diagnose conditions such as Acute Kidney Injury (AKI), Chronic Kidney Disease (CKD), Glomerulonephritis, Nephrotic Syndrome, and diabetic/hypertensive nephropathy.
Renal Procedures: Perform and supervise procedures including diagnostic kidney biopsies, temporary/permanent dialysis catheter placements, and AV fistula evaluations.
Dialysis Management: Oversee and prescribe Hemodialysis, Peritoneal Dialysis, and Continuous Renal Replacement Therapy (CRRT) for critical care patients.
Kidney Transplantation: Evaluate donors and recipients, manage pre-transplant workups, and provide long-term post-transplant immunosuppressive and medical care.
Multidisciplinary Collaboration: Work closely with urologists, critical care specialists, renal dietitians, and transplant surgeons to deliver comprehensive care.
Consultations: Provide expert renal consultations to emergency, cardiology, and other hospital departments

Preferred candidate profile
Education: MBBS followed by an MD/DNB in General Medicine, culminating in a super-specialty DM (Nephrology) degree (or equivalent Fellowship/DNB Nephrology).
Licensure: Valid state medical council registration and active board certification/specialty recognition.
Skills: High-level clinical decision-making, procedural competency (biopsies, dialysis access), emergency resuscitation skills for severe electrolyte/acid-base crises, and patient/family communication.

Description:
We have an immediate requirement for a HR Head - Assam
Develop and implement the HR strategy aligned with organizational goals and operational requirements.
Partner with senior management to forecast manpower needs across ambulance operations, call centers, and administrative functions.
Oversee recruitment and on boarding of EMTs, drivers, call center staff, and support functions.

Experience in healthcare, emergency services, or 24/7 operations preferred.
Only Males are preferred.

Company: PRISM(Parent of OYO)

As a Business Head, you will be responsible for driving the overall business performance of your assigned region. * Proven ability to manage large teams and deliver revenue and growth targets.
* Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, and leadership skills.
* Data-driven decision-making with strong analytical abilities.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region.

Description:
Exceptional Hospitality Starts with You
Picture yourself brightening someone s day. When you join our Hotels team, that s exactly what you ll do every time you come to work! You will develop the quality of the Finance function, and provide financial support, advice and expertise to the General Manager and hotel team, to maximize value. As a Finance Manager , you re not just responsible for all accounting and financial requirements for the hotel - you re spreading the light and warmth of hospitality by delivering memorable experiences that make the stay for every guest.
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of Hospitality . Acting with Integrity and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through Leadership . A belief that Teamwork drives the best outcomes. A sense of Ownership and accountability. And a focus on the Now , bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.
In addition, this role requires the following minimum qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
Proven experience in a managerial operational accounting role
Proficient in English (spoken and written) for business communication
Skilled in hotel systems: OnQ, Check SCM, SUN, OPERA/OnQ PMS, MICROS, HRLINK
Good communication and analytical skills.
Here s what you ll do during a typical day:
Financial Controls: Apply best-practice accounting within a strong control framework
Reporting: Deliver clear, actionable financial insights
Business Support: Provide commercial and financial guidance to operations
Technology Use: Improve efficiency through smart IT integration
Investment: Drive strong returns on capital projects
Planning Forecasting: Align budgets with strategic goals and accurate forecasts
Team Development: Build and grow a capable finance team
Cash Management: Safeguard liquidity through tight controls
Cost Efficiency: Help optimize operational cost structures

Description:
Reporting to Area Operations Manager

About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities:

Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score ( NPS )

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers

Driving sales vs. plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level

People development (Attrition Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it

Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer

Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards

SOP adherence & implementation

Ensuring that all SOPs for retail are implemented successfully and adhered to by store employees
Updating colleagues on business performance, new initiatives and other important issues
Scheduling the teams shift timings to meet the stores business needs and demands
Ensuring staffing levels are adequate to effectively operate the store

Store upkeep & maintenance

Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, regularly cleaning the frames and other equipment at the store
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store.

Description:
Direct Reportees: Store Managers
Interactions: Internal and External Stakeholders.
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from a diverse team.
- Retain talent - Reduce attrition

Organisational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
About the Role
The role of Cluster Optometrist at Lenskart revolves around a combination of a perfect blend of optometry and optical retail. He/she plays a pivotal role in upskilling the front end retail staff on the professional optometry grounds. They are responsible to deliver the best customer experience by leading the example in driving the key business metrics with their optometric approach. Their key deliverable in business includes maintenance of eye test quality and dispensing standards throughout as per Lenskart norms.
Responsibilities
Store Visit
Must visit assigned stores in Lenskart uniform and manage the complete Technical and Functional part of Lenskart stores

In Store Duty
Act as a Mentor and Coach to Fresher Optometrists. Help them with Sales Pitch, Technical Dispensing Guidance, Troubleshooting, Customer Query Handling etc.
Must also work as a store optometrist during busy hours, high sale days or to cover shifts of those who are on leave. Check eye test, QC drawers, Wooqer entries, CL expiry, merchandise, Instrument calibration, KMT products etc.
To ensure the Store NPS is achieved by training, troubleshooting, tracking detractor and lead by example

Manpower
To welcome new talent from market, conduct interview and on board. Initiation Prepare and conduct meetings with respective AOMs to discuss reviews, performance or proposals

Training
For new staff - Undertake regular reviews, analyse SOPs such as eye test, quality check, dispensing, contact lens, troubleshoot, deliver to measure the impact of training on store performance. Identify and Train the Store staff to help them achieve their goals

Audit
Periodically audit their eye test and dispensing performance

Team Leader
Wear multiple hats of Team leader, Bench, Senior, Consultant Optometrist to support store team

Revenue
Maximise In-Store Revenue through Optometrists through continuous training, periodic reviews, increasing number of eye tests done at store and reducing returns

Team Work
Work as a member of Business Team to accomplish goals and objectives. Participate in regional, departmental, executive, operational meeting as appropriate

Documentation
Maintain documentation and Report daily to PS regional manager on store visit summary
Working Hours
Same as store shift and as per business needs. Must work on weekends and public holidays to support store business

Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification - Diploma in Optometry with minimum 3 years of retail experience and a good track record
Good Knowledge in Optometry, Refraction, Eye Wear Products, Dispensing and Measurements
Must be ready to travel anywhere in India as per Business requirements
Passionate about Sales, Retail, Customer service and Training
Good understanding of market and product analysis
Must have leadership qualities such as - lead by example, coaching, motivating, great communication and never give up attitude
Energy, influence, 10 x think entrepreneur mind-set etc

Description:
You, as an Area Manager, play a critical role to lead diverse teams at store level who are in turn responsible in providing the best customer experience to Lenskart customers as well as revenue generation. You are the facilitator of growth, responsible to build vision & business strategies to achieve sales, customer experience, and other organisational goals by investing in people through regular coaching.

We are looking for enthusiastic & pragmatic leaders with strong inclination towards customer centricity, sales, digital mind-set, and people leadership. On a typical day, you would be spending your time at the stores in your area, helping the team deliver on the strategy, coaching them and helping remove road-blocks.

Key Responsibilities:

Sales Leadership:

- Developing & driving sales strategy for your area & team with focus on revenue goals.
- Driving the rigor to deliver world-class customer experience at the store, thereby increasing the Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the store and reducing detractors
- Drive high performance culture in your area across the metrics mentioned above
- Assessing business and performance trends regularly & build improvement opportunities.
- Serve as critical strategy planning link between Corporate and the field organization.
- Translate corporate goals including financial returns, sales growth and market share, into
Business plans.
- Assess field capability and establish performance priorities at group level.

People leadership:

- Partnership with Store Managers & HR team to make sure stores are adequately staffed.
- Leading leaders, coaching and developing future talent
- Assess & bridge skill gaps including those related to implementation of business plans, forecasts, financial analysis, associate development and communication
- Formal & Informal performance management for store managers they are responsible for
- Responsible for establishing a culture that embraces diversity and maximizes the learnings from
a diverse team.
- Retain talent -> Reduce attrition

Organizational leadership:

- Solely responsible for managing and maintaining territory and store budgets to ensure profitability at the area level
- Managing the top and bottom line effectively of the assigned territory and stores
- Responsible for overall operational effectiveness of stores on areas such as shrinkage, capacity, productivity, growth, attrition.
- Build creative & cost effective methods to ensure productivity while managing high standards of retail operations.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
1. Sales & Business Development
Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets for powder coatings.
Identify and develop new customers in industrial and commercial segments.
Increase market share within the assigned territory.
Develop and execute territory sales plans to maximize business growth.
Monitor competitor activities, pricing, and market trends.
2. Customer Relationship Management
Build and maintain strong relationships with OEMs, fabricators, architects, metal furniture manufacturers, appliance manufacturers, and general industrial customers.
Conduct regular customer visits to understand business requirements.
Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction and retention.
Handle customer queries and resolve commercial issues promptly.
3. Dealer & Channel Management
Appoint, develop, and manage dealers and distributors.
Ensure adequate inventory availability through channel partners.
Monitor dealer performance and implement business development initiatives.
Conduct dealer meetings and product awareness programs.
4. Technical & Product Support
Coordinate with the Technical Service team for product trials and application support.
Support customers during new product approvals and qualifications.
Assist in resolving product performance and application-related issues.
Promote new products and value-added coating solutions.
5. Business Planning & Reporting
Prepare sales forecasts and demand plans.
Maintain accurate sales reports, customer visit reports, and pipeline updates.
Track order execution, collections, and inventory movement.
Ensure timely submission of MIS reports.
6. Collection & Credit Control
Ensure timely collection of outstanding payments.
Monitor customer credit limits and overdue accounts.
Coordinate with finance teams for payment reconciliation.
7. Cross-Functional Coordination
Collaborate with Production, Supply Chain, Technical Service, Quality, and Marketing teams to ensure smooth order execution.
Coordinate product availability and delivery schedules.
Provide customer feedback to support product improvements.
8. Market Development
Identify opportunities in:
Architectural Aluminium
Steel Furniture
Automotive Components
Electrical Panels
Appliances (White Goods)
General Engineering
Industrial Fabrication
Participate in exhibitions, customer meets, and industry events.

Description:
Operations Executive Job Summary
As an Operations Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our operational processes to ensure efficient report production, delivery, and client satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including research, editorial, and sales, to streamline workflows, manage project timelines, and maintain high-quality standards. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. If you are a proactive problem-solver with a passion for operational excellence, we invite you to join our dynamic team.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee and optimize the end-to-end operational processes related to report production, including data collection, analysis, report writing, and quality assurance.
Ensure smooth coordination and communication across teams involved in the report production process, including research, editorial, design, and sales.
Manage project timelines and deadlines, identifying and resolving potential bottlenecks to ensure timely delivery of reports to clients.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to streamline operations and maintain consistency and quality across report production.
Conduct regular quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established standards and guidelines.
Optimize operational workflows and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, productivity, and cost-effectiveness.
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to operational processes in the market research industry.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or masters degree in business, operations management, or a related field.
Proven experience in operations management, preferably within the market research or publishing industry.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Excellent attention to detail, with a focus on maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process inefficiencies and implement effective solutions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Proactive mindset with a demonstrated ability to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and propose innovative solutions.
Knowledge of market research methodologies and report production processes is preferred.
If you are a detail-oriented operations professional with a passion for optimizing processes and ensuring operational excellence, we invite you to join our team as an Operations Executive. Together, we will streamline operations, enhance efficiency, and deliver high-quality market research reports to our clients, contributing to their business success in a competitive marketplace.

Description:
Research Associate Job Summary
As a Research Associate at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in conducting extensive market research and analysis to support the development and publication of syndicated market reports. You will collaborate closely with our research team to gather and analyze data, identify market trends, and provide valuable insights to our clients. This position requires strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for staying updated on market developments.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct comprehensive research on various industries and markets to gather relevant data and information.
Analyze market trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities to provide insights that contribute to the development of high-quality reports.
Collect and interpret quantitative and qualitative data from diverse sources, including industry databases, research reports, company websites, and government publications.
Collaborate with the research team to define research objectives, methodologies, and timelines for each project.
Conduct primary and secondary research, including interviews, surveys, and data mining, to gather accurate and up-to-date information.
Evaluate and validate data quality, ensuring its reliability and relevance to the research objectives.
Analyze research findings using statistical techniques and data visualization tools to create insightful and visually appealing reports.
Prepare well-structured, concise, and informative written reports that effectively communicate research findings and recommendations to clients.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance the quality and relevance of research reports.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and editorial, to ensure timely delivery and effective promotion of syndicate reports.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, marketing, market research, science and technology or a related field.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret complex data and draw meaningful insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
Detail-oriented mindset with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Self-motivated and proactive approach to research, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on industry trends.
If you are a highly motivated individual with a keen interest in market analysis, we invite you to join our dynamic team as a Research Associate. Together, we will contribute to the production of insightful syndicate market reports that enable our clients to make informed business decisions in a rapidly evolving market landscape.

Description:
Digital Marketing Executive Job Summary
As a Digital Marketing Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in driving digital marketing strategies to promote our reports, expand our online presence, and engage our target audience. You will be responsible for developing and executing digital marketing campaigns, managing social media platforms, optimizing website content, and analyzing campaign performance. This position requires a strong understanding of digital marketing channels, excellent communication skills, and a passion for leveraging digital platforms to reach and influence potential customers.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement digital marketing strategies to promote market research reports and increase brand visibility and engagement.
Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across various channels, including search engines, social media, email, and display advertising.
Manage and maintain social media platforms, creating compelling content and engaging with the audience to drive brand awareness and foster community engagement.
Monitor and analyze key performance metrics, such as website traffic, conversion rates, and engagement levels, to identify areas for improvement and optimize marketing efforts.
Conduct keyword research and optimize website content to improve search engine visibility and drive organic traffic.
Collaborate with internal teams to create persuasive marketing materials, including landing pages, blog posts, email newsletters, and promotional videos, to align digital marketing efforts with overall business goals.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging digital marketing technologies to implement innovative strategies and techniques.
Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to identify opportunities for differentiation and competitive positioning.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in marketing, digital marketing, communications, or a related field.
Solid understanding of digital marketing channels, including SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, content marketing, and display advertising.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create engaging content and effectively communicate with the target audience.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and metrics to make data-driven decisions and optimize campaign performance.
Creative mindset with a keen eye for design aesthetics and the ability to create visually appealing digital assets.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
If you are a results-oriented individual with a passion for digital marketing and the ability to drive impactful marketing campaigns, we invite you to join our team as a Digital Marketing Executive. Together, we will leverage digital platforms and strategies to promote our market research reports, engage our audience, and drive business growth in a competitive market landscape.

Description:
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects is inviting applications for the position of Graduate Engineer (Civil) at our Jorhat office.
We are a professional architectural and engineering firm based in Jorhat, Assam, working in the fields of architectural design, civil engineering, structural planning, interior design, building permission drawings, and turnkey construction projects . Our project portfolio includes residential buildings, commercial buildings, interior projects, institutional buildings, hotels, resorts, and other architectural works across Assam.
We are looking for a sincere, disciplined, and technically sound Civil Engineering graduate who is willing to learn, take responsibility, and work closely with our design and construction team.
Position
Graduate Engineer (Civil)
Location
DJ Baruah Engineers Architects 2nd Floor, Above Naffy Restaurant, Baruah Chariali, Opposite Westside Shopping Mall, Jorhat, Assam
Eligibility
The candidate should have:
B.E. / B.Tech in Civil Engineering
Basic knowledge of building construction, RCC works, finishing works, and site execution
Basic understanding of drawings, plans, sections, elevations, and structural details
Knowledge of AutoCAD will be preferred
Basic knowledge of estimation, quantity calculation, and BOQ preparation will be an added advantage
Good communication skills and willingness to work in a team
Freshers may apply
Job Responsibilities
The selected candidate will be involved in:
Reading and understanding architectural and structural drawings
Preparing basic quantity calculations and material estimates
Assisting in site supervision and construction monitoring
Coordinating with architects, engineers, contractors, vendors, and site workers
Checking site work as per approved drawings and specifications
Preparing site reports, measurement sheets, and work progress updates
Supporting the team in building permission drawings, BOQ preparation, and project documentation
Maintaining proper technical records and project files
Learning office standards, construction detailing, and professional project workflow

Description:
Sales Executive Job Summary
As a Sales Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a pivotal role in driving sales growth and expanding our client base. You will be responsible for generating new business leads, nurturing client relationships, and closing sales deals. This position requires strong sales acumen, excellent communication skills, and a deep understanding of the market research industry. If you are a self-motivated and results-driven individual with a passion for sales and a knack for building strong client relationships, we invite you to join our dynamic team
Key Responsibilities
Identify and pursue new business opportunities by proactively generating leads and establishing connections with potential clients.
Conduct market research and analysis to identify target industries and sectors for sales prospecting.
Build and maintain strong relationships with existing clients to foster loyalty and secure repeat business.
Deliver persuasive sales presentations and product demonstrations to prospective clients, showcasing the value and benefits of our syndicated market research reports.
Understand client needs, provide customized solutions, and effectively communicate the unique value propositions of our reports to drive sales conversions.
Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and implement effective sales strategies, campaigns, and promotional materials.
Utilize CRM systems and sales tools to track sales activities, manage leads, and monitor the sales pipeline.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and competitor activities to identify opportunities for growth and differentiation.
Attend industry conferences, trade shows, and networking events to expand professional networks and generate new sales leads.
Collaborate with internal teams, including research, marketing, and customer support, to ensure client satisfaction and seamless execution of sales processes.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
Proven experience in sales, preferably within the market research industry or a related field.
Strong sales acumen with a track record of achieving sales targets and driving business growth.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively articulate the value propositions of our syndicated market research reports.
Exceptional negotiation and closing skills, with the ability to handle objections and secure sales deals.
Strong relationship-building skills, with the ability to build trust and rapport with clients.
Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools to manage leads and track sales activities.
Self-motivated and results-driven mindset, with the ability to work independently and meet sales targets.
Excellent time management and organizational skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks and manage multiple client engagements simultaneously.
Knowledge of the market research industry, including the understanding of research methodologies, report types, and client needs, is preferred.
If you are a driven sales professional with a passion for driving business growth and a strong understanding of the market research industry, we invite you to join our team as a Sales Executive. Together, we will leverage your sales expertise to expand our client base, increase revenue, and deliver valuable market insights to our clients.

Description:
Position: Area Sales Manager (Depot In-charge)
Function: Retail
Location: Silchar
Department: Sales

Role Overview:
We are seeking a dynamic and results-driven Area Sales Manager (ASM) to lead and manage the sales operations of a dedicated Depot within a specified territory. The ASM will be responsible for driving the sales volume, value, and growth targets by leading and motivating a team of frontline sales personnel. You will be instrumental in expanding the retail distribution network, tracking competitive activities, and monitoring local market trends to identify opportunities for growth and improvement. The ASM will also have full accountability for the performance of the Depot and will oversee its day-to-day operations.

Key Responsibilities:
Sales Performance & Target Achievement:
Lead and manage the sales operations of a single Depot, ensuring the achievement of monthly and annual sales targets (volume and value).
Develop and implement effective sales strategies and action plans to drive growth in the territory.
Monitor sales performance against targets and take corrective actions as necessary to meet business goals.
Foster a high-performance culture within the sales team, setting clear objectives and expectations.
Team Management & Development:
Lead, mentor, and motivate a team of frontline sales personnel, ensuring optimal performance and development of team members.
Conduct regular performance reviews and provide coaching and training to improve sales effectiveness.
Build a strong, cohesive team with a focus on collaboration and achieving sales targets.
Market Analysis & Competitor Tracking:
Continuously monitor the local market landscape and competitor activities to identify trends and business opportunities.
Provide insights to senior management regarding market changes and competitive strategies.
Analyze sales data and market trends to adjust sales strategies accordingly.
Distribution Network Expansion & Management:
Identify opportunities for expanding the retail distribution network within the territory.
Develop and implement effective distribution management schemes to maximize coverage and penetration.
Ensure the optimal allocation and management of resources within the Depot.
Customer Relationship Management:
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, ensuring high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty.
Act as a liaison between customers and the organization, addressing their needs and concerns proactively.

Professional Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (Graduate)/MBA (Marketing)

Experience Requirements:
10-12 years of hands-on experience in sales management through a channel network, preferably within the paints, building materials, tyre or related industries.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets in a highly competitive market.
Strong experience in managing a sales team and Depot operations independently.

Desired Candidate Profile:
Age Range: 30-35 years

Personality Traits:
Dynamic and Goal-Oriented: Able to work in a fast-paced environment with a focus on results and business growth.
Strong Leadership and Managerial Skills: A natural leader with the ability to inspire and manage teams effectively.
Customer-Centric: Excellent interpersonal skills with a customer-first approach to sales and service.
Analytical Thinker: Strong ability to analyze sales data and market trends to drive informed decisions.
Team Player: Collaborative mindset with the ability to work cross-functionally with various departments.

Description:
Operations Executive Job Summary
As an Operations Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will be responsible for overseeing and optimizing our operational processes to ensure efficient report production, delivery, and client satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including research, editorial, and sales, to streamline workflows, manage project timelines, and maintain high-quality standards. This position requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. If you are a proactive problem-solver with a passion for operational excellence, we invite you to join our dynamic team.
Key Responsibilities
Oversee and optimize the end-to-end operational processes related to report production, including data collection, analysis, report writing, and quality assurance.
Ensure smooth coordination and communication across teams involved in the report production process, including research, editorial, design, and sales.
Manage project timelines and deadlines, identifying and resolving potential bottlenecks to ensure timely delivery of reports to clients.
Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs) to streamline operations and maintain consistency and quality across report production.
Conduct regular quality checks to ensure accuracy, completeness, and adherence to established standards and guidelines.
Optimize operational workflows and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency, productivity, and cost-effectiveness.
Stay updated on industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices related to operational processes in the market research industry.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or masters degree in business, operations management, or a related field.
Proven experience in operations management, preferably within the market research or publishing industry.
Strong organizational and project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously.
Excellent attention to detail, with a focus on maintaining high standards of quality and accuracy.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify process inefficiencies and implement effective solutions.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate and coordinate with cross-functional teams.
Proactive mindset with a demonstrated ability to take initiative, anticipate challenges, and propose innovative solutions.
Knowledge of market research methodologies and report production processes is preferred.
If you are a detail-oriented operations professional with a passion for optimizing processes and ensuring operational excellence, we invite you to join our team as an Operations Executive. Together, we will streamline operations, enhance efficiency, and deliver high-quality market research reports to our clients, contributing to their business success in a competitive marketplace.

Description:
Research Associate Job Summary
As a Research Associate at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in conducting extensive market research and analysis to support the development and publication of syndicated market reports. You will collaborate closely with our research team to gather and analyze data, identify market trends, and provide valuable insights to our clients. This position requires strong analytical skills, excellent attention to detail, and a passion for staying updated on market developments.
Key Responsibilities
Conduct comprehensive research on various industries and markets to gather relevant data and information.
Analyze market trends, competitive landscapes, and emerging opportunities to provide insights that contribute to the development of high-quality reports.
Collect and interpret quantitative and qualitative data from diverse sources, including industry databases, research reports, company websites, and government publications.
Collaborate with the research team to define research objectives, methodologies, and timelines for each project.
Conduct primary and secondary research, including interviews, surveys, and data mining, to gather accurate and up-to-date information.
Evaluate and validate data quality, ensuring its reliability and relevance to the research objectives.
Analyze research findings using statistical techniques and data visualization tools to create insightful and visually appealing reports.
Prepare well-structured, concise, and informative written reports that effectively communicate research findings and recommendations to clients.
Stay updated on industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies to enhance the quality and relevance of research reports.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including marketing, sales, and editorial, to ensure timely delivery and effective promotion of syndicate reports.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, marketing, market research, science and technology or a related field.
Strong analytical and critical thinking skills with the ability to interpret complex data and draw meaningful insights.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex information in a clear and concise manner.
Detail-oriented mindset with strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.
Strong teamwork and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
Self-motivated and proactive approach to research, with a passion for continuous learning and staying updated on industry trends.
If you are a highly motivated individual with a keen interest in market analysis, we invite you to join our dynamic team as a Research Associate. Together, we will contribute to the production of insightful syndicate market reports that enable our clients to make informed business decisions in a rapidly evolving market landscape.

Description:
Digital Marketing Executive Job Summary
As a Digital Marketing Executive at Next Move Strategy Consulting, you will play a crucial role in driving digital marketing strategies to promote our reports, expand our online presence, and engage our target audience. You will be responsible for developing and executing digital marketing campaigns, managing social media platforms, optimizing website content, and analyzing campaign performance. This position requires a strong understanding of digital marketing channels, excellent communication skills, and a passion for leveraging digital platforms to reach and influence potential customers.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement digital marketing strategies to promote market research reports and increase brand visibility and engagement.
Plan, execute, and optimize digital marketing campaigns across various channels, including search engines, social media, email, and display advertising.
Manage and maintain social media platforms, creating compelling content and engaging with the audience to drive brand awareness and foster community engagement.
Monitor and analyze key performance metrics, such as website traffic, conversion rates, and engagement levels, to identify areas for improvement and optimize marketing efforts.
Conduct keyword research and optimize website content to improve search engine visibility and drive organic traffic.
Collaborate with internal teams to create persuasive marketing materials, including landing pages, blog posts, email newsletters, and promotional videos, to align digital marketing efforts with overall business goals.
Stay up-to-date with industry trends and emerging digital marketing technologies to implement innovative strategies and techniques.
Monitor competitor activity and industry trends to identify opportunities for differentiation and competitive positioning.
Qualifications and Skills
Bachelor's or Master's degree in marketing, digital marketing, communications, or a related field.
Solid understanding of digital marketing channels, including SEO, SEM, social media, email marketing, content marketing, and display advertising.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create engaging content and effectively communicate with the target audience.
Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret data and metrics to make data-driven decisions and optimize campaign performance.
Creative mindset with a keen eye for design aesthetics and the ability to create visually appealing digital assets.
Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and manage multiple projects simultaneously.
If you are a results-oriented individual with a passion for digital marketing and the ability to drive impactful marketing campaigns, we invite you to join our team as a Digital Marketing Executive. Together, we will leverage digital platforms and strategies to promote our market research reports, engage our audience, and drive business growth in a competitive market landscape.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
The Project Director Execution is responsible for the end-to-end delivery of complex, high-value real estate and hospitality projects. This senior leadership role ensures seamless coordination across multidisciplinary teams, drives execution excellence, and aligns project outcomes with strategic business objectives. The role demands deep technical expertise, stakeholder management finesse, and a relentless focus on quality, timelines, and budget.
Certifications in HVAC, LEED, or PMP are advantageous
Key Responsibilities
Project Execution Leadership
Oversee full-cycle execution of luxury residential and hospitality developments
Translate strategic plans into actionable execution roadmaps
Ensure adherence to design intent, regulatory approvals, and contractual obligations
Team & Stakeholder Management
Lead cross-functional teams including consultants, contractors, and internal departments
Interface with HNWIs, investors, and senior leadership to align expectations
Mentor project managers and site leads to uphold execution standards
Budgeting & Cost Control
Monitor project budgets, cash flows, and cost-to-complete forecasts
Implement value engineering and cost optimization strategies
Quality & Compliance
Enforce quality assurance protocols and safety standards
Ensure compliance with local laws, environmental norms, and international benchmarks
Risk & Issue Resolution
Identify execution risks and implement mitigation strategies
Resolve site-level conflicts and escalate critical issues proactively
Reporting & Documentation
Deliver periodic progress reports to stakeholders and board members
Maintain comprehensive documentation for audits, handovers, and legal purposes
Required Skills & Competencies
Strategic execution planning and operational leadership
Expertise in construction methodologies, MEP systems, and finishing standards
Proficiency in MS Project, AutoCAD, SAP, Oracle P6, and ERP platforms
Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder engagement skills
Ability to lead multicultural and geographically dispersed teams
Preferred candidate profile
15+ years of experience in real estate or hospitality project execution
End-to-end project execution for luxury hospitality developments

Description:
Job Title: Senior Business Analyst- Assistant Director
Experience- 10 to 16
Location- Bangalore, Kochi

We are seeking an experienced Senior Business Analyst with experience implementing global projects and programs with a high level of competency in Talent systems.  The ideal candidate will play a key role in gathering complex requirements, designing integrated solutions, and contributing to the strategic use of Talent data to support business objectives.

Your key responsibilities:
Requirement Gathering: Lead the gathering of complex business requirements from stakeholders, ensuring a comprehensive understanding of needs related to Talent systems, with a focus on SAP SuccessFactors and data integration
Process Engineering/Optimization: Analyze existing Talent processes, identify areas for optimization, and recommend solutions that leverage SAP SuccessFactors and other technologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness
Data Integration: Collaborate with data architecture team to enable the data integration strategy, working closely with the technical teams. Work seamlessly to achieve efficient data exchange between SAP SuccessFactors and other relevant systems, with a focus on data quality and accuracy
Solution Design: Collaborate with technical teams to design integrated solutions, translating business needs into technical requirements, data mapping, security (RBP), and system functionalities
Data Analysis: Perform advanced data analysis, identifying trends, patterns, and insights from Talent data, and presenting findings to support data-driven decision-making
Documentation: Create detailed requirement documents, process flows, use cases, data mapping documents, and other relevant documentation to guide project implementation
Stakeholder Management: Engage with business stakeholders, executive leadership, and project teams, ensuring effective communication, alignment, and delivery of project objectives
Quality Assurance: Implement and maintain best practices for data quality, testing, and validation to ensure that SAP SuccessFactors and integrated systems meet business needs and quality standards
Change Management: Drive change management efforts to support end-users in adapting to new systems and processes resulting from SAP SuccessFactors implementations
