Description:
Job Title - Solution Architect - AI - Manager - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 7 -Manager
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore
Must have skills:Generative AI,Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI, , Large Language Models (LLMs)

Good to have skills:Model Context Protocol (MCP)/ Agent2Agent (A2A)
Experience:10 - 15 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:B.Tech/BE/M.Tech/MCA
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced Solution Architect - AI with 10+ years of overall technology experience, including at least 3 years of hands-on experience designing and architecting AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, or Agentic AI solutions. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in enterprise solution architecture and experience designing scalable, secure, resilient, and production-ready AI solutions on at least one major cloud platform such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
The role will be responsible for defining end-to-end AI solution architectures covering application, data, AI/ML, integration, security, infrastructure, and operational components. The architect will work closely with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, data teams, AI engineers, software engineers, security teams, and cloud platform teams to translate business requirements into practical and scalable technology solutions.
The candidate should have strong knowledge of modern AI architecture patterns including Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), Agentic AI, AI agents, vector databases, knowledge retrieval, API/tool integration, model orchestration, observability, security, and responsible AI. Experience in taking AI solutions from initial discovery and proof-of-concept through production deployment and operationalization is essential.


Roles and Responsibilities
Design end-to-end AI and Generative AI solution architectures that address business requirements while meeting enterprise standards for scalability, security, performance, reliability, and maintainability.
Define appropriate architecture patterns for Generative AI, Agentic AI, RAG, Machine Learning, intelligent automation, conversational AI, and AI-enabled enterprise applications.
Provide architectural leadership across the complete solution lifecycle, from discovery, feasibility assessment, architecture definition, prototyping, implementation, production deployment, and post-production operations.
Collaborate with business and technology stakeholders to evaluate AI use cases, identify suitable technologies, assess technical feasibility, and define implementation roadmaps.
Lead the architecture and solution design of enterprise AI, Generative AI, Machine Learning, and Agentic AI solutions across cloud and hybrid environments.
Translate business requirements, functional requirements, and non-functional requirements into scalable and secure solution architecture designs, architecture diagrams, integration patterns, and technical specifications.
Design AI solutions using services and technologies available on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform, including managed AI/ML, data, integration, compute, security, and observability services.
Define architectures for LLM-based applications, including prompt orchestration, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector search, embeddings, model routing, grounding, knowledge bases, AI agents, tool/function calling, and multi-agent architectures.
Design enterprise integration patterns connecting AI solutions with APIs, databases, data platforms, SaaS applications, enterprise applications, event-driven systems, and external services.
Evaluate and recommend appropriate foundation models, LLMs, embedding models, AI platforms, vector databases, orchestration frameworks, and supporting technologies based on business, technical, security, cost, and performance requirements.
Define architecture approaches for AI security, identity and access management, data privacy, guardrails, content filtering, responsible AI, model governance, and regulatory compliance.
Establish architectural standards for AI observability, monitoring, tracing, logging, evaluation, performance management, reliability, and operational support.
Work closely with AI engineers, data scientists, data engineers, application developers, DevOps/MLOps teams, cloud engineers, and security teams to guide implementation and ensure alignment with the target architecture.
Lead architecture reviews, technical design workshops, proof-of-concepts, technology assessments, and design governance activities while communicating complex technical concepts effectively to both technical and business stakeholders.
Ability to conduct AI use-case discovery, technical feasibility assessments, architecture assessments, technology evaluations, and solution option analysis.
Ability to create and communicate high-level architecture, detailed solution architecture, sequence diagrams, data flows, integration diagrams, deployment architectures, and architecture decision records.
Ability to design appropriate AI guardrails addressing areas such as hallucination, prompt injection, data leakage, harmful content, unauthorized tool execution, and inappropriate model responses.
Ability to define reference architectures, reusable architecture patterns, technical standards, and architecture governance frameworks for AI solutions.


Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, application architecture, cloud architecture, data architecture, solution architecture, or related technology roles.
Minimum 3 years of experience designing or implementing AI-based solutions, including Generative AI, Machine Learning, Intelligent Automation, Conversational AI, or Agentic AI.
Demonstrated experience working as a Solution Architect, Technical Architect, Cloud Architect, AI Architect, or equivalent senior architecture role.
Proven experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale, production-grade solutions involving multiple applications, platforms, integrations, and data sources.
Hands-on architecture experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), embeddings, vector databases, semantic search, document retrieval, and enterprise knowledge bases.
Strong hands-on architecture experience with at least one major cloud platform:
AWS - for example Amazon Bedrock, SageMaker,
Microsoft Azure - for example Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search,
Google Cloud Platform (GCP) - for example Vertex AI, Gemini, BigQuery
Strong understanding of cloud-native architecture patterns, including microservices, APIs, serverless architectures, containers, event-driven architectures, asynchronous processing, and distributed systems.
Strong understanding of REST APIs, API gateways, authentication and authorization, OAuth/OIDC, networking, secrets management, encryption, and enterprise security architecture.
Strong understanding of enterprise data architectures including data lakes, data warehouses, lakehouses, relational databases, NoSQL databases, vector databases, and streaming platforms.
Strong understanding of enterprise security architecture including Identity and Access Management, Role-Based Access Control, network security, encryption, key management, secrets management, and secure API design.
Strong ability to evaluate architectural trade-offs across cost, performance, scalability, security, maintainability, complexity, and time to market.
Experience integrating AI applications with enterprise data platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, Amazon Redshift, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies.
Experience designing integrations between AI solutions and enterprise systems using APIs, messaging platforms, event buses, queues, workflow engines, and integration platforms.
Experience designing highly available, scalable, fault-tolerant, secure, and cost-effective enterprise solutions.
Experience taking technology solutions through multiple lifecycle stages including discovery, architecture, proof-of-concept, implementation, deployment, and production support.
Experience with prompt engineering, context management, grounding techniques, model selection, model evaluation, hallucination mitigation, and AI guardrails.
Experience defining deployment strategies for AI applications across development, testing, staging, and production environments.
Experience working with enterprise security, risk, compliance, and governance teams to ensure AI solutions meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
Experience estimating solution complexity, cloud infrastructure requirements, implementation effort, technical dependencies, and architecture risks.
Understanding of common AI orchestration and development frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, DSPy, or equivalent technologies.
Understanding of AI production monitoring including model/application performance, latency, token consumption, cost, prompt and response tracing, model failures, retrieval quality, and system availability.
Understanding of Agentic AI concepts, including AI agents, planning and reasoning workflows, tool/function calling, agent orchestration, workflow automation, and multi-agent systems.
Understanding of CI/CD, Infrastructure as Code, DevOps, MLOps, LLMOps, containerization, Kubernetes, and automated deployment practices.
Understanding of data ingestion, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, data quality, metadata management, data governance, and data security concepts.
Knowledge of Responsible AI principles, AI governance, model risk management, data privacy, prompt security, content moderation, explainability, and human-in-the-loop controls.
Knowledge of emerging AI interoperability patterns and protocols such as Model Context Protocol (MCP) and Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication is desirable. Any experience with UCP is also a plus.
Familiarity with observability platforms and technologies such as OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, Google Cloud Operations, Datadog, Grafana, or equivalent tools.
Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage effectively with business leaders, product owners, enterprise architects, engineering teams, security teams, and senior management.
Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to explain complex AI and architecture concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate multiple technical approaches and clearly articulate architectural trade-offs.
Ability to provide technical leadership and architectural guidance to cross-functional engineering teams without necessarily being responsible for direct people management.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to understand business problems, challenge assumptions, identify technical risks, and recommend pragmatic solutions.
Ability to work across multiple projects and technology domains while maintaining consistency with enterprise architecture principles and standards.

Additional Information
Relevant cloud architecture certifications such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect, Microsoft Certified:Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Google Professional Cloud Architect, or equivalent certifications.
AI/ML or Generative AI certifications from AWS, Microsoft, Google, Databricks, NVIDIA, or other recognized technology providers are advantageous.
Experience working in large enterprise environments, consulting organizations, or complex multi-cloud transformation programs.
Experience defining or contributing to organizational AI architecture standards, Generative AI platforms, AI Centers of Excellence, or enterprise AI governance frameworks would be advantageous.

The candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, implementing, and supporting integration solutions using SAP Cloud Platform Integration (CPI) and SAP Integration Suite.The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience in SAP CPI, SAP Integration Suite, iFlows, Groovy Scripting, OData Services, API integrations, and cloud-based integration scenarios. Experience in implementation, migration, enhancement, and support projects is highly preferred.
Location: Bangalore,Chennai,Mysuru,Noida,Nagpur,Mumbai,Hyderabad,Kolkata,
Coimbatore,Thiruvanandhapuram,Mangaluru,etc
Experience: JL4: 2-5 Years | JL5: 5-9 Years
Roles & Responsibilities
Design, develop, and support integration solutions using SAP CPI and SAP Integration Suite.
Develop and maintain iFlows for cloud-to-cloud and cloud-to-on-premise integrations.
Create and enhance integration scenarios using SOAP, REST, IDoc, RFC, and OData services.
Develop custom integration logic using Groovy Scripts.
Configure adapters, mappings, content modifiers, routers, and exception handling mechanisms.
Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize integration interfaces.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams to understand business requirements and integration needs.
Perform unit testing, SIT, UAT support, defect resolution, and production support activities.
Prepare technical specifications and integration documentation.
Participate in implementation, rollout, migration, upgrade, and support projects.
Support SAP S/4HANA integration initiatives.
Ensure adherence to integration best practices, security standards, and governance processes.
Qualifications
Minimum 2 years of hands-on experience in SAP CPI/Integration Suite.
B.E./B.Tech/MCA/M.Sc/MBA or any Postgraduate degree.

SAP CPI,CLOUD PLATFORM,INTEGRATION SUITE,IFLOWS,GROOVY SCRIPT,ODATA,ODATA

Description:
Role Overview
The role involves developing and maintaining relationships with leading architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients, including HNI and UHNI customers.

This is a relationship-driven business development role, rather than a conventional field sales position. The selected candidates will represent a premium brand, identify high-value projects, develop market connections, coordinate client visits, and nurture business opportunities through to closure.

Key Responsibilities
Build and maintain strong professional relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients.
Identify and develop business opportunities in luxury residential projects, villas, hospitality, and premium commercial interiors.
Conduct regular market visits to architect studios, design firms, project sites, and client locations.
Promote MCI's premium collections of natural stone, marble, granite, imported stone, and surface solutions.
Generate leads through networking, market mapping, referrals, industry contacts, and architect/designer databases.
Understand project requirements and coordinate with architects and designers to recommend suitable products.
Arrange and coordinate visits to MCI's Experience Centre for architects, designers, and prospective clients, wherever applicable.
Maintain consistent follow-ups with prospects and project stakeholders to convert opportunities into business.
Track enquiries, quotations, samples, project requirements, and lead conversion status.
Develop and maintain an updated database of architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium customers.
Support the development of the assigned market and achievement of business targets.
Maintain disciplined daily and weekly activity reports, lead updates, and follow-up records.
Represent MCI professionally at client meetings, exhibitions, industry events, and design-related networking activities.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, upcoming projects, and emerging business opportunities.

Ideal Candidate Profile
Candidates with experience in any of the following industries will be preferred:
Natural stone, marble, granite, and imported stone
Premium tiles, sanitaryware, and surface materials
Luxury furniture, modular kitchens, and premium interiors
Architectural products, high-end lighting, and home automation
Luxury real estate, project sales, and premium construction materials
Other premium product segments involving regular interaction with architects, interior designers, builders, and developers

Experience in natural stone, marble, granite, imported stone, or premium surface materials will be an added advantage.
Freshers are also welcome if they demonstrate strong communication skills, confidence, professionalism, a willingness to learn, and an interest in architecture and luxury interiors.

Required Skills & Qualities
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Confident, energetic, well-groomed, and professionally presentable.
Strong relationship-building, networking, and negotiation skills.
Genuine interest in luxury interiors, architecture, and premium products.
Ability to engage effectively with architects, interior designers, builders, developers, and premium clients.
Proactive, self-motivated, and target-oriented approach.
Strong follow-up, lead-management, and reporting discipline.
Willingness to undertake regular field visits and travel within the assigned market.
Knowledge of the local market and established industry contacts will be an advantage.
Fluency in English and the relevant local language is essential. Hindi proficiency will be an added advantage.

Salary Range:
- Freshers: 20,000 30,000 per month
- Experienced candidates: 25,000 40,000 per month
Final compensation will depend on the candidate's experience, communication skills, market exposure, relevant industry knowledge, and overall suitability for the role

Interested Candidates
Candidates who are passionate about premium products, relationship management, and business development in the luxury architecture and interior-design segment are encouraged to apply.

Description:
Job description,

Hiring for Selenium Automation tester with experience range 3 years & above

Mandatory Skills: Automation testing, Selenium, Java, C#

Education: BE/B.Tech/BCA/MCA/M.Tech/ME/BSc/MSc./MS

Location: Pan India

Responsibilities
A day in the life of an Infoscion
As part of the Infosys consulting team, your primary role would be to actively aid the consulting team in different phases of the project including problem definition, effort estimation, diagnosis, solution generation and design and deployment
You will explore the alternatives to the recommended solutions based on research that includes literature surveys, information available in public domains, vendor evaluation information, etc. and build POCs
You will create requirement specifications from the business needs, define the to-be-processes and detailed functional designs based on requirements.
You will support configuring solution requirements on the products; understand if any issues, diagnose the root-cause of such issues, seek clarifications, and then identify and shortlist solution alternatives
You will also contribute to unit-level and organizational initiatives with an objective of providing high quality value adding solutions to customers. If you think you fit right in to help our clients navigate their next in their digital transformation journey, this is the place for you!


Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.
To learn more about Infosys and see our ideas in action please visit us at www.Infosys.com

Description:
Key Responsibilities:
Design, build, and maintain Alteryx workflows for data preparation, transformation, and integration.
Develop and support ETL/data workflows to ingest, cleanse, validate, and enrich data from multiple sources.
Translate business requirements into technical workflow designs and reusable components/macros.
Implement data quality checks, reconciliation logic, and exception handling to ensure accuracy and completeness.
Optimize workflow performance by improving logic, reducing run time, and managing resource usage effectively.
Document workflow logic, data mappings, and operational steps to support maintainability and handovers.
Collaborate with analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to troubleshoot issues and deliver enhancements.
Support production runs, monitor scheduled workflows, and resolve failures within defined timelines.

Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelors degree (or equivalent) in Engineering/Technology/Computer Applications/Science (e.g., BTech, BE, BSc, MCA, MTech, MSc).
2-5years of experience working with Alteryx to build and maintain data preparation or automation workflows.
Strong hands-on experience in ETL and data workflow development, including transformation and validation steps.
Solid understanding of data concepts such as joins, aggregations, filtering, data types, and schema handling.
Ability to analyze requirements, debug workflow issues, and deliver reliable outputs with attention to detail.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience integrating Alteryx workflows with databases and file-based sources, including efficient input/output patterns.
Familiarity with SQL for data validation, reconciliation, and performance-aware querying alongside Alteryx pipelines.
Exposure to workflow scheduling/automation and operational support for recurring data processes.
Understanding of analytics lifecycle practices such as versioning, documentation standards, and reusable workflow design.
Ability to communicate clearly with stakeholders, present findings, and recommend improvements to data processes.
Good to have skills:
SQL, Data Warehousing, Data Quality Frameworks, Power BI, Python

Description:
EY- Assurance Senior
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

Educational Criteria : Must be a Qualified CA - Fresher or Upto 1 yr exp.

The opportunity
Were looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills.

Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures and ensure these are embedded into the engagement team’s work.
Proactively discuss workflow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training. Lead by example.

Skills and attributes for success
Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have
Freshly Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI)
0-1 year of Sub small experience in Assurance.

Ideally, you’ll also have
Proficiency in MS – Excel, MS – Office.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
AboutCompany:
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Job Description: Retail Sales Officer
Company Name: Noble Steel (Sangam Steel)
Job Title: Retail Sales Officer
Department: Sales
Job Location: Kozhikode, Salem, Kochi, Namakkal, tuticorin, Chennai, Chengalapattu
Employment Type: Full-Time
Reporting To: HOD
Website: https://www.noblesteels.com/

Job Summary
Sangam Steel is looking for a motivated and customer-oriented Retail Sales Executive to manage retail sales, assist customers, promote steel products, and achieve sales targets. The ideal candidate should have good communication and negotiation skills, a customer-focused approach, and the ability to develop strong relationships with customers, contractors, fabricators, and dealers.

Key Responsibilities
Attend to walk-in customers and understand their steel product requirements.
Explain product specifications, quality, pricing, sizes, and availability.
Generate sales leads and convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
Prepare quotations, sales orders, invoices, and other sales documents.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
Maintain strong relationships with existing customers and develop new customers.
Coordinate with the store, warehouse, and dispatch teams to ensure timely delivery.
Monitor stock availability and communicate inventory requirements to the concerned team.
Handle customer queries, complaints, and after-sales service.
Follow up on pending quotations, customer orders, and outstanding payments.
Maintain accurate sales records and prepare daily sales reports.
Ensure proper product display, store cleanliness, and adherence to company policies.
Keep track of local market trends, competitor pricing, and customer preferences.

Required Qualifications
Minimum graduate degree in any discipline is preferred.
13 years of experience in retail sales, preferably in steel, hardware, building materials, or construction-related products.
Knowledge of steel products such as TMT bars, MS angles, channels, flats, pipes, sheets, and other steel items is an advantage.
Basic computer knowledge, including MS Excel and billing or inventory software.
Good communication, customer service, and negotiation skills.
Ability to work with sales targets and manage multiple customer enquiries.

Key Skills
Retail Sales and Customer Handling
Product Knowledge and Sales Pitching
Lead Generation and Follow-up
Negotiation and Order Closing
Billing and Documentation
Inventory Coordination
Relationship Management
Target Achievement

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Achievement of monthly sales targets.
Number of new customers acquired.
Conversion rate of customer enquiries into orders.
Repeat business and customer satisfaction.
Timely follow-up on quotations and pending orders.
Accuracy of sales documentation and billing.
Collection of outstanding payments, wherever applicable.

Compensation and Benefits
Salary: As per industry standards and candidate experience.
Incentives based on sales performance, as per company policy.
Training and career growth opportunities.
Other benefits as per company policy.

Preferred Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate should be energetic, trustworthy, proactive, and commercially oriented, with a strong interest in retail sales. Experience in steel trading, hardware, construction materials, or a building materials showroom will be an added advantage.

Description:
Job Title - Pricing & CPQ Specialist - ACS SONG
Management Level:Level 9-Specialist
Location:Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad
Must have skills:Pricing & CPQ

Good to have skills:PROS Smart Price Optimization
Experience:5 - 8 years of experience is required

Educational Qualification:Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)
Job Summary
Results-driven Pricing & CPQ Lead responsible for designing and implementing CPQ solutions that streamline sales processes and ensure accurate product configurations, pricing, and quoting. This role partners closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into robust technical specifications, while guiding development teams and ensuring seamless integration with enterprise systems. Demonstrated success in improving pricing accuracy, reducing quote turnaround times, and driving revenue growth through process optimization and strategic pricing recommendations.


Roles and Responsibilities
Lead Pricing/CPQ transformation initiatives, designing scalable and flexible PROS-based solutions.
Oversee the end-to-end implementation of PROS Pricing/CPQ solutions, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Develop detailed Technical design and architecture to implement PROS Pricing/CPQ
Manage large-scale Pricing/CPQ implementations, providing hands-on technical and functional guidance.
Resolve integration challenges between various backend enterprise systems.
Ensure application performance, scalability, and optimization.
Act as a trusted advisor, guiding clients through best practices and digital transformation in pricing and CPQ.

Qualification
Professional and Technical Skills
2+ years of experience architecting Pricing/CPQ solutions, with expertise in Product modelling, configuration, and rules (CTO and ETO) Guided selling and complex pricing models Discounting structures and approval workflows Quoting, document generation, and e-signature processes Contracts, subscriptions, and renewals Seamless Quote-to-Order conversion
5 years working with pricing and CPQ platforms
Strong hands-on experience in solution design and validation, including code review and script validation.
Certification in PROS Pricing/ CPQ is a must

Job description

Only for Malayalam Candidates

Kick-start your career in Python development through structured training, hands-on project experience, and industry-focused mentorship. This program is designed to help fresh graduates gain practical software development skills by working on real-world applications and projects while receiving guidance from experienced professionals. Work on real-world applications and live development projects.
Assist in designing, developing, testing and debugging Python applications.
Write clean, maintainable and well-documented code.
Collaborate with experienced developers on project tasks.
Work with databases such as MySQL or PostgreSQL.
Develop and integrate REST APIs.
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions and development activities.
Build an industry-ready project portfolio and strengthen technical skills.

Required Skills:

Freshers and basic knowledge of python programming.
Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).
Familarity with SQL and relational databases.
Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS and Javascript is an advantange.
Logical thinking and Problem-Solving ability.
Strong learing attitude and willingness to upskill.
Passion for software development and technology.

What we Offer:

Structured Training and Senior Developers mentorship.
Hands-on experience through real-time Company own and client development projects.
Practical experience to industry-standard tools and workflows.
Project portfolio development.
Career guidence, interview preparation and placement support.
Professional and collaborative work environment.

Preferred Qualification: Graduate and Diploma, PG

Experience:
Freshers or candidates upto 3 years of experience are welcome to apply.

Location: Kochi, Kerala (On-site/off-site)

Eligibility: Malayalam speaking candidates or candidates willing to relocate to kochi.

Job Responsibilities
Receive, unload, and process deliveries and account for incoming freight based on invoice and receiving reports.
Stage merchandise by department, mark appropriately for placement in facility, and deliver merchandise to appropriate department.
Verify and track received inventory and complete inventory reports and logs.
Reconcile shipping invoices and receiving reports to ensure count accuracy.
Receive, store, ship, and deliver incoming and outgoing department packages and mail.
Secure the receiving room and its contents, ensuring safekeeping of packages.
Follow all national, state, and local hazardous material shipping guidelines and regulations.
Ship all out-going mail and packages.

Communicate with proper management regarding any loss or damage with packages.
Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications.
Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets.
Address guests service needs in a professional, positive, and timely manner.
Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette.
Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others.
Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (eg, small print).
Visually inspect tools, equipment, or machines (eg, to identify defects).
Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance.
Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination.
Move through narrow, confined, or elevated spaces.
Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces as well as up and down stairs and/or service ramps.
Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping.
Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

AboutCompany:
The Muthoot Group is a leading business conglomerate that has successfully expanded, in each and every town, across the nation. The Group has 20 diversified business divisions and 5443+ branches with a global presence across USA, UK, UAE, Costa Rica, Sri Lanka and Nepal.
The Group serves over 2.5 lakh customers every single day through its network of branches. Till date, the Group has served over 70 crore customers, including repeat customers. The Muthoot Groups story from humble beginnings to its ever growing stature is built on the firm foundation of 7 fundamental principles of Ethics, Values Reliability, Dependability, Trustworthiness, Integrity and Goodwill. The Group practices an equal opportunity policy wherein people from all sections of the society have equal opportunities to join and be part of the 40,000+ strong Muthoot Family.
Muthoot Finance, the flagship company of The Muthoot Group has been rated India’s No. 1 Most Trusted Financial Services Brand for five consecutive years, from 2016 to 2020 by TRA’s Brand Trust Report. It has been certified as ‘Great Place To Work, 2021-22’ and has been recognised and featured as one of the Top 30 Best Places to Work at in India by Skill Tree Global Knowledge Consortium in the Workplace Excellence Show on CNBC TV-18 in 2016.
The Company offer 30+ Staff Welfare Measures ranging from Fast Track Promotions, Career Development Programs, National Pension Scheme, Foreign Trips, five types of Annual Incentives/Bonuses, Cash Rewards, Contests with prizes, Maternity Benefits, Medical benefits, Employee Insurance etc. to name a few.
Muthoot Finance believes in promoting local hiring from the region. Every 5th employee is a woman and roughly 24% of the workforce comprises of women.
Shri. Amitabh Bachchan Ji is the Brand Ambassador of The Muthoot Group.
The Group takes humble pride in its 800 years of family business legacy and unblemished track record. Over these years, millions of underserved Indians have been served through a bouquet of products and services and have been helped in a big way to move ahead in life.

Job Description

About the Role:

We are looking for an energetic, persuasive, and empathetic Senior Academic Counsellor to guide prospective students toward suitable courses and educational pathways. In this role, you will interact with students and parents, understand their career goals, recommend tailored learning solutions, and assist them through the enrollment process.
Key Responsibilities:

Student Guidance: Conduct telephonic, online, or face-to-face counselling sessions with prospective students and parents to understand their career goals and educational requirements.

Lead Management: Handle warm leads provided by marketing and perform timely follow-ups via phone calls, WhatsApp, and emails.

Program Pitching: Explain course structures, curriculum, certification details, fee structures, and career outcomes clearly to potential candidates.

Admissions & Conversions: Drive course enrollments and meet individual and team monthly targets.

CRM Management: Maintain accurate student records, track lead statuses, and update log details regularly in the company CRM.

Relationship Building: Build trust and strong rapport with students to provide ongoing assistance throughout their admission process.

Desired Candidate Profile

Qualification: Any Graduate / Postgraduate degree (Education, Psychology, Business Administration, or related fields preferred).

Experience: 0 to 5 years in EdTech, admissions counselling, tele-calling, or inside sales.

Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal and written communication in Malayalam and English

Skills: Excellent active listening, active persuasion, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.

Target-Oriented: Proactive, self-motivated, and comfortable working towards monthly targets.

Tech-Savvy: Basic knowledge of MS Excel, and online communication platforms.
Perks & Benefits

Uncapped attractive performance incentives
Structured career progression & promotion path
Paid leaves and health coverage
Friendly and supportive work culture
Competitive salary

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Obstetric anesthesia: Provide anesthesia and pain relief during normal delivery (epidural, where available) and cesarean sections.
Gynecological surgeries: Administer anesthesia for procedures such as hysterectomy and other gynecological operations.
Pediatric anesthesia: Provide safe anesthesia for infants, newborns, and children undergoing surgery.
Pre-anesthesia assessment: Review medical history, allergies, investigations, and fitness for anesthesia before surgery.
Intraoperative monitoring: Monitor vital signs, including heart rate, blood pressure, oxygen saturation, and breathing.
Postoperative care: Manage pain, nausea, and recovery after anesthesia.
Emergency management: Respond to obstetric emergencies, difficult airways, severe bleeding, and other critical situations.
Team coordination: Work closely with obstetricians, pediatricians, neonatologists, surgeons, nurses, and operating theatre staff.
Documentation: Maintain anesthesia records, consent documentation, and postoperative monitoring records.

Develop and execute category growth strategies aligned with overall business objectives.
Drive revenue, margin, and market share growth for assigned jewellery categories.

Description:
Position: Python Developer
Experience: 5-8 Years
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Python Developer with 5-8 years of experience in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable applications. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Python programming, backend development, API integration, database management, and cloud technologies. The candidate will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet business requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain robust Python-based applications and services.
Build scalable and secure RESTful APIs and microservices.
Collaborate with business analysts, product owners, and development teams to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and reliability.
Develop reusable, efficient, and maintainable code following best practices.
Integrate applications with databases, third-party systems, and cloud platforms.
Participate in code reviews, debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
Implement automated testing and CI/CD pipelines.
Ensure adherence to security, compliance, and coding standards.
Mentor junior developers and contribute to technical discussions and solution design.
Required Skills
Technical Skills
Strong proficiency in Python with 5-8 years of hands-on development experience.
Experience with Python frameworks such as:
Django
Flask
FastAPI
Strong understanding of Object-Oriented Programming (OOPs) concepts.
Experience in developing REST APIs and Microservices architecture.
Hands-on experience with SQL and NoSQL databases:
PostgreSQL
MySQL
MongoDB
Redis
Experience with ORM frameworks such as SQLAlchemy or Django ORM.
Good understanding of asynchronous programming and multithreading concepts.
Experience with Version Control Systems such as Git.
Cloud & DevOps
Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized deployments.
Experience with CI/CD tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or Azure DevOps.
Data & Messaging
Experience working with message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or AWS SQS.
Understanding of data processing and integration workflows.

Description:
EY- Assurance Assistant Manager
As part of our EY-Assurance Team, you would be the main point of contact from GDS for the tasks assigned by the global client serving assurance teams and be responsible for the timeliness and quality of deliverables along with managing day to day operations of those engagements.

The opportunity
We’re looking for candidates who possess technical knowledge, including ability to interpret reviews and accounting standards and strong project management skills along with excellent communication and leadership skills. GDS Assistant Manager’s, would have Associate level or Senior level personnel to work with at GDS and get the tasks executed from them along with performing a review as an Assistant Manager  , which is defined by the Global client serving assurance teams.

Your key responsibilities
Lead an engagement from the GDS front and ensure the team delivers timely and high-quality work, as per EY GAM and in line with the Global team expectations.
Demonstrate strong understanding of GAM while performing reviews of procedures performed by GDS staff, along with knowledge of EY tools to make reviews more efficient and meaningful.
Develop and maintain productive relationships with key EY Global counterparts like Assurance executives based out of Americas or Europe.
Develop an understanding of EY Quality and Risk Management procedures, and ensure these are embedded in to the engagement team’s work.
Proactively discuss work flow management with the assurance teams, allocating resources to the assigned work and monitoring performance against standards. Monitor utilization for one’s team, budget to actuals, and other operational matters.
Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clarity of communication when dealing with GDS and Global teams.
Establish expectations of value to be delivered to the respective GDS Global teams aligned.
Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work for GDS on one’s own engagements.
Standardize review processes along with leveraging best practices across one’s aligned engagements or beyond.
Motivate and lead one’s GDS team members, identify and foster key talents, coach and supervise team members.
Be responsible for various operational matters related to engagements aligned.
Conduct timely performance reviews and provide performance feedback/training.
Ability to Lead by example.

Skills and attributes for success
Expert Knowledge of Indian accounting and assurance standards or knowledge of IFRS / UK GAAP / US GAAP and International review standards is an added advantage.
Excellent communication skills.
Effective interpersonal, risk management, facilitation and presentation skills
Ability to confidently lead conversations and discussions with key stakeholders
Project management, leadership, coaching, counselling and supervisory skills
Robust logical and reasoning skills.
Ability to spread positive work culture, teaming and live EY values.
The ability to quickly form strong working relationship with colleagues in India and global teams.

To qualify for the role, you must have
Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) / ACCA / CPA
1-5 years post-qualification experience with either
a) Mid-or top-tier accounting firm focused on external or Assurance reviews
b) MNC or larger domestic Indian companies, preferably within a Shared Service
     Environment.
Ideally, you’ll also have
Proficiency in MS – MS office and Outlook.
Interest in business and commerciality.

What we look for
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Location: North & South India
Experience: 24 Years
Industry Preference: Telecom (Preferred)

We are looking for a result-oriented Sales Trainer to enhance the capabilities of field sales teams across North and South India. The role focuses on improving sales effectiveness through structured training, on-ground coaching, and performance-driven interventions.

Deliver sales capability training programs for frontline field sales teams
Coach teams on sales pitch, objection handling, and conversion techniques
Conduct on-ground coaching, shadowing, and field audits
Drive improvement in key sales KPIs such as conversion rates and revenue
Customize and adapt training content based on market dynamics and team needs

Strong understanding of sales processes and funnel management
Proven coaching and mentoring skills
Excellent communication, presentation, and influencing abilities
Experience in field training and on-ground coaching preferred

Graduate in any discipline
2–4 years of experience in sales training or frontline sales with training exposure

Description:
Role summary
The Lead AI Process Transformation Engineer leads larger, complex and cross-functional workflow redesign and AI-enabled transformation opportunities. The role is the senior process-and-AI engineering anchor for OEE, combining enterprise process transformation, capability and maturity assessment, portfolio leadership, practical solution architecture, hands-on technical credibility, executive influence and coaching.
Role purpose and scope
This role operates within OEEs process-first transformation model. It owns the path from ambiguous enterprise problem to validated current state, redesigned workflow, bounded AI-enabled solution, governance approval, adoption and realized value. The role leads the second AI Process Engineer, supports the AI Builders Network and works across business and technology teams to ensure that technical choices follow process evidence rather than lead it.
Enterprise workflow transformation leadership
Lead complex, cross-functional workflow discovery across people, process, technology, data, policies, controls, systems and organizational boundaries.
Frame ambiguous business challenges into clear outcomes, process boundaries, operating assumptions, measures and decision requirements.
Guide current-state and future-state design using process maps, SIPOCs, value-stream views, service blueprints, decision flows and operating-model views.
Challenge solution-first requests and ensure the sequence Eliminate, Simplify, Standardize, Integrate, then Automate or apply AI is followed.
Define process ownership, roles, decision rights, controls, exception paths, escalation routes, service expectations and management routines.
Review and assure the quality of transformation charters, process designs, value cases, implementation plans and control approaches.
Capability mapping and transformation portfolio leadership
Lead capability-mapping and maturity-assessment activities linking enterprise outcomes to capabilities, workflows, owners, KPIs, systems, data and dependencies.
Build and govern a prioritized pipeline of workflow redesign and AI-enabled transformation opportunities.
Assess opportunities using strategic alignment, customer impact, volume, effort, cycle time, quality, risk, controls, data readiness, feasibility, reuse and value potential.
Establish decision gates for discovery, redesign, prototype, pilot, production handoff, scale, remediation and retirement.
Manage dependencies, risks, decisions and capacity across multiple transformation opportunities and technical partners.
Provide concise executive views of portfolio health, value, risks, readiness and decisions required.
AI solution architecture and technical direction
Translate redesigned workflows into AI-enabled solution strategies covering tasks, inputs, outputs, context, knowledge, integrations, controls, human review and operational ownership.
Define solution patterns for agentic workflows, AI assistants, retrieval-based solutions, workflow automation and deterministic controls.
Lead or co-lead proofs of concept and bounded implementations using enterprise-approved platforms such as Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI capabilities, approved APIs and Python.
Provide technical direction on prompt engineering, grounding, retrieval-augmented generation, orchestration, evaluation and integration patterns.
Determine when bounded low-code or coded implementation is appropriate and when production engineering, architecture or data-platform support is required.
Assure that solution design includes human-in-the-loop decisions, exception handling, fallback, access controls, auditability, supportability and lifecycle ownership.
AI Builders Network and team leadership
Act as the senior process-transformation partner for Principal AI Leads, AI Builders and business leaders on complex or cross-functional opportunities.
Coach the second AI Process Engineer and builders on workflow discovery, process-first solutioning, value measurement, agent design, testing and adoption.
Establish reusable playbooks, templates, prompts, test packs, control patterns and solution assets for enterprise reuse.
Conduct design reviews and provide escalation support where process, technology, risk or ownership choices are unclear.
Build practical process-transformation and AI fluency across OEE and participating business teams.
Value realization, governance and adoption
Own the measurement strategy across baselines, targets, leading indicators, lagging indicators and balancing measures.
Develop and challenge value cases covering financial savings, cost avoidance, capacity release, cycle time, quality, risk, service and customer or associate value.
Ensure forecast and realized value are validated with appropriate business and Finance partners.
Lead governance readiness across Responsible AI, Architecture, Information Security, Privacy, Legal, Risk, Accessibility and Records requirements.
Guide adoption, stabilization, operational handover and scale, remediate or retire decisions.
Ensure accountable business owners retain ownership for workflow decisions, adoption and sustained outcomes.
Required qualifications and experience
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data, Business, Operations or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
10+ years of relevant experience, including significant leadership across process transformation, business architecture, solution engineering, automation or AI-enabled delivery.
Demonstrated experience independently leading complex cross-functional current-state discovery, future-state redesign and implementation.
Experience in capability mapping, maturity assessment, transformation portfolio prioritization and executive decision support.
Strong practical Lean and process-engineering capability covering process mapping, SIPOC, VSM, waste analysis, root-cause analysis, standard work, controls and benefit measurement.
Hands-on credibility building or co-building AI agents, intelligent workflows, automation prototypes or small digital solutions on enterprise platforms.
Strong working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG, prompt engineering, grounding, orchestration and solution evaluation.
Ability to work with APIs, structured data and scripting; working proficiency in Python or an equivalent language.
Demonstrated ability to coach practitioners, influence senior leaders, challenge solution-first requests and drive outcomes without direct authority.
Excellent executive communication and ability to convert complex evidence into clear choices, trade-offs and decisions.
Preferred qualifications and experience
Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, or equivalent advanced process-transformation qualification supported by practical application.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Semantic Kernel or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of API integration, JSON, authentication, connectors, data preparation, vector search and enterprise knowledge sources.
Experience leading or supporting an AI Center of Excellence, Builders Network, transformation studio or enterprise automation program.
Experience with Agile delivery, product thinking, service design, organizational change, operating-model design or program management.
Experience in Finance, Operations, Technology, shared services, customer operations or another complex enterprise environment.
Cloud, AI, business architecture, process-improvement or automation certifications.
Expected outcomes
A governed portfolio of high-value workflow redesign and AI-enabled transformation opportunities with clear sequencing, owners and decision gates.
Priority capabilities and workflows have validated current states, maturity gaps, baselines, future states, controls and readiness decisions.
Complex opportunities progress from discovery through redesign, bounded solution, governance, adoption and measurable value realization.
AI Builders and the second AI Process Engineer receive effective technical and process-transformation direction.
Reusable process, solution, testing and control patterns are adopted across multiple opportunities.
Leadership receives transparent and decision-ready evidence on value, risk, dependencies, adoption and scale.
What success looks like
Creates clarity and a credible path forward from ambiguous enterprise problems.
Improves the complete workflow and operating mechanism, not merely one automated task.
Balances process rigor, technical feasibility, control requirements, speed and business value.
Can challenge leaders constructively and guide multiple stakeholders toward an evidence-based decision.
Builds team and enterprise capability while personally retaining technical and transformation credibility.
Delivers sustained outcomes and reusable transformation capability.

Description:
EY Assurance Manager (Real Estate Practice)
As part of our EY Assurance Real Estate practice, you will serve as the primary point of contact from GDS for engagements assigned for the Americas regions. You will be responsible for managing end-to-end engagement delivery, including quality, timeliness, stakeholder management, operational oversight, resource planning and team leadership. The role requires working closely with engagement teams and client-serving professionals to deliver high-quality assurance services while driving continuous improvement, digital adoption, risk management and process standardization across a portfolio of Real Estate clients.

The Opportunity
EY's Real Estate Assurance practice serves a broad range of clients across the real estate ecosystem, including real estate investment trusts (REITs), real estate private equity funds, property owners, developers, asset managers and other real estate-related entities. The practice provides exposure to complex accounting, reporting and assurance matters unique to the real estate industry, including property acquisitions and disposals, fair value measurements (level III), leasing, joint ventures, investment funds and capital markets transactions. We're looking for qualified accountants with strong leadership, stakeholder management and project management skills. The incumbent will have an excellent opportunity to work directly with engagement teams across the Americas, develop deep industry knowledge, gain exposure to leading global Real Estate clients and contribute to the growth and transformation of the EY Assurance Real Estate practice.

Your key responsibilities
- Support a portfolio of engagements by leading teams of Associate Managers, Assistant Managers and staffs, ensuring timely, high-quality delivery in line with EY methodology, engagement expectations and quality standards.
- Demonstrate strong technical and methodological expertise through service delivery, pre-issuance reviews, assurance quality reviews, hot reviews and other quality initiatives, while proactively identifying and mitigating engagement risks.
- Develop and maintain productive relationships with Assurance executives, Partners and key engagement stakeholders across Americas, acting as a trusted advisor and proactively managing stakeholder expectations.
- Develop a strong understanding of EY Risk Management procedures and ensure compliance requirements are embedded across all engagement activities and team deliverables.
- Work closely with engagement teams to transition new engagements and services to GDS Assurance, expand GDS scope and identify opportunities for increased participation across audit phases.
- Proactively manage engagement workflow, resource allocation, staffing mix, utilization, budgets, capacity planning and engagement economics, while monitoring performance against established operational goals and KPIs.
- Demonstrate professionalism, competence and clear communication when working with both GDS and engagement teams, ensuring timely escalation and resolution of issues where necessary.
- Establish and continuously reinforce expectations regarding value delivery, service quality, efficiency and stakeholder satisfaction for aligned engagements.
- Identify opportunities to improve the scope of work, increase GDS adoption and support portfolio growth through new wins, centralization and standardization initiatives.
- Drive process improvement, automation, digital adoption and the sharing of leading practices to enhance audit quality, efficiency and consistency across engagements.
- Lead by example, build high-performing teams and create an inclusive culture through effective coaching, delegation, mentorship and career development.
- Conduct timely performance reviews, provide regular feedback, support counselor responsibilities and actively contribute to talent development, retention and succession planning.
- Leverage technology, analytics and EY tools to enhance service delivery, monitor engagement performance and support productivity improvement initiatives.
- Contribute to technical, digital and soft-skills training programs to continuously develop team capabilities and strengthen the overall talent pipeline.

Skills and attributes for success
- Knowledge of US GAAP and International Standards on Auditing (ISA).
- Understanding of Real Estate industry accounting, reporting and assurance requirements.
- Experience with REITs, Real Estate Funds, Property Owners, Developers and Asset Management entities.
- Knowledge of fair value measurements, lease accounting, acquisitions/dispositions and joint venture structures.
- Ability to identify and assess industry-specific risks, controls and financial reporting considerations.
- Strong stakeholder management, project management and team leadership skills.
- Experience leveraging audit technologies, data analytics and digital tools to drive quality and efficiency.

To qualify for the role, you must have

- Qualified Chartered Accountant (ICAI) with 5-6 years of post-qualification relevant experience.
- Qualified ACCA / CPA with 7-8 years of post-qualification relevant experience.

- Articleship with a Big 4, top-tier or mid-tier accounting firm.
- Experience in external audit and assurance engagements, preferably with exposure to Real Estate, REITs, Private Equity Real Estate Funds, Asset Management or Hospitality clients.
- Experience working on US-based Real Estate engagements and applying US GAAP reporting requirements is preferred.
- Experience managing engagement teams, stakeholder relationships and multiple concurrent audit engagements.
- Experience with audit technology, data analytics and digital audit tools is preferred.
- Experience in either:
a) A Big 4, top-tier or mid-tier accounting firm focused on external audit and assurance engagements.
b) An MNC or large Indian organization, preferably within a Shared Services environment.
c) Big 4 firms serving both Indian and global assurance practices.

Ideally, you'll also have
- Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office and audit technology tools.
- Interest in business, commerciality and industry trends.
- Exposure to Real Estate clients, including REITs, Real Estate Funds, Developers and Property Management entities.
- Understanding of key Real Estate accounting areas such as lease accounting, fair value measurements and investment properties.
- Strong analytical, stakeholder management and problem-solving skills.
- Ability to drive process improvements, digital adoption and continuous learning initiatives.

What we look for
- A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
- An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
- Opportunities to work with EY GDS Assurance practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

What we Offer
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.

Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Role summary
The Senior AI Process Transformation Engineer provides delivery capacity for workflow redesign and AI-enabled transformation. The role combines practical process discovery and redesign with hands-on implementation of bounded agents, intelligent workflows, automation prototypes and small digital solutions, while partnering with the Lead AI Process Transformation Engineer on complex or enterprise-wide opportunities.
Role purpose and scope
This role operates within OEEs process-first transformation model. It moves assigned opportunities from business problem and evidence through current-state discovery, future-state redesign, functional and technical requirements, prototype or small implementation, testing, adoption and value tracking. The role is expected to execute independently within an agreed scope and escalate architecture, risk or enterprise decisions with clear evidence.
Workflow discovery and process redesign
Partner with process owners and subject-matter experts to define the business outcome, customer need, scope, process boundary and measures of success.
Conduct current-state discovery across people, process, technology, data, policies, controls, systems and handoffs.
Create current-state and future-state process maps, SIPOCs, value-stream views, service blueprints and decision flows.
Identify waste, delays, queues, rework, duplicate activity, failure demand, inconsistent rules, control gaps and avoidable variation.
Facilitate focused root-cause analysis using Problem Trees, 5 Whys, Fishbone, Pareto and targeted data analysis.
Design future-state workflows using Eliminate, Simplify, Standardize, Integrate, then Automate or apply AI.
Document process owners, roles, controls, exceptions, escalation paths, service expectations and operational measures.
Capability evidence and opportunity assessment
Connect assigned workflows to relevant capabilities, outcomes, owners, KPIs, systems, data and dependencies.
Prepare evidence, workflow inventories and assessment views to support capability mapping and maturity assessment.
Assess opportunities using volume, effort, cycle time, quality, customer impact, risk, data readiness, feasibility and value potential.
Distinguish process problems from technology problems and flag solution requests where ownership, baseline, controls or expected outcomes are unclear.
Create transformation charters, use-case definitions, implementation backlogs, testable value hypotheses and decision packs.
Applied AI solution engineering
Translate redesigned workflows into functional and technical requirements covering tasks, inputs, outputs, decision rules, context, knowledge, integrations, controls and human review.
Design and build or co-build bounded agents, AI assistants, retrieval-based solutions and workflow automations using approved platforms and patterns.
Create proofs of concept and small implementations using Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI capabilities, approved APIs and Python where appropriate.
Apply prompt engineering, grounding, RAG, orchestration and evaluation techniques suitable for the use case.
Configure human-in-the-loop decisions, exception handling, fallback behavior, auditability and access controls.
Create and execute test cases covering business accuracy, groundedness, usability, process performance, controls and failure conditions.
Partner with Lead Engineer, Engineering and Architecture where production software, complex integration or enterprise data engineering is required.
Builders Network delivery support
Support Principal AI Leads and AI Builders in translating business problems and backlogs into process-ready use cases.
Facilitate workflow discovery and identify what should be removed, simplified or standardized before agent development.
Provide hands-on guidance on prompt structure, grounding, testing, controls, adoption and value measurement.
Document and publish reusable workflows, prompts, test scripts, control approaches and solution assets.
Escalate complex, high-risk or cross-functional choices to the Lead AI Process Transformation Engineer and the appropriate Responsible AI, Architecture, Information Security, Privacy, Legal and Risk partners.
Measurement, adoption and sustainment
Establish operational definitions, baselines, targets, leading indicators, lagging indicators and balancing measures for assigned opportunities.
Prepare value cases covering capacity, cycle time, quality, risk, service and customer or associate value.
Track adoption, usage, performance, reliability, exceptions, control results and forecast versus realized value.
Support change, training, operational handover and stabilization activities.
Provide clear status updates on progress, risks, dependencies, decisions and outcomes.
Required qualifications and experience
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Data, Business, Operations or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
5+ years of relevant experience spanning process improvement, business analysis, workflow transformation, automation, solution engineering or AI-enabled delivery.
Demonstrated experience conducting cross-functional current-state discovery and contributing to future-state workflow redesign.
Practical Lean knowledge covering process mapping, SIPOC, waste analysis, root-cause analysis, standard work, controls and benefit measurement.
Hands-on experience building AI agents, intelligent workflows, automation prototypes or small digital solutions using at least one enterprise platform.
Working knowledge of generative AI, LLMs, agentic workflows, RAG, prompt engineering, knowledge grounding and solution evaluation.
Ability to translate business and process requirements into functional designs, technical requirements, test cases and implementation tasks.
Ability to work with APIs, structured data and basic scripting; working proficiency in Python or an equivalent language.
Strong facilitation, analytical problem-solving, stakeholder management and written and verbal communication.
Ability to work through ambiguity, manage assigned work independently and escalate decisions with clear evidence.
Preferred qualifications and experience
Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or Black Belt certification supported by practical application.
Experience with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Power Automate, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI or comparable platforms.
Working knowledge of API integration, JSON, authentication, connectors, data preparation, vector search and enterprise knowledge sources.
Experience supporting an AI Builders Network, AI Center of Excellence, transformation studio or enterprise automation program.
Experience with Agile delivery, product thinking, service design, change management or program coordination.
Experience in Finance, Operations, Technology, shared services, customer operations or another complex enterprise environment.
Cloud, AI, business analysis, process-improvement or automation certifications.
Expected outcomes
Assigned workflows have validated current states, owners, baselines, target outcomes, controls and documented readiness decisions.
Prioritized opportunities progress efficiently from discovery to redesigned workflow, bounded prototype or implementation, adoption and measurable outcome.
Builders receive practical process and solution-engineering support for assigned opportunities.
Prototypes and small implementations demonstrate value without creating unmanaged production risk.
Reusable process, prompt, testing and control assets are captured and published.
Business owners receive clear evidence on performance, adoption, risks and realized value.
What success looks like
Diagnoses the workflow before prescribing technology.
Produces accurate, usable process, requirement, test and implementation artifacts.
Builds enough of the solution to accelerate learning and delivery while respecting production boundaries.
Escalates evidence-based choices early and collaborates effectively with business and technical specialists.
Delivers adopted and controlled improvements with measurable outcomes.
Continually builds proficiency in both process transformation and applied AI engineering.
