Description:
Job Title: Technology Sourcing Manager
Function: Supply Chain Services
Sub-Function: Global Procurement
At EY, youll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
The opportunity
The purpose of the global EY organization is to Build a Better Working World. The insights and services the organization provides help to drive long-term value for clients, people and society and to build trust in the capital markets. An essential function under EY Business Enablement, Supply Chain Services (SCS), is a global team with more than 600 professionals in over 35 countries supporting the EY organization across the globe. This structure helps enable knowledge-sharing across categories and regions, streamlining efforts in seeking innovative suppliers that can provide exceptional client service to maximize SCS’s value for the EY organization and the world's supply chain.
A key component of SCS is Global Procurement, whose purpose is to drive significant synergies and value creation from sourcing to contract lifecycle management, deliver exceptional client experiences and build more vital collaboration to manage Technology, Talent, Alliances and Brand, Marketing and Communications (BMC) categories. We forge meaningful supplier relationships and strengthen supplier resilience to help EY maximize long-term value for its people, clients and communities.
Technology Sourcing is part of Global Procurement focusing on the requirements from the Technology team and managing circa $2.3B of spend annually. The Technology Sourcing team supports infrastructure and services at a global enterprise scale and supports key programs and solutions globally in partnership with our EYT colleagues in order to continue to enhance EY’s position as a technology driven industry leader.
Why this role matters
Global Procurement drives synergy from sourcing through contract lifecycle management, strengthens supplier resilience and delivers exceptional internal client experience across Technology, Talent, Alliances and BMC categories.
Your key responsibilities
The Technology Sourcing Assistant Director reports into a Technology Sourcing Leader within the Technology Sourcing team and is responsible for sourcing strategy and execution, customer engagement and experience, and vendor management in line with the Global Procurement Policy and processes.
The role of the Technology Sourcing Assistant Director may include:
Responsibility as a senior individual contributor on an Enterprise Technology Sourcing team, aligned to one or more technology categories.
Act as an individual contributor and trusted business advisor - managing multiple complex transactions directly or indirectly and working closely with senior stakeholders to deliver successful results.
Working closely with risk management business partners to minimize contractual risks to the firm whilst demonstrating year on year improvement in value for money.
Partnering with GCO (legal) to lead key negotiations and reporting on the quantitative and brand value delivered.
Effectively build a pipeline of deals and develop the appropriate resourcing plans.
Supporting improvement in processes, policy, systems, management information and reporting.
Successfully leading negotiations for global and regional deals meeting the timelines, scope, and requirements agreed with key stakeholders.
Working with senior EYT and Service Line stakeholders to help develop a category strategy which supports the overall global technology strategy.
Supporting the broader Technology Sourcing team in the delivery and management of procurement activities may include the following activities:
Manage full lifecycle of contracts for assigned programs of work and key suppliers
Pro-actively manage contract and license renewals
Build and foster collaborative working relationships with EYT and other internal business partners
Supporting and leading stakeholders through the Onboarding of Technology Goods and Services end- to-end process.
Socialization and facilitation of the Technology Sourcing policy and processes, ensuring that the project team and stakeholders understand the value of the policy and adhere to it accordingly
Timely and frequent submission of management information, including project status and savings reporting
Support for the Enterprise Technology Sourcing team in developing a strategy which adheres to the overall global technology strategy while supporting local engagements
Facilitation of any needed market research to identify potential suppliers, ensure competitive pricing and terms, etc.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong experience with senior stakeholder management with the ability to collaboratively co-develop strategies and set and manage expectations.
Extensive experience negotiating contracts related to technology services – ideally including managed services / outsourcing
Heavy experience with negotiating contracts globally.
Experience of managing complex service agreements both from the commercial and service delivery side
Experience of working in a Sourcing/Procurement/Vendor Management team in a complex and global environment
Experience working in an IT role as part of delivering technology solutions is a plus
Strong influencing and networking skills as the organization relies on working in cross functional teams across borders
Good knowledge of technology vendors and new technologies is important to successfully work with the EYT teams
Up to date with all issues in the services space including Outsourcing, Infrastructure as a Service and offshoring / rightshoring
Strong communication skills required; must have the ability communicate in English effectively, transparently, and timely across multiple mediums (email, voice, IM, etc) in a global environment
The ability to independently manage and prioritize workload
Strong organizational skills
Demonstrate a positive attitude and have an appetite for challenge
Provide Exceptional Client Service
To qualify for the role, you must have
Required
Degree educated with:
Minimum of 8 years experience in a strategic sourcing role
Alternatively, technology or business operations experience may be considered in lieu of some of the sourcing experience for the right candidate.
In depth experience negotiating for multiple Service delivery models (Outsourcing, Platform as a Service, Infrastructure as a Service, Software as a Service etc)
Experience of stakeholder management at a senior level in their current or previous role
Ideally, you will also have
Excellent oral, written communication and presentation skills in business English.
Experience with a global, culturally diverse organization.
Experience working collaboratively, virtually and independently.
Certification Requirements:
CPSM qualification or equivalent desired
What we look for
We are looking for a high-energy individual who embraces change to ensure we continue to strategically deliver world class innovative solutions to the global EY organization in an ever-changing business environment.
You simplify complexity, align diverse stakeholders, and turn business strategy / roadmaps into repeatable delivery and realized benefits.
What we offer
Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.
AboutCompany:
EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Your key responsibilities
Define and maintain the product vision, roadmap, priorities and success measures for assigned BMC technology (Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and enablement of products or capabilities.
Partner with BMC stakeholders to understand business objectives, user needs, operational pain points, adoption barriers, and opportunities to improve product value.
Translate business priorities into clear product outcomes, epics, features, user stories, acceptance criteria and backlog items that guide delivery teams.
Own backlog prioritization and trade-off decisions, balancing business value, user impact, delivery complexity, risk, dependencies and available capacity.
Work closely with project managers, business analysts, data engineers, Power BI developers, EY Technology and vendors to ensure delivery is aligned to product intent and agreed outcomes.
Lead product discovery, option assessment and stakeholder alignment activity, ensuring decisions are based on strong evidence, clear requirements and realistic delivery considerations.
Monitor product performance, adoption, benefits, feedback and user experience to identify enhancements and inform future roadmap decisions.
Support governance, planning, and leadership reporting by providing clear updates on product priorities, progress, risks, dependencies, decisions, and expected value.
Contribute to continuous improvement across BMC Enablement by helping standardize product management practices, roadmap governance, backlog discipline and value measurement.
Skills and attributes for success
Hands-on experience working with Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Customer Journey Analytics and/or Adobe Journey Optimizer.
Strong product management capability in complex, matrixed organizations, ideally working across business, technology, data and vendor teams.
Strong understanding of customer data platforms (CDPs), audience management, customer profile architecture and marketing activation ecosystems.
Good understanding of marketing, communications, or enterprise technology environments, with the ability to quickly understand user needs, business processes, and platform implications.
Commercial and outcome-oriented mindset, with the ability to connect product decisions to strategic priorities, user value and measurable business impact.
Structured thinker who can turn ambiguity into clear product direction, practical priorities and actionable delivery requirements.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage roadmaps, backlogs, stakeholders and competing priorities without losing sight of outcomes.
Clear communicator who can translate product complexity into concise messages, decisions and recommendations for delivery teams and senior stakeholders.
Confident stakeholder manager with the ability to build trust, challenge constructively, influence without formal authority and keep teams aligned around shared goals.
Solution-focused and resilient, with the persistence to resolve blockers, manage trade-offs and maintain product momentum through ambiguity.
Committed to quality, governance and operational discipline, acting as a dependable point of product ownership across teams.
To qualify for the role, you must have
Proven experience as a Product Manager, Product Owner or Digital Product Lead supporting Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA), Adobe Experience Platform (AEP/CDP), Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) or related MarTech platforms.
Experience supporting technology, digital, marketing, communications, transformation, analytics or enablement of products or platforms.
Strong practical skills in roadmap management, backlog prioritization, stakeholder engagement, requirements shaping, user story definition, and value tracking.
Experience working with cross-functional delivery teams, including project managers, business analysts, data, engineering, technology, vendors and/or offshore resources.
Ability to manage competing priorities, make clear product trade-offs, and produce high-quality product artefacts, leadership updates and decision materials.
Experience using agile, product-led or iterative delivery approaches to deliver measurable improvements for users and the business.
Ideally, youll also have
Product management certification or working knowledge of agile, SAFe, Scrum, design thinking, service design or similar delivery approaches.
Familiarity with Adobe Experience Cloud ecosystem including Adobe Analytics, Adobe Target, Adobe Campaign and related customer experience technologies.
Experience with product discovery, user research, adoption planning, benefits measurement, OKRs, KPIs or product performance reporting.
Experience with marketing technology, content platforms, campaign operations, data products, analytics, AI-enabled capabilities or enterprise workflow tools.
A continuous improvement mindset and confidence proposing practical ways to simplify, standardize and strengthen product management ways of working.
Experience working in a cross-border role or supporting globally distributed teams.
Technologies and Tools
Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO)
Software or Marketing technology products
MS Office tools (Word, Excel, IE); web/production technologies such as HTML, XML, JavaScript, and CSS
What we look for 
Analytical mind-set and problem-solving capability.
Passionate about new technologies and digital products
Enthusiastic and self-motivated, with the ability to lead projects proactively.
Meticulous attention to detail, with an overall passion for continual improvement.
Innovative and creative, with a logical and methodical approach to problem solving.
Credible and articulate, with excellent communication, presentation and interpersonal skills.
Ability to think strategically and guide marketers of different levels with the best practices and industry trends

Description:
Position: Instructional Designer Senior Associate
Education: Any Graduate
Experience: 4 7 years of relevant experience
The opportunity
This position will support the design of individual learning items and blended learning programs. The instructional designer will work to agreed design quality standards and processes, using approved templates and tools, and will collaborate with other designers and learning professionals to support the continuous improvement of design and development speed, efficiency, and quality. In addition, the designer will develop and maintain strong relationships with content owners, Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), learning and performance consultants, developers, deployment teams, and vendors.
Your key responsibilities
Actively participate in Skills Needs Analysis (SNA) conversations leading to the design of learning solutions.
Draft learning objectives that meet EY quality standards
Apply effective learning strategies and design guidelines to ensure the creation of impactful learning materials.
Assist in drafting Learning Solution Plans and contribute to the continuous improvement of learning solutions.
Create comprehensive learning documents (e.g., Storyboards, trainer/participant decks for Physical and Virtual Classroom programs) that contribute to the development of final learning assets.
Maintain strong working relationships with Subject Matter Reviewers (SMRs), graphic designers, and other stakeholders to produce effective learning solutions.
Review all learning deliverables for content flow, accuracy, language, and adherence to quality standards.
Independently liaise with SMRs for technical reviews and feedback to enhance learning materials.
Conduct quality assurance checks with SMRs, technical reviewers, and deployment teams; utilize their feedback to revise design documents.
Utilize rapid authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Adobe Captivate, and Articulate Studio to create engaging and interactive learning modules.
Ensure deliverables align with EY design and quality standards related to written materials.
Skills and attributes for success
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with content owners, SMRs, deployment teams, and other members of the learning team.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to write effective instructional text, and facilitator materials.
Ability to adapt to a constantly changing and growing business environment.
Good problem-solving skills and a customer service-focused mindset.
Proactive in mentoring junior team members and facilitating effective teamwork.
To qualify for the role, you must have
3 to 6 years of experience in designing courses and other learning items.
Experience in designing effective learning solutions across different modalities
Proficiency with Microsoft Office tools and rapid authoring tools.
Experience building and maintaining strong relationships with business customers/clients.
Ability to work in fast-paced, stressful environments to deliver required results.
What we look for
An experienced instructional designer who can support multiple projects concurrently.
A professional who can quickly problem-solve and can offer perspective on solutions

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Project Lead - Land Acquisition | Industrial Project
Project-Industrial Project,
Function-Land Acquisition / Project Development
Location-Bihar-Bhagalpur,Pirpainti,Patna
Reporting

Reporting to State Head

LAND ACQUISITION • DUE DILIGENCE • GOVERNMENT LIAISON • STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT
1. Role Overview
The Project Lead will drive and coordinate land acquisition and land-readiness activities for the Industrial Project. The role requires practical experience in land identification and sourcing, private and government acquisition, title verification and due diligence, government liaisoning, statutory approvals, stakeholder management, including negotiations if any. The job involves coordination with client state and district land team, project team and legal team landowners, government authorities, project stakeholders. Maintaining all records and history of correspondence and approval, preparation of monthly management information reports
2. Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end land identification, sourcing and acquisition activities for the industrial project. Including identification preparing land schedule, plant layouts on village map identification of land owners. To coordinate with client and obtain conformation for suitability
Assess and coordinate acquisition of private, government land through state policies revenue allotment policies through LARR, surface right or through industrial development corporation of respective state, including right of way or right of use in case of linear project and other project land parcels.
To carry out due process, post allotment measurement necessary entries at revenue record, measurements handing over allotted land parcel to client
Coordinate land aggregation against project requirements, including parcel-wise status, area and ownership tracking.
Oversee title verification and land due diligence, including ownership records, revenue records, encumbrances, disputes and transferability.
Coordinate with legal teams/consultants on Title Search Reports (TSRs), legal documentation, opinions and title-related issues.
Coordinate government acquisition processes and liaise with District and state authorities, also has to maintain cordial relations with state authorities and resolve issues with Liaoning with Administration, Revenue authorities and other relevant departments.
Track and facilitate applicable land-use requirements, statutory permissions and project-related approvals.
Maintain practical knowledge of the applicable of land/revenue framework, industrial policy and relevant energy-sector policy requirements.
Coordinate with relevant state industrial-development and project authorities and understand applicable land-allotment/industrial-area processes.
Handle and negotiate land-related issues with landowners, local representatives and other stakeholders.
Build and maintain effective relationships with local stakeholders and government officials.
Lead commercial discussions relating to land acquisition, including land rates, transaction terms and other commercial conditions within approved parameters.
Coordinate with Project, Legal, Compliance, Survey, Documentation and Administration teams.
Ensure land and project documentation is properly collected, organised, updated and accessible.
Track parcel-wise progress, pending actions, approvals and dependencies and provide timely management updates.
Use Google Earth, maps and satellite imagery for preliminary site assessment, location understanding, access assessment and land identification.
Coordinate with survey teams for demarcation, measurement, boundaries, coordinates and site verification.
Support project handover by ensuring required land records, documentation, approvals and site information are complete.
Identify acquisition bottlenecks and recommend practical solutions to accelerate project progress.
3. Role Specific Responsibilities
Understand the land requirements of a the particular project, including the main project site and supporting land requirements.
Coordinate land requirements connected with project infrastructure, access, utilities, transmission/connectivity and other ancillary facilities, as applicable.
Understand the different processes applicable to private, government and forest-related land and coordinate with the relevant teams/authorities.
Coordinate with technical/project teams so land acquisition and site planning remain aligned with the project's basic footprint and development schedule.
Keep land-related activities aligned with project milestones and implementation timelines.
Act as a key on-ground interface with landowners, local communities, government authorities and project stakeholders; handle sensitive local issues through communication, negotiation and problem-solving.
4. Authority & Accountability
Act as the primary on-ground coordinator for land acquisition and land-readiness activities for the project.
Coordinate with internal teams, external consultants, landowners and government authorities to resolve acquisition-related issues.
Escalate material legal, commercial, regulatory and stakeholder risks affecting project timelines.
Track acquisition milestones and proactively recommend corrective actions where delays or bottlenecks arise.
Ensure that land acquisition activities remain aligned with approved commercial parameters, legal requirements and project timelines.
5. Required Experience & Qualifications
7-8 years of relevant experience in land acquisition, land aggregation, infrastructure, energy, industrial projects, real estate or a closely related field.
Graduate qualification in Law, Engineering, Management, Commerce or another relevant discipline.
Hands-on experience managing land/project activities and working directly with landowners, government authorities and project stakeholders.
Practical experience in title verification, due diligence, land documentation, government processes and negotiations.
6. Core Skills & Competencies
Land Acquisition & Aggregation
Private & Government Land Processes
Title Verification & Due Diligence
Revenue Records & Land Documentation
Government Liaisoning & Approvals
Stakeholder/Client Management
Landowner Negotiation
Commercial Understanding & Negotiation
Google Earth / Map-Based Site Assessment
Problem Solving & On-Ground Execution
Excellent Communication Skills
Working knowledge of the local language and local land/acquisition environment preferred
7. Key Success Measure
The Project Lead will be expected to ensure that required land parcels are identified, legally and commercially assessed, progressed through applicable acquisition and approval processes, properly documented and made available for the project in accordance with agreed timelines. To arrange land parcels as per project requirement in given time. Exercise all-out efforts to handover possession of land to client in accordance with the project start date. Remain compliant and ensure land is free of encumbrance and that the land is free of any previous liabilities and to ensure uninterrupted project execution till project completion.

Skills: Skills highlighted with ‘‘ are preferred keyskills, Body Massage, TherapySPAWellnessMassageSlimming Therapist, About company, Guided by the vision of “Transforming Lives”, the VLCC Group seeks to urge self transformation, spread happiness and imbibe every individual with wellness for life. These three mantras have been the pillars of strength for the Company since it was founded by Mrs. Vandana Luthra in 1989. Till date they remain the firm foundation upon which the company continues to build its success story.
Description:
Job Score Card Slimming Therapist
Section

Details
Mission Statement

Provide a wide range of exceptional slimming services to clients, enhancing their appearance and well-being while adhering to VLCC’s standards and creating superior customer satisfaction.
Outcomes and Accountabilities

1. High Quality of Service, delivering specialized services in slimming category as well as operation of slimming appliances as per the SOP
2. Client Consultation advice in simple words about the basic principle of therapies and appliances
3. Ensure that the trolley and bed setting in the therapy and appliance rooms is done as per the SOP and cleanliness of room and appliances is maintained.
4. Client Referrals by identifying skin/hair issues and referring clients to appropriate experts.
5. Disinfect appliance pads with a germicidal like savlon and Dettol before every session and clean them periodically (every fortnight cleaning in water boiled for 20 minutes so that they are sterilized) as per SOP.
6. Hygiene and Equipment Maintenance by ensuring tools & equipment are sterilized and well-maintained after each execution.
Competencies

1. Technical Expertise in hands-on execution of services with proficiency in slimming treatments.
2. Take and record the measurements of the client at the Enquiry Stage (waist circumference or any other problematic area) / At the time of Zero session and thereafter at the end rolling period for full body and every alternate session for spot reduction therapies as per SOP.
3. Measurements (whole body / problematic area) to be entered in the CPR accurately and signatures taken from the client and that of self.
4. Adhere to the Medical Contraindications with respect to Therapies & Appliances as guided by the Doctor, Physiotherapist and Dietician prior to giving of the respective session.
5. Sales Acumen to soft sell packages and products.
6. Attention to Detail, to maintain high standards of hygiene & personal appearance.
7. Organizational Skills allowing efficient management of appointments & records.
Cultural Fit

Alignment with VLCC’s commitment to customer satisfaction, quality service, business growth, and continuous improvement.
Job Responsibilities

Perform Slimming/ Weight Loss services
1. Execute appliance / therapy session as per SOP always ensuring comfort to the client.
2. Deliver expected Weight loss & CM loss for scientific service delivery and customer delight and maintain record duly undersigned by the client and self.
Client Consultation and Sales
1. Provide weight/inch loss or maintenance advice and soft sell slimming packages and products.
Hygiene and Maintenance
1. Sterilize and maintain equipment, organize raw ingredients, and handle slimming tools responsibly. Maintain proper slimming product stock and timely update the slimming head on stock requirement.
Client Referrals
1. Recognize and refer clients with skin/hair issues to the appropriate experts.
Administrative Tasks
1. Schedule appointments, maintain slimming service records, and generate required reports.
Continuous Improvement
1. Attend staff and training meetings, upgrade skills, and multitask as needed.
Reporting Structure

Reports to Slimming Head
Positions Supervised

Nil.
Compensation and Benefits

Competitive salary with performance-based incentives, health benefits, and other perks as per company policy.
Experience and Education

Passed class 10, Hands-on-experience, Apprenticeship Training. At least 2-3 experience in a similar industry. Willing to work in shifts, accept additional responsibilities, and be comfortable with transfers.
AboutCompany:
Guided by the vision of “Transforming Lives”, the VLCC Group seeks to urge self transformation, spread happiness and imbibe every individual with wellness for life. These three mantras have been the pillars of strength for the Company since it was founded by Mrs. Vandana Luthra in 1989. Till date they remain the firm foundation upon which the company continues to build its success story.

By redefining wellness, VLCC has revolutionized the wellness industry to acquire the status of being the Number 1 Wellness Brand in South Asia & Middle East, with a presence of 300 locations across 109 cities in 10 countries namely India, UAE, Oman, Bahrain, Qatar, Kuwait, Sri Lanka, Bangladesh, Malaysia and Nepal.

VLCC is widely recognized for its scientific weight loss solutions and its therapeutic approach to beauty treatments. With a staff strength of nearly 6000, over two-third of whom are experienced specialists including medical doctors, nutritionists, psychologists, cosmetologists and physiotherapists and having served over 10 million customers since its inception, VLCC is the largest and most-preferred brand in the Wellness domain in the countries it operates in.
CompanyAddress: Second Floor, SF 201-217 Magnum City Centre, GOLF COURSE EXTENSION SECTOR 63A, GURGAON, Haryana, India

Proficiency in MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and training software/tools.
Ability to communicate in local/regional languages is an advantage.

Teamwork and attention to detail

Description:
Job Details

Designation - Store Manager
Function - D2C
Level/Grade- Assistant Manager

Position Description

The purpose of this role is to manage the Airtel store and ensure successful running of its operations. Additionally, the role requires maintaining compliance with agreed guidelines in order to deliver best in class experience and managing store revenue & cost targets.




Regional Head (~ Zonal Own Retail Manager)
Total number of employees supervised by you DIRECTLY or INDIRECTLY
Managerial Individual Contributors
Directly
Indirectly




Manage & ensure the operations are in line with pre-defined SOPs with the look and feel of the store as per guidelines / standards.
Control inventory levels, conduct regular stock checks, and coordinate with the supply chain for optimal product availability.
Oversee visual merchandising efforts, ensuring that product displays and store layouts are appealing and on-brand.
Effectively track transactions and budgets for store operations, ensuring cost-effectiveness and financial targets are met.
Implement security measures and loss prevention strategies to safeguard inventory and assets.
Accountable for clearing store for formal launches across dimensions and during refit & conversion.

Implement processes to enhance the overall customer experience, customer satisfaction, and issue resolution.
Ensure an outstanding in-store customer experience, including product knowledge, assistance, and issue resolution, fostering customer loyalty.
Implement KPIs to monitor and evaluate the success of store operations, providing regular reports to senior management.

Lead retail staff, providing guidance, coaching, and performance feedback to ensure a high level of customer service and sales effectiveness.
Anchor trainings as required for team member development on product knowledge, sales techniques, and best practices.
Collaborate with central functions such as marketing, finance, and HR to ensure alignment with broader company policies and to maintain integration of in-store & online operations.




Internal / External Stakeholders
(Internal means External to the department and internal to the organization; External means External to the organization)
Internal Zonal / Area Sales Managers & Field Sales Executives
External Channel Partners



Technical Competencies
Proficiency in retail operations and S&M techniques
Basic knowledge of MS Office: Excel, PowerPoint, Word & Outlook
Leadership and Behavioural Competencies
Process Orientation
Influencing Personality
Communication Skills (oral/written)
Interpersonal Skills
Teamwork and Collaboration

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Oversees the administrative, clinical, and logistical operations of the surgical suites to ensure safe, efficient, and high-quality patient care.
Operational & Surgical Scheduling: Manage daily surgical timetables, emergency case prioritization, and theatre resource/table allocations.
Staff Leadership & Supervision: Lead, mentor, and schedule multidisciplinary medical and non-medical staff, including nurses, OT technicians, and support personnel.
Infection Control & Safety: Enforce strict sterile field protocols, biomedical waste disposal guidelines, fumigation schedules, and occupational health and safety policies.
Equipment & Inventory Management: Oversee the availability, maintenance, and calibration of high-end surgical and anesthesia equipment (such as ventilators, monitors, and C-arm machines), alongside surgical consumables and diagnostic supplies.
Performance & Flow Optimization: Track key performance indicators (KPIs) such as OT utilization rates, room turnaround times, case delays, and cancellations.
Interdepartmental Coordination: Act as a central liaison between surgeons, anesthesiologists, central sterile supply departments (CSSD), and hospital administration.
Budgeting & Compliance: Help manage department budgets, resource allocation, and accreditation compliance standards required by medical college and health authorities.
Academic & Research Support: Support teaching, training, and clinical observerships for medical, nursing, and paramedical students rotating through the college's operation theatre complex

Job Specifications & Requirements
Qualifications:
Bachelors or Master’s degree in Nursing (B.Sc./M.Sc. Nursing), Healthcare Management, or an equivalent health executive qualification (such as an IBODE or certified theatre specialization).
Experience:
Typically 5 to 10 years of clinical nursing or technical experience in an operating theatre environment, with at least 2 to 5 years in a supervisory or management role.
Key Skills:
Strong crisis management and decision-making abilities under high-pressure clinical conditions.
Deep knowledge of surgical workflows, sterilization standards, and biomedical waste protocols.
Excellent communication, team-building, and digital dashboard reporting skills.

Description:
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority .

A Builder- Car Advisor (Sales Associate) at Cars24 assists customers in buying and selling vehicles by providing expert guidance, evaluating car conditions, and ensuring a smooth and transparent transaction process.

What will you drive?
Customer Interaction: Greet and engage with customers, understanding their needs and preferences to recommend suitable pre-owned vehicles.
Sales Process: Manage the entire sales process from initial contact to closing the sale, ensuring a seamless and positive experience for customers.
Product Knowledge: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of the pre-owned car inventory, including features, pricing, and competitive comparisons.
Test Drives: Arrange and accompany customers on test drives, providing detailed explanations and answering any questions they may have.
Finance: Pitching Customer financing options, ensuring fair deals.
Documentation: Assist customers with the completion of sales contracts, financing applications, and other required documentation.
Follow-Up: Conduct follow-up calls with potential and previous customers to maintain relationships and encourage repeat business.
Customer Service: Address any customer concerns or issues promptly and professionally, striving to resolve them to the customer's satisfaction.
Team Collaboration: Work closely with the sales team and other departments to ensure a coordinated and efficient sales process.

Who are we looking for?
Proven experience in automotive sales or a similar customer-facing role.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong negotiation and closing skills.
Ability to build rapport and trust with customers.
In-depth knowledge of pre-owned cars and the automotive market.
Valid driver's license and a clean driving record.

Why Join Us?
Drive key business initiatives and growth.
Work in a fast-paced, innovative environment.
Competitive compensation and career.

Sales Officer

Department: Sales

Work Location: Patna

Grade: O1/O2

Travel Required: Yes

Reporting to:

Administrative: ASM

Reported by: None

Functional:

Minimum Job Requirements

Educational Qualification: Any Graduation

Experience:

3-5 yrs. in sales with exposure to Retail Sales and Distribution management in Footwear, FMCG or FMCD industry.

Any additional requirement:

Purpose of the Position
(Job Summary)
To drive secondary sales and act as interface between distributor and retailers and increase market share for our product at end user
Key Roles and Responsibilities
Financial

Sharing the in-demand not-in-stock details with the ASM and assisting ASM in planning for primary based on demand capture of focus NPDs and focus articles
Management and timely resolution of the claims received by the company from the trade partners
Customer Oriented

Assisting distributor to liquidate stock of low demand articles/sizes and following up with distributor to ensure retailer demand fulfillment and helping distributor resolve outlet service gaps
Sharing distributors market service feedback with ASM
Resolving retailer complaints by investigating problems, developing solutions, preparing reports and making recommendations to ASM.
People Oriented

Seeking ASMs counsel for resolving retailer/distributor complaints
Internal Business Process

Identifying existing outlets not serviced by distributors and capturing new outlets added. Ensuring distributor coverage at these outlets
Sharing information with ASM on prospective distributors, competitor information like Trade promotions, NPDs, engagement programs and reporting of market working
Checking product availability & range and ensuring product visibility & merchandising utilization at Retail outlets
Ensuring demand creation through product sampling for NPDs / Focus Articles and sharing the demand information with distributors and ASMs
Ensuring retailer awareness on company products and trade promotions through market visits, catalogues / leaflets etc.
Driving distributor to purchase articles with market demand and enhancing range selling

Technical/Functional

Behavioral
Selling skills
Analytical skills

Customer Orientation
Interpersonal skills

Quantitative

Qualitative
% Revenue Contribution from NPDs in defined sales area
Increase in Range Billing in defined sales area
Incremental retail coverage
Increase in % Demand Fulfillment of NPD / Focus Articles
PJP adherence
Timely Submission of Market Working reports

Adherence to Market Working Norms
Market intelligence & Relationship building
Key Stakeholder Management
Internal

External
ASM
MIS Admin team

Description:
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart SalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Storeupkeep& maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority

Description:
About the Role
The role of an Optometrist at Lenskart is different from competing brands and is not limited to only eye check-ups but also includes sales as a critical deliverable. He/she plays a key role in delivering technical expertise through eye-checks, dispensing, and diagnosis as well as selling products, executing stocktakes and SOPs to deliver an exceptional customer experience.

Responsibilities
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Following the 12-step Optometry process at Lenskart, during the eye check-up
Sharing the prescription clearly and educating the customer about single vision and progressive lens while recommending the appropriate lens and/or frames
Performing a quality check of the lenses fitted before handing over the product to the customer
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences
Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: Diploma/ Bachelors in Optometry
Freshers are eligible to apply- no minimum work experience required
Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions
Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation
Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority .

SUMMARY
Job Title: Blue Collar Recruiter
Job Industry: Recruitment / Staffing
Job Locations: Gorakhpur, Patna, Murshidabad, Jaipur, Bhubaneswar, Delhi & Kolkata
Job Summary
We are looking for target-oriented Blue Collar Recruiters to source and recruit skilled and semi-skilled workers for domestic and international projects, especially in the construction sector.
Key Responsibilities
Source candidates such as Masons, Electricians, Welders, Plumbers, Carpenters, Fabricators, Drivers, and other blue-collar workers.
Source candidates through ITIs, contractors, vendors, referrals, field visits, and local networks.
Screen candidates and verify their skills, experience, licences, and documents, as applicable.
Coordinate interviews, trade tests, recruitment drives, and candidate mobilization.
Build a strong candidate pipeline and maintain regular follow-ups.
Achieve recruitment targets and maintain candidate records.

Requirements
Minimum 2 to 5 years of experience in Gulf recruitment, primarily in blue-collar, construction, driver, or field recruitment verticals.
Good understanding of skilled and semi-skilled manpower sourcing.
Strong networking, communication, and coordination skills.
Only Male candidates may apply.
Existing contacts with contractors, ITIs, vendors, or manpower suppliers will be an advantage.
Target-oriented approach and willingness to travel locally for recruitment activities.

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique - with food and drinks on the side.
Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal.
Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G. E. D. equivalent.
Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.
Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

Job Summary
As a Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role is to assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basics of store operations. Your key responsibilities include:
Responsibilities

Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.
Assist with Cashiering: When needed, help with basic cashier duties to provide smooth service.
On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.
Qualifications
Essential: Minimum 12th Pass
Preferred: Any Graduate

Description:
Title Sales Associate
Reporting to Store Manager
Skip Level Areas Operations Manager
About the Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Sales Associate
Customer focus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up
Being involved in stocktakes, maintaining sales floor standards, and other day-to-day tasks to deliver the best shopping experience to the customers
Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively
Being dedicated to customer satisfaction and resolving any concerns that the customer has
Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achieving sales Vs. Plan & SOP adherence
Achieving the assigned target for sales, eye-test conversion, returns; and following all SOPs
Post making the sale, coordinating with the customer for product pick-up, after receiving due communication from the warehouse. In case of returns, he/she is expected to understand the reason and try to resolve the same to control the return percentage.
Store upkeep & maintenance
Maintaining the store as per Lenskart standards, cleaning the frames and other equipment regularly, and ensuring there is no deviation as per the SOP
Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personal attributes & competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile

Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
SUMMARY
Title: Business Development Executive Field sales apprentice role
Location: Patiala / Patran / Jagraun / Ajnala / Batala / Moga / Bathinda
Job Type: Full-Time apprentice role for 12 months
Industry: Beauty & Cosmetics / Retail / FMCG

Summary:
We are seeking a motivated Business Development Executive to drive growth for a leading online cosmetic and beauty products retailer across Uttar Pradesh. This role is centred on expanding our retail footprint by building strong relationships with distributors, retailers, and vendors within the assigned territory. The ideal candidate will be proactive in lead generation, product promotion, and sales execution, ensuring consistent visibility and performance of our offerings in key retail locations. The position is retail store-based with regular field visits, offering a dynamic opportunity to contribute directly to business expansion in a fast-paced FMCG environment.

Responsibilities:
Identify and develop new leads through systematic market visits, provided data, and personal referrals
Engage with distributors, retailers, and vendors to present product portfolios and drive sales
Conduct in-store product sampling and promotional activities to enhance customer engagement
Execute targeted product launch initiatives and ensure timely deal closures
Support retail partners with business development strategies and on-ground execution
Monitor, analyse, and report monthly sales performance, campaign outcomes, and key market insights

Requirements
Graduate in any discipline (from 2021 to 2025 pass-out)
Freshers are encouraged to apply
Up to 11 months of sales or field experience is acceptable
Must be a local resident of the assigned location (within 10 km of the retail store)
Personal two-wheeler (bike preferred) is mandatory with valid driving license
Prior knowledge or experience in the beauty/cosmetics or FMCG sector is preferred
Male candidates are preferred for this role

Work Details:
Work Schedule: 6 days a week
Weekly Off: Sunday
Work Type: Retail store-based with regular local market visits


Benefits
Fixed salary:  11,500 from Nykaa + 4500 from Govt (16000 inhand)
Daily TA/DA: 200
Attractive performance-based incentives

KeyDeliverables (Essentialfunctions Responsibilities of the Job) :

Asa Customer Service Associate at Marks and Spencer, your main role isto assist customers, maintain store standards, and learn the basicsof store operations. Your key responsibilities include:

1.Customer Service:
Greet Assist Customers: Welcome customers with a friendly attitude and help them find what they need.
Understand Customer Needs: Listen to customers, understand their preferences, and recommend suitable products.

2.Store Standards:
Support Visual Merchandising: Help maintain the stores appearance by following guidelines for product displays.
Proper Product Handling: Ensure products are handled carefully and organized correctly on the shelves.

3.Basic Operations:
Learn Store Procedures: Follow company guidelines for tasks like stocking, housekeeping, and cashiering.
Assist with Cashiering: When needed, help with basic cashier duties to provide smooth service.

4.Growth Learning:
On-the-Job Training: Take part in training sessions to improve your skills and grow within the role.

Description:
Lead - Business Development
About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.
Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.
Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, FTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.

Description:
A2. Job Purpose
Buy raw materials (base oil, additives) and packaging materials on time. Buy at the right price and in the right quantity. Make sure production never stops for want of material. Make sure domestic and export dispatches are not delayed. Avoid extra stock that blocks money. Keep all purchase records correct and complete.


A3. Main Responsibilities

A3.1 Purchase Orders
Receive material requirements (indents) from production, stores and quality.
Check the requirement is approved before buying.
Send enquiries to suppliers.
Take at least 3 quotations.
Prepare a comparison of quotations (price, freight, tax, credit days).
Make purchase orders (PO) in Tally / ERP.
Get the PO approved by the Purchase Manager.
Send the PO to the supplier.
Get written confirmation of quantity, rate and delivery date.
Change or close POs when needed, with approval.


A3.2 Follow-up and Delivery
Keep a list of all pending orders.
Follow up with suppliers every day.
Confirm vehicle number and driver phone number in advance.
Confirm expected arrival date and time.
Coordinate base oil tanker deliveries.
Coordinate packaging material truck deliveries.
Plan deliveries as per the production plan.
Check storage space before material arrives.
Inform the Purchase Manager early about any delay.
Handle urgent purchases with proper approval.


A3.3 Stock Control
Check stock of all materials regularly.
Order before stock reaches the reorder level.
Check stock plus pending orders before ordering again.
Calculate how many days the stock will last.
Keep supplier minimum order quantity (MOQ) in mind.
Report slow-moving and unused materials.
Report materials near expiry.
Help in monthly physical stock count.


A3.4 Import Support
Follow up with overseas suppliers for proforma invoice.
Request advance / LC payment through accounts.
Collect shipping documents (invoice, packing list, bill of lading, COA, MSDS).
Coordinate with customs agent (CHA) for clearance.
Track shipment arrival date.
Keep an import shipment list updated.


A3.5 Export Support
Get export order details from the export team.
Arrange export labels and cartons.
Arrange pallets (fumigated where needed).
Arrange shrink wrap and other export packing.
Make sure all material reaches before the loading date.


A3.6 Material Receipt and Quality
Check invoice and e-way bill with every delivery.
Check test certificate (COA) with every oil / chemical delivery.
Match received material with the PO.
Inform quality team for testing.
Do not allow use of material before quality approval.
Inform supplier in writing about shortage or rejection.
Arrange return or replacement of rejected material.
Raise debit notes through accounts.


A3.7 Bills and Payments
Match PO, material receipt (GRN) and supplier bill.
Sort out rate or quantity differences with supplier.
Check GST number and GST details on bills.
Check e-way bill details.
Give accounts a weekly list of payments due.
Mark MSME suppliers for payment within 45 days.
Track advances paid to suppliers.


A3.8 Suppliers
Collect documents from new suppliers (GST, PAN, bank, MSME).
Create new suppliers in Tally / ERP.
Keep supplier phone, email and contact person updated.
Keep supplier lead time and MOQ updated.
Find new suppliers for important materials.
Keep record of supplier delivery and quality performance.


A3.9 Reports
Daily report of pending orders and deliveries.
Weekly report of late deliveries.
Monthly report of purchases by material and supplier.
Monthly report of price changes.
Report of slow-moving stock.
Check all figures and units before sending.


A3.10 Records and Ethics
Keep a complete file for every purchase.
Keep files ready for audit.
Keep supplier prices confidential.
Do not accept gifts or favours from suppliers.
Follow company purchase rules.


A3.11 General & Sales Coordination
Coordinate with the sales team on customer order requirements and dispatch dates.
Share material availability status with sales before order confirmation.
Arrange packing material for urgent and special customer orders.
Coordinate with production, stores, dispatch and accounts for smooth order execution.
Handle general coordination work assigned by the Purchase Manager / management.
Attend internal meetings and follow up on action points.


A3.12 Reports Generation from Software
Generate purchase, stock and pending-order reports from Tally / ERP.
Export data from software to Excel and prepare summaries.
Prepare supplier-wise and material-wise purchase reports.
Prepare stock ageing and reorder-level reports.
Check software data against physical records and correct errors.
Share MIS reports with management on time.


A4. Daily / Weekly / Monthly Work
Daily
Check pending orders and follow up.
Check deliveries due today.
Check stock of important materials.
Update order tracker.
Weekly
Review stock against reorder levels.
Send payment-due list to accounts.
Report late deliveries.
Monthly
Monthly purchase report.
Slow-moving stock report.
Help in physical stock count.
Close completed purchase orders.

Description:
Job Title:Shift Incharge Electrical
Department: Electrical Maintenance
Location: Rajpura
Reporting To: Section Head Electrical
Grade: Assistant Manager / Deputy Manager
JobPurpose
To ensureuninterrupted operation of downstream steel manufacturing lines by effectivelymanaging electrical maintenance activities during the shift, minimizingequipment downtime, ensuring safety compliance, and leading the shiftelectrical team to achieve production and maintenance objectives.
KeyResponsibilities
1.Shift Operations
Ensure smooth operation of all electrical systems during the assigned shift.
Attend electrical breakdowns promptly and restore equipment within targeted downtime.
Coordinate with Production, Mechanical, Instrumentation, and Utility teams for seamless plant operations.
Ensure proper shift handover and maintain detailed shift logs.
2.Preventive Predictive Maintenance
Execute preventive and predictive maintenance schedules for all electrical equipment.
Monitor the health of motors, drives, transformers, switchgear, MCCs, PCCs, UPS, DG sets, and electrical panels.
Ensure timely inspection, testing, and maintenance of critical electrical assets.
3.Breakdown Maintenance
Analyze root causes of electrical failures and implement corrective actions.
Troubleshoot PLC, VFD, servo drives, sensors, HMI, and field electrical equipment.
Minimize downtime through effective troubleshooting and resource management.
4.Safety Compliance
Ensure compliance with electrical safety standards, statutory regulations, and company safety procedures.
Implement Lockout-Tagout (LOTO), Permit-to-Work (PTW), and electrical isolation procedures.
Conduct safety toolbox talks and ensure the use of appropriate PPE.
Participate in safety audits and incident investigations.
5.Team Management
Supervise shift electricians and contract manpower.
Allocate work, monitor execution, and ensure adherence to maintenance standards.
Provide on-the-job training and technical guidance to team members.
Evaluate contractor performance and ensure work quality.
6.Reliability Improvement
Identify recurring equipment failures and implement reliability improvement initiatives.
Participate in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Kaizen, TPM, and continuous improvement projects.
Recommend equipment modifications to improve reliability and energy efficiency.
7.Documentation Reporting
Maintain maintenance records, equipment history, breakdown reports, and shift reports.
Update maintenance activities in SAP/CMMS.
Monitor spare parts consumption and raise material requisitions.
8.Energy Management
Monitor electrical power consumption and recommend energy-saving initiatives.
Ensure efficient utilization of electrical resources.
KeyEquipment Exposure
HT/LT Distribution Systems
Transformers
VFDs and Soft Starters
AC/DC Motors
MCC PCC Panels
PLC Systems (Siemens / ABB / Rockwell / Mitsubishi)
HMI SCADA
Industrial Sensors and Instrument Interfaces
UPS and Battery Banks
DG Sets
Cranes and Material Handling Equipment
Galvanizing, Color Coating, Pickling, Slitting, and CTL Line Electrical Systems
EducationalQualification
B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering
Diploma in Electrical Engineering (with relevant experience may also be considered)
Experience
510 years of experience in electrical maintenance in a steel manufacturing or continuous process industry.
Minimum 23 years of experience in a shift handling role in a downstream steel plant is preferred.
TechnicalCompetencies
Electrical troubleshooting and fault diagnosis
PLC and VFD knowledge
HT/LT maintenance
Electrical drawings and schematics
Preventive and predictive maintenance
SAP/CMMS knowledge
Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
TPM, 5S, Kaizen
LOTO and PTW systems
BehavioralCompetencies
Leadership and team management
Decision-making under pressure
Problem-solving and analytical skills
Communication and coordination
Planning and execution
Safety consciousness
Continuous improvement mindset
KeyPerformance Indicators (KPIs)
Electrical equipment availability (%)
Breakdown frequency and MTTR
Preventive maintenance compliance
Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)
Safety compliance and zero electrical incidents
Energy consumption reduction
Maintenance cost control
Shift-wise equipment uptime
Spare parts optimization
Implementation of reliability improvement initiatives
ThisJD is suitable for downstream steel facilities such as Cold Rolling Mill(CRM), Continuous Galvanizing Line (CGL), Color Coating Line (CCL), PicklingLine, Slitting Line, and Cut-to-Length (CTL) operations .

Description:
Our jobs aren t just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed.
Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique.
Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel.
They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done.
Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.
No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success - ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional.
Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance).
Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts - to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.
At Marriott International, we are dedicated to being an equal opportunity employer, welcoming all and providing access to opportunity.
We actively foster an environment where the unique backgrounds of our associates are valued and celebrated.
Our greatest strength lies in the rich blend of culture, talent, and experiences of our associates.

Description:
About us
We are a distinguished executive search firm, recognized for our ability to deliver strategic leadership talent to organizations across industries. Our consultative approach, market intelligence, and commitment to excellence enable us to serve as trusted advisors to clients navigating complex talent landscapes.

Role Summary
The Manager will oversee multiple teams within the executive search function, ensuring operational excellence, client satisfaction, and revenue growth. This role requires a seasoned professional with strong leadership capabilities, business acumen, and a proven track record in executive recruitment.
Key Responsibilities
Lead and manage Team Leaders and their respective recruitment teams.
Drive execution of senior-level search mandates with precision and confidentiality.
Develop and nurture long-term client relationships, positioning the firm as a strategic partner.
Establish performance metrics, monitor delivery, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Contribute to organizational growth through business development and market expansion.
Provide strategic insights on talent trends and industry developments to clients and internal stakeholders.

Candidate Profile
Minimum 6 years of experience in executive search, recruitment consulting, or talent advisory.
Demonstrated success in managing teams and delivering leadership mandates.
Strong client engagement and relationship management skills.
Exceptional communication, negotiation, and analytical abilities.
Postgraduate qualification in HR, Business Management, or related discipline preferred.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation package.
Performance-based incentives and leadership growth opportunities.
Exposure to marquee clients and strategic leadership assignments.
A collaborative, high-performance culture with emphasis on professional excellence.

Location: Ludhiana

Position Summary: To ensure enhancement of visual representation of each Puma store by continuously updating the look and feel of the space.

Fostering VM creativity to front end through VM trainings, Competitions & Store Audits

Net Sales
Stock Cover
Maintaining Vendor Base

Internal: Visual Merchandising Team , Sales Ops Team, Merchandising Team and Project Team
External: Execution partners for hangers, Execution partners for mannequins, Execution partners for branded supplies and Execution partners for print media

Bachelors/Masters degree in Fashion Communication / Fashion /Accessories/ Textile Design
Work experience as a Visual Merchandiser including design/ execution
Demonstrable visual design skills with a strong retail merchandising portfolio
Proficiency in Microsoft presentation & excel, Photoshop, Illustrator and other visual design tools
Well versed with best practices of VM in Global industry
Excelling Photography skill
Creative and innovative thinker
Acing Number game- analyzing and tracking of the executions done
A proficient communicator.

Description:
About Us

We are a premier executive search organization, trusted by leading corporations to identify and attract senior-level talent. Our commitment to excellence, discretion, and strategic insight has positioned us as a partner of choice for organizations seeking leadership solutions.

Role Summary

The Team Leader will be responsible for managing a high-performing recruitment team, ensuring delivery of executive mandates, and strengthening client partnerships. This role requires a blend of leadership acumen, operational discipline, and deep understanding of executive search methodologies.

Key Responsibilities
Provide strategic direction and operational oversight to the recruitment team.
Drive execution of executive search assignments with precision and timeliness.
Cultivate and sustain long-term client relationships through consultative engagement.
Monitor team performance against KPIs and implement continuous improvement initiatives.
Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities for growth and expansion.

Candidate Profile
Minimum 3 years of experience in executive search, recruitment, or talent advisory.
Demonstrated ability to lead and develop teams in a professional services environment.
Strong client management and stakeholder engagement skills.
Excellent communication, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities.
Postgraduate qualification in HR, Business, or related discipline preferred.

What We Offer
Competitive compensation aligned with industry standards (upto 4.5 LPA).
Performance-linked incentives and career advancement opportunities.
Exposure to marquee clients and senior leadership mandates.
A collaborative, growth-oriented organizational culture.

To apply / Schedule your interview, Kindly contact Gurpreet Kaur, +91 98770 91683 or share your updated resume at gurpreet.kaur@lavyaassociates.com
