Description:
The Asian International University is looking for Estate Manager to join our dynamic team and embark on a rewarding career journey.An Estate Manager, also known as a Property Manager or Estate Supervisor, is responsible for overseeing and managing various aspects of a property or estate, ensuring its efficient operation and maintenance. Estate Managers can work in residential, commercial, or institutional settings, and their duties may vary based on the size and nature of the estate they are managing.

Key Responsibilities:

Property Maintenance:

Supervise and coordinate maintenance and repair tasks.
Ensure the property is clean, well-maintained, and aesthetically pleasing.
Manage landscaping, gardening, and outdoor maintenance activities.
Regularly inspect the property to identify maintenance needs and address them promptly.
Financial Management:

Prepare and manage budgets for property operations and maintenance.
Monitor expenses, approve invoices, and reconcile financial records.
Negotiate contracts with vendors and service providers to ensure cost-effective services.
Security and Safety:

Implement and oversee security measures to safeguard the property and its occupants.
Coordinate with security personnel and install security systems as necessary.
Develop and enforce safety protocols and emergency procedures.
Tenant and Guest Relations:

Interact with tenants, guests, and residents in a professional and courteous manner.
Address tenant concerns, complaints, and requests promptly and effectively.
Conduct regular tenant meetings and ensure a high level of tenant satisfaction.
Staff Management:

Recruit, train, and supervise estate staff, such as maintenance workers, security personnel, and housekeeping staff.
Delegate tasks and responsibilities to staff members.
Conduct performance evaluations and provide feedback to employees.
Administrative Tasks:

Maintain accurate records of property-related activities, contracts, and expenses.
Prepare regular reports for property owners or management.
Handle administrative tasks such as scheduling, correspondence, and document management.
Compliance and Regulations:

Ensure the property complies with local, state, and federal regulations and codes.
Stay updated on relevant laws and regulations affecting property management.
Obtain necessary licenses and permits for the property's operation.
Project Management:

Oversee renovation, remodeling, and construction projects on the property.
Coordinate with contractors, architects, and designers to ensure projects are completed on time and within budget.
Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Business, Property Management, Hospitality, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
Previous experience in property management, estate management, or a related field is highly desirable.
Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills.
Knowledge of property management software and basic financial principles.
Ability to multitask, prioritize tasks, and work efficiently in a fast-paced environment.
Leadership skills and the ability to motivate and manage a team effectively.

Description:
We are currently hiring for Sales Specialist for our Apple Retail Stores in India.


Do you love how it feels to encourage others? As a Part-Time Specialist, you help create the energy and excitement around Apple products, providing the right solutions and getting products into customers hands. You understand that the Apple Store is dedicated to delivering a customer experience thats unlike any other. It starts with you discovering customers needs. And with the support of your store team members, you match those needs with the right products. Every day is an opportunity for you to turn another Apple Store visitor into a loyal Apple customer.


Role & responsibilities

Deliver excellent service to Apple customers by seeking to understand their needs, identifying ownership opportunities, presenting products and services, and educating customers on relevant ways to buy products.
Understand and proactively stay up to date on Apples products, services, purchase options and Product Zone sales processes.
Support your peers throughout the store as needed by sharing knowledge about Apples products, services and purchase options, and assist in offering ownership opportunities. Maintain accuracy and follow guidance.
Perform other tasks as needed, including but not limited to providing customer service and support in other areas of the store.
Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each others differences and having the curiosity to learn.
Demonstrate Apples values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

Demonstrate knowledge of Apple products and services.
Personalise solutions based on customer needs, and effectively communicate them.
Work in a fast-paced environment, often supporting multiple customers at the same time.
Work in a team environment, demonstrating shared responsibility and accountability with other team members.
Be curious and open to learning from others and helping each other grow.
Learn about and deepen your understanding of Apple products and services, and third-party products, to enhance the customer experience.
Be trusted with sensitive or confidential information, keeping with Apples core values.
You should have availability to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.

Active Workday Financials certification.

Demonstrates critical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Description:
We are seeking a skilled SAP ABAP Developer to design, develop, test, and support SAP applications and custom developments. The candidate should have strong expertise in ABAP programming, SAP data dictionary, reports, interfaces, enhancements, forms, and performance optimization.
Key Responsibilities
Develop and maintain SAP ABAP programs, reports, interfaces, conversions, enhancements, forms, and workflows.
Design and develop:
Reports (Classical, Interactive, ALV)
BDC Programs
Smart Forms / SAP Scripts / Adobe Forms
User Exits, Customer Exits, BAdIs, Enhancement Framework
RFC, BAPI, IDoc, ALE Interfaces
Perform debugging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
Create technical specifications based on functional requirements.
Work closely with functional consultants and business stakeholders.
Support SAP implementation, rollout, upgrade, and enhancement projects.
Ensure compliance with development standards and best practices.
Participate in code reviews and unit testing activities.
Required Skills
Strong experience in SAP ABAP development.
Expertise in:
Data Dictionary (Tables, Structures, Views, Lock Objects)
Reports and ALV Programming
Smart Forms, SAP Scripts, Adobe Forms
Enhancements (User Exits, BAdIs, Enhancement Points)
BAPI, RFC, IDoc, ALE
Module Pool Programming
ABAP Object-Oriented Programming (OOABAP)
Performance Tuning and Debugging
Knowledge of SAP functional modules such as MM, SD, FICO, PP, or HCM.
Experience with SAP HANA and ABAP on HANA is preferred.

Property Relationship Manager (Property RM) Inside Sales
Company: NoBroker Technologies Solutions Pvt. Ltd.
Job Type: Full-time
Location: Bangalore
Work Mode: Work From Office (WFO)
Working Days: 6 Days a Week
Industry: Real Estate
Job Summary
We are looking for a customer-focused and target-oriented Property RM to join our Inside Sales team.
The Property RM will handle customers who have already enrolled in a plan through the Supply RM team. You will understand their property requirements, suggest suitable properties, manage follow-ups, and drive customers towards successful property transactions.
Roles & Responsibilities
Connect with customers who have already enrolled in a NoBroker plan.
Understand customer requirements such as location, budget, property type, preferences, and timelines.
Suggest suitable properties based on customer requirements.
Explain property details, features, pricing, and other relevant information.
Build strong relationships with customers throughout their property search.
Handle customer queries, concerns, and objections.
Conduct regular follow-ups and keep customers engaged.
Coordinate with internal teams to provide suitable property options.
Encourage customers to proceed with property visits and further transaction stages.
Negotiate with customers and work towards successful deal closures.
Take ownership of the customer journey from lead allocation to closure.
Update customer and sales information accurately in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales and conversion targets.
Eligibility & Requirements
Any Graduate / Post Graduate preferred.
Experience in Inside Sales, Real Estate, Property Sales, B2C Sales, or Telesales is preferred.
Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong customer-handling and relationship-management skills.
Good negotiation, persuasion, objection-handling, and closing skills.
Strong follow-up and lead-management abilities.
Comfortable working in a target-driven environment.
Familiarity with CRM and sales processes.
Self-motivated, persistent, and result-oriented.
Languages
English + Hindi + Regional Language

Title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Intelligence Developer
Skills: Salesforce Marketing Cloud | AMPscript | CloudPages | SQL | SSJS | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Journey Builder | Automation Studio | Content Builder | Contact Builder | Data Extensions | REST API | SOAP API | Marketing Cloud Connect
Description:
Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, or Hyderabad.
Word Mode: 2 Days weekly WFO
Interview: 3 rounds virtual.
Notice: Immediate
Code: 108260-42
Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Sr. Developer
We are seeking an experienced Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC) Developer with strong hands-on expertise in AMPscript, CloudPages, SQL, Journey Builder, and Automation Studio.
The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, testing, and supporting personalized marketing communications, landing pages, data-driven campaigns, and automated customer journeys within Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This role requires strong technical development skills as well as the ability to translate business and marketing requirements into scalable SFMC solutions.
Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and deploy solutions within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Develop personalized and dynamic email content using AMPscript.
Build and maintain CloudPages, landing pages, microsites, forms, preference centers, and subscription-management pages.
Develop server-side functionality on CloudPages using AMPscript and Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) where applicable.
Create dynamic forms and landing pages that read from and write data to Data Extensions.
Implement form submission, validation, data capture, confirmation pages, and error-handling logic.
Develop secure and personalized CloudPages using URL parameters, encrypted query strings, subscriber attributes, and Data Extension lookups.
Build reusable AMPscript components for personalization, conditional content, data retrieval, data updates, and campaign logic.
Develop complex SQL queries for audience segmentation, campaign targeting, reporting, and data transformation.
Design and manage Data Extensions, subscriber data, Contact Builder relationships, and SFMC data architecture.
Develop and maintain automated processes using Automation Studio, including SQL Query Activities, imports, extracts, file transfers, and scheduled workflows.
Build and support customer journeys using Journey Builder, including entry events, decision splits, personalization, triggered communications, and journey data.
Develop responsive HTML email templates and landing pages using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Integrate Salesforce Marketing Cloud with Salesforce CRM and other enterprise platforms using Marketing Cloud Connect, REST APIs, SOAP APIs, SFTP, and other integration mechanisms.
Troubleshoot AMPscript, CloudPages, automations, journeys, email rendering, and data-related issues.
Perform unit testing, code reviews, deployment validation, and production support.
Develop reusable technical components and follow development standards for security, maintainability, performance, and scalability.
Maintain technical documentation for CloudPages, data models, APIs, automations, journeys, and integrations.
Work closely with marketing, business, technology, and data teams to translate requirements into technical solutions.
Required Qualifications
Strong hands-on experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud (SFMC).
Strong proficiency in AMPscript, including:
Personalization
Conditional logic
Lookup functions
Data Extension reads and updates
Subscriber and contact attributes
String, date, and formatting functions
Redirects and URL handling
Error handling
Dynamic content
Strong hands-on experience developing CloudPages.
Experience developing:
Landing pages
Lead capture forms
Registration forms
Preference centers
Unsubscribe pages
Confirmation and thank-you pages
Dynamic personalized pages
Experience using AMPscript functions such as Lookup, LookupRows, RetrieveSalesforceObjects, UpsertData, InsertData, UpdateData, RequestParameter, Redirect, CloudPagesURL, and related functions.
Strong SQL skills for segmentation, data transformation, and audience management.
Hands-on experience with:
Content Builder
Email Studio
Journey Builder
Automation Studio
Contact Builder
Data Extensions
Experience with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.
Understanding of responsive email and web development.
Experience integrating SFMC with external systems using REST and/or SOAP APIs.
Experience with SFTP-based file integrations and automated data processing.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and analytical skills.
Understanding of Salesforce Marketing Cloud subscriber, contact, and consent-management concepts.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS) within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
Experience with CloudPages security and secure data handling.
Experience implementing encrypted and personalized URLs using CloudPagesURL.
Experience working with Salesforce CRM through Marketing Cloud Connect.
Familiarity with JSON and API-based integrations.
Experience building custom preference centers and consent-management solutions.
Knowledge of email deliverability and subscriber-management best practices.
Understanding of CAN-SPAM, GDPR, CCPA, and related data-privacy requirements.
Experience with enterprise-scale Salesforce Marketing Cloud implementations.
Salesforce Marketing Cloud certifications are preferred.
Experience
8+ years of Salesforce Marketing Cloud development experience preferred.
6+ years of hands-on AMPscript development experience.
Demonstrated experience designing and developing CloudPages and custom landing-page solutions.
Experience supporting production marketing campaigns, automated journeys, and enterprise-scale customer communications.
Key Skills
Salesforce Marketing Cloud | AMPscript | CloudPages | SQL | SSJS | HTML | CSS | JavaScript | Journey Builder | Automation Studio | Content Builder | Contact Builder | Data Extensions | REST API | SOAP API | Marketing Cloud Connect

You will be responsible for designing, implementing, and delivering digital marketing programs to kickstart the sale of our products and drive the rapid expansion and growth in the market. You will identify new and exciting opportunities and establish brand awareness. Responsibilities
Comprehend categories, products, customers and business goals
Know the persona of customers and understand their needs
Research products and competitors to identify opportunities
Establish a digital marketing strategy across various engagement channels both online and offline and develop a marketing calendar
Identify syndication schedules for editorial calendars for blogs, content, and social media posts
Develop effective paid search strategies to gain market share
Plan, design, launch and optimize various PPC campaigns
Perform keyword research and audience targeting in support with management
Work with web developers and designers to manage integrations and tooling for PPC, social media, etc.
Monitor advertisement budgets and oversee search platform accounts
Track KPIs, analyze web traffic metrics, and provide recommendations and useful reports for management
Maintain partnerships with PPC ad platforms and vendors
Identify click frauds and eliminate it
Ensure the highest possible ROI on ad-spend
Perform ongoing keyword discovery, expansion, and optimization
Research and implement search engine optimization recommendations
Research and analyze competitor advertising links
Develop and implement link building strategy
Recommend changes to website architecture, content, linking, and other factors to improve SEO positions for target keywords
Build a social media strategy through the audience identification, competitive research, benchmarking and messaging including platform strategy
Setup, Review, and Optimize company pages on social media platforms
Establish metrics and goals on customer engagement and intimacy on social media to boost website traffic and gain revenue
Engage with the customer on behalf of the brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Proven SEM experience with PPC campaign management across multiple web and social channels
In-depth experience with website analytics tools such as Google Analytics
Solid understanding of performance marketing, conversion, and online customer acquisition
Expertise in keyword research, data analysis and reporting
Knowledge of ranking factors and search engine algorithms
Up-to-date with the latest trends and best practices in SEO and SEM
Strong business acumen and expert communicator
Experience with A/B and multivariate experiments
Basic understanding of HTML, CSS, XML, JavaScript, and web development and industry-leading commerce tools
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Marketing, Quantitative, Media or a related field
Google Adwords Certification
Google Analytics and other SEO training are welcome

Description:
Role: Workday Recruiting Consultant
Exp: 2 to 10 years
Locations: Bang/Hyd/Chennai/Pune/Gurugram
Mode of work: Hybrid
Certifications: Workday Certified (Mandatory)

Required Skills:
Active Workday Core HCM, Recruiting certification.
Workday HCM experience and ability to work on multiple projects.
Hand on experience on setting up Questionnaires, Job requisitions, Evergreen Requisitions.
Subject Matter Expertise in configuring Job Posting Templates, Career Sites, Job Applications Business Process while identifying opportunities for automation and process improvements.
Expertise on configuring Referrals, Prospects, Candidates.
Functional experience in multiple HR processes like Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Compensation, Absence, Talent.
Perform HRIS operational duties for Workday HCM and Recruiting.
Ability to work with the client and drive design sessions for various HCM/Recruiting areas and hands-on experience in business process configuration and building validation/condition rules.
Understanding of HR programs and policies along with a commitment to HR principles of confidentiality required data analysis and report building skills is essential.
Hands-on experience creating and troubleshooting EIBs (Enterprise Interface Builder).
Ability to help customers resolve functional issues requiring in depth expertise in the Workday solutions.
In-depth knowledge of Workday security framework, calculated fields, custom reports like Advanced/Matrix/Composite and setting up notifications.
In-depth knowledge of various data sources available and how to use them.
Analyze Workday release updates to understand impacts of feature changes, in relation to clients existing configuration.
Ability to maintain the highest regulatory and compliance standards in handling employee records.
Ensure effective engagement and collaboration with cross functional teams (HRIS & Digital, P&C, People Analytics).
Preferred Skills:
Good to have additional certifications like: Payroll, Time Tracking, Benefits, Absence, Talent, Advanced Compensation, Reporting.
Knowledge on using object transporter, Customer Central for configuration and migration.
AboutCompany:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.

Description:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Ecommerce Developer (Magento 2) to join our platinum team of entrepreneurial, enthusiastic, and caring people.
You will be responsible in developing, maintaining, securing, and optimizing our eCommerce platform based on Magento 2 on hyper scaler cloud environment including underlying components.
You will identify new and exciting functionalities and develop new modules.
If you are the person who can design and develop web / mobile platforms securely at an unbelievable pace, we would like to meet you.
To succeed in this role, you must have a growth mindset and be a self-starter, top-notch communicator and passionate hands-on programmer.
Responsibilities
Optimize existing Magento 2 installation
Provide regular and emergency support for break-fixes
Troubleshoot integration and performance issues
Design interfaces, themes, templates while following best practices and maintain world-class coding styles and standard
Anticipate the performance requirements and communicate with management on remediation plans to CTO/CIO
Develop new Magento modules and functionalities
Manage and upgrade Magento add-ons and conduct code reviews/scans
Establish DevOps pipelines, Release/Change management procedures, etc.
Develop testing scenarios including unit testing, integration testing and automate those
Work with UI/UX and graphic designers to implement front-end changes
Work with content writer to implement new contents
Implement additional components such as Elastic Search, Varnish, Redis, CDN, RabbitMQ, etc.
Manage SSL certificates, software accounts, keys, etc.
Rearchitect environment and provide vertical and horizontal scaling as demand grows
Fine-tune batch jobs (Crons) or Consumers
Migrate databases and data
Develop integrations for files, images, etc.
Manage stack components and upgrade them (Ubuntu, PHP, Percona, Nginx, Composer, Firewall, Redis, etc.)
Create plans for developing mobile experience, mobile apps or PWA front end environment
Maintain confidentiality about IP, methods, processes and data
Participate in conferences, webinars and provide presentations while socializing and partnering with startups
Install security patches and monitor web traffic
brand and perform soft-sell while managing and improving brand reputation
Collaborate with other stakeholders such as content developer (copywriter), graphics and media designer, and management for consistent brand messaging and best customer experience
Qualifications
Strong experience with Magento 2 development and debugging
Strong experience with high-performance technologies such as Nginx, Varnish, Redis, ElasticSearch
JavaScript and AJAX experience for Front-end
Extensive HTML5, LESS and CSS knowledge
Understanding of modern UI/UX trends
Experience or knowledge of React.js, Vue.js and Node.js
Experience with AWS components such as VPC, IAM, EC2, ECS, Lambda, S3, CloudFront, WAF Cloud Formation
Linux or Ubuntu server operations working and know-hows
Experience in working with MySQL databases like MariaDB and Percona
Basic understanding of networking and ports
Experience with Google Tag Manager, SEO, Google Analytics, PPC, Facebook Pixels. A/B Testing
Strong attention to details about design styles to improve look and feel
Very good PHP knowledge and understating of various frameworks
Ability to work in a professional capacity and team environment is must
Ability to manage projects and work in strict deadlines
Education Certifications
Bachelors/Masters in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field
Magento 2 Certification is required
Cloud Computing Certification (AWS/GCP/Azure) is a plus
AboutCompany:
Prayag Healths idea dates back to 2017 when one of the founders experienced an acute episode of back pain and could not get the product guidance to obtain temporary relief. Prayag Health was born out of his life- long passion for healthcare and commitment in Allen, Texas. Prayag Health began its operations in late 2019 to help people live healthy and happy. We achieve that by providing innovative solutions that can influence their lives and the lives of their loved ones.

Description:
Senior Python AWS GenAI Engineer | Backend & Cloud Development
Experience
6-12 Years
Location
Hyderabad, Pune, Bangalore, Chennai / Hybrid
Job Overview
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Backend & Cloud Engineer with strong expertise in Python, AWS Cloud, and Generative AI technologies. The ideal candidate should have hands-on experience designing and building scalable AI-powered applications using RAG architectures, Agentic AI frameworks, Vector Databases, and AWS Bedrock. The role involves developing cloud-native solutions, integrating LLMs, and building high-performance backend systems on AWS.
Mandatory Requirements
Minimum 6+ years of overall software development experience
Minimum 3+ years of hands-on Generative AI experience
Strong expertise in Python development
Experience developing and deploying AI/ML applications in AWS environments
Strong understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, and scalable backend development
Key Responsibilities
Design and develop enterprise-grade Generative AI applications using LLMs and AWS services.
Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines.
Develop Agentic AI solutions and multi-agent workflows.
Integrate and manage Vector Databases for semantic search and knowledge retrieval.
Build scalable REST APIs and microservices using Python frameworks.
Design event-driven and serverless architectures on AWS.
Collaborate with product, engineering, and AI teams to deliver innovative AI solutions.
Ensure application reliability, security, scalability, and performance.

What We Are Looking For
Hands-on developer, not just a coordinator or architect.
Strong GenAI implementation experience with real-world projects.
Ability to work across AI, Backend, and Cloud technologies.
Excellent problem-solving and debugging skills.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
Data Warehouse Testing Engineer - Job Description

Job Title: Data Warehouse Testing Engineer
Experience: 8-15 Years
Location: Bangalore / Hybrid
Employment Type: Full-Time
Job Summary
We are looking for a skilled Data Warehouse Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality, accuracy, and integrity of data across Data Warehouse, ETL, and Reporting systems. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in SQL, Data Warehousing concepts, ETL testing, and source-to-target data validation.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business requirements, data models, and source-to-target mapping documents.
Develop test strategies, test plans, test cases, and test scenarios for Data Warehouse projects.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) processes.
Perform data reconciliation and source-to-target validation.
Verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across systems.
Execute functional, integration, regression, and system testing.
Validate reports, dashboards, and business intelligence solutions.
Perform backend testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects using defect management tools.
Collaborate with Data Engineers, ETL Developers, Business Analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics.
Required Skills
Strong experience in Data Warehouse Testing and ETL Testing.
Advanced SQL skills including joins, subqueries, aggregations, and stored procedures.
Strong understanding of Data Warehousing Concepts:
Fact and Dimension Tables
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
OLAP Concepts
Experience with ETL tools such as Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, or Ab Initio.
Expertise in source-to-target data validation and data reconciliation.
Experience with defect tracking tools such as JIRA.
Knowledge of Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC) and Agile methodologies.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Cloud Data Warehouses:
Snowflake
Amazon Redshift
Azure Synapse
Google BigQuery
Knowledge of Big Data technologies such as Hadoop, Hive, and Spark.
Experience with BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Cognos.
Basic automation knowledge using Python or SQL scripting.
Experience with Data Lake and Data Migration Testing.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
ISTQB or relevant Data Testing certifications are preferred.
Key Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail.
Ability to understand complex data flows and business rules.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and within cross-functional teams.
Keywords for Resume Screening
Data Warehouse Testing, ETL Testing, SQL, Data Validation, Data Reconciliation, Informatica, SSIS, Talend, DataStage, Ab Initio, Star Schema, Snowflake Schema, Fact Tables, Dimension Tables, SCD, Data Migration Testing, Snowflake, Azure Synapse, Redshift, BigQuery, Tableau, Power BI, JIRA, Agile.
Must-Have Skills
Data Warehouse Testing
ETL Testing
Advanced SQL
Source-to-Target Validation
Data Reconciliation
Data Warehousing Concepts (Star/Snowflake Schema, Facts & Dimensions)
Agile & JIRA Experience

Description:
Required Technical Skill Set:

1. Extensive experience in designing, planning and implementing IMS-based voice solutions including VoLTE, VoWiFi and VoNR services across multi-vendor telecom environments.
2. Proven capability in translating business and service requirements into High-Level Designs (HLDs), Low-Level Designs (LLDs) and deployment-ready architecture artefacts.
3. Strong understanding of IMS Core architecture including P-CSCF, I-CSCF, S-CSCF, SBC, TAS, HSS/UDM and their integration with EPC and 5GC networks.
4. Expertise in SIP signaling, call routing, interconnect, roaming, policy control and service continuity mechanisms.
5. Experience in designing and validating Emergency Services (999/112), Lawful Intercept (LI), number portability and regulatory service requirements.
6. Strong capability in performing design assurance, architecture reviews, capacity planning, resiliency assessment and interoperability evaluations.
7. Experience managing HLD-to-LLD traceability and ensuring alignment between design, implementation and validation activities.
8. Ability to provide technical leadership during integration, testing, migration and production deployment phases.
9. Experience working with telecom operators, OEMs and cross-functional teams to resolve architecture and service design challenges.
10. Knowledge of cloud-native IMS evolution, automation frameworks and autonomous network principles.

Description:
Job Title: Seller Business Development Associate (BDA)
Company: NoBroker Technologies Pvt. Ltd.
Job Type: Full-time | Field Sales
Location: Bangalore, Chennai, Mumbai, Pune
Experience: Minimum 1 year / Smart Freshers
Industry: Real Estate
Job Summary
We are looking for energetic and customer-focused Business Development Associates (BDA) to join our field sales team. You will interact with property owners and customers, conduct property/site visits, explain NoBroker services, and help drive successful property transactions.
Qualified leads will be provided by the company.
Key Responsibilities
Meet property owners and customers for property sales, rentals, and leases.
Conduct property visits and accompany buyers during site visits.
Explain property details, pricing, and NoBroker services.
Coordinate property photoshoots and ensure accurate property information.
Negotiate with buyers and sellers to support deal closure.
Onboard property owners and promote premium services where applicable.
Visit commercial properties and collect owner details.
Update property details through the NoBroker App or Google Forms.
Maintain customer interactions and sales updates in CRM.
Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
Eligibility
Diploma or Graduation is mandatory.
Smart Freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of field sales experience.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Comfortable with field sales and customer interaction.
Mandatory Requirements
Own bike and valid driving licence.
Smartphone.
Ability to communicate in at least one of these combinations:
English + Kannada
English + Telugu
English + Tamil
English + Hindi
English + Marathi

Description:
Location - Bangalore / Mumbai / Nagpur / Kolhapur / Sambhajinagar / Amaravati / Hyderabad / Warangal / Vijayawada / Vizag / Amaravati (AP) / Kalaburagi / Mysore / Tumkur / Gadag / Hassan / Cuddalore / Villupuram

Role Overview-
As a Corporate Linkages Professional, you will serve as the bridge between trained students and potential employers. You will be responsible for developing and managing corporate partnerships,
identifying employment opportunities, facilitating placement activities, and supporting students throughout their career journey.

The role requires strong relationship-building skills, an understanding of evolving industry hiring trends, and the ability to work closely with students, training teams, educational institutions, and employers
to achieve placement outcomes.
Your primary objective will be to maximize student placements and contribute to the overall employability success of the programs.

Key Responsibilities-

1. Corporate Engagement & Partnerships

Identify, map, and connect with HR teams, recruiters, hiring managers, and industry leaders across sectors.
Build and maintain strong relationships with employers to generate placement opportunities for trained students.
Understand industry hiring requirements and workforce trends.
Develop and manage a robust employer network to support ongoing placement activities.
Represent TNSIF at industry events, networking forums, and employer engagement initiatives.

2. Student Placement & Career Support

Understand students' career aspirations, skills, and employment preferences.
Identify suitable job opportunities through corporate partnerships, professional networks, job portals, and recruitment platforms.
Conduct placement readiness sessions, career counselling, and employability guidance.
Support students in resume building, interview preparation, and professional communication.

3. Placement Drives & Recruitment Events

Plan and execute placement drives, recruitment campaigns, job fairs, career fests, and hiring events.
Coordinate with employers and educational institutions to ensure smooth execution of recruitment activities.
Facilitate interviews, assessments, group discussions, and selection processes.
Enable meaningful interactions between students and employers to improve placement outcomes.

4. Data Management & Reporting

Maintain accurate records of employer engagement, job opportunities, interviews, selections, and placements.
Update placement dashboards, trackers, and MIS reports regularly.
Analyse placement performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities.
Contribute towards achieving placement targets and program KPIs, including student joining and retention rates.

5. Post-Placement Support
Provide support to students during onboarding and joining processes.
Conduct regular follow-ups with placed students and employers.
Track student retention and career progression.
Address challenges related to onboarding, workplace adaptation, and job continuity.

6. Stakeholder Management

Collaborate closely with program teams, trainers, colleges, universities, and corporate partners.
Ensure alignment between student skill development initiatives and market requirements.
Maintain strong communication with internal and external stakeholders to drive placement success.


Preferred Skills & Experience-

27 years of experience in Corporate Relations, Placements, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment,
Business Development, Employer Engagement, or Industry Partnerships.
Experience working with educational institutions, skilling programs, employability initiatives, or workforce development programs is preferred.
Exposure to placements across sectors such as IT/ITeS, Manufacturing, Engineering, BFSI, Retail, Logistics, Healthcare, Emerging Technologies, or allied industries.
Strong corporate networking and relationship management skills.
Proven ability to organise placement drives and recruitment events.
Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills; strong data management, reporting, and analytical abilities.
Ability to work independently in a dynamic and target-driven environment.
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and placement tracking systems.

Description:
As an Oracle Technical - Manager, you will play a pivotal role in our business application consulting team, specializing in Oracle technology. You will be responsible for analyzing client needs, implementing software solutions, and providing training and support to optimize operational efficiency and help clients achieve their strategic objectives. Within our Technology Consulting practice, you will utilize and manage the Oracle suite of software and technologies, focusing on installation, configuration, administration, development, and support of Oracle products and solutions.
As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for confirming project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
Responsibilities
- Leading the implementation and management of Oracle software solutions to optimize client operations
- Analyzing client needs and developing tailored Oracle technology strategies to achieve business objectives
- Overseeing the installation, configuration, and administration of Oracle products and solutions
- Guiding teams in the development and support of Oracle Application Development Framework (ADF) and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
- Utilizing Oracle Business Intelligence (BI) Publisher and Oracle Data Integration to enhance data-driven decision-making
- Driving process improvement and optimization initiatives within client environments
- Coaching and mentoring team members to develop their skills and deliver quality outcomes
- Collaborating with clients to address challenges and provide strategic technology planning
- Embracing change and fostering a culture of innovation and digital tooling within teams
- Building and maintaining strong client relationships to support business transformation efforts
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 4 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Computer Science, Computer and Information Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Data Science
- At least one of the following: Oracle Cloud certification in technical, integration, database, or related Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) domains
- Demonstrating proficiency in Oracle Application Development Framework (ADF) and Oracle Business Intelligence (BI) Publisher
- Utilizing strategic technology planning to drive business transformation initiatives
- Embracing AI fluency and AI-human collaboration for innovative solutions
- Excelling in process improvement and optimization within Oracle environments
- Leading teams with a focus on coaching and feedback to enhance performance

Good to Have:
LLM fine-tuning and model evaluation
MLOps / LLMOps
NLP and machine learning fundamentals
Production monitoring using Azure monitoring tools
Experience with enterprise-scale AI deployments

Experience
3 -10 Years
Job Summary
We are seeking a skilled ETL Testing Engineer to validate data extraction, transformation, and loading processes in data warehouse and business intelligence environments. The ideal candidate should possess strong SQL skills, hands-on ETL testing experience, and expertise in data validation and quality assurance.
Key Responsibilities
Analyze business and technical requirements related to data migration and ETL processes.
Design and execute ETL test cases, test plans, and test scenarios.
Validate data extraction, transformation, and loading from source systems to target databases.
Perform data integrity, completeness, and reconciliation testing.
Verify data mappings, transformation rules, and business logic.
Execute database testing using complex SQL queries.
Identify, document, and track defects through defect management tools.
Perform regression, integration, system, and UAT support testing.
Validate data quality and consistency across multiple platforms.
Collaborate with developers, data engineers, business analysts, and stakeholders.
Prepare test metrics, reports, and test execution status updates.
Required Skills
Strong knowledge of ETL Testing concepts and methodologies.
Hands-on experience with ETL tools such as:
Informatica
SSIS (SQL Server Integration Services)
Talend
DataStage
Ab Initio
Advanced SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation.
Experience with Data Warehouse concepts including:
Star Schema
Snowflake Schema
Fact and Dimension Tables
Slowly Changing Dimensions (SCD)
Experience with database platforms such as Oracle, SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL, or Teradata.
Expertise in data quality and data migration testing.
Familiarity with defect tracking tools (JIRA, Azure DevOps).
Preferred Skills
Automation experience using Python, Selenium, or ETL automation frameworks.
Experience with cloud data platforms:
Azure Data Factory (ADF)
Azure Synapse
AWS Glue
Snowflake
Databricks
Knowledge of Big Data technologies (Hive, Hadoop, Spark).
Understanding of CI/CD and DevOps practices.
Performance and volume testing experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or related field.
Certification in ETL, Data Warehousing, or Database technologies is a plus.

About the Job:
Step into a dynamic role as an Automation Test Engineer, where your expertise will drive the quality and reliability of software products. In this collaborative environment, you will work alongside talented teams to ensure seamless integration and functionality. Your contributions will play a pivotal role in delivering high-quality solutions that meet user needs and exceed expectations. Embrace the opportunity to innovate and enhance testing processes, all while growing your skills in a supportive and motivating atmosphere.
Key Responsibilities:
Design, develop, and execute automated test scripts using Selenium to ensure software quality.
Collaborate with development teams to identify test requirements and create comprehensive test plans.
Analyze test results, identify defects, and work closely with developers for resolution.
Continuously enhance testing frameworks and processes for improved efficiency and effectiveness.
Participate in code reviews and provide feedback to ensure testability and quality standards.
Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's degree in BTech, BCA, BE, or BSc.
Proven experience in QA Automation with a focus on Selenium.
Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.
Excellent problem-solving abilities and communication skills.
Preferred Qualifications:
Experience with Java Selenium for creating robust test scripts.
Familiarity with continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipelines.
Proven track record of improving testing processes and methodologies.
Ability to work in an Agile environment and adapt to changing requirements.
Experience in performance and load testing is a plus
AboutCompany:
Infosys is a global leader in next-generation digital services and consulting. We enable clients in 46 countries to navigate their digital transformation. With over three decades of experience in managing the systems and workings of global enterprises, we expertly steer our clients through their digital journey. We do it by enabling the enterprise with an AI-powered core that helps prioritize the execution of change. We also empower the business with agile digital at scale to deliver unprecedented levels of performance and customer delight. Our always-on learning agenda drives their continuous improvement through building and transferring digital skills, expertise, and ideas from our innovation ecosystem.
To learn more about Infosys and see our ideas in action please visit us at www.Infosys.com

Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Salesforce using Copado and ADO.

Support release management activities, including planning, monitoring, and issue resolution.

Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) pipelines and work item tracking.
Familiarity with Salesforce metadata, SFDX, and package-based deployments.
Knowledge of release management processes in large-scale enterprise environments.
Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to troubleshoot deployment failures.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Preferred Skills
Experience with Gearset, AutoRABIT, or other Salesforce DevOps tools.
Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and containerization concepts.
Knowledge of test automation tools (Selenium, Provar, etc.) integrated with CI/CD.
Salesforce certifications (Admin/Platform Developer) and Copado certifications.

Job Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled PLM Support Engineer with 3 to 8 years of experience in supporting and maintaining Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) applications. The ideal candidate will be responsible for providing L2/L3 production support for PLM platforms such as PLM Support ,Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam, ensuring stable operations, timely incident resolution, and continuous process improvement. The role involves troubleshooting workflows, CAD integrations, BOM management, release processes, and collaborating with global cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality support.
Key Responsibilities
Production Support & Incident Management
Provide L2/L3 production support for PLM applications including Teamcenter, Aras Innovator, and SmarTeam across production and non-production environments.
Act as the primary point of contact for business users for PLM operational, application, and workflow-related issues.
Manage incidents, service requests, problem tickets, and change requests within agreed SLA timelines.
Perform impact analysis and prioritize tickets based on business criticality.
PLM Functional Support

Manage and troubleshoot complex BOM (Bill of Material) structures and product data issues.
Support product release processes, document lifecycle management, and workflow execution activities.
Assist users with process adherence, workflow execution, and system functionality.

Investigate dataset validation failures, translator issues, and CAD file management problems.

Support vault server management, job server monitoring, and scheduled background jobs.
Monitor workflow execution and system performance to ensure application availability and stability.
Analyze system bottlenecks impacting user performance and workflow processing.
Root Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring production incidents.
Implement corrective and preventive actions to reduce ticket volumes and improve system reliability.
Identify opportunities for automation and process improvements within PLM support operations.
Maintain knowledge articles, support documentation, and troubleshooting guides.
Reporting & Stakeholder Management
Generate and publish support metrics, incident reports, ticket trend analysis, and SLA compliance reports.
Provide regular status updates to management and key stakeholders.
Coordinate with development, infrastructure, database, and global support teams for issue resolution and deployments.

Hope youre doing well!
We have an urgent opening for a SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant of our esteemed clients.

Experience Required: 10 – 15 Years
Location: Hyderabad,Bangalore,Pune,Mumbai,Noida,Chennai

Education: B. Tech / M. Tech / M.Sc. / MCA

Position Overview
Job Descripition:

We are seeking an experienced SAP Senior SD Functional Consultant with 9+ years of expertise in SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and SAP S/4HANA. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes, global template rollouts, business process analysis, and SAP implementations. The role involves collaborating with business stakeholders, conducting workshops, gathering requirements, configuring SAP SD solutions, supporting testing activities, and ensuring successful project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Lead workshops with business users and stakeholders to define functional requirements.
Configure and support SAP SD processes, including Sales, Shipping, Delivery, Billing, Pricing, and O2C.
Participate in SAP S/4HANA implementation and global rollout projects.
Prepare functional specifications and coordinate with technical teams for developments.
Support SIT, UAT, defect resolution, cutover, and post-go-live activities.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including MM, FI, WM/EWM, and Logistics.
Create and maintain functional documentation and provide end-user support.
Ensure solution quality, process compliance, and timely project delivery.

Required Skills
9+ years of SAP SD Functional experience.
Strong knowledge of SAP S/4HANA and Order-to-Cash (O2C) processes.
Experience in SAP implementations, enhancements, and global rollouts.
Expertise in Sales Order Processing, Pricing, Shipping, Delivery, and Billing.
Experience in business process analysis, configuration, testing, and production support.
Strong stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills.
Knowledge of SAP integration with MM and FI modules.

Preferred Candidate
Experience in SAP S/4HANA transformation projects.
Exposure to Agile or SAP Activate methodology.

Description:
Position - Senior Enterprise AI Architect GenAI, Agentic AI & Enterprise Applications
Location : Pune / Bangalore / Hyderabad / Chennai (Hybrid / Work from Office as per project requirement)
Experience : 15–25 Years
About the Role
We are looking for a highly experienced Enterprise AI Architect who can drive the design and implementation of AI/GenAI solutions across large-scale enterprise environments.
The ideal candidate should have experience integrating AI solutions with enterprise business platforms such as:
SAP (S/4 HANA, SAP BTP, SAP AI Core)
Oracle (Oracle ERP, Oracle CX, Oracle Cloud)
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
The role requires a blend of Enterprise Architecture, AI Strategy, Agentic AI, GenAI, Platform Integration, and Business Transformation.
Key Responsibilities
Enterprise AI Transformation
Define Enterprise AI strategy and target-state architecture.
Drive AI adoption across enterprise applications and business processes.
Build AI-led transformation roadmaps aligned to business objectives.
Enterprise Platform Integration
Design and implement AI solutions integrated with:
SAP
Oracle
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
Generative AI & Agentic AI
Architect GenAI and Agentic AI solutions using:
OpenAI
Azure OpenAI
AWS Bedrock
Anthropic Claude
Gemini
Llama
Design autonomous and multi-agent workflows.
Implement enterprise-grade RAG architectures.
AI Solution Architecture
Build scalable and secure AI platforms.
Define reference architectures, governance frameworks, and reusable AI patterns.
Establish LLMOps, MLOps, observability, evaluation, and monitoring mechanisms.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business leaders, CIOs, CTOs, Enterprise Architects, and Product Owners.
Conduct architecture reviews and technical governance.
Lead client workshops, solutioning discussions, and strategic transformation initiatives.
Must-Have Skills
AI / GenAI
Generative AI
Agentic AI
RAG
LangChain
LangGraph
LLM Integration
Prompt Engineering
AI Governance
Enterprise Platforms (Critical)
Strong hands-on experience in at least one or more:
SAP
Oracle
Salesforce
ServiceNow
PEGA
Cloud Platforms
Azure
AWS
GCP
Architecture
Enterprise Architecture
Solution Architecture
Microservices
API-led Architecture
Cloud-native Design
Preferred Skills
SAP AI Core / SAP BTP
Oracle ERP / Oracle CX
Salesforce AI initiatives
ServiceNow AI integrations
TOGAF Certification
BFSI, Retail, Healthcare, Telecom, Manufacturing experience
AI Center of Excellence leadership
What We Are Looking For
Candidates who have successfully implemented:
AI + SAP
AI + Oracle
AI + Salesforce
AI + ServiceNow
AI + PEGA
rather than profiles that are purely focused on standalone GenAI, Data Science, or AI research.
Summary -
"We are looking for a Senior Enterprise AI Architect who has implemented GenAI/Agentic AI solutions on top of enterprise platforms such as SAP, Oracle, Salesforce, ServiceNow, PEGA. The role is focused on enterprise transformation, AI integration, and business process automation rather than standalone AI development."
Detailed Job Description
Position Overview
Tech Mahindra is hiring Senior AI Architects across Hyderabad, Chennai, Pune, and Bangalore. This role is for senior technology leaders who can define AI architecture strategy, design enterprise-grade solutions, and guide teams from concept to production at scale.
The position combines strategic advisory responsibilities with hands-on architecture and implementation leadership. It is suited to professionals who can connect business priorities, enterprise platforms, cloud ecosystems, and AI engineering practices into scalable and reusable solution patterns.
Role Purpose
The Senior AI Architect will shape and validate AI-led transformation programs for enterprise clients, with a strong focus on scalable architecture, reusable assets, and outcome-driven solution design. The role is expected to bridge business stakeholders, enterprise architects, platform teams, data and AI engineering teams, and delivery leadership across global engagements.
This role requires practical judgment on how AI should be embedded into enterprise landscapes, including business applications, integration layers, governance controls, and production operations. Strong communication with CXOs and cross-functional stakeholders is central to success in this role.
Key Responsibilities
Define target-state AI and data architecture aligned to business outcomes, enterprise architecture standards, and transformation roadmaps.
Design end-to-end AI solution architectures covering data pipelines, model development, deployment, monitoring, security, and integration with enterprise applications.
Build scalable and reusable assets, accelerators, reference architectures, frameworks, and patterns for enterprise AI adoption.
Evaluate and validate solution options across cloud, AI, and enterprise application platforms such as SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, and Salesforce.
Lead architecture reviews, technical due diligence, feasibility studies, and proof-of-concept direction for AI initiatives.
Collaborate with business leaders, delivery teams, product owners, security teams, and global stakeholders to shape credible and implementable solutions.
Establish good practices for testing, deployment, observability, lifecycle management, and production support of AI systems.
Drive architectural governance across responsible AI, compliance, privacy, model risk, and enterprise security requirements.
Mentor engineering and architecture teams, influence critical technology choices, and support executive-level solution positioning.
Required Experience
12+ years of overall experience in enterprise technology, architecture, or digital transformation, with strong recent experience in AI/ML solution architecture and delivery.
Proven hands-on experience designing and implementing production-grade AI or ML solutions for enterprise use cases.
Experience across more than one enterprise platform, preferably SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or adjacent enterprise ecosystems.
Experience working in architecture consulting, transformation programs, or complex enterprise modernization engagements.
Demonstrated ability to work with CXOs, business stakeholders, and multidisciplinary global teams to influence architectural decisions.
Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, API-led architecture, security, scalability, and non-functional design principles.
AI And Technical Skills
AI Architecture
End-to-end AI/ML architecture, including data ingestion, feature engineering, training pipelines, model serving, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Experience with generative AI architecture, including LLM-based applications, retrieval-augmented generation, prompt orchestration, guardrails, and evaluation patterns.
Ability to define reference patterns for recommendation, forecasting, NLP, computer vision, intelligent automation, and enterprise copilots.
Cloud And MLOps
Strong architecture experience on one or more cloud platforms such as AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud.
Working knowledge of enterprise MLOps and LLMOps practices such as experiment tracking, model registry, pipeline orchestration, deployment automation, and model monitoring.
Experience with tools and platforms such as Azure Machine Learning, Amazon SageMaker, Vertex AI, Databricks, MLflow, Kubeflow, DVC, Airflow, or equivalent ecosystems.
AI Engineering Stack
Hands-on familiarity with Python and common AI/ML frameworks such as TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, or similar tools used in enterprise AI delivery.
Understanding of vector databases, knowledge retrieval patterns, API orchestration, agent frameworks, and model integration approaches for production AI systems.
Experience integrating AI services with enterprise applications, data platforms, and middleware layers using secure and scalable design patterns.
Enterprise Platform Expectations
Candidates should bring hands-on architecture or implementation exposure across at least two enterprise platforms or transformation ecosystems. Preferred experience includes SAP BTP or SAP AI capabilities, Oracle enterprise applications and data services, ServiceNow workflow and automation platforms, Salesforce ecosystem integrations, and broader enterprise application modernization patterns.
The role values professionals who can embed AI into enterprise process landscapes rather than treating AI as a standalone lab initiative. Strong grounding in business process transformation, platform interoperability, and enterprise-scale rollout models is important for success.
Leadership And Consulting Skills
Executive presence and the ability to articulate architecture choices, trade-offs, risks, and value realization clearly to senior business and technology stakeholders.
Strong consulting mindset with structured problem solving, solution framing, estimation support, and transformation roadmap definition.
Ability to lead cross-functional workshops, align distributed teams, and drive decisions in complex, fast-moving programs.
Practical, solution-oriented approach with the confidence to challenge weak designs and strengthen architecture quality before implementation.
Education
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline is required. A master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.
Preferred Certifications
AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud architecture certifications.
AI/ML specialty certifications on major cloud platforms.
Enterprise architecture or platform certifications across SAP, Oracle, ServiceNow, Salesforce, or related ecosystems.
Work Locations
Hyderabad | Chennai | Pune | Bangalore

About PwC
At PwC, we connect people with diverse backgrounds and skill sets to solve important
problems together and lead with purposefor our clients, our communities and for the
world at large. It is no surprise therefore that 429 of 500 Fortune global companies engage
with PwC.
Acceleration Centers (ACs) are PwCs diverse, global talent hubs focused on enabling
growth for the organization and value creation for our clients. The PwC Advisory
Acceleration Center in Bangalore is part of our Advisory business in the US. The team is
focused on developing a broader portfolio with solutions for Risk Consulting, Management
Consulting, Technology Consulting, Strategy Consulting, Forensics as well as vertical
specic solutions.
PwC's high-performance culture is based on passion for excellence with focus on diversity
and inclusion. You will collaborate with and receive support from a network of people to
achieve your goals. We will also provide you with global leadership development
frameworks and the latest in digital technologies to learn and excel in your career. At the
core of our rm's philosophy is a simple construct: We care for our people.
Globally, PwC is ranked the 3rd most attractive employer according to Universum. Our
commitment to responsible business leadership, diversity & inclusion, work-life exibility,
career coaching and learning & development makes our rm one of the best places to work,
learn and excel.
Apply to us if you believe PwC is the place to be. Now and in the future!
Role overview- Sector Ops - Health
Designation: Experienced Associate
Location: Bangalore
What does this role entail?
PwC US Advisory Management Consulting
Our Management Consulting team works with our global clients to design and implement
growth, operational and customer focused strategies for sustainable competitive advantage.
Our thought leadership and unparalleled experience help clients turn formidable challenges



into market advantage across the value chain and around the globe. Additionally, our
extensive expertise in various industries allows us to serve clients with consulting services
with a focus on the most protable elements of the value chain to create scalable businesses
that will deliver increased sustainable prots.
Our Management Consultants work with the client and project teams to support global
engagements from India through activities that are driven towards delivering results:
conduct analyses and develop insights, prepare excel models, analyze large sets of data,
capture as-is processes, prepare work plans, design to-be processes, support project lead,
work directly with client teams and facilitate meetings to enable decision making, organize
and prepare recommendations on client issues, and participate actively in new business
development, thought leadership and rm building activities.
Competency Overview: Sector Ops - Health
The Sector Ops - Health team works with clients across healthcare, supporting engagements
in driving clients strategic vision and objectives, assessing market expansion and growth
strategies, researching key market trends and its impact on key stakeholders, driving
operational and process improvements, evaluating sustainable cost transformation
alternatives and enabling technology driven business success.
Our team supports a broad range of healthcare clients across Provider, Payer, and Pharma &
Life Sciences, with projects spanning operational improvement, organizational
transformation, growth strategy, technology, and data and analytics.
In the provider team, we work with health systems to design and implement organizational
transformations that improve performance and enable sustainable growth. Our work
includes labor and productivity assessments, portfolio rationalization, benchmarking,
process mapping and design, operating model design, project management, technology
eectiveness assessments, and market strategy.

Description:
The Opportunity
Join our Acceleration Center India and help shape the future of business for our diverse client portfolio across geographies and jurisdictions. Youll work at the heart of global teams across Advisory, Assurance, Tax and Business Services—solving real client challenges through connected collaboration. We’ll help you grow your skills so you can go further. With hands-on learning, cutting-edge tools and an inclusive culture, this is your opportunity to do inspiring work that makes a difference—every day.
As a Data Science Manager, you will play a pivotal role in transforming raw data into actionable insights, enabling informed decision-making and driving business growth. Within our Advisory practice, you will focus on leveraging advanced analytics and statistical techniques to extract insights from large datasets and drive data-driven decision-making. As a Manager, you will lead teams and manage client accounts, focusing on strategic planning and mentoring junior staff. You are accountable for project success and maintaining standards. Enhancing your leadership style, you motivate, develop, and inspire others to deliver quality. You are responsible for coaching, leveraging team members' unique strengths, and managing performance to deliver on client expectations. With your growing knowledge of how business works, you play an important role in identifying opportunities that contribute to the success of our Firm. You are expected to lead with integrity and authenticity, articulating our purpose and values in a meaningful way. You embrace technology and innovation to enhance your delivery and encourage others to do the same.
In this role at PwC Acceleration Center India, you will work on exploratory and descriptive analysis, statistical modeling, and creating data visualizations to help solve complex business problems and inform strategic decisions.
Responsibilities
- Leading data science initiatives to transform raw data into actionable insights for informed decision-making
- Guiding teams in the application of advanced analytics and statistical techniques to solve complex business problems
- Developing and implementing data-driven strategies using machine learning, predictive modeling, and artificial intelligence
- Overseeing the creation and maintenance of data pipelines and data lakes to support large-scale data processing
- Collaborating with stakeholders to identify opportunities for leveraging data science to drive business growth
- Utilizing programming languages such as R and MATLAB to develop and refine data models and algorithms
- Promoting the use of innovative technologies and methodologies within data science teams
- Confirming data quality and integrity through rigorous data validation and troubleshooting processes
- Mentoring junior staff and fostering a culture of continuous learning and development within the team
- Engaging in strategic planning and execution to align data science projects with organizational goals
What You Must Have
- At least a Bachelor's degree
- At least 7 years of experience
- Oral and written proficiency in English required
What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Business Analytics, Computer and Information Science, Computer Engineering, Computer Programming, Data Processing/Analytics/Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Machine Learning, Management Information Systems, Mathematics, Statistics, Systems Engineering
- Demonstrating proficiency in data science algorithms and workflows
- Utilizing machine learning and deep learning techniques effectively
- Excelling in data-driven decision making and predictive modeling
- Managing data pipelines and confirming data quality
- Leveraging programming languages such as R and MATLAB
- Applying natural language processing and neural network methodologies

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Required Technical Skills
Programming & Application Support:
.NET Framework, Visual Basic (VB.NET), ASP.NET Web Forms, Windows Forms, WPF
UI & Integration:
iFrame-based application integration, web application embedding, HTML, JavaScript (basic troubleshooting)
Reporting & Data Integration:
SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS), SQL Server Reporting Services (SSRS), T-SQL
Database Support:
SQL Server, Stored Procedures, Views, Indexing, Query Optimization
Performance & Troubleshooting:
Visual Studio Debugger, SQL Profiler, Performance Monitor, Application Logs
Server & Deployment:
IIS, Windows Services, Scheduled Tasks, Windows Server
DevOps & CI/CD:
Azure DevOps, Jenkins, MSBuild, NuGet, Git, TFS
Monitoring & Logging:
Splunk, ELK Stack, Windows Event Viewer, Application Insights
Security & Compliance:
Authentication & Authorization, Role-Based Access Control, SSL/TLS, Secure Coding Practices
Key Responsibilities
1 Incident Management & Troubleshooting
Provide Level 2/3 support for applications built on .NET Framework and Visual Basic.
Troubleshoot application crashes, functional defects, and performance issues.
Debug issues related to assemblies, DLL dependencies, and configuration mismatches.
Analyze logs, Windows Event Viewer, and application traces to identify root causes.
Follow ITIL-based Incident, Change, and Problem Management processes using ServiceNow, JIRA, or Remedy.
2 Reporting & Data Integration Support
Support, troubleshoot, and enhance SSRS reports, subscriptions, and scheduled deliveries.
Debug and optimize SSIS packages for data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL).
Resolve data accuracy, performance, and failure issues in SSIS jobs.
Support business users with reporting requirements and ad-hoc data requests.
3 Database & Query Optimization
Analyze and optimize SQL queries, stored procedures, and indexes.
Resolve database performance issues impacting application and reporting workloads.
Support data validation, reconciliation, and data consistency checks.
4 UI & Integration Support
Support applications leveraging iFrame-based integrations between internal and external systems.
Troubleshoot rendering, authentication, and session-related issues in embedded applications.
Collaborate with frontend and integration teams to resolve cross-application issues.
5 Performance Optimization
Identify performance bottlenecks in application code, database queries, and reporting layers.
Optimize application response times, report execution duration, and data refresh cycles.
Monitor application health and proactively address performance degradation.
6 Server & Environment Support
Deploy and support applications hosted on IIS and Windows Servers.
Manage Windows Services, batch jobs, and scheduled tasks supporting application workflows.
Coordinate environment-related fixes across Development, QA, and Production systems.
7 CI/CD & DevOps Support
Support build and deployment pipelines for .NET and SSIS/SSRS artifacts.
Assist with automated deployments using Azure DevOps, MSBuild, and release pipelines.
Maintain source control practices using Git or TFS.
8 Security & Compliance
Ensure applications and reports comply with enterprise security and compliance standards.
Support secure authentication, authorization, and data access controls.
Address vulnerabilities and audit findings related to application and reporting platforms.
9 Collaboration & Documentation
Work in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) environments supporting continuous improvement.
Maintain technical documentation, SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Development, Infrastructure, DBA, and Business stakeholders.

Job Title: SAP Basis Consultant
Position: Senior Software Engineer
Experience: 5 -10 Years
Category: Software Development/ Engineering
Shift: General
Main location: Bangalore/Hyderabad/Chennai
Position ID:
Employment Type: Full Time
Education Qualification: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or higher with minimum 7 years of relevant experience.
Position Description:
We are seeking an experienced SAP Senior Consultant – SAP Basis & SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) with expertise in SAP Cloud ALM to design, implement, administer, and optimize SAP landscapes across on-premise and cloud environments. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in SAP Basis administration, SAP BTP services, cloud integration, system monitoring, and lifecycle management. You will work closely with functional, technical, infrastructure, and business teams to ensure secure, reliable, and high-performing SAP environments.
Responsibilities:
Administer, maintain, and support SAP Basis landscapes across on-premise and cloud environments.
Install, configure, upgrade, patch, and maintain SAP systems including S/4HANA, ECC, and NetWeaver.
Implement and manage SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) services and subaccounts.
Configure and support SAP Cloud ALM for monitoring, implementation, operations, and integration scenarios.
Perform system monitoring, performance tuning, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.
Manage transport management, client administration, and system refresh activities.
Collaborate with functional and technical teams for SAP deployments, upgrades, and migrations.
Ensure system availability, security, backup, disaster recovery, and compliance with SAP best practices.
Support SAP integration with cloud and third-party applications.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in production support and on-call activities as required.
Must-Have Skills
5+ years of experience in SAP Basis Administration.
Strong hands-on experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (SAP BTP).
Experience implementing and administering SAP Cloud ALM.
Expertise in SAP system installation, upgrades, patching, kernel upgrades, and migrations.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA, ECC, NetWeaver, and HANA Database administration.
Strong knowledge of transport management, client administration, and system monitoring.
Experience with SAP security concepts, user administration, and authorizations.
Knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems and database administration.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) supporting SAP workloads.
Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with SAP Solution Manager.
Knowledge of SAP Integration Suite and SAP Cloud Connector.
Experience with automation and scripting using Shell, Python, or PowerShell.
SAP Basis, SAP BTP, or SAP Cloud ALM certifications.
Experience working in Agile/DevOps environments.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
CGI is an equal opportunity employer. In addition, CGI is committed to providing accommodation for people with disabilities in accordance with provincial legislation. Please let us know if you require reasonable accommodation due to a disability during any aspect of the recruitment process and we will work with you to address your needs.
Life at CGI:
It is rooted in ownership, teamwork, respect and belonging. Here, you’ll reach your full potential because
You are invited to be an owner from day 1 as we work together to bring our Dream to life. That’s why we call ourselves CGI Partners rather than employees. We benefit from our collective success and actively shape our company’s strategy and direction
Your work creates value. You’ll develop innovative solutions and build relationships with teammates and clients while accessing global capabilities to scale your ideas, embrace new opportunities, and benefit from expansive industry and technology expertise
You’ll shape your career by joining a company built to grow and last. You’ll be supported by leaders who care about your health and well-being and provide you with opportunities to deepen your skills and broaden your horizons
Come join our team, one of the largest IT and business consulting services firms in the world

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Leading data engineering workstreams for Databricks-based client solutions across data modernization initiatives
- Designing and building scalable data pipelines, integration patterns, and transformation logic to support analytics and reporting needs
- Developing cloud-based data architectures using Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Snowflake, and related platforms
- Applying data modeling, warehouse design, and performance tuning methods to improve data availability and query response times
- Coordinating technical delivery across teams and stakeholders to translate business requirements into data solutions
- Validating data quality, lineage, and transformation logic throughout the development lifecycle
- Guiding teams through complex implementation issues, tradeoffs, and dependencies across multiple workstreams
- Coaching team members on data engineering methods, delivery planning, and technical problem solving
- Presenting progress, risks, and solution options to client leaders in a clear and concise manner
- Supporting the development of reusable frameworks and delivery approaches that improve efficiency across engagements

What Sets You Apart
- Preference for at least one of the following fields of study: Management Information Systems, Computer and Information Science, Systems Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Mathematical Statistics
- Demonstrating Databricks platform experience across data engineering projects
- Applying cloud data platform knowledge with Azure, AWS, or Snowflake
- Leading client-facing data modernization work through complex delivery
- Crafting data pipelines, modeling, and transformation solutions
- Coaching teams through ambiguity while solving technical issues
