Job Title: Accounts Payable Financial Associate
Location: Bangalore
Experience: 2 - 8 Years
Qualification: Graduate / Postgraduate / Masters Degree in Commerce or Finance
Key Responsibilities:
Process vendor invoices accurately, validate supporting documents, and resolve discrepancies promptly.
Post vendor liabilities correctly and ensure timely invoice posting as per process flows.
Reconcile vendor and bank accounts; clear open items and unreconciled balances.
Manage the end-to-end invoice processing and payment cycle.
Handle employee travel & expense (T&E) claims, perform audits for high-risk claims, and manage exceptions/escalations.
Track key performance metrics (SLA/KPI) and ensure performance targets are achieved.
Ensure timely payments to vendors and compliance with company policies.
Manage unpaid invoice and claim aging, ensuring resolution within timelines.
Prepare reports such as AP aging and T&E outstanding reports.
Drive process excellence initiatives for standardization and continuous improvement.
Apply best practices to enhance efficiency and effectiveness in Accounts Payable operations.
Oversee team performance, support hiring, and contribute to capability building.
Ensure adherence to company policies, internal controls, and regulatory compliance.
Support ad hoc finance and process improvement projects.
Requirements:
2-8 years of relevant experience in Accounts Payable and Employee Claims processes, preferably in a shared services environment.
Strong communication skills (written and verbal) in English.
High attention to detail, accuracy, and accountability.
Strong interpersonal and vendor management skills.
Proactive, dependable, and a collaborative team player.
Ability to work independently with a positive and solution-oriented mindset.

Data Engineer
Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gurgaon, Chennai
JOB DESCRIPTION:
Building the machine learning production System(or MLOps) is the biggest challenge most large companies currently have in making the transition to becoming an AI-driven organization. This position is an opportunity for an experienced, server-side developer to build expertise in this exciting new frontier. You will be part of a team deploying state-of-the-art AI solutions for Fractal clients.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
As MLOps Engineer, you will work collaboratively with Data Scientists and Data engineers to deploy and operate advanced analytics machine learning models. You ll help automate and streamline Model development and Model operations. You ll build and maintain tools for deployment, monitoring, and operations. You ll also troubleshoot and resolve issues in development, testing, and production environments.
Enable Model tracking, model experimentation, Model automation Develop scalable ML pipelines
Develop MLOps components in Machine learning development life cycle using Model Repository (either of): MLFlow, Kubeflow Model Registry
Machine Learning Services (either of): Kubeflow, DataRobot, HopsWorks, Dataiku or any relevant ML E2E PaaS/SaaS
Work across all phases of Model development life cycle to build MLOPS components
Build the knowledge base required to deliver increasingly complex MLOPS projects on the Cloud(AWS, Azure, GCP)/On Prem Be an integral part of client business development and delivery engagements across multiple domains.
QUALIFICATIONS: REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS:
3-12 years experience building production-quality software
Strong experience in System Integration, Application Development or DataWarehouse projects across technologies used in the enterprise space
Basic Knowledge of MLOps, machine learning and docker
Object-oriented languages (e.g. Python, PySpark, Java, C#, C++ )
Experience developing CI/CD components for production ready ML pipeline.
Database programming using any flavors of SQL
Knowledge of Git for Source code management
Ability to collaborate effectively with highly technical resources in a fast-paced environment
Ability to solve complex challenges/problems and rapidly deliver innovative solutions
Team handling, problem solving, project management and communication skills & creative thinking
Foundational Knowledge of Cloud Computing either one AWS, Azure or GCP
Hunger and passion for learning new skills
Recommended (not mandatory): completion of Fractal Data Science Professional Certificate" with this - https: / / www.coursera.org / professional-certificates / fractal-data-science
EDUCATION:
B.E/B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or related technical degree OR Equivalent.

The Technology Strategy & Advisory Practice is a part of and focuses on the clients most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models using agile methodologies.

Description:
Dear Candidate,

We have an exciting opportunity at our company Tata Business Hub for a Lead IT Infra Role, and based on your experience and skill set, we believe this role could be a great fit for you.

Company Details : Tata Business Hub is a digital first B2B organization setup by TATA Group to holistically address the needs of Emerging Businesses. We value the pivotal role of emerging businesses in our Nations economic growth and prosperity, and believe in empowering them to be deeply aware, widely connected and digitally integrated. Offering a host of economical and highly relevant business capabilities, Tata Business Hub aims to be the catalyst, propelling emerging businesses into new frontiers of growth and performance.

At Tata Business Hub, our ambition is vast-
We want to become the pre-eminent company that works for MSMEs in India

Grow their business
Solve their challenges
Optimize their processes

Role Summary
Responsible for managing enterprise IT infrastructure, Microsoft 365, AWS cloud platforms, network security and IT operations, while ensuring effective IT procurement, vendor coordination and billing management.
Key Responsibilities
1. Microsoft 365 & SharePoint
Manage Microsoft 365, SharePoint Online, SSO, Active Directory and Azure integrations.
Develop and maintain SharePoint customizations, SPFx/React JS applications and Power Platform solutions.
Manage Microsoft 365 security policies using Defender and Intune.
Troubleshoot Office 365, email, network, firewall and cloud service issues.
2. Infrastructure & Cloud
Manage DNS, email routing, Azure services, web applications, APIs and storage.
Deploy and manage AWS services, instances, AMIs and SaaS infrastructure.
Configure and optimize AWS, Azure and internal cloud environments.
Implement automation, patching, backup and disaster recovery solutions.
Monitor cloud usage, capacity, performance and costs.
3. Network & Security
Manage enterprise network and security infrastructure, including firewalls, IPS, proxy, web/email filtering and next-generation security solutions.
Configure firewall policies, authentication services, load balancers and SD-WAN.
Maintain knowledge of MPLS, BGP, OSPF, TACACS and related network technologies.
Identify, investigate and resolve major incidents and security vulnerabilities.
4. Identity, Endpoint & IT Support
Manage Active Directory, Azure AD/Entra ID, Azure AD Connect, ADFS and Hybrid Exchange.
Implement SSO, MFA, access controls and endpoint security.
Manage BYOD, ActiveSync and mobile device support.
Provide technical support, problem management and infrastructure troubleshooting.
Drive ITSM, SLA adherence and service improvement.
5. IT Procurement & Vendor Management
Coordinate IT procurement for hardware, software, cloud services, licenses and infrastructure.
Raise and track purchase requisitions, POs, quotations and delivery schedules.
Coordinate with vendors, Procurement, Finance and internal teams for timely delivery.
Maintain records of contracts, licenses, warranties, renewals and IT assets.
Support vendor evaluations, commercial negotiations and cost optimization.
6. IT Billing & Cost Control
Validate vendor invoices against POs, contracts, SOWs and agreed rates.
Verify quantities, taxes, rental charges, licenses, cloud consumption and discounts.
Track recurring IT bills, AMC, connectivity, cloud and managed services.
Resolve billing discrepancies and coordinate corrections, credit notes and adjustments.
Maintain billing trackers and support monthly cost reconciliation and budget reporting.
7. Documentation & Compliance
Maintain infrastructure documentation, configuration records and asset details.
Follow IT security, change management, audit and compliance requirements.
Ensure timely closure of vulnerabilities, audit observations and operational issues.

Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT or related field.
8-12 years of experience in M365, cloud infrastructure, network security and IT operations.
Strong knowledge of AWS, Azure, GCP, Active Directory, Exchange, networking and security technologies.
Proficiency in PowerShell and infrastructure automation.
Experience in IT procurement, vendor management and invoice validation.
If you're a motivated individual with a keen eye for quality and a desire to drive excellence in every project, we invite you to apply and join our team.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Description:
Job Description
The Finance Solution team works closely with client and project teams in the US to help CFOs and their finance organizations identify, design and implement programs that transform their finance functions to meet todays demanding requirements while continuing to provide valuable insights to the business.
A career within the Finance Solutions team, will provide the opportunity to work alongside CEOs, CFOs and Controllers to optimize their Record to Report process. We work closely with clients to diagnose current-state finance operations, identify improvement opportunities, design future-state processes, and implement digital and process solutions to enhance efficiency, accuracy, and control in financial reporting.
Role & responsibilities
4-9 years Experience R2R Finance Strategy, Process Transformation,Blackline end to end Implementation.
1. Finance Strategy, Process Transformation & Optimization
Assist the finance function to define the finance vision, outline clear-set of value proposition, define sustainable cost reduction model, prepare a roadmap for finance transformation strategy, define and develop a finance target operating model.
Lead assessments and diagnostics of clients Controllership function / R2R processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, and control gaps.
Design future-state processes aligned with leading practices and automation opportunities.
Drive simplification, standardization, and centralization initiatives across global finance functions.
Performance / KPI Management - define an effective set of performance measures and KPIs which will focus the business on the delivery of strategy and business plans
2. Technology Enablement & Digital Finance
Lead implementation and optimization of Last mile tools (BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva, Alteryx, Power BI).
Collaborate with technology teams to define system requirements, support testing, and ensure smooth deployment.
Leverage analytics, RPA, and AI-based solutions to drive continuous improvement.
3. Financial Close & Reporting Excellence
Improve close cycle timelines, accuracy of financial statements, and reconciliation efficiency.
Implement best-in-class closing calendars, governance models, and reporting frameworks.
4. Stakeholder Management & Communication
Act as a trusted advisor to client CFOs, Controllers, and Shared Services leaders.
Coordinate with cross-functional teams (FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Procurement) to ensure end-to-end process alignment.
Prepare and deliver high-quality deliverables, presentations, and reports for leadership reviews.
5. People Development & Knowledge Sharing
Contribute to firm-wide knowledge creation, methodologies, and accelerators for finance transformation projects.
Mentor junior team members and support their development through on-the-job training and feedback.
Preferred candidate profile
An ideal candidate for the Finance Solutions practice of PwC Advisory Acceleration Center should be proficient in one or more of the below:
Advising global organizations on improving efficiency and effectiveness in Record to Report processes
Have a strong business acumen, with an ability to understand how business processes and decisions impact people and organization
Ability to conduct walkthroughs, workshops and meetings involving various business stakeholders
Strong understanding of Record to Report processes (GL, Intercompany, Fixed Assets, Reconciliations, Financial Close, Inventory Accounting and Reporting).
Exposure to automation and reporting tools like BlackLine, Trintech, Floqast, ReconNet, Workiva.
Working knowledge of any digital tools and accelerators such as Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, Power Automate, Power Apps etc. would be an added advantage

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Reporting to the Customer Service Managing Director, you will build and lead a team of Managers, Consultants and Analysts and carry accountability for generating business development opportunities upwards of USD 4M. Advise boards and C-suite on where to sequence quick wins against enterprise-scale change.

Blueprint services across people, process, data and technology layers.

Define channel strategy spanning mobile app, web, WhatsApp, voice, social, store desk and associate/picker devices.

Build KPI and performance frameworks tied to customer value, growth, margin, operational efficiency and enterprise resilience outcomes.

Design conversational and agentic AI (Kore.ai, Dialogflow) intent detection, content enrichment, knowledge graphs and decisioning/policy engines.

Build service analytics, predictive/prescriptive models and root-cause analysis capability.
Human + Agentic Operations

Role Summary
Support fund accounting, financial reporting, investor reporting, and operational activities across private equity funds, co-investment vehicles, SPVs, GP entities, and management companies.
Perform accounting, reconciliations, capital activity processing, and quarter-end close within a complex alternative investment environment.
Partner with finance, fund administration, audit, tax, compliance, and investor relations teams to ensure accurate reporting and operational excellence.
Key Responsibilities
Prepare and post journal entries independently using supporting schedules, transaction documentation, and bank statements.
Perform bank reconciliations and investigate outstanding reconciling items.
Review and process fund and management company invoices and validate expense allocations.
Record accruals, prepaid amortization, management fees, and other period-end accounting adjustments.
Track and record capital calls, distributions, commitments, and investor transactions.
Support Investran reconciliations and maintain integrity between accounting and reporting systems.
Perform end-to-end quarter-end and year-end close activities.
Prepare financial statements and supporting schedules in accordance with reporting requirements.
Review financial statements for accuracy, tie-outs, cross-references, and presentation consistency.
Support preparation of investor reporting packages, capital account statements, and quarterly reporting deliverables.
Assist with regulatory, compliance, tax, and audit reporting requirements including standard reporting packages.
Manage investor queries, maintain reporting trackers, and support ad hoc accounting and operational projects.
Required Experience
5+ years of experience in Private Equity Fund Accounting, Fund Administration, Fund Operations, or Alternative Investments.
Strong understanding of private equity fund structures, partnership accounting, capital activity, and investor allocations.
Proven experience preparing journal entries independently using supporting documentation and bank statements.
Strong understanding of end-to-end quarter-end close and financial statement preparation.
Experience with reconciliations, expense allocations, accruals, and general ledger accounting.
Exposure to investor reporting, fund reporting, and audit support activities.
Advanced Excel and strong analytical skills.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
Preferred Experience
Experience with Investran.
Exposure to flagship buyout funds, co-investment structures, SPVs, and management company accounting.
Experience supporting investor reporting and regulatory reporting requirements.
Experience working with fund administrators, auditors, tax advisors, and investor relations teams.
Exposure to process improvement and automation initiatives.
Basic Information
Position Title - Senior Associate
Experience Level - 5+
Department - Private Markets
Location - Gurgaon/Bangalore
Position reports to - Delivery Manager

Description:
Tech Transformation delivery leader- Associate Director
Join our team in Technology Strategy & Transformation for an exciting career opportunity to drive large-scale complex AI led Technology Transformation programmes for our most strategic clients across the globe. You will lead the execution of enterprise-wide transformation initiatives that drive strategic business outcomes, operational excellence, and sustainable value creation across Technology Modernization, AI Enterprise Transformation, M&A and Enterprise Agility pillars.
Practice: Technology Strategy & Transformation, Global Network
Areas of Work: Tech Transformation delivery leader
Level: Associate Director
Location: Bangalore/Gurugram/Mumbai/Pune/Chennai/Kolkata/Hyderabad
Years of Exp: 17+ years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Do you thrive on leading complex transformations, improving SDLC using AI, Mainframe Modernisation, Data & AI, building domain driven Architecture and high-stakes transformation programmes? Are you a delivery leader who is passionate about complex Technology Delivery and helping CIOs, CTOs and business executives drive technology change that delivers real commercial outcomes? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
If yes, this is the right opportunity for you. Join Accenture Technology Strategy & Transformation practice and lead and deliver complex, high-value transformation portfolios for global clients. Working at C-suite level, you will take Revenue (P&L) accountability for accounts and portfolios, managing budgets from $5M to $30M, scaling delivery organisations, and ensuring transformation investments generate lasting revenue and business value. You will govern multi-programme portfolios, drive commercial growth, and serve as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation at the highest levels of client organisations.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
Technology Strategy & Transformation Practice is a part of Digital Core Reinvention Partner and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through technology transformation initiatives, aimed at modernising delivery, improving operational performance and generating measurable enterprise value.
We provide you with a strong learning environment, deep-rooted in Technology Strategy, large-scale programme delivery and business transformation, where you will work with key global clients to drive the next evolution of enterprise technology change. As part of this high-performing team, you will lead organisations through complex transformation journeys - from translating transformation vision into measurable business outcomes through disciplined execution across global teams, functions, and delivery partners. This is a delivery leadership role with direct accountability for transformation outcomes These are some of the initiatives you will support:
Enterprise Transformation Portfolio Leadership:Own and lead a portfolio of strategic transformation initiatives aligned to enterprise priorities and growth objectives, ensure transformation programs deliver measurable business outcomes, operational improvements, customer impact, and financial value. End-to-End Delivery Accountability:Assume full accountability for transformation execution from mobilization through implementation, stabilization, and value realization - including complex systems implementation, Mainframe Modernisation, and cloud-native migration programmes, lead multiple concurrent, large-scale transformation programs with significant organizational, operational, and technology complexity.Revenue Management and Financial Governance:Carry P&L accountability for accounts and portfolios with budgets of $5M-$30M; manage actuals, forecasts, margin protection, revenue recognition and commercial change control; identify and drive revenue growth opportunities and account expansions AI & Intelligent Transformation Leadership:Lead and manage scaled deployment of Agentic AI, Generative AI, automation, and digital workforce solutions as part of enterprise transformation programs, establish governance, risk management, and adoption frameworks for responsible deployment of AI-enabled transformation initiatives. Integration and Dependency Management:Govern complex multi-programme integration across internal teams, client stakeholders and third-party vendors; manage interdependencies, interface points, data migration streams and system integration programmes to ensure coherent, risk-managed portfolio delivery; lead cloud-native and API-led architecture transitions within delivery programmes Value Realisation and Benefits Framework:Track measurable transformation outcomes across the portfolio - cost reduction, revenue growth, operational efficiency, risk reduction and speed-to-market; report on value delivered at board level Global Delivery Leadership:Act as a trusted partner to C-suite executives and senior business leaders, lead executive governance forums and transformation steering committees, communicate complex delivery and business challenges clearly, providing actionable recommendations and mitigation strategies. Executive Stakeholder Leadership:Shape CxO narratives, transformation roadmaps and investment choices at portfolio level; advise on vendor strategy and scale-up plans; lead deal-shaping and account growth, representing Accenture externally and contributing to practice development and market offerings


Role Summary
As Delivery Lead Associate Director, you are accountable for the overall delivery performance of an account or portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M. You will lead high-impact delivery for programs on a scale, carry P&L accountability, and align outcomes to strategic client objectives. You will engage at C-suite level, govern Senior Manager delivery leads, drive revenue management and commercial growth, embed continuous improvement, and make decisions that carry major, lasting impact across the organisation.



Key Responsibilities

Own delivery accountability across an account or portfolio of programmes;


Define and enforce portfolio-level delivery standards, governance frameworks, and quality controls; lead the introduction and embedment of Agile delivery models, CICD practices and modern ways of working within client organisations.


Lead executive-level governance forums and Steering Committees; act as executive delivery sponsor with the client.


Manage relationships at C-suite and board level; act as a trusted strategic advisor on delivery and transformation.


Drive Agentic AI-powered transformation; articulate and demonstrate prior experience using Agentic AI in transformation contexts to clients and internal stakeholders, building confidence and adoption.


Accountability for the account P&L manage budgets of $5M-$30M, protect margin, drive revenue recognition and pursue revenue growth opportunities.


Shape and negotiate commercial terms; manage material changes to contract scope and commercial structure.


Manage and facilitate the governance of large programs comprising 50-150+ FTEs including mentoring and coaching people in the programs.


Manage risk, escalation decisions, and demand/supply balance across the portfolio.


Lead identification and scaling of continuous improvement and delivery innovation initiatives across the portfolio.


Lead deal-shaping and proposal strategy for significant account expansions and new pursuits.


Represent Accenture externally; contribute to practice development, capability strategy, and market offerings.


Qualification

What We're Looking For

17-20 years' total experience; 3-5 years proven experience managing and delivering complex portfolio of transformation programmes with budgets of $5M-$30M.


Proven ability to govern complex, multi-programme transformation portfolios in a large global services environment, with direct accountability for delivery, revenue and commercial outcomes.


Demonstrated track record of C-suite stakeholder engagement, influence, and relationship management.


Experience leading organisational change and embedding operational performance improvements at scale.


Track record of account growth, deal-shaping, and business development alongside delivery execution.


Strong executive presence:communicates with clarity and gravitas; builds trust with senior audiences rapidly.


Must have experience of working across at least one of the following areas; Technology Modernization, Mainframe Modernisation, AI Enterprise Transformation, Complex Delivery, Enterprise Agility

Set yourself apart:
Mastery of managing complex deliveries coordinating with more than one supplier with multiple dependencies and work plans
Experience delivering cloud-native transformation programmes leveraging Cloud Technologies (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), microservices architectures, API-led integration, or SaaS platforms
Experience of delivering transformation at scale within a highly regulated or complex industry sector
Cloud/Industry and Programme Management certifications and credentials
Demonstrate a strong Technical and Emotional Quotient





Qualifications & Certifications

Bachelor's degree (relevant discipline); Master's / MBA strongly preferred.


PMP, MSP, or equivalent programme management certification.


SAFe, or equivalent Agile certification.


Cloud/enterprise platform certifications (AWS, Azure, Guidewire, SAP, ServiceNow etc.) - advantageous.

What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on transformative projects with key G2000 clients
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Position Title-Delivery Lead- Salesforce Business Partner
Department-Sales operations
Location-Gurgaon/ Bangalore/ Colombo
Position reports to-Associate Director - Sales Operations / Global Sales Operations
Job Summary
To provide hands-on ownership of Acuity's enterprise Salesforce ecosystem across user support, platform administration, data management, integration, enhancements and user enablement. The role will translate business needs into secure, scalable CRM solutions; strengthen data quality; support responsible AI adoption; and turn Salesforce data into actionable commercial insight.
Another important angle will be to improve forecasting accuracy by developing repeatable, data-led approaches that use opening pipeline position, conversion, win rates, sales cycle dynamics and deal level signals to better anticipate quarterly and year-end sales outcomes.
Responsibilities
Business-facing support and ownership: Act as the primary contact for Salesforce incidents, service requests, enhancements and user queries; manage intake, prioritization, communication, resolution and escalation; provide training, release updates and clear documentation.
Salesforce administration: Manage users, licenses, profiles, permission sets, roles, sharing settings and access reviews; configure Flows, approvals, validation and assignment rules, record types, page layouts, Dynamic Forms and Lightning pages; maintain reports, dashboards, queues and notifications.
Platform development and continuous improvement: Apply configuration-first thinking while using Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL and APIs where appropriate; troubleshoot defects, address root causes, reduce technical debt and coordinate environments, deployments and post-release validation.
Integrations and data management: Support Salesforce integrations with ERP, billing, CPQ, e-signature, marketing and other enterprise platforms; oversee APIs, authentication, middleware, monitoring and error handling; lead migration, cleansing, deduplication, reconciliation, backup and validation activities.
AI, analytics and forecasting: Build operational and executive dashboards covering pipeline, conversion, sales, forecasting, revenue, customers, adoption and service performance; establish repeatable predictive methods to forecast quarterly and year-end landing positions using opening pipeline, stage conversion, win rates, sales-cycle velocity, slippage and deal-level risk; identify and deliver high-value use cases using Agent force, Einstein and related capabilities.
Governance, risk and documentation: Maintain effective release, change, backup, testing and deployment controls; support audits and ITGC requirements; maintain solution designs, SOPs, configuration inventories, deployment records and user guidance; coordinate vendors while retaining clear internal accountability.
Stakeholder partnership: Work closely with Sales, Finance, Marketing, Billing, Delivery, IT and external partners to support connected Lead-to-Order and Order-to-Cash processes, including merger and acquisition initiatives.
Key Competencies
Customer and support orientation: Approachable and accountable front line for Salesforce users.
Technical depth: Strong knowledge of Sales Cloud, Flow, Apex, Lightning Web Components, SOQL/SOSL, APIs, testing and deployment, balancing configuration-first thinking with development and integration capability.
Commercial forecasting and analytical judgement: Converts CRM data into reliable forecasts, early-warning indicators and practical actions for Sales Leadership; challenges assumptions and explains variance clearly.
AI and automation mindset: Identifies AI and automation opportunities that simplify day to day business processes
Ownership and delivery: Takes responsibility from problem definition through design, delivery, validation, adoption and support.
Communication and stakeholder management: Make complex principles easy to understand and explain technical and analytical topics clearly to users, technical teams and senior leadership.
Continuous improvement: Identifies opportunities for automation, simplification, innovation and improved user experience.
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in computer science preferred but Information Systems, Engineering, Analytics or a related discipline considered too, Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification required, with Sales Cloud Consultant, Platform Developer, Omni studio, CPQ, platform data architect or Agent force certification advantageous.

Result-oriented approach with a flair to solve problems in a diverse, multi-cultural environment.
Excellent with strong business acumen

Integrated business perspective
Business acumen

Cross cultural competence

Description:
Technology Strategy - IT Service Management (ITSM) Strategy & Transformation Manager
Practice:Technology Strategy & Advisory, Capability Network IAreas of Work:Analyze, Design & Deliver ITSM strategy, process design, and operating model advisory to enhance service management maturity for clients ILevel:Manager | Location:Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore | Years of Exp:8-14 Years
Explore an Exciting Career at Accenture
Are you passionate about leveraging technology for large-scale transformation and innovation for global clients? Are you passionate about being part of an inclusive, diverse and collaborative culture?
Then, this is the right place for you! Welcome to a host of exciting global opportunities in Accenture Technology Strategy & Advisory.
The Practice - A Brief Sketch
The Practice is a part of and focuses on our clients' most strategic priorities. We help clients achieve growth and efficiency through innovative R&D transformation, aimed at redefining business models.
We provide you with a great learning ground, where you will get an opportunity to advice and work with our key global clients, driving end-to-end transformative strategic value and business growth. You would be working with senior leaders at client organizations and partner with them to create strategic solutions at the intersection of business, technology, and operations. As a part of this high performing team, these are some of the initiatives you will drive:
Business problem assessment: Engage with client stakeholders to assess ITSM pain points and current-state service management capabilities, define problem statements, scope engagements, and drive project workstreams to deliver measurable outcomes
Process Design & Analysis:Analyze client ITSM processes across key functions (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, CMDB, Service Catalog, etc.) to identify maturity gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities, and develop structured recommendations for process re-engineering and operating model enhancement
ITSM Transformation Delivery:Lead specific workstreams/modules within ITSM transformation programs, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality outputs and alignment with client objectives
Value Realization:Guide your team in designing ITSM target-state processes and operating model constructs that translate client objectives into practical, achievable transformation roadmaps. Contribute to defining KPIs/OKRs and tracking improvement in service quality, cost optimization, automation, and user experience
Understand and apply the key service management levers of a business, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement
Innovation & Modernization: Support adoption of next-gen ITSM capabilities such as AIOps, automation, and AI-driven service management solutions
Ensure Continued Success: Support and develop junior team members; contribute to building ITSM frameworks, reusable assets, and accelerators; assist in GTM activities and support business development efforts in the ITSM consulting space
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
(5-8) years of relevant consulting experience in IT Service Management, with hands-on exposure to ITSM assessments, process design, and operating model development. Strong skills in structuring analysis, building client narratives, and crafting compelling deliverables in PowerPoint and other formats.
Good understanding across multiple ITSM domains including Incident Management, Problem Management, Change & Release Management, Service Request Management, CMDB/Asset Management, Service Catalog, and Knowledge Management. Preferred experience in ITSM strategy and operating model design.
(5-8) years of relevant experience in ITSM process re-engineering, operating model design, and service integration and management (SIAM). Familiarity with the ITSM tooling landscape (e.g., ServiceNow, JIRA Service Management, BMC Remedy/Helix, Ivanti) from a consulting advisory standpoint is a plus.
Practical exposure to modern ITSM trends including AIOps, AI/GenAI-led service management, automation, and self-healing operations
Understanding of ITSM-ITOM convergence, including CMDB, event management, and observability integration
Hands-on consulting skills include CXO-level communication, structured problem solving, stakeholder management, and team collaboration. Ability to synthesize complex ITSM concepts into clear, actionable client recommendations.
3+ years of experience developing ITSM maturity assessments, process design documents, and transformation business cases to support strategic IT service management initiatives
Quickly understand the key ITSM and service management levers of an organization, how they impact the scope and approach of the engagement
Advanced presentation, public speaking skills and ability to drive C-suite/senior leadership level discussions
Ability to manage ITSM engagement planning, scoping, and workstream management activities and contribute to client proposals and project planning documentation
Proficiency in ITSM maturity assessment frameworks, process mapping, and the ability to translate findings into executive-ready presentations and structured recommendations
Maximize capacity to develop high impact thought leadership that articulates a forward-thinking view of the market and work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment.
Promote a culture of experimentation and innovation.
Read more about us.


Qualification
Your experience counts!
MBA from a tier 1 institute
Working experience across:
10-14 years of experience in IT/technology consulting, with a strong focus on ITSM strategy, process design, and service management transformation
7+ years of relevant experience in ITSM process design and re-engineering, service management operating model design, and ITSM consulting delivery
Solid knowledge of ITSM frameworks (ITIL 4, VeriSM, COBIT) and their practical application in enterprise service management environments
Awareness of and interest in emerging ITSM trends including AI-driven service management, AIOps, intelligent automation, and next-generation service desk models
Working knowledge of ITSM frameworks and standards-e.g., ITIL 4, VeriSM, SIAM, COBIT-and core ITSM process areas such as Incident, Problem, Change, CMDB, and Service Catalog management. General awareness of the ITSM tooling landscape is beneficial but not a requirement
Practical industry expertise in Financial Services, Retail, Consumer Goods, Telecommunications, Life Sciences, Transportation, Hospitality, Automotive/Industrial, Mining and Resources is of interest but experience in equivalent domains is also welcome.
What's in it for you?
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Contribute to the development and execution of organizational and practice initiatives.

 Qualification

The Opportunity

As a Workday Financials Delivery Manager at PwC AC, you will lead delivery across Workday Financial Management engagements with a focus on Record to Report (R2R), Procure to Pay (P2P), and overall delivery coordination.
The role combines strong Workday Financials functional knowledge with delivery leadership. You will coordinate across functional and technical workstreams, manage priorities and dependencies, oversee quality and timelines, and act as a key point of contact for client and internal stakeholders.

Strong functional knowledge of R2R and/or P2P, with good understanding of end-to-end financial business processes.
Experience across key Workday Financials capabilities such as Accounting, Supplier Accounts, Procurement, Expenses, Banking, Settlement and related business processes.
Experience leading or coordinating multiple functional and technical workstreams within Workday implementations, optimization programs or managed-services engagements.
Strong understanding of the Workday delivery lifecycle, including requirements, solution design, configuration, testing, deployment and production support.
Ability to review functional solutions, identify cross-workstream impacts and guide teams toward scalable solutions.
Experience managing client stakeholders, priorities, escalations and competing delivery demands.

Experience mentoring and developing junior team members and providing functional direction.
Experience across both R2R and P2P is preferred; deep expertise in one with good working knowledge of the other is acceptable.

Why Technology Consulting
The Technology Consulting business within Global Network invents the future for clients by providing them with the right guidance, design thinking and innovative solutions for technological transformation. As technology rapidly evolves, it is more important than ever to have an innovation advisor who can create a new vision or put one into place to solve the client''s toughest business problems. Specialise in management or technology consulting to transform the world''s leading organisations by building innovative business solutions as their trusted advisor by:
Helping Clients: Rethinking IT and Digital ecosystems and innovating to help clients keep pace with fast-changing, customer-driven environments.
Enhancing your Skillset: Building expertise and innovating with leading-edge technologies such as Cloud, Artificial Intelligence and Platform Engineering.
Transforming Businesses: Developing customized, next-generation products and services that help clients shift to new business models designed for today''s connected landscape of disruptive technologies.
Principal Duties & Responsibilities
Overview
Own and lead large-scale GCP cloud architecture advisory programs for enterprise clients ?? setting the overall architecture vision, governance approach, and delivery strategy. Serve as the executive trusted advisor to CTO, CIO, and senior technology leaders, translating complex GCP architecture decisions into clear business outcomes. Define the target-state GCP architecture including Cloud Foundation Blueprints, Resource Hierarchy (Organization, Folders, Projects), and Organization Policy configurations that set the standards teams work within.
Shape the cloud security architecture stance for client engagements ?? setting Zero Trust principles, IAM governance models, VPC Service Controls, Security Command Center configurations, and policy-as-code frameworks that downstream teams implement.
Define the FinOps strategy and financial governance model for client GCP estates ?? setting Committed Use Discount (CUD) strategies, chargeback and showback models, and multi-year cost optimisation roadmaps using GCP Billing and the Recommender API. Own the quantification of cost savings and present these to CFO and CIO-level stakeholders.
Set the IaC and platform engineering standards for client engagements ?? defining governance, tooling choices (Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, Config Connector), and architectural patterns that ensure consistency and scalability. Own the observability architecture strategy, defining monitoring frameworks across Google Cloud Operations Suite and third-party platforms such as Datadog and Dynatrace.
Beyond core GCP architecture, shape how the practice engages across adjacent areas ?? defining the AI-ready cloud foundation for AI and agentic workloads using Vertex AI, Gemini on GCP, and Google Agentspace; setting the cloud architecture standards that Tech Modernization and Technology Resiliency colleagues build upon; and leading ecosystem advisory covering Google Cloud partner strategy, ISV/MSP rationalisation, and CUD/SUD commercial model evaluation.
Lead business development activities including RFP and RFI responses, solutioning for large cloud architecture and transformation programs, client presentations at CTO/CIO level. Shape and evolve cloud architecture advisory offerings, reference architectures, and methodologies that strengthen the practice.
Build practice capability through asset development, methodologies, and points of view.
Qualification
Qualifications
Educational Background
Bachelor''s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a closely related technical discipline. Proven experience owning the end-to-end GCP architecture vision for large transformation programs ?? setting target-state designs, defining Cloud Foundation Blueprint and Resource Hierarchy standards, and governing architecture quality across delivery teams.
Deep experience shaping cloud security posture for enterprise clients ?? defining Zero Trust frameworks, IAM governance models, VPC Service Controls, Security Command Center strategy, and policy-as-code approaches at program level.
Experience defining and owning FinOps strategy for large GCP estates ?? building multi-year cost models, setting Committed Use Discount frameworks, quantifying savings, and presenting financial outcomes to CFO and CIO-level stakeholders.
Experience leading cross-capability cloud architecture programs spanning AI infrastructure, application modernisation, and technology resiliency ?? positioning the GCP platform as the foundational layer, particularly leveraging GCP''s data and AI strengths via BigQuery, Vertex AI, and Gemini.

FUNCTIONAL COMPETENCIES
Executive presence, storytelling, and synthesis ?? able to advise CTO, CIO, and CFO-level stakeholders on cloud architecture strategy, platform choices, and investment decisions, translating technical complexity into clear strategic narratives.
Cloud architecture strategy and roadmap development ?? able to assess current-state cloud estates, identify architecture gaps, define target-state designs, and build pragmatic transformation roadmaps aligned to business priorities.
Structured problem-solving under ambiguity ?? able to frame cloud architecture challenges, evaluate trade-offs across cost, performance, security, and resilience dimensions, and produce actionable recommendations.
Financial and commercial acumen ?? able to build cloud business cases, evaluate hyperscaler commercial models, quantify FinOps value levers, and support investment decisions across cloud platform choices.
Business development and solutioning leadership ?? experience shaping RFP responses, leading large solutioning efforts, and building cloud advisory propositions that differentiate the practice in the market.
TECHNICAL COMPETENCIES
GCP cloud architecture ?? expert-level mastery of Cloud Foundation Blueprints, Resource Hierarchy design, Organisation Policies, VPC and Cloud Interconnect networking, compute (Compute Engine, GKE, Cloud Run, Cloud Functions), storage (Cloud Storage, Filestore), databases (Cloud SQL, AlloyDB, Spanner, BigQuery, Bigtable), IAM, Security Command Center, and Google Cloud Operations Suite. Able to define architecture standards and govern quality across large programs. Working knowledge of AWS and Azure for cross-cloud advisory.
Cloud security architecture ?? expert ability to define Zero Trust frameworks, IAM governance models, VPC Service Controls, Security Command Center strategy, and policy-as-code approaches at program and enterprise level.
Cloud FinOps ?? expert ability to define multi-year FinOps strategies, set Committed Use Discount frameworks, build executive-facing cost models, and quantify value from rightsizing and architectural optimisation using GCP Billing and the Recommender API.
Infrastructure as code and platform engineering ?? expert advisory fluency across Terraform, Cloud Deployment Manager, Config Connector, Cloud Build, and Cloud Deploy; able to set IaC governance standards and define DevSecOps pipeline design for large programs.
Observability architecture ?? expert ability to define enterprise observability strategies using Google Cloud Operations Suite (Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Logging, Cloud Trace) and third-party platforms such as Datadog and Dynatrace.
Containers and cloud-native patterns ?? deep knowledge of Kubernetes (GKE, Cloud Run), Anthos Config Management, microservices architecture, serverless patterns, and cloud-native developer platform design; able to advise on platform engineering strategy.
AI and agentic AI infrastructure ?? expert advisory knowledge of Vertex AI, Gemini on GCP, Google Agentspace, and BigQuery ML; able to define AI-ready landing zone standards, GPU and TPU environment strategy, and enterprise-scale AI infrastructure frameworks.
Ecosystem advisory ?? deep knowledge of Google Cloud partner ecosystem, ISV/MSP landscape, CUD/SUD commercial models, and Google alliance strategy; able to advise clients on build-buy-partner decisions at enterprise level.

Overview

Job Description
This role is part of the Marketing function and is responsible for driving strategy, market development, commercialization, and lifecycle management across assigned products and therapeutic areas. The Marketing team partners closely with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional stakeholders to identify growth opportunities, accelerate adoption, and deliver sustainable business results through customer-focused strategies.
This position is based in Gurgaon, India and operates in a Flex work model, combining on-site and remote work based on business needs. Travel of approximately 35-40% is expected to support customer engagement, market development activities, internal collaboration, and business initiatives across regions.
The Marketing Manager is responsible for developing and executing product, portfolio, and market strategies that drive commercial growth and customer impact. This individual will translate customer, market, and competitive insights into actionable strategies, lead commercialization initiatives, and influence cross-functional teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. The role requires strong strategic thinking, analytical rigor, and accountability from opportunity identification through execution.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned.
Develop and execute product, portfolio, and market strategies aligned with commercial and business objectives.
Analyse customer, market, competitive, and business data to identify growth opportunities, unmet needs, and emerging market trends.
Lead product planning, commercialization, launch execution, market development, and lifecycle management 
initiatives.
Define customer segmentation, product positioning, value propositions, and go-to-market strategies to improve market performance.
Partner with Sales, Research & Development, Clinical, Medical Affairs, Regulatory, Finance, Operations, and regional teams to deliver strategic priorities.
Monitor business performance, evaluate return on investment, and optimise marketing programmes, resource allocation, and investments.
Influence stakeholders across functions and geographies to build alignment, support decision-making, and drive execution of key initiatives.
Manage project timelines, budgets, risks, and resources to ensure successful delivery of high-impact programmes.

Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related discipline and 10+ years of experience in marketing, product management, commercial strategy, market development, or related commercial roles; MBA from a premier business school required.
Demonstrated experience developing and executing product, portfolio, or commercial strategies that delivered measurable business results.
Experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and business functions.
Strong analytical capability with experience translating market, customer, competitive, and business insights into strategic recommendations.
Experience managing commercialization, product launch, market development, or lifecycle management activities.

Preferred Qualifications
Experience within MedTech, healthcare, medical devices, diagnostics, biotechnology, or life sciences industries.
Experience leading regional or multi-country marketing initiatives and influencing stakeholders across geographies.
People leadership experience, including coaching, mentoring, or managing marketing professionals.
Experience with portfolio optimisation, market access strategies, and customer engagement planning.
Advanced proficiency in business analytics, forecasting, market assessment, and strategic planning methodologies.

Description:
Role Purpose
The Software Procurement intern is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end lifecycle of global software assets, software procurement processes, and supplier contracts at Thoughtworks. This role ensures cost efficiency, streamlined workflows, timely supplier payments, regulatory compliance, and seamless cross-functional collaboration across GITS, InfoSec, Finance, Accounts Payable, and Legal departments.
Key Responsibilities
Learn and work closely with Software Procurement Lead on below mention responsibilities:
1. Procurement Operations & Purchase Management
End-to-End Workflow Optimisation: Direct and analyse the efficiency of software procurement processes, from request ingestion to inventory updating
Coupa Platform Management: Initiate supplier onboarding forms, monitor supplier statuses until active, and create/publish Purchase Orders (POs) and Virtual Contracts in Coupa
Requisition Approvals: Act as the designated Global Procurement Approver and authorise high-value requisitions (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) on behalf of the Global Software Lead.
Manage Credit Card Spend: Manage monthly or annual subscriptions that are on credit card and submit weekly expense reports in Expensify; allocating cost accurately.Manage multiple domain registrars: Register and renew domains, working closely with LegalAWS account provisioning: Work closely with CloudOps team on provisioning / deprovisioning AWS accounts including management of login credentials
2. Vendor Relationship & Renewal Management
Vendor Coordination: Manage direct communication with major global SaaS vendors (e.g., JetBrains, LinkedIn, Snowflake, Sisense, Pearson VUE) regarding quotes, order forms, and payment terms.
Renewal Pipeline Tracking: Partner with external procurement platforms to monitor renewal deadlines, evaluate license needs, coordinate stakeholder feedback, and schedule retirements of legacy software.
3. Financial & Budget Governance
Invoice & Payment Resolution: Partner closely with Accounts Payable (AP) to verify receipts, resolve billing discrepancies, split invoices manually, and escalate critical past-due accounts.
Budgeting & Cost Allocation: Monitor license allocations and manage pay-as-you-go or credit-based models to optimize spend and ensure unused credits do not expire.
Cost Distribution Mapping: Distribute software costs accurately among business units, regions (DEC/POH), and specific accounts or departments by aligning data from Jigsaw and other tools.
4. Software Entitlement & Compliance Management
Software Asset Management (SAM): Track active software assets and license assignments via ServiceNow (SNOW). Requires close coordination with multiple teams.
Risk & Regulatory Compliance: Collaborate with GITS, InfoSec, and regional legal leads to verify software compliance, evaluate export regulations (such as the Remote Access Security Act), and implement geographic usage restrictions.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Learn and build following skills (tools/applications and Soft skills:
Procurement Platforms: High proficiency in Coupa Software, ServiceNow, Expensify and Zendesk.
Negotiation & Financial Acumen: Strong capability in analyzing pricing models (pay-as-you-go, subscription, credit-based, or enterprise commitments) and driving cost splits across departments.
Collaboration & Stakeholder Alignment: Exceptional cross-functional relationship-building skills, specifically with Finance, AP, Legal (contracts/compliance), GITS, and InfoSec.

Description:
Virtual Engagement Solutions (Remote Sales) is focused on expanding customer reach, increasing engagement with existing and prospective accounts, and driving commercial growth through remote customer interactions. VES partners with sales leaders across multiple Medtronic Operating Units to identify opportunities, support market development initiatives, and improve access to Medtronic therapies through a scalable virtual engagement model.
This role leads remote sales activities across the North, East, and West regions of India, supporting a broad portfolio of businesses and customer segments. The position is preferably based in Gurugram, with Mumbai also considered, and operates in a primarily office-based environment where virtual engagement is the primary mode of customer and stakeholder interaction. Travel is expected up to 25% for business reviews, team engagement activities, customer meetings, and key stakeholder interactions.
The Remote Sales Supervisor will lead the expansion and execution of the Virtual Engagement Solutions (VES) model across North, East, and West India. This role combines people leadership, strategic account management, pipeline oversight, business development, and cross-functional collaboration to drive commercial growth through remote sales channels. The position is responsible for building team capability, supporting market expansion, and delivering commercial objectives across multiple Operating Units.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:
Build, lead, and develop a high-performing team of 6-7 remote sales representatives to deliver annual operating plan objectives across assigned regions.
Manage and grow a portfolio of strategic customer accounts, driving engagement, opportunity development, and commercial outcomes through virtual interactions.
Partner with commercial leaders and stakeholders across multiple Operating Units to identify growth opportunities and execute market development initiatives.
Expand Medtronic's presence within new and underserved accounts through targeted remote engagement strategies and customer outreach programmes.
Monitor sales pipelines, account targeting activities, opportunity progression, forecasting, and reporting to maximise commercial performance.
Coach and develop direct reports through performance management, capability building, and sales effectiveness initiatives.
Analyse sales performance data, market trends, and customer insights to identify opportunities for revenue growth, market share expansion, and process improvement.
Lead planning, coordination, reporting, and implementation of VES projects and operational initiatives across supported businesses.

Required Knowledge and Experience:
Bachelor's degree with a strong academic record and a minimum of 8 years of relevant experience, including 5+ years of team management, product marketing, sales leadership, or commercial management experience.

Preferred:
Experience within the medical device, healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceutical, or related healthcare industry.
Experience managing inside sales, remote sales, contact centre, virtual sales, or customer engagement teams.
3+ years of people management experience leading, coaching, and developing teams of 6-7 or more direct reports.
Experience supporting multiple business units, product portfolios, or matrixed commercial organisations.
Knowledge of account development, market expansion, customer engagement strategies, and data-driven sales performance management across diverse geographic regions.
AboutCompany: Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

Description:
Lead - Business Development

About the Role:
The role will spearhead strategic revenue growth by driving enterprise customer acquisition and expansion across key verticals and geographies. The role demands deep industry insight, strong solutioning capability, and the ability to build executive relationships within large organizations. As a senior leader, you will own the go-to-market strategy, shape high-value logistics solutions for clients, and build a scalable and high-performing BD team.

Key Responsibilities:
Drive Revenue Growth: Lead and deliver aggressive revenue targets on a monthly and quarterly basis through new customer acquisition and strategic account expansion in the logistics and supply chain domain.
Enterprise Sales Ownership: Identify, engage, and convert large B2B clients particularly those with complex freight, warehousing, and distribution needs across industries such as retail, FMCG, manufacturing, and e-commerce.
Market Development: Launch and scale presence in new geographies; perform competitive intelligence, demand mapping, and localization of offerings to suit regional market dynamics.
Team Leadership: Build, mentor, and lead a high-impact BD team; establish scalable processes for lead generation, funnel management, and account growth.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Operations, Product, Pricing, and Finance to develop compelling proposals, pilot programs, and commercial models.
Performance Tracking: Own pipeline forecasting, sales performance metrics, and revenue attribution; regularly report to executive leadership on growth performance and strategic initiatives.
Client Success & Retention: Ensure seamless client onboarding, continuous engagement, and upselling of adjacent logistics services such as reverse logistics, express delivery, or value-added services.

Preferred Background & Skills:
5+ years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a strong focus on logistics, LTL/PTL, freight forwarding, 3PL/4PL, or supply chain tech platforms.
Strong track record of closing complex enterprise deals, especially in contract logistics, transportation management, and integrated logistics solutions.
Deep understanding of supply chain processes including LTL, FTL, warehousing, distribution networks, and logistics tech platforms.
Data-driven, solution-oriented mindset with strong commercial acumen.
Ability to work in a high-growth, agile environment with rapidly evolving priorities.
Local market knowledge or regional exposure is a strong advantage.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.
CompanyAddress: PLOT NO. 5 SECTOR 44 GURGAON , GURGAON, Haryana, India

About the Role
Are you a strategic operational leader with a strong track record in managing external service providers and driving operational excellence within a shared services environment? We are seeking a highly capable Regional BPO Manager to take ownership of all contractual and performance aspects of our Business Process Outsourcing (BPO) and Shared Service Centre (SSC) partners.
In this strategic management role, you will act as the vital bridge between our regional business stakeholders and our external BPO service provider across multiple outsourced process streams. While functional Tower Leads manage day-to-day process execution, you will ensure our BPO partners deliver against contractual commitments, achieve financial efficiency targets, maintain high customer satisfaction, and execute seamless process transitions.
Key Responsibilities
Contract & Commercial Management: Manage and coordinate all aspects of the BPO partner contract for the region. Oversee invoicing, timesheets, FTE approvals, volume modifications, service onboarding, and the tracking of contractual cost savings.
Relationship & Governance Ownership: Serve as the primary operational contact between internal regional business leadership and service provider management, driving alignment and acting as the escalation point for issue resolution.
Performance Management: Implement and maintain performance management frameworks using contractual KPIs and SLAs to ensure alignment with organizational benchmarks.
Regional Service Reviews: Lead regular Regional Service Reviews covering performance evaluations, issue mitigation, and future continuous improvement initiatives across all regional markets.
Transition Management: Oversee the onboarding and implementation of newly outsourced process workstreams into standard Business-As-Usual (BAU) operations.
Change Governance: Develop and execute the formal change note approval process for contractual and scope updates.
Customer Satisfaction & Insights: Implement periodic internal customer satisfaction survey processes, translating stakeholder feedback into joint action plans with service providers to address operational gaps.
Financial & Budgetary Control: Manage annual and in-year financial budgets for shared service operations, ensuring partner costs accurately reflect productivity gains, scope shifts, and volume changes.
Risk & Quality Framework: Establish risk and control processes governing vendor activities while championing standard process documentation across provider teams.
Role Deliverables
Outsourced process operations delivered consistently within contractually agreed KPIs and SLAs.
Measurable productivity and efficiency savings achieved through structured process improvements.
Transparent, budget-aligned service provider costs reflecting volume dynamics, expanded scope, and savings targets.
Successful execution of the annual Customer Satisfaction Survey process with clear action plans implemented.
Required Skills and Experience
Outsourcing Expertise: Proven experience in managing complex, large-scale outsourced process operations across multi-location environments.
Performance Management: Track record of developing, monitoring, and driving vendor performance using structured KPI and SLA frameworks.
Process Transformation: Demonstrated ability to deliver process efficiency and continuous improvement initiatives through SSC and BPO models.
Financial & Commercial Acumen: Hands-on experience developing and managing operational budgets, complex commercial contracts, and vendor change notes.
Functional Knowledge: Practical working knowledge of core Finance and HR process flows.
Stakeholder & Negotiation Skills: Excellent negotiation and bridge-building capabilities with the ability to translate complex process problems into clear, actionable, high-impact strategies for internal leadership and external partners.
AboutCompany: Founded in 1989, G4S India is the leading security solutions group in the country. The company today has more than 160,000 employees with a strong network of over 200 branches and regional offices spread throughout India. Besides its core business of Secure Solutions, Cash Solutions, Security Systems, G4S offers a range of services including Training, Facilities Management, Aviation Security, Central Monitoring, Garment Manufacturing, Recruitment &amp;amp;amp; Placement, IT, Asset Tracking and Security Consultancy. As a worldwide security solutions provider, G4S operates in more than 125 countries. We manage a workforce of nearly 657,000 employees worldwide.

Job Description:
Core Finance Change Delivery
Key Responsibilities
Avaloq - Monthly Goca Maintenance
Support the maintenance and updates of the Chart of Accounts of the Private Bank entities using the Avaloq Core Banking System - Swiss, Luxembourg, Guernsey, UK, Hong Kong, Singapore - by ensuring this is following the Groups FTP Chart of Account
Analyse demands regarding Grca, FTP and Goca changes, and provide clear guidance and conclusion in the usage of these figures for each Private Bank entities using the Avaloq Core Banking System.
Avaloq Changes
Support in designing solutions and in implementing each demand (Jira's), by analysing the technical requirements, by liaising with concerned stakeholders (Finance and IT), and by performing needed tests in the change workflow (DEV, SIT, UAT) into Avaloq.
Avaloq Implementations
Perform all testing regarding latest implementation of Avaloq, as per accounting perspective
=>Testing Balancing Rules lifecycle for each Product
=>Testing Booking rules lifecycle for each Product - analysing the usage of the Bookind in Avaloq

Data Controls
Organize and perform controls on important amount of data, highlight the inconsistencies that might appear, understand the reasons of these, and liaise with concerned stakeholders to implement needed changes.

Product Owner Administration
Follow up on Product Owner subjects (jiras).

Customers / Stakeholders
Build strong relationships within GPB Finance teams, and IT teams
Be accountable to present clear solutions within changes and implementation for new requirements

Leadership & Teamwork
Collaborative behaviours, actively share ideas / approaches with the rest of the GPB Finance teams
Utilise fully the onshore / offshore operating model

Operational Effectiveness & Control
Ensure all work is completed in accordance with appropriate Group Standard and practices
Provide assurance that any process risks identified are highlighted and managed as appropriate
Support all regulatory and compliance matters and the management of operational risk

Major Challenges
Be able to cover a wide range of financial matters and products from accounting perspective
Partner with the Finance teams to achieve a strong and accurate maintenance of the Avaloq Chart of Account

Management of Risk
Ensure all actions take account of the likelihood of operational risk occurring
Addressing any areas of concern in conjunction with line management and/or the appropriate department

Observation of Internal Controls
Maintains internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit points together with any issues raised by external regulators
Understands, follows and demonstrates compliance with all relevant internal and external rules, regulations and procedures that apply to the conduct of the business in which the jobholder is involved, specifically Internal Controls and any Compliance policy including, inter alia, the Group Compliance policy

Requirements
Knowledge of IFRSs and awareness of banking/finance concepts
Strong working knowledge in MS Office tools
Being able to handle simple source systems with no guidance and complex source systems with limited guidance
Proven evidence of strong communication skills used to successfully lead, coordinate and conclude business discussion sessions
Ability to initiate and drive discussions with key stakeholders to effective conclusion
Capable of organizing and managing day to day activities/initiatives for self & team independently
Good team player with proven ability of working with colleagues within & outside of own functional area/team
Ability to multi-task on activities within & outside of the immediate functional area/team
Demonstrate capability to learn and improve self & team's performance on an on-going basis
Proven team working and change management skills
Mind set of continuous improvement and aiming for excellence
Consistently demonstrate integrity, fairness and professional conduct

What additional skills will be good to have?
Knowledge of FTP Chart of Account, GRCA and FTP Global mappings
