Description:
Experience Management Supervising Associate
About Global Delivery Services:
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
The Opportunity:
As a part of a team, you will act as a Resource Management Hub Deputy Manager who provides consistent, high quality services to key individual stakeholders.
Your Key Responsibilities:
Service Delivery Leadership:
Manage end-to-end resource fulfilment, ensuring alignment with delivery timelines and business priorities.
Oversee billing and finance operations related to resource deployment, ensuring accuracy and compliance.
Own headcount planning to support growth and efficiency.
Champion and lead Strategic Experience Management initiatives, aligning resource strategy with long-term business objectives.
Monitor and improve service levels, turnaround times, and stakeholder satisfaction.
Planning & Optimization:
Forecast demand and plan capacity across skill sets.
Maximize bench utilization and redeployment efficiency.
Collaborate with Talent Acquisition and HR to align hiring plans with pipeline and delivery needs.
Performance Management:
Establish and track KPIs for resource performance, utilization, and productivity.
Conduct regular reviews with delivery leads to assess individual and team performance.
Stakeholder Management:
Act as a strategic partner to delivery, business leaders.
Facilitate governance forums to review resource allocation, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Resolve escalations related to staffing conflicts, skill mismatches, or delivery risks.
Data & Analytics:
Maintain accurate dashboards and reports on resource availability, utilization, and forecasting.
Use data-driven insights to inform decision-making and identify improvement opportunities.
Skills and attributes for success:
Hands on knowledge on End to End Resource management
Be proficient in MS Project/Word/PowerPoint/Excel - working knowledge of MS office
Knowledge in Data Visualisation tools would be an added advantage
Exceptional communication skills - both written and oral
Demonstrate strong organizational skills and structured thinking abilities
Demonstrate strong interpersonal and analytical skills
Demonstrate an eye for detail
Be flexible and willing to adjust responsibilities to align with developing business needs
Flexibility to adjust to multiple demands, shifting priorities, ambiguity and rapid change
To qualify for the role, you must have:
Graduate / MBA (HR) with 12-14 years of overall experience with 8+ years of relevant experience in E2E resource management, deployment, forecasting and scheduling concepts.
Exposure of short term and long-term resource planning would be an added advantage.
What we look for:
A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
An opportunity to be part of a market-leading, multi-disciplinary team in the only integrated global assurance business worldwide.
Opportunity to work with EY GDS practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries
What we offer you:
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
Our Commitment: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
Professional Development: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
People and Culture: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
Benefits: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
How to Apply: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy

EY | Building a better working world
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Description:
Job description
Key Responsibilities:
As a Learning Design & Development practitioner, you will play a key role in helping clients navigate their transformation challenges by designing and building the learning solutions that carry those transformations, owning the work from curriculum architecture through to release-ready assets. You will provide tailored learning solutions to enhance workforce capabilities, optimize HR functions, and support long-term organizational success. By offering insights into company culture and designing impactful learning programs, you will help clients build a skilled, adaptable workforce that drives performance and growth
As such, the key responsibilities for this position include (but are not limited to):
Engagement Delivery
Delivering learning solutions for technology driven or culture-based client transformation journey, by including (but not limiting to) the below skill sets:
Learning Strategies:
Instructional Design (ID) or Learning Experience Design (LXD) with a strong command of adult learning principles and instructional strategies, and working fluency in recognized frameworks - ADDIE and/or SAM, Blooms taxonomy for objective setting, and Kirkpatrick for evaluation.
Demonstrate a deep understanding of business operations and ERP and HCM solutions like Workday, Oracle, SAP, etc.
Learning Activities:
Collaborate with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to deliver Training Needs Analysis, Curriculum design, role-based learning plans and blended training solutions.
Ability to use a variety of collaboration tools available to the client to run workshops and presentations.
Ability to develop engaging scenarios, activities, and assessments for blended learning solutions.
Hands-on proficiency with industry-standard authoring and multimedia tools - Articulate Storyline and Rise 360, Adobe Captivate, Camtasia, Vyond, or equivalent - to build visually engaging learning assets.
Publish and troubleshoot content on an LMS or LXP, including SCORM/xAPI packaging and versioning, and build to accessibility standards (WCAG 2.1 / Section 508).
Work directly with clients to support engagement delivery spanning across phases of analysis, design, development, and implementation of training.
Learning Effectiveness:
Evaluate the effectiveness of learning programs against Kirkpatrick Levels 13 using a range of methods - reaction surveys, knowledge checks, and on-the-job performance measures.
Continuously improve learning programs based on feedback, industry best practices, and emerging trends.
General Requirements:
Excellent storyboarding skills, and able to produce release-ready facilitator guides, participant materials and ILT/vILT decks to a publishable standard.
Communicate complex information effectively through engaging written and verbal formats tailored to the client's needs and audiences.
Ensure regular communication and alignment on project updates with the engagement team
Ability to work through ambiguity, flexibility to adapt to changing priorities and business needs.
Ability to work flexibly across time zones as per project requirements, ensuring seamless coordination and efficient project execution.
Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements in learning and development.
Contribute learning scope, effort estimates and instructional methodology input to pursuits and proposals as a subject-matter expert.
Provide guidance and support to team members to reinforce learning from engagements.
Believe in the value created by diverse teams and adapt to different working styles.
Continue to develop internal relationships and your PwC brand.

Description:
About The Role


Job Title -

Instructional Design - Associate

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:12 - Associate

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 0-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:-0-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.
AboutCompany: Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services—all powered by the world’s largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 514,000 people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We embrace the power of change to create value and shared success for our clients, people, shareholders, partners and communities.

Title:- 11 - Ind & Func AI Decision Science Analyst

About S&C - Global Network:- Accenture Global Network - Data & AI practice help our clients grow their business in entirely new ways.?Analytics enables our clients to achieve high performance through insights from data - insights that inform better decisions and strengthen customer relationships. From strategy to execution, Accenture works with organizations to develop analytic capabilities - from accessing and reporting on data to predictive modelling - to outperform the competition
About the Team:-
The team is focused on driving Data & AI based solutions for SaaS and PaaS clients for Accenture. The team collaborates actively with onsite counterparts to help identify opportunities for growth as well as drives client deliveries from offshore.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
As part of our Data & AI practice, you will join a worldwide network of smart and driven colleagues experienced in leading statistical tools, methods, and applications. From data to analytics and insights to actions, our forward-thinking consultants provide analytically informed, issue-based insights at scale to help our clients improve outcomes and achieve high performance.
Accenture will continually invest in your learning and growth. You'll work with experts in SaaS & PaaS and Accenture will support you in growing your own tech stack and certifications.
In Data & AI you will understands the importance of sound analytical decision-making, relationship of tasks to the overall project, and executes projects in the context of a business performance improvement initiative.
What you would do in this role
Development and testing of AI algorithms and techniques, custom-tailored to effectively address and solve specific, complex business problems.
Manage large databases proficiently, conducting exploratory data analytics to derive valuable insights for stakeholders.
Track down and thoroughly investigate previous information related to a problem, asking probing questions to identify root causes.
Employ a systematic approach to problem-solving, exploring known avenues and asking insightful questions to unravel the core issues.
Work collaboratively with both internal teams and external consultants/managers to achieve project objectives.
Develop and manage data pipelines to streamline the flow of information for enhanced efficiency.
Demonstrate adaptability and flexibility in responding to changing project requirements.
Proactively seek and embrace continuous learning opportunities to stay updated with the industry trends and advancement.


Qualification

Bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, engineering, data science, or a related field.
Experience working for large Software or Platform organizations.
Proven experience (2+ years) in working on AI projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Hands-On exposure to Generative AI frameworks (Azure Open AI, Vertex AI) and implementations & Strong knowledge of AI technologies, including Embedding, prompt engineering, natural language processing, computer vision, etc.
Hands on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modelling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings / insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL
Proficiency in statistical packages such as R, Python, Java, SQL, Spark, etc.
Knowledge in training large language models and fine-tuning for specific applications or domains.
Experience with cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS word, PowerPoint, etc.

About The Role


Job Title - SC Global Network - AI - Healthcare Analytics - Consultant


Management Level:9-Team Lead/Consultant


Location:Bangalore/Gurgaon


Must-have skills:GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, Python, SQL, AI/ML, Visualization (Power BI or Tableau)



Good to have skills:R, Spark, data bricks, Ability to leverage design thinking, business process optimization, and stakeholder management skills.


Job

Summary:
This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.






Roles Responsibilities:

Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.


WHATS IN IT FOR YOU
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.


What you would do in this role
Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.
Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules.
Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science
Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry.
Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the clients business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.


Who are we looking for
Bachelors or Masters degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) EMR (Electronic medical records)
Leverage ones hands on experience of working across one or more of these areas such as real-world evidence data, RD clinical data, digital marketing data.
Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL.
Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills




Professional Technical


Skills:

- Relevant experience in the required domain.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.






Additional Information:

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects.
- Career growth and leadership exposure.

Qualifications

Good to have skills:R, Spark, data bricks, Ability to leverage design thinking, business process optimization, and stakeholder management skills.
Job Summary:
This role involves driving strategic initiatives, managing business transformations, and leveraging industry expertise to create value-driven solutions.
Roles & Responsibilities:
Deliver strategic advice to clients by providing data-driven recommendations that enhance business outcomes.
Independently manage communications with clients, ensuring clear understanding of project objectives and progress updates.
Design and implement GenAI, RAG, Agentic AI, or traditional AI/ML algorithms tailored to address specific business challenges within the healthcare and life sciences sector.
Demonstrate knowledge of life sciences datasets and maintain strong domain expertise to drive the development of robust analytics solutions.
Support the delivery of consulting projects for global clients, working as part of a small to medium-sized team or as an individual contributor as required.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams, leveraging skills in data engineering, data science, and business intelligence tools such as Power BI or Tableau.
Apply design thinking principles and business process optimization to recommend and implement innovative, value-driven solutions.
Engage in ongoing learning to develop consulting acumen, industry knowledge, and technical capabilities.
WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
An opportunity to work on high-visibility projects with top Pharma clients around the globe.
Potential to Co-create with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners, and business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed responsible business into everything-from how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your strategy & consulting acumen to grow your skills, industry knowledge, and capabilities.
Opportunity to thrive in a culture that is committed to accelerating equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.
What you would do in this role
Support delivery of small to medium-sized teams to deliver consulting projects for global clients.
Responsibilities may include strategy, implementation, process design, and change management for specific modules.
Work with the team or as an Individual contributor on the project assigned which includes a variety of skills to be utilized from Data Engineering to Data Science
Provide Subject matter expertise in various sub-segments of the LS industry.
Develop assets and methodologies, point-of-view, research, or white papers for use by the team and the larger community.
Acquire new skills that have utility across industry groups.
Support strategies and operating models focused on some business units and assess likely competitive responses. Also, assess implementation readiness and points of greatest impact.
Co-lead proposals, and business development efforts and coordinate with other colleagues to create consensus-driven deliverables.
Execute a transformational change plan aligned with the client's business strategy and context for change. Engage stakeholders in the change journey and build commitment to change.
Make presentations wherever required to a known audience or client on functional aspects of his or her domain.
Who are we looking for?
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Business Analytics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or other Quantitative field.
Extensive GenAI expertise with a track record of creating and deploying GenAI and Agentic AI solutions.
Proven experience (4+ years) in working on Life Sciences/Pharma/Healthcare projects and delivering successful outcomes.
Excellent understanding of Pharma data sets - commercial, clinical, RWE (Real World Evidence) & EMR (Electronic medical records)
Leverage one's hands on experience of working across one or more of these areas such as real-world evidence data, R&D clinical data, digital marketing data.
Hands-on experience with handling Datasets like Komodo, RAVE, IQVIA, Truven, Optum etc.
Hands-on experience in building and deployment of Statistical Models/Machine Learning including Segmentation & predictive modeling, hypothesis testing, multivariate statistical analysis, time series techniques, and optimization.
Proficiency in Programming languages such as Python, SQL, Spark, etc.
Ability to work with large data sets and present findings/insights to key stakeholders; Data management using databases like SQL.
Experience with any of the cloud platforms like AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud for deploying and scaling language models.
Experience with any of the Data Visualization tools like Tableau, Power BI, Qlikview, Spotfire is good to have.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with a data-driven mindset.
Proficient in Excel, MS Word, PowerPoint, etc.
Ability to solve complex business problems and deliver client delight.
Strong writing skills to build points of view on current industry trends.
Good communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills
Professional & Technical Skills:
- Relevant experience in the required domain.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

- Opportunity to work on innovative projects.
- Career growth and leadership exposure.

Job Title - Manager - Process Excellence
Management Level:07 - Manager
Location:Delhi, Gurgaon, Mumbai, Bangalore, Chennai, Pune, Hyderabad
Must Have Skills
Strong expertise in B2B Sales process transformation, covering end-to-end Sales process steps such as Lead Management, Lead Qualification, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Account Management, Forecasting, CPQ, Deal Management, Contract Management, Order Management, and Sales Operations.
Proven experience in future-state process design, process transformation, process optimization, and operating model design.
Strong ability to lead client discovery and design workshops, stakeholder interviews, design-thinking sessions, and co-creation workshops.
Experience integrating AI, GenAI, automation, and analytics into business and Sales processes.
Strong understanding of Sales platforms and enterprise applications that enable the B2B Sales lifecycle.
Ability to connect business processes, technology, operating models, and organizational change to develop practical transformation solutions.
Strong team management and people leadership skills, including coaching, mentoring, work allocation, quality assurance, and developing junior practitioners.
Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to present and defend recommendations to senior client leadership.
Good-to-Have Skills
Experience with process mapping, process modeling, and visualization tools, including Microsoft Visio or equivalent applications.
Exposure to process mining, digital twin, process simulation, or other data-driven approaches for process assessment and validation.
Familiarity with AX Design and designing AI-agent experiences within business processes.
Experience supporting Business Development, sales pursuits, RFP/RFI responses, proposal development, solutioning, and client presentations.
Experience conducting change-impact assessments across people, process, technology, data, skills, and operating models.
Knowledge of Sales platforms such as CRM (Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics), CPQ (Salesforce, Conga, SAP), CLM (Icertis Conga), Sales Planning (Anaplan, Xactly), Forecasting (Clari, Aviso), Incentive Compensation (Varicent, SAP Callidus), Order Management (Salesforce, SAP), and Revenue Management (Salesforce, SAP)
Experience
8 -12 years of experience in management consulting, process transformation, process excellence, Sales Operations, business transformation, or related areas.
Demonstrated experience leading process transformation workstreams and managing client and internal stakeholders.
Experience managing and developing consulting teams
Experience supporting BD, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities is preferred.

Educational Qualification
Bachelor's Degree or equivalent.
MBA/PGDM (Preferred)
Job Summary
As a Manager - B2B Sales Transformation & Process Excellence, you will lead the design and transformation of end-to-end B2B Sales processes for clients across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
You will own the process transformation design cycle-from understanding the client's current-state Sales processes and assessing industry, market, technology, and competitive forces, through defining future-state processes and operating models, to developing implementation and adoption approaches. You will bring strong knowledge of key Sales process steps, including Lead-to-Opportunity, Opportunity Management, Pipeline Management, Forecasting, Account Management, CPQ, Deal Management, Contracting, Order Management, and Sales Operations. You will also assess how Sales platforms and applications enable these processes and identify opportunities for platform optimization, digital transformation, automation, and AI/GenAI integration.
The role requires strong consulting leadership, including client workshop facilitation, stakeholder management, executive communication, team management, and delivery ownership. You will lead and coach practitioners, ensure quality of deliverables, and build reusable methodologies and assets. You will also contribute to Business Development and RFP/RFI activities, including opportunity shaping, solution development, proposal responses, process narratives, capability presentations, and client presentations.
As part of AI-led transformation, you will apply AX Design principles to consider the intersection of human, AI agent, and process. Future-state process designs should define where AI agents operate autonomously, where human intervention is required, escalation triggers, controls, and the quality of human-agent handoffs.
Roles & Responsibilities
B2B Sales Process Transformation
Lead end-to-end B2B Sales process transformation initiatives across multiple Sales process steps and functional areas.
Assess current-state processes, identifying pain points, inefficiencies, control gaps, manual activities, duplication, and opportunities for standardization and automation.
Lead the design of future-state Sales processes and operating models aligned to business objectives and industry leading practices.
Drive transformation across key Sales processes including:
Lead Management & Qualification
Lead-to-Opportunity
Opportunity Management
Pipeline Management
Account Management
Sales Forecasting & Planning
CPQ & Deal Management
Contract Management
Order Management
Sales Operations & Revenue Operations
Connect process design with people, technology, data, governance, and operating model changes.
Develop transformation roadmaps, process specifications, business requirements, operating models, and implementation recommendations.
Sales Platforms & Applications
Assess the role of Sales platforms and applications in enabling end-to-end B2B Sales processes.
Support transformation initiatives involving CRM/Sales Cloud, CPQ, CLM, Sales Planning, Forecasting, Deal Management, Incentive Compensation, Order Management, and Revenue Management platforms.
Identify opportunities to improve platform adoption, integration, automation, data quality, user experience, and process effectiveness.
Lead process visualization and documentation using Microsoft Visio and other process mapping/modeling tools.
Work closely with business and technology teams to translate process requirements into platform and solution requirements.
Client Leadership & Workshops
Lead client discovery workshops, stakeholder interviews, design-thinking sessions, and co-creation workshops.
Facilitate discussions with Sales, Operations, Technology, Finance, and Business stakeholders.
Present transformation recommendations and future-state designs to senior client leadership.
Manage day-to-day client relationships, stakeholder expectations, risks, dependencies, and issue resolution.
Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and establish credibility through strong Sales domain and consulting expertise.
AI, GenAI & AX Design
Embed AI, GenAI, automation, and analytics into future-state Sales process designs and team ways of working.
Identify high-value opportunities where AI can improve Sales productivity, decision-making, forecasting, customer engagement, and operational efficiency.
Use appropriate AI tools to accelerate research, benchmarking, analysis, process documentation, and deliverable creation.
Apply AX Design principles to future-state process specifications by defining:
AI-agent responsibilities
Autonomy levels
Decision-making boundaries
Escalation triggers
Human intervention points
Human-agent handoff protocols
Quality and governance requirements
Evaluate how AI agents and human users should collaborate across individual Sales process steps.
Process Excellence, Benchmarking & Analytics
Lead process maturity, benchmarking, and performance assessments to identify transformation opportunities.
Assess market and industry trends across Software & Platforms, High Tech, and Communications & Media.
Leverage AI-assisted analytics and benchmarking tools to develop data-driven insights.
Use process mining, digital twin, and process simulation approaches where appropriate to validate current-state and future-state process designs.
Develop change-impact assessments covering people, process, technology, data, skills, and organizational structures.
Business Development & RFP
Contribute actively to Business Development, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities.
Support opportunity qualification, solution shaping, and development of differentiated value propositions.
Lead or contribute to RFP responses, proposal narratives, solution approaches, process diagrams, operating models, case studies, and capability presentations.
Translate client requirements into practical B2B Sales transformation solutions and roadmaps.
Support client presentations, solution demonstrations, workshops, and pursuit discussions.
Develop reusable Sales transformation assets, accelerators, frameworks, and points of view to support future pursuits.
Team Management & People Leadership
Lead and manage consulting teams across Sales transformation engagements.
Allocate work, establish priorities, monitor delivery quality, and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
Coach and mentor junior consultants and practitioners on B2B Sales processes, process redesign, consulting methodologies, analytics, and AI-enabled transformation.
Provide regular feedback and support team members in developing consulting and domain capabilities.
Foster a collaborative, high-performing team environment across onsite, offshore, and distributed teams.
Build team capabilities through knowledge sharing, training, reusable assets, and hands-on coaching.
Ensure appropriate quality reviews and adherence to Accenture delivery and consulting standards.
Professional & Technical Skills
Deep understanding of B2B Sales processes and end-to-end Sales process steps.
Proven experience in process transformation, future-state process design, process excellence, and operating model design.
Strong knowledge of Sales Operations and Sales transformation.
Experience with Sales platforms and applications supporting the B2B Sales lifecycle.
Proficiency or working knowledge of Microsoft Visio and process mapping/modeling tools.
Experience applying AI, GenAI, automation, and AI-assisted analytics to business process transformation.
Strong benchmarking, analytical, problem-solving, and structured-thinking capabilities.
Experience developing executive-level presentations, process specifications, transformation roadmaps, and business cases.
Strong client-facing consulting and stakeholder management skills.
Strong team leadership, coaching, mentoring, and people management capabilities.
Business Development & Consulting Skills
Demonstrated experience contributing to BD, RFP/RFI, proposal, and pursuit activities.
Ability to develop client-ready solution approaches, proposals, presentations, and supporting artifacts.
Strong executive communication and storytelling skills.
Ability to translate complex process, technology, and AI concepts into clear business recommendations.
Experience facilitating senior stakeholder workshops and presenting recommendations to leadership.
Ability to manage multiple priorities across client delivery, team management, and business development.
Industry Focus
The role will primarily support clients across:
Software & Platforms
High Tech
Communications & Media
The Manager is expected to build strong knowledge of industry-specific B2B Sales models, Go-to-Market strategies, Sales operating models, Sales processes, technology landscapes, and emerging AI opportunities.

Additional Information
Strong interest and demonstrated experience in B2B Sales transformation, Sales Operations, digital transformation, AI/GenAI, and emerging Sales technologies.
Ability to bridge business processes, technology, data, AI, and operating model considerations.
Familiarity with process mining, digital twins, and data-driven process validation approaches.
Applied understanding of AX Design, including AI-agent autonomy, escalation, decision boundaries, and human-agent collaboration.
Demonstrated ability to balance client delivery, team leadership, and Business Development responsibilities.
Strong consulting mindset with the ability to work across diverse client environments and lead teams toward measurable transformation outcomes.

Job Title -

Instructional Design - Analyst

- T&O- (S&C GN)

Management Level:11 - Analyst

Location:Gurugram, Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata and Chennai

Must have skills:

Instructional Design OR Storyboarding OR Articulate Storyline


Good to have skills:Whatfix, walk me, ADDIE model

Experience:Minimum 2-3 year(s) of experience is required


Educational Qualification:Any Bachelors Fulltime

Job

Summary:

As a Talent & Organization (T&O) professional in the S&C Global Network, youll help clients across a variety of industries in the areas of Learning Design and Development, Change Management and HR Transformation. Youll use your expertise to develop exciting new learning strategies and solutions. Youll help clients manage organizational change and smooth the transition process. Essentially, youll be part of the team that is creating the workforce of the future!

Roles & Responsibilities:



Although no two days at Accenture are the same, as an Instructional Designer Analyst in our T&O practice, a typical day might include:
Support team/ project through various phases of learning design and development based on the identified business problem, audience profile, and evaluation methodology.
Help develop standards and templates for the proposed learning solution.
Create effective training materials mapping the clients needs using learning modalities such as Instructor-led training, Web-based training, virtual Instructor-led training, simulations, videos, interactive learning nuggets, and performance support materials.
Collaborate with stakeholders such as Subject Matter Experts, team leads, media and technology teams to support iterations to the learning material for improved business outcomes.
Creatively visualize the content and work with the visual design team to convey the course content/key messages impactfully.
Write impactful storyboards by understanding the raw content and repurposing it based on audience, content, modality, and other considerations.
Perform quality checks on the training deliverables to meet the standard quality benchmarks.
Bring your best skills forward to excel in the role:
Proficiency in content development and instructional design, research and information gathering, content analysis, knowledge of latest trends in the learning industry.
Understanding of industry standard design/rapid authoring tools such as Articulate/Captivate/ Lectora/ Camtasia/ SAP Enable Now/WalkMe and be comfortable with client proprietary authoring tools. An ideal candidate should be well-versed with the technical functionalities and limitations of these tools.
Work in a problem-solving global environment with Cross cultural competence.
Possess excellent interpersonal and writing skills with a strong business acumen.


Qualification

Professional & Technical

Skills:

Graduate/Post Graduate in any specialization, preferably Journalism / Mass Communication / English Literature /Advertising / Public Relations
Desired work experience:2-3 years in instructional design and content development with an understanding of training and design strategy
Adept at gathering and understanding source content to create engaging courses based on the target audience
Experience in applying proven learning methodologies and emerging technologies for adult learning



Additional Information:
A transparent career path designed for rapid career progression
A supportive culture that is serious about training, coaching and continuous learning
A global network where only state-of-the-art tools and technologies will do
A bighearted environment with opportunities to give back to our local communities
An opportunity to work on with key G2000 clients
Potential to with leaders in strategy, industry experts, enterprise function practitioners and, business intelligence professionals to shape and recommend innovative solutions that leverage emerging technologies.
Ability to embed into everythingfrom how you service your clients to how you operate as a responsible professional.
Personalized training modules to develop your to grow your skills, industry knowledge and capabilities
Opportunity to thrive in a that is committed to accelerate equality for all. Engage in boundaryless collaboration across the entire organization.

Deep understanding of cloud networking, identity, governance, and security principles.
Experience with hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
Strong background in enterprise application design and microservices architecture.
Familiarity with cloud cost optimization and FinOps practices.

Description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
What you will be doing:
Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.
What we need to see:
Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd:
Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.
AboutCompany:
Since its founding in 1993, NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) has been a pioneer in accelerated computing. The company‚’s invention of the GPU in 1999 sparked the growth of the PC gaming market, redefined computer graphics, ignited the era of modern AI and is fueling the creation of the metaverse. NVIDIA is now a full-stack computing company with data-center-scale offerings that are reshaping industry.

Description:
Job Title -Customer Care - Admission / OPD

Designation - Junior Officer / Officer / Senior Officer

Department - Clinical Administration

Location - Mumbai

Essential Qualification - Graduate

Additional Qualification - PG / Diploma

Relevant Experience 0-5 years

JOB REQUIREMENT (SKILLS):

• Accountable and resilient
• Commitment to delivering a high level of customer service.
• Ability to work under pressure.
• Flexibility to work as part of the team
• Able to work accurately with an eye for details

JOB PURPOSE:

Ensure that all procedural requirements and formalities in connection with the Admission of patients are quickly and satisfactory
completed to enable them to get admitted within the shortest possible time after their arrival in the hospital.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES AND ACCOUNTABILITIES:

• Close and continuous monitoring of outstanding cases.
• Timely referral of cases for obtaining concessions.
• Furnish statistical data relating to admission/ Data analysis of outstanding recoveries/necessary statistical inputs etc. for
information of Management and Finance Department for preparation of revenue budget and forecasts.
• Objective evaluation of Individual staff performance and counseling them periodically.
• Monitors monthly employee schedule ( Officer, Supervisors ,clerks, receptionist and attendant )
• Motivating staff to carry out routine activities and develop special skills for better patient/relative service delivery as well
educating them about the time management, professional etiquette, adaptability of computer usage etc.
• Developing job profiles and reviews if the position is being replaced.
• Study to enhance the processes, reduce waiting time and increase capacity utilization.
• Prepare monthly duty roster of staff.
• To keep a track of optimal utilization of beds.
• To take care of needs and comforts of the patient, while awaiting admission.
• Ensure that the patients are provided with all the information along with the leaflets and booklets pertaining to the
hospital, the services provided by the hospital and the rules and regulations of the hospital.
• Ensure that billing/ refund action is completed well in time, so that the patient/the relatives need not have to wait long by
settlement of Accounts and final discharge should be made to appear as a smooth , swift and pleasant experience to the
patient/ relatives.
• Checking of invoices is raised on credit parties to ensure that they are supported by relevant back up papers before
dispatching them to the costing department. Since the normal permissible credit period is one month from the date of
receipt of invoices by the credit party, it is essential that invoices are dispatched within two days after the discharge of
the patients.
• Ensure that after tallying the credit cards and Cheque collection, their statement are sent to accounts.
• Render assistance whenever manpower shortage is experienced in any area due to staff absenteeism etc. so that the
operative functions go on smoothly.
• Provision of indenting of stationary items from General stores on periodical basis.
• Assign extra or special duties to staff whenever is required.
• To maintain liaison with the sister-in-charge and unit clerk of the patient floors to know the general nature and extent of
treatment given , in order to ensure that the expenses already incurred on the treatment of the patients are always well
within the advance amounts collected from them.
• Sending the complete TPA/corporate files on time to finance department.
• Coordinating with corporate for resolving the queries regarding the admission or the procedure.
• Ensuring all the reports are properly send to report dispatch and the department is functioning smoothly.
• Ensure the smooth admission, OPD procedures for the High profile patients.
• To be part of the Quality Improvement initiative and protocols of the organization.

Position:Apprentice - AI
Job Description:
What You’ll Be Doing 
Perform basic job role functions with close supervision.
Assist experienced employees by performing entry-level tasks.
Communicate in a professional manner using verbal and written communications.
Perform basic problem-solving functions.
Monitor and report on assigned business area measurements as applicable.
Work in real time corporate environment and adapt the transition from college to corporate world.
 What We Are Looking For
2026 Pass out , Fresh Graduates with 60 % Aggregate.
Technical Apprentice: MCA/MSc IT/BE/B. Tech (IT, CS ,Electronics related streams only)
(You may also refer students who are awaiting their final semester results, provided they have no backlogs, and ensure they have their provisional degree certificate at the time of joining.)
Apprentice Program for 1 year (Extendable subjected to program norms & conditions / Converted as Employee subject to performance & availability of roles)
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
Express ideas with clarity since role require regular exchange of communication.
Demonstrate Logical and analytical thinking skills.
Skill in prioritizing work and multi-tasking
Committed and willingness to learn, contribute and grow.
Process oriented and a good team player
Good to have Knowledge on MS Office : Basic Excel & PPT is an addon advantage.
Programming knowledge like, PL/SQL, SQL etc. (For Technical Apprentice only)
Programming knowledge like, C,C++,Python and A Basic understanding of micro controllers or microprocessors/Power electronics/ FPGA. Thorough understanding of Lab equipment like DSO and Multimeters (For Electronic Engineering Apprentice Only )
What’s in for you
On the job skill-based training, projects, assignments, opportunity to learn new skills.
Annual Fixed Stipend (INR 30,000 per month)
Insurance (Self):
Medical : Coverage of INR 500,000/-
Accidental & Life as per policy
Time off:
20 days of Annual leave
12 days of Casual/Sick leave &
10 days of Holidays (Festival & National)
 About Arrow
Arrow Electronics, Inc. (NYSE: ARW), an award-winning Fortune 148 and one of Fortune Magazine’s Most Admired Companies. Arrow guides innovation forward for over 220,000 leading technology manufacturers and service providers. With 2025 sales of USD $30.9 billion, Arrow develops technology solutions that improve business and daily life. Our broad portfolio that spans the entire technology landscape helps customers create, make and manage forward-thinking products that make the benefits of technology accessible to as many people as possible. Learn more at www.arrow.com.

Our strategic direction of guiding innovation forward is expressed as Five Years Out, a way of thinking about the tangible future to bridge the gap between what's possible and the practical technologies to make it happen. Learn more at https://www.fiveyearsout.com/.

Job Category:Business Support

On the job skill-based training, projects, assignments, opportunity to learn new skills.

Description:
Customer Care Executive (CCE) - Gold Loan Division

Roles & responsibilities
Handle walk-in customers and assist them with gold loan products.
Explain loan terms, interest rates, and repayment procedures to customers.
Perform KYC verification and ensure proper documentation.
Maintain strong follow-up with customers for loan renewals and repayments.
Manage customer queries, complaints, and service requests efficiently.
Support branch operations including vault management (as needed).
Coordinate with the sales team for lead conversion and customer engagement.
Actively cross-sell health insurance and business loan products to eligible customers.
Achieve assigned sales targets for third-party products as per company norms.
Ensure accurate data entry and reporting of cross-sell activities.

Gold Appraiser (GA)

Roles and Responsibilities:
Assess and evaluate the purity and weight of gold ornaments/jewelry for pledging.
Provide accurate valuation as per company guidelines and current market rates.
Maintain proper documentation and system entries for appraised items.
Handle pledged gold securely and ensure proper storage in the branch vault.
Assist in loan processing and ensure compliance with internal policies.
Support in gold auctions, loan closure, and coordination with credit operations.
Promote and sell health insurance and business loans to interested customers.
Achieve monthly cross-sell targets alongside core appraisal duties.
Contribute to overall branch performance and customer satisfaction.

Preferred candidate profile:

Customer Care Executive: candidates with min 1 Yr experience in Sales or Marketing.

Gold Appraiser : Minimum 1 year of experience in Gold Checking & Sales, preferably from BFSI Sector.
Contact Details:
HR Vaishnavi - 8356866455
AboutCompany:
IIFL Finance Limited (hitherto referred to as IIFL) (NSE: IIFL, BSE: 532636) is one of the leading players in the financial services space in India. Together with its subsidiaries IIFL Home Finance Limited, IIFL Samasta Finance Limited (Formerly known as Samasta Microfinance Limited) and IIFL Open Fintech Private Limited, it provides a diverse range of loans and mortgages.
These include home loans, gold loans, business loans including loans against property and medium & small enterprise financing, micro finance, developer & construction finance and capital market finance; catering to both retail and corporate clients.
The company has a nationwide presence with a thriving network of 2600+ branches across 500+ cities.

Description:
Tele Sales Executive
Department: Sales

Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at NoBroker as a Tele Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and sell properties!

Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.97 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.
Specific Responsibilities

Make outbound calls and handle inbound enquiries from prospective customers for approximately 3 to 4 hours every day as part of a voice-based sales process.

Own end-to-end sales conversion understand customer requirements, pitch NoBrokers property and service offerings, and close deals to achieve monthly sales targets.

Build trust and rapport with leads, negotiate effectively, and provide regular follow-ups until conversion.

Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, and conversions using internal CRM tools and adhere to company sales processes.

Consistently work towards and exceed individual and team sales targets to maximize performance-based incentives.

Perks & Value Proposition

Attractive incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of 20,000 - 25,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.

Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.

Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.

Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top sales performers.

Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.

Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.

Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education:
Graduation, 12th, or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.

Skills:

Description:
About RepIndia

Founded in 2013, RepIndia is one of Indias largest independent digital agencies, delivering powerful digital marketing and communication solutions through social media, content, data, and analytics.
We’re a full-service, one-stop brand-building powerhouse for clients such as JBL, IDFCBank, MTV, JSW, Medanta, Fortis, Colorbar, Canon, and many more.
With offices in Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Bangalore & Hyderabad, our team of creative thinkers is committed to helping brands build presence, manage reputation, drive business goals, and achieve success through a 360 digital approach.

Role Overview – ORM Executive

As an ORM Executive, you will monitor, manage, and protect the online reputation of our clients. You’ll track conversations, engage with audiences, and develop proactive strategies to maintain a positive brand image across social and digital platforms. Your insights will help shape brand perception and support overall marketing objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Monitor social media, review sites, forums, and other online platforms for mentions of clients and relevant industry conversations.
Respond to queries, comments, and reviews in line with brand voice and policy.
Escalate potential crises, negative sentiment, or emerging trends to senior stakeholders promptly.
Collaborate with social, content, and strategy teams to align ORM efforts with campaigns.
Prepare reports and insights on brand perception, trends, and competitor activity.
Stay updated on digital trends, platform policies, and best practices for online reputation management.

Requirements
0–1 years of experience in ORM, social media management, Email responses or digital marketing roles.
Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field.
Strong understanding of social media platforms, digital ecosystems, and online conversation trends.
Excellent written communication, editing, and storytelling skills.
Ability to handle sensitive situations calmly and maintain brand reputation.
Familiarity with ORM tools, social listening platforms, and analytics is a plus.
6 days work week with rotational shift is must (Rotational shift includes night shift).

Why RepIndia
Work with some of India’s most iconic and high-growth brands.
Thrive in a culture that celebrates creativity, curiosity, and collaboration.
Be part of an award-winning team shaping the future of digital storytelling.
AboutCompany:
About RepIndia

Since its inception in 2013, RepIndia has grown into one of Indias leading independent digital agencies. With over 300 professionals spread across multiple locations, we proudly serve a diverse portfolio of clients, including renowned names like IDFC First Bank, Adani, Tata, JSW, Canon, Viacom 18, and Colorbar, among others.

Description:
Customer Service Executive

Department: Customer Servicing

Are you a people-first individual who enjoys helping customers and solving problems? Join our team at NoBroker as a Customer Service Executive and be the trusted voice that helps our customers through their property journey!

Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.28 LPA to 5.05 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us

NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities

Act as a Relationship Manager for paid customers, building trust and ensuring long-term engagement.
Handle inbound and outbound calls for approximately 3–4 hours daily as part of a voice-based customer service process.
Understand customer needs and assist in resolving queries and finding the right tenant or property, with a strong focus on customer experience rather than hard sales targets.
Provide regular, proactive updates on account/service progress and utilize internal tools while adhering to company guidelines for high-quality service delivery.
Go the extra mile to provide exceptional customer service and ensure customer satisfaction; performance is monitored though the role is not heavily target-based.

Perks & Value Proposition

Performance incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of up to 15,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education: Graduation, HSC (12th) or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.
Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication, good interpersonal skills, numerical and analytical ability, and strong decision-making and problem-solving skills.
Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word).
Work schedule: 6-day working week — Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.
Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.
Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

Why NoBroker?
At NoBroker, we believe in empowering our employees to reach their full potential. Join a dynamic team of professionals who are passionate about changing the real estate landscape. Take the next step in your career and apply today!

Description:
Tele Sales Executive

Department: Sales
Are you a motivated individual with a passion for real estate sales? Join our team at NoBroker as a Tele Sales Executive and help revolutionize the way people buy and sell properties!

Location: Kaikondrahalli, Bengaluru (Bangalore)
Position Type: Full-time
Salary Range: 4.97 LPA to 5.74 LPA (inclusive of variable components & based on current relevant experience)

About Us
NoBroker.com, founded in 2014 by Amit, Akhil, and Saurabh, is Indias first Proptech unicorn. Its a brokerage-free platform that directly connects property owners with tenants and buyers, eliminating the need for middlemen. With over 1 crore customers and 5 lakh new users each month, its reshaping the real estate market. The platform handles 55,000 transactions monthly, saving INR 1200 crore in brokerage fees each year. Headquartered in Bengaluru, NoBroker operates in key cities like Mumbai, Delhi, Pune, Chennai, and Hyderabad. Recently, it raised USD 210 million, bringing its valuation to over USD 1 billion.

Specific Responsibilities

Make outbound calls and handle inbound enquiries from prospective customers for approximately 3 to 4 hours every day as part of a voice-based sales process.
Own end-to-end sales conversion understand customer requirements, pitch NoBrokers property and service offerings, and close deals to achieve monthly sales targets.
Build trust and rapport with leads, negotiate effectively, and provide regular follow-ups until conversion.
Maintain accurate records of calls, leads, and conversions using internal CRM tools and adhere to company sales processes.
Consistently work towards and exceed individual and team sales targets to maximize performance-based incentives.

Perks & Value Proposition

Attractive incentives: Earn performance-based incentives of 20,000 - 25,000 per month, over and above your fixed salary.
Health insurance: 1 lakh group insurance per year, fully paid by the company.
Promotions: Employees are promoted every 6 months, with outstanding performers eligible for promotions every quarter.
Rewards: Monthly recognition and rewards for top sales performers.
Career growth: Employees can become Assistant Managers in as little as 2 years.
Team-building activities: Regular team parties and an Annual Day outing for all employees.
Employee referral program: Incentives for bringing in new talent.

Educational & Skill-Set Qualifiers

Education: Graduation, 12th, or 10th qualified. Should not be currently pursuing any full-time, part-time, online, or distance-learning course.
Skills: Excellent verbal communication, strong negotiation and persuasion skills, target-driven mindset, and good interpersonal skills.
Languages: English mandatory; Hindi, Kannada, Tamil, or Marathi preferred.
Technical skills: Basic proficiency in MS Office (Excel, Word) and comfort using CRM/calling tools.
Work schedule: 6-day working week Saturday and Sunday are working days, with one rotational weekly off between Monday and Friday.
Leave policy: Leaves are generally not approved during the first three months of joining, except in case of emergencies.
Age: 18 - 30
Other: Should not be currently engaged in any real estate business or property brokerage. Candidates should be able to join immediately.

Description:
Job Overview
We are looking for a well-presented, polite, and responsible Receptionist & Front Desk Executive to manage front desk operations, assist visitors and students, and handle basic pantry duties, including preparing and serving tea/coffee to faculty members and guests.
Key Responsibilities
Front Desk & Reception
Welcome and assist students, parents, visitors, and faculty members.
Handle incoming phone calls, enquiries, and messages professionally.
Maintain visitor records and manage the reception area.
Coordinate with the admission and administration teams.
Assist with basic data entry, documentation, and office work.
Ensure the reception area remains neat and organised.
Pantry & Office Support
Prepare and serve tea, coffee, and refreshments to faculty members and visitors.
Maintain cleanliness and hygiene in the pantry area.
Ensure cups, utensils, and pantry supplies are clean and properly maintained.
Monitor pantry stock and inform the administration team when supplies need replenishment.
Provide general office support whenever required.
Required Skills & Qualifications
Minimum 12th pass; graduates preferred.
Good communication and interpersonal skills.
Basic computer knowledge, including MS Office.
Pleasant personality, punctuality, and a helpful attitude.
Ability to manage front desk responsibilities and pantry duties efficiently.
Prior experience in reception, hospitality, or office administration will be an advantage.
Working Hours
Full-time, as per institute working hours.
Salary
Negotiable, based on experience and suitability.
Interested candidates can share their resume for consideration.
AboutCompany:
International School of Design (INSD) one of the best design institutes in Baner Pune , renowned legacy of providing excellent academic experiences. International School of Design core mission is to provide a future-focused design curriculum that prepares students to work as professionals in the future. Our campus boasts of state-of-the-art resources with massive fashion studios, photography studio, fine art studio, gallery space, computer lab , Styling & Make Up studio, teaching labs to our in-house catwalk space. Students also have access to massive landscaped open spaces, creative zones including outdoor sports facilities and an amphitheatre within a secure gated community at Creaticity. 
International School of Design is considered and counted amongst the top design institutes in India for its infrastructure, studios and competent training faculty determined to guide students to achieve academic excellence and become professionals in the functional domains of Fashion Design, Product, Communication Design, Graphic Design , Interior Design and related professionals.

Proficiency in Microsoft Excel

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Process Executive (PE) Job Description | Delhivery Limited
Position: Process Executive (PE) 
Department: Operations 
Location: Sriperumbudur
Salary: 2.5 LPA to 2.75 LPA

Roles & Responsibilities
Handle daily inbound, outbound, sorting, scanning, loading, unloading, and dispatch activities.
Ensure shipments are processed accurately within the defined SLA/TAT.
Scan shipments and update shipment status using the required systems and applications.
Perform shipment segregation, packing, palletization, and movement as per operational requirements.
Ensure shipment accuracy and minimize errors, damages, losses, and misrouting.
Follow company SOPs, safety guidelines, and operational procedures.
Support inventory management, shipment reconciliation, and documentation activities.
Coordinate with Team Leaders and team members to achieve daily operational targets.
Report shipment discrepancies and operational issues to the concerned Team Leader.
Maintain productivity, quality standards, discipline, and cleanliness in the assigned work area.
Follow shift timings and support operational requirements during peak season.
Qualification
Diploma / Any UG Graduate/PG Graduate 
Freshers and experienced candidates may apply.
Candidates should be willing to work in warehouse operations and rotational shifts.
Shift Timings
Morning Shift: 6:30 AM 3:30 PM
Afternoon/Evening Shift: 1:30 PM – 10:30 PM
Night Shift: 10:00 PM – 7:00 AM

Description:
Role & responsibilities

A Stacker Operator (also referred to as a stalker or forklift/stacking equipment operator) at Delhivery Limited manages the safe handling, movement, sorting, and stacking of parcels and inventory inside the warehouse or hub.

Key Responsibilities
Parcel & Material Handling: Sort parcels according to destination, route, or shipment category.
System Updates: Scan shipment barcodes and update real-time parcel and inventory status in the warehouse management system.
Loading & Unloading: Load, unload, and transport goods/pallets safely using stacking equipment or forklifts.
Warehouse Organization: Arrange, stack, and organize materials neatly to maintain optimal floor space and prevent damage.
Safety Compliance: Adhere strictly to company safety protocols, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and equipment handling guidelines.


Job Details & Compensation (Kaniyur / Coimbatore Hub Context)
Location: Delhivery Warehouse / Hub, Kaniyur, Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu.
Salary Range: Typically 25,000 to 27,000 per month

Key Responsibilities:
- Generate leads and convert sales for Ashok Leyland vehicles.
- Field visits & customer follow-ups.
- Build and maintain customer relationships.
- Achieve monthly sales targets.

Desired Candidate Profile:
- Any Graduate / 12th Pass with good communication skills.
- Must have a two-wheeler and willingness for field work.

- Experienced candidates from Automobile / Commercial Vehicle sales will be given preference.

- Salary: Rs. 15,000 + Rs. 2,500 TA + Attractive Incentives (Best as per experience)

AboutCompany:
Sahu & Sons Truckings Pvt. Limited is an authorized dealership of Ashok Leyland (M&HCV) in Jharkhand. We operate state-of-the-art 3S dealerships at Ratu Road & NH-20 (Ormanjhi), Ranchi.
We cater to M&HCV vehicles with modern tools and equipment, including wheel alignment machines, pneumatic systems, and dedicated accident repair bays.
Our network proudly serves Ranchi, Hazaribagh, Koderma & Barhi.
Additionally, we are part of the 50+ year old Sahu & Sons Group, Ranchi (Since 1972), which also operates:
Sahu & Sons Fireworks - Leading fireworks wholesaler of Jharkhand and Bihar. Our retail outlet at Itki Road, Major Kothi, Ranchi.
SS Powerbikes - Authorized Yamaha Dealership with two branches in Ranchi - Pandra & Hawai Nagar.

5. Address post-publish content issues reported through customer tickets within SLA.
6. Update trackers, dashboards, and workflow tools to maintain task visibility.
7. Consistently meet SLA, productivity, and quality goals.
