This position is with a nationally accredited, 500-bed, multi-super speciality teaching hospital located in a major regional capital city. Established decades ago, the facility stands as the primary healthcare landmark for the Northeast region, housed in a nine-storied structure with over 300,000 square feet of floor space. The institution is academically affiliated with a prominent, decades-old University renowned for excellence in medical education and healthcare.

The hospital is equipped with state-of-the-art infrastructure, including 13 general specialities, multiple super-speciality departments, and 12 dedicated operation theatres. It provides comprehensive 24x7 services, including a fully equipped trauma care unit and advanced diagnostic imaging featuring 1.5 Tesla MRI, 64-slice CT scan, and digital X-ray facilities. Critical care capabilities are extensive, supported by 46 well-equipped ICU beds (covering ICU, SICU, NICU, PICU, CCU, and ITU) and round-the-clock emergency services.

Role Summary
We are seeking a highly skilled and dedicated Nephrologist to join our team as a Clinical Practitioner. The successful candidate will manage the diagnosis and treatment of kidney-related diseases, providing expert care to inpatients and outpatients. While the role is primarily clinical and does not require an extensive academic portfolio, the institution places a high priority on candidates who possess relevant work experience within recognized university or medical college hospital settings.

Key Responsibilities
Clinical Management: Provide comprehensive clinical care for patients with acute and chronic kidney diseases, electrolyte imbalances, hypertension, and other renal disorders.
Dialysis Services: Oversee and manage the Dialysis Unit, which is equipped with modern hemodialysis machines (currently 8 units, including isolation facilities) and expertise in Continuous Ambulatory Peritoneal Dialysis (CAPD).
Critical Care Nephrology: Collaborate with the intensive care team to manage complex cases requiring renal replacement therapy (CRRT, SLED) in the 46-bed ICU setup.
Patient Consultation: Conduct regular outpatient consultations, providing holistic treatment plans that include lifestyle modification and dietary guidance in coordination with nutritionists.
Interdepartmental Collaboration: Work closely with General Medicine, Cardiology, Urology, and other specialities to ensure a multidisciplinary approach to patient care, particularly for diabetic and hypertensive nephropathy.
Procedures: Perform necessary nephrological procedures such as renal biopsies and placement of temporary vascular access for dialysis.
Quality Assurance: Adhere to national accreditation standards (NABH protocols) and hospital policies to ensure the highest quality of patient safety and care delivery.

Qualifications and Experience
Essential Post-Graduate Qualification: M.D. or DNB in General Medicine or Paediatrics from a recognized institution.
Required Super Speciality Qualification: D.M. in Nephrology (Recognized by the National Medical Commission) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience: 1 to 4 years of experience post-completion of the super specialization (D.M.) / M.Ch Nephrology.
Experience Preference: Crucially, priority will be given to candidates who have gained their experience in recognized university or teaching hospital settings.
Note: Experience is strictly counted only after the completion of the super specialization.

Compensation
Salary Range: INR 3.5 Lakhs to INR 4.5 Lakhs per month.
Determination: Final offer will be commensurate with the candidate's specific post-DM / M.Ch experience and expertise.

Additional Information
Nature of Role: This is a full-time Clinical Practitioner position.
Academic Profile: While an academic profile (publications, research) is not mandatory, the clinical expertise gained in an academic environment is highly valued.
Facility Highlights: The selected candidate will practice in a facility that acts as a tertiary care referral centre for the entire state and neighbouring regions, backed by comprehensive support services including a 24-hour central laboratory and blood bank.
AboutCompany: Super Speciality College and Hospital system run by Reouted University
CompanyAddress: Capital of Northeastern state of India

Description:
Job Title: Head of Department (HoD) Psychology (Professor/Associate Professor)

Role Overview
The Head of the Department of Psychology will provide visionary leadership to build a high-impact, industry-relevant, and research-driven department. The role requires balancing academic rigor with innovation, student employability, and institutional growth, while ensuring compliance with UGC norms and alignment with NEP 2020.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic & Academic Leadership
Develop and execute a growth strategy for the department (new programs, student intake, branding)
Design industry-aligned curriculum (e.g., clinical practice, organizational psychology, behavioural data science, counselling)
Introduce value-added certifications and interdisciplinary courses
Drive NAAC/NIRF rankings contributions and accreditation readiness

2. Program Development & Innovation
Integrate technology in psychology (e.g., psychometrics tools, data analytics, AI applications in behaviour studies)

3. Faculty Leadership & Talent Building
Implement performance-driven culture (KPIs: teaching quality, publications, student feedback, placements)
Mentor faculty for research output, consulting, and executive education

4. Research, Consulting & Revenue Generation
Build a research and consulting ecosystem (corporate training, assessments, mental health services)
Secure funded projects, consultancy assignments, and collaborations
Establish labs/centres (e.g., Behavioural Lab, Counselling Centre)
Promote publications in Scopus/Web of Science indexed journals

5. Student Outcomes & Employability
Ensure strong placement and internship pipelines (Hospitals, NGOs, EdTech, corporates)
Develop career-oriented training (soft skills, psychometric testing, counselling skills)
Track and improve student success metrics (placements, higher education, certifications)

6. Industry & Institutional Partnerships
Build MoUs with hospitals, corporates, NGOs, schools, and wellness centers
Organize guest lectures, workshops, and live projects
Promote international collaborations and exchange programs

7. Administration & Operations
Manage departmental budgets with a focus on ROI and efficiency
Ensure smooth academic operations, timetabling, and compliance
Handle student grievances and maintain discipline
Contribute to university committees and strategic initiatives

Eligibility Criteria

Essential Qualifications
B.A/B.Sc & MA/M.Sc in psychology & Ph.D. in Psychology (mandatory, as per UGC/AICTE norms)
Minimum 815 years of experience in teaching/research/industry
At least 3–5 years in academic leadership roles (HoD/Program Head/Coordinator)
Strong research and publication record

Key Skills & Competencies
Leadership with a focus on growth and revenue generation
Strong networking and industry engagement skills
Ability to balance academic quality with market relevance
Data-driven decision-making and innovation mindset

Description:
Experience: 6 - 15 Years
Location: Bangalore, Mumbai, Pune, Gandhinagar
Employment Type: Full-Time
Notice Period: Immediate to 30 Days Preferred
About the Role
Capgemini is seeking highly skilled SAP Central Finance (CFIN) Consultants to join our growing SAP Finance Transformation practice. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in SAP Central Finance, SAP S/4HANA Finance, financial process transformation, data migration, and system integration. You will play a key role in designing, implementing, and supporting enterprise-wide Central Finance solutions for global clients.
Key Responsibilities
SAP Central Finance Implementation & Solution Design
Lead and participate in end-to-end SAP Central Finance (CFIN) implementation projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into scalable SAP Central Finance solutions.
Configure and support SAP CFIN functionalities including:
Initial Load & Replication
Central Payment
Central Reconciliation
Application Interface Framework (AIF)
Source System Mapping
Key & Value Mapping
Design and implement real-time financial data replication using SAP LT Replication Server (SLT).
Collaborate with business teams to harmonize finance processes across multiple ERP landscapes.
Integration & Data Migration
Integrate SAP ECC, SAP S/4HANA, and non-SAP systems into the SAP Central Finance environment.
Manage data migration activities, including data cleansing, mapping, transformation, validation, and reconciliation.
Support financial master data governance and integration with SAP MDG.
Ensure data consistency, completeness, and accuracy throughout migration and replication processes.
Troubleshoot replication and interface issues to ensure business continuity.
Finance Transformation & Process Optimization
Drive finance transformation initiatives leveraging SAP S/4HANA Central Finance capabilities.
Analyze existing business processes and recommend improvements based on SAP best practices.
Enable process standardization and harmonization across global business units.
Support business stakeholders in defining future-state finance operating models.
Financial Reporting & Support
Support financial reporting, analytics, and consolidation requirements.
Develop and enhance reporting solutions using SAP Fiori, Embedded Analytics, SAC, and BW.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities.
Provide post-go-live support and resolve issues related to:
Data Replication
Financial Postings
AIF Monitoring
Mapping Errors
Reconciliation Discrepancies
Financial Reporting
Required Skills & Qualifications
Technical Skills
Strong hands-on experience in SAP Central Finance (CFIN).
Expertise in SAP S/4HANA Finance and SAP FI/CO.
Experience with:
SLT Replication
AIF Framework
MDG Integration
Data Migration & Reconciliation
Financial Master Data Management
SAP Fiori Applications
Understanding of SAP integration methodologies and architecture.
Functional Expertise
Strong knowledge of:
General Ledger (GL)
Accounts Payable (AP)
Accounts Receivable (AR)
Asset Accounting (AA)
Cost Center Accounting
Profit Center Accounting
Internal Orders
Bank Accounting
Financial Closing & Reporting
Preferred Experience
6 to 15 years of SAP consulting experience.
Minimum 4+ years of hands-on SAP Central Finance experience.
At least one full lifecycle SAP Central Finance implementation is preferred.
Experience working on global SAP S/4HANA transformation programs.
Exposure to Treasury, Group Reporting, and Cash Management would be an advantage.
Experience in Agile and SAP Activate methodologies.

Locations: Bangalore | Mumbai | Pune | Gandhinagar
Experience: 6-15 Years
Notice Period: Immediate to 90 Days Preferred

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in retail business processes, demand forecasting, replenishment planning, inventory optimization, and SAP CAR implementations/support projects.

Total Exp - 6yrs to 20yrs
Location - Mumbai/Pune/Bangalore/Hyderabad/Kolkata/Gandhinagar

Key Responsibilities
SAP CAR Implementation & Support
Participate in end-to-end SAP CAR implementation, rollout, upgrade, and support projects.
Gather business requirements and translate them into SAP CAR functional solutions.
Configure and support SAP CAR modules including:
POSDTA (Point of Sale Data Transfer & Audit)
OAA (Omnichannel Article Availability)
DDF (Demand Data Foundation)
UDF (Unified Demand Forecast)
CAR Planning & Forecasting

Integration

SAP S/4HANA / ECC
SAP Retail
SAP BW/4HANA
SAP F&R
SAP IBP (preferred)
POS systems and third-party applications

Conduct workshops, fit-gap analysis, and solution design sessions.

Provide post-go-live support and issue resolution.
Stakeholder Management
Collaborate with business users, architects, and development teams.
Provide recommendations for process optimization and system enhancements.
Conduct user training and knowledge transfer sessions

Description:
SAP Project Manager S/4HANA Public Cloud
Location - Mumbai , Pune , Bangalore , Gandhinagar

Flexible / Hybrid / Remote

Experience
8-15 years in SAP Project Management with at least 2 end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementations.
Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Project Manager to lead SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects. The ideal candidate will be responsible for managing project delivery, stakeholder engagement, budget oversight, risk management, and ensuring successful deployment of SAP best practices using the SAP Activate methodology.
The Project Manager will collaborate with business stakeholders, SAP consultants, system integrators, and technical teams to drive projects from initiation through go-live and hypercare support.
Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Manage project scope, timelines, budgets, risks, and resources.
Drive project governance and ensure compliance with SAP Activate methodology.
Facilitate requirement gathering, fit-to-standard workshops, and solution design discussions.
Coordinate cross-functional teams including Functional, Technical, Integration, Data Migration, and Change Management workstreams.
Monitor project progress and provide regular status reporting to leadership and steering committees.
Manage stakeholder expectations and ensure alignment with business objectives.
Identify and mitigate project risks, issues, and dependencies.
Oversee testing cycles including SIT, UAT, and Go-Live readiness activities.
Support cutover planning, deployment, hypercare, and project closure activities.
Ensure delivery quality, adherence to best practices, and customer satisfaction.
Required Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.
8+ years of SAP project management experience.
Minimum 2 full lifecycle SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud implementation projects.
Strong understanding of SAP Activate methodology and Cloud ERP deployment models.
Experience managing global or multi-country SAP programs.
Proven expertise in project planning, budgeting, risk management, and vendor management.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Experience with Agile, Hybrid Agile, and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
Preferred Qualifications
SAP Activate Project Manager Certification.
PMP, PRINCE2, Scrum Master, or Agile certifications.
Experience with SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP), SAP Integration Suite, and SAP Signavio.
Knowledge of finance, procurement, supply chain, manufacturing, or HR business processes.

Description:
Designation : Business Analyst
Location : Bangalore & Navi Mumbai Location

Responsibilities :
Business Analyst would be responsible for working closely with the Business Teams and helping them in making data driven decisions. This would require cross-communication between the Business Team, Product Team & Data Engineering as well. Apart from solving the business problem at hand, a Business Analyst would also be responsible for sharing insights and learning basis the data exploration/mining and convert these into clear action points and ensure that the same are being worked upon
Getting business requirements from the respective Business Teams, identifying the
underlying business case and building a generalized solution
Extracting & Exploring the data from database and other sources that may exist,
cleaning the data for any issues/missing values also needs to be owned upon
Converting the cleaned data into actionable insights and sharing the same with relevant
Audience
Automation of data problems/solutions that occur recursively
Flagging to Data Engineering in case of data sanity issues are to be seen
Ensure that the action insights shared with the business teams are worked upon
Ensure new business requirements are thoroughly vetted and signed off
Knowledge sharing within the team and outside if required

What are we looking for ?
2 to 4 years of work experience in the relevant field, preferably in a consumer facing company
Proficient in SQL and/or HQL , ability to handle complex/inner queries
Hands-on with Google Sheets / Microsoft Excel (basic data cleaning, pivoting and data exploration)
Must have worked on any one Data Visualization Tool (Tableau, Power BI, Microstrategy, Metabase etc)
Basic automation skills using Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel are expected
Hands on Knowledge of Python programming and Python for Data Analytics
Working knowledge on Machine Learning and Data Science Algorithms are a plus
Communication skills to get the business requirements and give out the final insights
Data Inquisitiveness

Job Description: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant (4 to 10 Years)
Position: SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant
Experience: 4 to 12Years
Locations: Mumbai, Pune, Bangalore, Gandhinagar
Interview Type: Face-to-Face
Date:10-OCTOBER-2026

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced SAP SD S/4HANA Consultant with 4 to 10 years of SAP Sales and Distribution experience. The candidate should have strong expertise in SAP SD business processes, S/4HANA implementations, configuration, integrations, and support projects.
Key Responsibilities
Gather and analyze business requirements and translate them into SAP SD solutions.
Configure SAP SD modules including:
Sales Order Processing
Pricing
Billing
Shipping & Transportation
Output Management
Credit Management
Returns & Rebate Processes
Participate in S/4HANA implementation, rollout, migration, and support projects.
Work on integrations with MM, FI, WM/EWM, TM, and PP modules.
Conduct fit-gap analysis and prepare functional specifications.
Support testing activities including Unit Testing, SIT, UAT, and Go-Live.
Provide end-user training and post-go-live support.
Collaborate with technical teams for enhancements, reports, forms, interfaces, and workflows.
Required Skills
4 to 10 years of SAP SD consulting experience.
At least one end-to-end SAP S/4HANA implementation project.
Strong configuration knowledge in:
Enterprise Structure
Sales Document Types
Item Categories
Schedule Lines
Pricing Procedures
Output Determination
Partner Determination
Copy Controls
Batch Management
Experience with S/4HANA SD simplifications and business processes.
Knowledge of APIs, IDOCs, EDI, and interfaces.
Strong understanding of OTC (Order-to-Cash) processes.
Preferred Skills
Experience with SAP Fiori applications.
Exposure to SAP EWM, TM, GTS, or SAP CAR.
Knowledge of SAP Activate methodology.
Experience in AMS support and global rollout projects.
SAP SD or S/4HANA certification is preferred

Job Description:
Data Architect-Data Fabric
Location: Bangalore / Pune
Experience: 13+ Years
The Opportunity
We are seeking an experienced Data Architect with strong expertise in data modelling and enterprise data architecture to design scalable, secure, and high-performing data solutions. The role will work closely with business, technology, data engineering, and governance teams to define data architecture and deliver strategic data initiatives.

Principal Responsibilities
Define and implement enterprise and solution-level data architecture aligned with business and technology strategy.
Develop and review conceptual, logical, and physical data models across complex business domains.
Establish data modelling standards, principles, naming conventions, and reusable patterns.
Design architectures for data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses, and analytical platforms.
Define data integration patterns across ETL/ELT, APIs, batch, and real-time data pipelines.
Assess and recommend appropriate databases, cloud platforms, and data technologies.
Ensure solutions address data quality, governance, security, scalability, and performance.
Partner with data engineers, developers, architects, and business stakeholders to ensure effective implementation.
Review existing data landscapes and define target-state architecture and modernisation roadmaps.
Produce architecture documentation, data models, design standards, and technical recommendations.

Requirements
13+ years of experience in Data Architecture, Data Modelling, Database Architecture, or related roles.
Strong hands-on experience in conceptual, logical, and physical data modelling.
Excellent understanding of relational, dimensional, OLTP, and OLAP data models.
Experience with data warehousing, data lakes/lakehouses, and cloud data platforms.
Strong SQL and database knowledge.
Experience with ETL/ELT, data integration, data governance, metadata, and data lineage.
Exposure to AWS, Azure, or GCP data services is desirable.
Experience with modelling tools such as Erwin, ER/Studio, Sparx EA, or equivalent is advantageous.
Strong analytical, communication, stakeholder management, and documentation skills.
Experience in large and complex enterprise environments preferred.

Qualifications
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.
Certifications such as DAMA, TOGAF, AWS/Azure/GCP, or equivalent are advantageous.

Description:
IMMEDIATE JOINERS || 4-7 years || Pune / Bengaluru

Roles & Responsibilities:
As a member of the CLE ADB Productization the associate will be responsible for development and maintenance of Live Procedures handled by SAF team.
The Procedure Expert needs the skill set required to support a range of SAP systems including ABAP, Java stack, Non-NetWeaver systems. The associate would be responsible to Plan / Validate / Maintain the Procedures according to the ECS standard and sometimes non-standard procedures as requested by the stakeholder.
Associate will be majorly responsible for
Monitor the Procedure execution and identify the task errors and reason
Get feedback from Delivery Team, SEO and Service Owners and identify scope of Procedure enhancement.
Prepare and maintain the Task failure analysis report and track ‘First time Success Rate’.
Propose solution and suggest modification in Procedure by discussing with PO’s.
Drive the procedure enhancement by coordinate with developers / SEO / PO / Developer.
Coordinate with developers and support them with required inputs.
Perform Validation and report the issues encountered while running the procedures in VLAB environment with the concerned procedure owner to ensure the issue doesn’t reoccur in PROD Environment.
Sharing the feedback of the Task documentation if unclear or needs to be modified
First level of issue analysis encountered in the procedure by troubleshooting the underlying procedure along with the PO by understanding the basic ECS architecture, newly released features of the tools involved etc
Support Delivery colleagues in case of Procedure failure and propose immediate work around
Proactive follow-up on the tickets created for the issues encountered
Knowledge sharing within the team and with larger audience of the technical and process aspects
Maintaining documentation of the above deliverables
Expectations and Tasks:
Understand the SAF Basis Team functioning and process model.
Knowledge ECS support tools - LVM, SPC, JIRA, CRT , Customer Launch Pad ,Service Now, TIC and Etc.

Description:
About the Role
Were building and growing our hyperlocal (on-demand) logistics business within Delhivery, and are for someone who can take ownership from day zero acquiring customers, shaping the GTM motion, and building a repeatable revenue engine.
You will operate as a full-stack sales owner — from identifying opportunities within SMEs and enterprises to closing deals and ensuring long-term account success. The role requires a mix of hunting (acquisition) and farming (growth & retention), with a strong bias toward building from scratch.

What You’ll Do
Own the end-to-end sales cycle: prospecting pitching closing account growth for leads with monthly wallet potential of 5L to 10L
Acquire and onboard SMEs and enterprise customers onto Delhivery’s hyperlocal logistics platform
Build a strong pipeline through outbound efforts, partnerships, and market mapping
Work closely with operations to ensure a seamless fulfillment experience for customers while providing top-notch customer assistance
Drive account expansion and retention, identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities
Develop a deep understanding of customer supply chains and last-mile needs
Contribute to GTM strategy, pricing inputs, and product feedback as an early member of the business
Lay the foundation for scaling this business line and becoming a trusted + reliable logistics partner for our customers
Who We’re Looking For
2–5 years of experience in B2B sales, with a strong focus on acquisition-led roles
Prior experience in logistics, on-demand delivery, or supply chain platforms
Strong exposure to both SME and enterprise sales
Hands-on experience with solution selling (not just transactional sales)
High ownership mindset — comfortable operating in 0-1 environments
Strong understanding of last-mile logistics, fulfillment challenges, and operational nuances

What Makes This Role Different
You’re not inheriting a book of business — you’re building it
Direct impact on shaping a new vertical within Delhivery
Opportunity to scale into a larger role as the business grows
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

About Allegis Global Solutions (AGS)
Allegis Global Solutions (AGS), a part of Allegis Group, is a global leader in Managed Services Provider (MSP) and Recruitment Process Outsourcing (RPO) solutions. AGS partners with organizations worldwide to deliver innovative workforce solutions and help businesses attract, engage, and retain top talent.

Job Summary
We are seeking a confident, customer-focused, and proactive Full Cycle Recruiter to manage end-to-end recruitment activities for client requirements. The ideal candidate will have experience in full-cycle recruiting and be comfortable working closely with candidates, hiring managers, and stakeholders in a fast-paced, client-facing environment.
This role requires strong communication skills, ownership, stakeholder management, and the ability to deliver a high-touch candidate experience throughout the recruitment lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities
Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle from requisition intake to onboarding follow-up.
Partner with Hiring Managers and stakeholders to understand hiring needs and candidate requirements.
Source candidates through job portals, internal databases, referrals, social networking platforms, and other sourcing channels.
Identify and engage both active and passive candidates.
Conduct candidate screening through phone and video interviews.
Evaluate candidates based on skills, experience, communication, motivation, and cultural fit.
Coordinate interviews and facilitate smooth communication between candidates and stakeholders.
Provide exceptional candidate care and maintain engagement throughout the recruitment process.
Share regular hiring updates, pipeline reports, market insights, and recruitment progress with stakeholders.
Maintain accurate candidate records in ATS/CRM systems.
Build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
Work in a target-driven environment while maintaining recruitment quality and candidate experience.
Continuously improve recruitment effectiveness through feedback implementation and process enhancement.

Required Qualifications
1 to 2+ years of recruitment experience with exposure to full-cycle recruitment.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management and relationship-building abilities.
Customer-service mindset with a focus on delivering a white-glove candidate and hiring manager experience.
Strong ownership, accountability, and follow-through.
Ability to accept and implement feedback effectively.
Excellent time management and multitasking skills.
Ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.
Strong work ethic and commitment to delivering results.
Bachelor's or Master's degree.
Minimum 60% aggregate across 10th, 12th (PUC), and Graduation.
For recent graduates, all semester mark sheets must be available and there should be no active backlogs.

Work Schedule
Night Shift (Flexible):
5:30 PM / 6:30 PM IST to 2:30 AM / 3:30 AM IST
7:00 PM / 8:00 PM IST to 4:00 AM / 8:00 AM IST
8:30 PM / 9:30 PM IST to 5:30 AM / 6:30 AM IST
Week Off: Saturday & Sunday
Benefits
5-day work week
Medical Insurance
Free two-way cab facility (within 14 km radius of office)
Hybrid work model
Career growth opportunities within Allegis Group

Location Constraint
Candidates should reside within a 14 km radius of the Bengaluru office or be willing to relocate within the eligible distance.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Title Store Manager
Reporting to Area Operations Manager
Skip Level City/Zonal Manager
About the Role
A Store Manager at Lenskart acts as an important link between strategy and execution. He/she drives the store towards achieving all assigned metrics of Store Sales, Conversions, Customer satisfaction etc. and is responsible for keeping a high level of morale among the store staff, developing them, controlling attrition, and ensuring smooth operations at the store.
Responsibilities
Area

Activities expected to be performed by a Lenskart Store Manager
Customer focus:
Driving Net
Promoter Score

Greeting customers when they enter store and coaching the team to do the same
Displaying commitment towards providing exceptional Customer Service and ensuring that Lenskart associates also treat Customer Satisfaction as a priority
Dealing with customer service issues such as queries and complaints at store level and ensuring this is consistent with the team
Striving to have long lasting and fruitful relationships with each of our customers
Driving sales vs.
plan

Driving the sales of the store to meet the allotted targets by allocating the targets to the staff
Developing a culture of high sales performance expectations, i.e. Sales Leadership
Motivating and inspiring the field team to drive for results
Assessing field capability and establish performance priorities at group level
People development
(Attrition
Control)

Assisting in recruiting and selecting high potential staff
Providing effective on-the-job training and guidance to team members making use of company training modules
Delivering clear, motivating and constructive feedback in a timely manner to all retail associates
Evaluating the training needs of store associates and working closely with L&D department to execute the developmental plan
Understanding the reasons for attrition and taking measures to control it
Cash & Inventory management

Monitoring cash reconciliation to ensure there is no mismatch of store funds
Ensuring availability of required merchandise and services
Conducting stocktakes regularly
Ensuring the staff at store level has basic understanding of POS System to ensure transactions are properly and effectively processed
Performing the necessary quality checks for the new products
Working very closely with other departments till the product reaches the customer and ensuring the best customer experience to the Lenskart Customer
Supervision

Ensuring that all store employees, including the Optometrist, are taken care of and their issues are resolved
Ensuring that the eye check-ups are conducted as per the SOP and maintain high quality standards
Preferred candidate profile :
Candidate should has to 4 to 10 Years of Experience in store managing

Perks and benefits
ESI and PF
Family insurance policy
Incentive policy : Daily - weekends - monthly - festival incentive program.
Professional Training : 25 Days training in Bangalore post selection in Lenskart Academy .

Description:
Job Summary:
Under minimal supervision and in accordance with Cummins Delegation of Authority Policy, determines the quantity and order date for materials needed to meet the master production schedule or independent customer demand. Expedites purchase or production orders as appropriate.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations. Engages in HSE training. Quality Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures. Performs quality checks on material planning master data (lead time, order quantities, etc. ) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP). Works with Quality to disposition non-conforming material in a timely manner. Delivery Initiates purchase and work orders to support the demand plan. Participates on allocation calls with Sourcing Manager, supplier, and other Cummins entities to understand nature and impact of constraints. Works with suppliers to reduce lead time and order quantities balancing supply with demand. Collaborates with Supply Chain Planners across the organization to reposition excess inventory to locations with supporting demand. Provides accurate, timely updates specific to inventory availability and back order recovery plans. Manages part change requests and ramp up / ramp down activities to meet demand while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory. Reconciles order boards for critical suppliers, critical parts, and past due orders on a routine basis. Supports the Deliver Supplier Improvement Process initiative to improve performance metrics. Documents, communicates, and follows-up on action items impacting the ability to execute the plan. Takes ownership and accountability for delivery of supplier schedules that supports end Customer needs. Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies. Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals. Teamwork Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals. Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc. ) projects.
Drive end-to-end supply chain performance by ensuring superior customer service, achieving Customer On-Time Delivery (OTD) targets, managing order fulfillment processes, optimizing trading supply chain operations, and implementing functional excellence through system-driven planning and continuous improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities

1. Customer OTD & Customer Service
Ensure achievement of Customer OTD targets for internal and external customers.
Monitor customer demand, order fulfillment status, and service level performance.
Coordinate with Production, Procurement, Warehousing, and Logistics teams to ensure timely deliveries.
Analyze delivery performance and implement corrective actions to improve customer satisfaction.
Proactively manage supply risks to minimize customer service disruptions.

2. Order Management
Manage the complete order-to-delivery process.
Review customer orders, prioritize requirements, and ensure accurate order execution.
Monitor backlog orders and expedite critical customer requirements.
Ensure timely order confirmation, scheduling, invoicing, and dispatch coordination.
Resolve order-related issues through cross-functional collaboration.

3. Trading Supply Chain Management
Plan and manage trading product procurement and replenishment.
Coordinate with suppliers and distribution teams to maintain optimum inventory levels.
Monitor stock availability and prevent shortages or excess inventory.
Drive supplier performance improvement initiatives to ensure uninterrupted supply.
Manage inventory health, working capital, and product availability.

4. Functional Excellence
Lead continuous improvement initiatives across SCM processes.
Develop and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs).
Drive Lean, process optimization, and cost reduction projects.
Monitor key KPIs and implement actions for sustained performance improvement.
Support digital transformation and best-practice deployment across the organization.

5. System-Driven Planning
Utilize ERP, ASCP, and planning systems to drive data-based decision-making.
Maintain planning master data and planning parameters.
Improve forecast accuracy, material planning, and inventory optimization through system-generated recommendations.
Develop dashboards and reports to support planning reviews and business decisions.
Ensure effective adoption of digital tools, automation, and planning processes.
Key Competencies
Supply Chain Planning & Execution
Customer Focus
Order Management
ERP / ASCP Knowledge
Data Analytics & Reporting
Inventory Optimization
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Problem Solving & Decision Making
Continuous Improvement Mindset
Agility, Accountability, and Ownership
Competencies:
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Customer focus - Building strong customer relationships and delivering customer-centric solutions.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

Part Change Control Management - Evaluates and implements engineering change request (obsolescence, supersessions, new part release, etc. ) to meet customer delivery requirements while minimizing excess and obsolete inventory.

Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Master Supply Scheduling - Establishes and maintains a valid Master Production Schedule for a family of products, which meets customer s expectations and requirements while maximizing operational efficiency; validates procurement scheduling, production scheduling, and replenishment planning are aligned to manufacturing and assembly assets for conversion.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.

College, University or equivalent degree in Business, Engineering, or related field preferred.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires significant relevant work experience or specialized skills obtained through education, training, or on-the-job experience in an equivalent field such as materials planning, production scheduling, manufacturing, or inventory control.

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Senior Sales Manager with strong experience in the steel industry to drive business growth, develop new markets, manage key accounts, and lead the sales team. The ideal candidate should have in-depth knowledge of steel products, excellent negotiation skills, and a proven track record of achieving sales targets.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and implement sales strategies to achieve revenue and business growth targets.
Identify new business opportunities, develop new customers, and expand market presence.
Build and maintain strong relationships with key customers, distributors, dealers, and industrial clients.
Lead, motivate, and manage the sales team to achieve individual and organizational targets.
Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing, and customer requirements.
Manage key accounts and negotiate commercial terms with customers.
Coordinate with internal departments to ensure timely order processing, delivery, and customer satisfaction.
Prepare sales forecasts, market reports, and business development plans.
Identify opportunities to improve sales performance, profitability, and customer retention.



Minimum 10 years of sales experience, preferably in the steel industry.
At least 5 years of experience in a sales leadership or managerial role.
Strong understanding of steel products, the supply chain, and the Indian steel market.
Proven track record of achieving and exceeding sales targets.


Required Skills
Steel Sales and Business Development
Strategic Sales Planning
B2B Sales and Key Account Management
Team Leadership and Sales Team Management
Customer Relationship Management
Negotiation and Commercial Skills
Market Analysis and Competitor Research
Revenue Growth and Sales Target Achievement
Sales Forecasting and Business Planning
Strong Communication and Interpersonal Skills


Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate will be a proactive sales professional with strong industry connections, a customer-focused approach, excellent leadership abilities, and the capability to develop long-term business relationships while driving sustainable revenue growth.

Interested candidates with relevant experience in steel sales and business development are encouraged to apply.

Description:
Role & responsibilities:
Manage day-to-day Accounts Payable (AP) operations for the manufacturing/plant facility.
Review, verify, and process high-volume plant/vendor invoices accurately and within timelines.
Perform 3-way matching of Vendor Invoices, Purchase Orders (POs), and Goods Receipts (GR/IR).
Identify and resolve pricing, quantity, tax, and invoice discrepancies in coordination with Procurement and Warehouse/Receiving teams.
Monitor and manage the GR/IR clearing account to ensure timely resolution of unmatched or pending receipts.
Ensure accurate General Ledger (GL) coding and cost center allocation for manufacturing lines, freight, utilities, raw materials, etc.
Manage vendor accounts and vendor reconciliations, including review of vendor statements.
Act as the primary point of contact for vendor queries, payment status, statement discrepancies, and account-related issues.
Ensure all applicable vendor credits and outstanding adjustments are identified and accounted for.
Ensure timely and accurate vendor payments in line with agreed payment terms and internal processes.
Ensure compliance with internal controls, AP policies, and finance procedures.
Coordinate with Procurement, Sourcing, Warehouse, Receiving, and Plant Operations for smooth AP processing.
Support month-end closing, AP reconciliation, accruals, and reporting activities.
Identify process gaps and support continuous improvement and automation of AP processes.
Ensure accuracy, completeness, and timely closure of AP-related transactions and reconciliations.


Preferred candidate profile :
CA/CMA with 10 to 13 years of relevant experience.
Experience in Accounts Payable/P2P, preferably in Power/Manufacturing/Plant environment.
Strong knowledge of Invoice Processing, 3-Way Matching, GR/IR & Vendor Reconciliation.
Hands-on experience in SAP/ERP and GL accounting.
Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.

Description:
Job Title: Sales Associate
Job Location: Nagpur
Experience: 3-6 Years
Industry: Medical Devices / Healthcare / Ophthalmology / Consumables
Function: Sales & Business Development
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a motivated Sales Associate Consumables to drive sales growth and strengthen the market presence of our consumables portfolio in the assigned territory.
The role will be responsible for achieving sales targets, developing new business opportunities, managing customer and channel relationships, monitoring market and competitor activities, and ensuring strong customer retention and satisfaction.

Key Responsibilities
Develop and execute sales plans and strategies for the assigned territory.
Track sales pipeline, forecasts and achievement against targets.
Identify new key accounts and direct trade opportunities.
Manage and develop relationships with dealers, distributors and customers.
Drive sales growth and ensure achievement of territory targets.
Maintain pricing discipline and ensure timely payment/collection as per company policies.
Monitor competitor activities, pricing, schemes and market positioning.
Maintain accurate sales and market information in SFDC/CRM.
Work closely with Marketing for RTM, CME and Live Surgery activities.
Collaborate with Equipment Sales, Marketing and other internal teams to drive cross-selling and synergy sales.
Maintain strong relationships with hospitals, clinics and customers within the assigned territory.
Prepare and submit regular sales reports, forecasts and market updates.
Contribute to customer retention, satisfaction and overall territory growth.

Candidate Requirements
Bachelor's degree in any relevant discipline.
3–6 years of experience in Ophthalmology, Healthcare, Medical Devices or Consumables.
Strong experience in field sales / territory sales.
Experience in hospital, clinic, institutional or B2B sales will be preferred.
Experience managing dealers, distributors or channel partners.
Strong sales target orientation and business development skills.
Good commercial and strategic acumen.
Strong analytical and data-driven approach.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
Strong English communication skills.
Candidates with ophthalmic/eye-care consumables experience will be preferred.
AboutCompany:
ZEISS is an internationally leading technology enterprise operating in the fields o f o ptics a nd optoelectronics. In the previous fiscal year, the ZEISS Group generated annual revenue totaling 10 billion euros in its four segments Semiconductor Manufacturing Technology, Industrial Quality & Research, Medical Technology and Consumer Markets

ZEISS in India ZEISS in India is headquartered in Bengaluru and present in the fields of Industrial Quality Solutions, Research Microscopy Solutions, Medical Technology, Vision Care and Sports & Cine Optics. ZEISS India has 3 production facilities, R&D center, Global IT services and about 40 Sales & Service offices in almost all Tier I and Tier II cities in India. With 2200+ employees and continued investments over 25 years in India, ZEISS success story in India is continuing at a rapid pace. Further information at ZEISS India

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Responsible for delivering production as per production plan, ensuring safety, quality within specifications, yields and usages within targets
Responsible for carrying out Preventive Maintenance/ Time Based Maintenance of line equipments
Responsible for carrying out breakdown maintenance for all equipment within the shortest possible time during the shift, RCA and CAPA implementation to be done for the same
Responsible for manning requisition and allocation of available manpower to various workstations during the shift.
Responsible for verification of CLTI and logbooks along with rejections in the shift
Responsible for conducting 1hr per equipment on the respective equipment on daily basis by focusing on 5S, CLTI, PM, Abnormality identification and tagging, operator training and safety
Maintaining run hours of each equipment in SAP, PM Schedule generation & abnormality entry and Tag closure. Total Tag age to be reduced below 7 days by pushing equipment tracking sheet and maintaining spares inventory
Planning, communication and execution of punch list activities during maintenance window
Performing Contract Workforce Management system entries and maintaining preform tracking sheet
Ensuring all the safety protocols are followed all the time including machine guarding, safety interlocks and LOTO system during maintenance.
Ensuring GMP practices as per the company standards
Ensuring finished goods are produced as per the quality protocols


Preferred candidate profile
Qualifications: B. Tech/B.E.- Mechanical/Electrical/Instrumentation

Description:
Project Lead - Land Acquisition | Industrial Project
Project-Industrial Project,
Function-Land Acquisition / Project Development
Location- Odisha, Cuttack, Sundargarh
Reporting

Reporting to State Head

LAND ACQUISITION • DUE DILIGENCE • GOVERNMENT LIAISON • STAKEHOLDER MANAGEMENT
1. Role Overview
The Project Lead will drive and coordinate land acquisition and land-readiness activities for the Industrial Project. The role requires practical experience in land identification and sourcing, private and government acquisition, title verification and due diligence, government liaisoning, statutory approvals, stakeholder management, including negotiations if any. The job involves coordination with client state and district land team, project team and legal team landowners, government authorities, project stakeholders. Maintaining all records and history of correspondence and approval, preparation of monthly management information reports
2. Key Responsibilities
Lead end-to-end land identification, sourcing and acquisition activities for the industrial project. Including identification preparing land schedule, plant layouts on village map identification of land owners. To coordinate with client and obtain conformation for suitability
Assess and coordinate acquisition of private, government land through state policies revenue allotment policies through LARR, surface right or through industrial development corporation of respective state, including right of way or right of use in case of linear project and other project land parcels.
To carry out due process, post allotment measurement necessary entries at revenue record, measurements handing over allotted land parcel to client
Coordinate land aggregation against project requirements, including parcel-wise status, area and ownership tracking.
Oversee title verification and land due diligence, including ownership records, revenue records, encumbrances, disputes and transferability.
Coordinate with legal teams/consultants on Title Search Reports (TSRs), legal documentation, opinions and title-related issues.
Coordinate government acquisition processes and liaise with District and state authorities, also has to maintain cordial relations with state authorities and resolve issues with Liaoning with Administration, Revenue authorities and other relevant departments.
Track and facilitate applicable land-use requirements, statutory permissions and project-related approvals.
Maintain practical knowledge of the applicable of land/revenue framework, industrial policy and relevant energy-sector policy requirements.
Coordinate with relevant state industrial-development and project authorities and understand applicable land-allotment/industrial-area processes.
Handle and negotiate land-related issues with landowners, local representatives and other stakeholders.
Build and maintain effective relationships with local stakeholders and government officials.
Lead commercial discussions relating to land acquisition, including land rates, transaction terms and other commercial conditions within approved parameters.
Coordinate with Project, Legal, Compliance, Survey, Documentation and Administration teams.
Ensure land and project documentation is properly collected, organised, updated and accessible.
Track parcel-wise progress, pending actions, approvals and dependencies and provide timely management updates.
Use Google Earth, maps and satellite imagery for preliminary site assessment, location understanding, access assessment and land identification.
Coordinate with survey teams for demarcation, measurement, boundaries, coordinates and site verification.
Support project handover by ensuring required land records, documentation, approvals and site information are complete.
Identify acquisition bottlenecks and recommend practical solutions to accelerate project progress.
3. Role Specific Responsibilities
Understand the land requirements of a the particular project, including the main project site and supporting land requirements.
Coordinate land requirements connected with project infrastructure, access, utilities, transmission/connectivity and other ancillary facilities, as applicable.
Understand the different processes applicable to private, government and forest-related land and coordinate with the relevant teams/authorities.
Coordinate with technical/project teams so land acquisition and site planning remain aligned with the project's basic footprint and development schedule.
Keep land-related activities aligned with project milestones and implementation timelines.
Act as a key on-ground interface with landowners, local communities, government authorities and project stakeholders; handle sensitive local issues through communication, negotiation and problem-solving.
4. Authority & Accountability
Act as the primary on-ground coordinator for land acquisition and land-readiness activities for the project.
Coordinate with internal teams, external consultants, landowners and government authorities to resolve acquisition-related issues.
Escalate material legal, commercial, regulatory and stakeholder risks affecting project timelines.
Track acquisition milestones and proactively recommend corrective actions where delays or bottlenecks arise.
Ensure that land acquisition activities remain aligned with approved commercial parameters, legal requirements and project timelines.
5. Required Experience & Qualifications
7-8 years of relevant experience in land acquisition, land aggregation, infrastructure, energy, industrial projects, real estate or a closely related field.
Graduate qualification in Law, Engineering, Management, Commerce or another relevant discipline.
Hands-on experience managing land/project activities and working directly with landowners, government authorities and project stakeholders.
Practical experience in title verification, due diligence, land documentation, government processes and negotiations.
6. Core Skills & Competencies
Land Acquisition & Aggregation
Private & Government Land Processes
Title Verification & Due Diligence
Revenue Records & Land Documentation
Government Liaisoning & Approvals
Stakeholder/Client Management
Landowner Negotiation
Commercial Understanding & Negotiation
Google Earth / Map-Based Site Assessment
Problem Solving & On-Ground Execution
Excellent Communication Skills
Working knowledge of the local language and local land/acquisition environment preferred
7. Key Success Measure
The Project Lead will be expected to ensure that required land parcels are identified, legally and commercially assessed, progressed through applicable acquisition and approval processes, properly documented and made available for the project in accordance with agreed timelines. To arrange land parcels as per project requirement in given time. Exercise all-out efforts to handover possession of land to client in accordance with the project start date. Remain compliant and ensure land is free of encumbrance and that the land is free of any previous liabilities and to ensure uninterrupted project execution till project completion.

Role & responsibilities

Business Development: Generate leads and sales for Home Loans (HL) and Loans Against Property (LAP) through direct sales, DSAs, builders, and referrals.
Customer Acquisition & Consultation: Meet potential customers, understand financial needs, explain loan products, eligibility, and documentation.

AboutCompany:
Jana Small Finance Bank, erstwhile Janalakshmi Financial Services, is headquartered in Bengaluru. It is one of the 10 financial institutions which had received in-principle approval from RBI, in 2015, to set up a Small Finance Bank.
Established in Bengaluru in 2008, it went on to become the largest Micro Finance Institution (MFI) in India, and was recognised globally as one of the world€™s innovative financial institutions working on the problem of financial inclusion.
Jana Bank received the final banking license in April 2017 and started banking operations on March 28, 2018. Under the leadership of its MD & CEO, Ajay Kanwal, Jana Small Finance Bank€™s vision is to become the leading inclusive digitised bank serving all customer segments and communities of an aspirational India.
Currently, post the transition phase, the bank is enabling its existing 45 lakh customers across 19 states in India to access banking services. It has Capital Adequacy Ratio (CAR) of about 35 percent and a loan book of INR 76 billion as on March 31, 2018. By 2020, the bank aspires to add four million customers.
The bank has deep domain expertise in banking and financial services, with the senior management team having 25+ years of average experience in banking sector. Its current employee strength is of 15,000. By end of 2019, Jana Bank€™s 500 branches will be operational across 19 states, post conversion of majority of its micro finance storefronts into bank branches.
Bengaluru-headquartered Jana Small Finance Bank is regulated by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI).

Description:
Role: Area Sales Manager
Location: Zonal office- Bhubaneswar
Reporting to: Regional Sales Manager
Team name: Sales team
About the Team and the Role:
The Sales team at Ather is responsible for building a network and establishing the blueprint for selling Electric Vehicles in India, driving a historic transformation of the two-wheeler commute through a breakthrough product and an engaged community.
This role is for an Area Sales Manager who will play a key role in the growth story, owning the business in their region and ensuring growth in sales while maintaining high levels of customer experience and operational profits.
Responsibilities:
Drive sales through assigned Channel Partners
Build teams and systems that ensure sustainable sales growth while maintaining exceptionally high customer experience standards.
Foster and manage strong relationships with retail partners to ensure business thriving and alignment with brand vision.
Execute operational excellence at Channel Partners covering local demand generation and sales driving activities.
Analyze the sales funnel to identify problem statements, develop solutions, and motivate teams for implementation.
Deliver against steep ramp-up plans with a focus on scaling the regional business effectively.
Manage multi-stakeholder inputs from internal teams and external partners to maintain design and operational integrity.
Conduct regular performance reviews and site assessments to ensure business health and consistency across locations.
Strategise and strive to improve Ather market share in the assigned territory
Required qualifications
Postgraduate or graduate degree in Business or Engineering from a Tier I/Tier II institute.
4 to 10 years of experience in B2C/Channel sales.
Must Have Competencies
Data-driven analysis of sales funnels to identify bottlenecks and implement strategic solutions for revenue growth.
Strategic channel management to align retail partners with corporate goals while ensuring partner profitability.
Operational excellence in retail management, specifically driving local demand generation and customer experience standards.
Expertise in B2C sales strategies and the ability to execute aggressive market ramp-up plans in competitive environments.
Good to Have Competencies
Deep understanding of technology or automobile retail landscapes and evolving mobility trends in the Indian market.
Advanced negotiation and persuasive communication skills for navigating complex stakeholder relationships and retail partnerships.
Proficiency in organizational planning and resource prioritization to manage multi-location business operations.
Ability to build and empower high-performing teams through structured mentorship and performance management systems.
Want to know more?
At Ather, weve built India’s first intelligent scooter, from scratch. Based on the philosophy of clean design and smart technology, we are transforming the urban commute experience. We are expanding in India, and in the coming years, we look forward to scaling up and launching more products globally. Today, our product offerings include the Ather 450X, 450S, 450 Apex, and Rizta. Beyond the product, we are also setting up an extensive charging network and re-imagining end-to-end ownership experience. To know more, check out our Careers site and our Substack.
Be You, With Us
The Ather story doesn't write itself - our people do. We believe everyone is equal, but not the same. Diversity is our strength, and building an inclusive and equitable workplace begins with acknowledging and embracing our differences. We are an equal opportunity employer, and our team reflects a wide range of identities, experiences, and perspectives - all united by a shared passion to shape the Ather journey.

Description:
Job Summary:
Under general supervision, uses statistical analysis, collaborative cross-functional intelligence, and validated planning parameter settings to disaggregate the demand plan and determine the optimal inventory levels. Aligns the supply plan with the demand plan and drives stability in the supply chain.
Key Responsibilities:
Health, Safety & Environmental (HSE) Reports any work-related injury, illness, incident or hazard. Complies with HSE standards, policies, procedures & regulations. Engages in HSE training. Quality Follows applicable standard work, process documentation, and quality procedures. Performs quality checks on system planning parameters (min/max inventory level, re-order point, upper/lower tracking signals, segments, etc.) taking action to support Plan for Every Part (PFEP). Delivery Performs supply and demand analysis, highlighting areas of concern for the next 12 months. Assists others in gathering and compiling information through primary and secondary research. Runs planning parameter setting changes in the simulation environment to analyze the impact to KPIs, and provides executive and detailed report of results. Monitors signals indicating abnormal demand and/or stock levels feeding the supply schedule. Makes adjustments to the planning parameter settings if approved. Enters approved forecast adjustments at the detail level to align with the aggregate demand plan. Takes ownership and accountability for the disaggregate demand plan, supply plan, and inventory plan that supports end Customer needs. Demonstrates the target level of proficiency in core competencies. Remains flexible and performs other miscellaneous duties, as required, to meet business goals. Teamwork Communicates effectively within the assigned team and with all support teams. Completes training and personal development in line with business requirements and career goals. Participates in improvement (quality, safety, process, material flow, etc.) projects.
Need hands on experience on reverse logistics.
Good written&verbal communication.
Competencies:
Communicates effectively - Developing and delivering multi-mode communications that convey a clear understanding of the unique needs of different audiences.

Drives results - Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

Global perspective - Taking a broad view when approaching issues, using a global lens.

Manages complexity - Making sense of complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively solve problems.

Optimizes work processes - Knowing the most effective and efficient processes to get things done, with a focus on continuous improvement.

Materials Planning System Utilization - Uses the materials planning system to manage supply and demand plans taking long-term corrective action on exception messages and other alerts based on root cause analysis; occasionally refers to adhoc tools such as Excel, Access, TOAD, OMS, etc. in performing problem solving, while leveraging the materials planning system as the primary tool in day-to-day operations.

Plan for Every Part (PFEP) - Uses PFEP in planning, designing, and management of systems and processes within a facility to ensure delivery of right part at the right time in the right quantity to the right place, which in turn guarantees smooth operations; applies PFEP principles on the end to end supply chain with particular attention to the relationships between master data management, materials planning parameters, engineered material flows, transport management, and warehouse management.

Inventory Management and Optimization - Uses analytics and algorithms to determine the optimal level of inventory investment across the end-to-end supply chain within specific constraints (warehouse space, customer delivery, etc.); provides guidance and expertise on planning parameter refinement; develops inventory strategies to support Cummins strategy and not just a business unit strategy.

Materials KPI Management - Operates in relation to recent or historical outputs as compared to expectations of the organization to determine next steps to drive improvement; assesses gaps to the supply chain performance against the expectation of achieving target deliverables; interprets KPIs to understand end-customer impact; strategically balances trade-offs to influence one KPI while minimizing the impact to others.

Network Master Supply Planning - Uses statistical analysis and collaborates with other disciplines to provide a long term view of customers demand, and ensures the supply plan is aligned with the demand plan; balances supply and demand in a manner that achieves the financial and service objectives, while stabilizing the supply chain and optimizing the supply chain tensions.

Values differences - Recognizing the value that different perspectives and cultures bring to an organization.

Education, Licenses, Certifications:
High school diploma or certificate of completion of secondary education or equivalent experience to the extent such experience meets applicable regulations.
This position may require licensing for compliance with export controls or sanctions regulations.

Experience:
Requires some work experience and intermediate level knowledge obtained through training or on-the-job experience.

Description:
Role & responsibilities

Sales Focus
Achieving agreed market and segment share targets
Achieving monthly, quarterly, yearly sales that are set in the beginning of the year
Monitoring actual sales against expectations
Implementation of Trade Management plans
Implementing market and outlet coverage plans
Ensuring adherence to fixed call frequency for self and customer groups
Ensuring availability and visibility as per norms for all SKUs
Ensuring that the products have been launched in the market successfully
Planning how to launch new SKUs in the same outlet
Implementation of category / brand input plans
Implementation of trade and consumer schemes
Communication and Reporting of Monthly and quarterly schemes for the products to the dealers
Implementing all Branding elements at the appropriate place and time
Quality execution of merchandising activity
Evaluating pre/during and post sales feedback
Stock control
Monitoring & ensuring the Stock at Distributor level for all SKU
Monitoring and reporting any issues w.r.t customer and dealer of stock
Coordinating with the ASE / ASM to ensure adequate stock availability
Competitor Analysis and Feedback
Informing on competitive activities on timely basis and, implementing recommendations for countering competitor activities
Customer Focus
Developing & maintaining superior trade relations with key trade members.
Reviewing the products that sold well in the market in comparison to others, and sharing market feedback and customer feedback with the ASM
Educating and training customer groups on selling techniques through live examples
Regular checking of Distributors ROI
Others
Coordinating with the Depot, ASM, Distributor on day to day basis in terms of getting the right Product Mix, and ensuring dispatch of goods to respective towns/distributors
Preferred candidate profile

Graduates minimum & Post graduation (Desired)
Good Market exposure.

Description:
Your Role
Are you confident, well-spoken, presentable and passionate about working with people?
We are looking for a Front Office Executive cum HR Associate who can confidently represent our organization at the front desk while supporting the HR team in recruitment and employee coordination.
This is a great opportunity for someone who wants to build practical experience across HR, Recruitment, Administration and Client/Guest Management.

What Youll Do

HR & Recruitment
Post vacancies on recruitment platforms and social media.
Source and screen potential candidates.
Conduct preliminary/telephonic interview rounds.
Coordinate interviews with candidates and hiring managers.
Follow up with candidates regarding interviews, selection, documentation and joining.
Maintain recruitment trackers, HR records and employee files.
Coordinate the movement and proper filing of HR documents.
Assist with joining formalities and other HR activities.

Front Office & Administration
Welcome and professionally assist clients, guests, candidates and visitors.
Handle incoming calls, enquiries and visitor coordination.
Coordinate meetings and appointments with relevant departments.
Maintain visitor records and front-office documentation.
Ensure the reception area and front office are maintained professionally.
Support the HR/Admin team in day-to-day office coordination.

The Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who is:
Confident & professionally presentable
Excellent in communication skills
Good at understanding instructions and situations
Polite, warm and approachable
Strong in follow-ups and coordination
Organized and detail-oriented
Comfortable interacting with candidates, employees, clients and senior professionals
Proficient in MS Office / Google Workspace
A positive learner who is willing to take ownership

Why This Role?
One role. Multiple skill sets.
Gain hands-on exposure to:
Recruitment HR Operations Administration Client Handling Professional Communication

If you are looking for a role where you can learn, interact, coordinate and grow, we’d love to meet you!

Interested candidates can share their updated CV with the hrd@cayana.co.in.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Onco-Reconstructive Surgery: Perform complex plastic, microvascular, and reconstructive surgical procedures following major oncological resections, including head and neck, breast, musculoskeletal, and soft tissue reconstructions.
Microvascular Procedures: Plan and execute free tissue transfers, pedicled flaps, and microsurgical vessel anastomoses to restore form and function in post-cancer resection cases.
Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Participation: Collaborate closely with surgical oncologists, head and neck surgeons, surgical mammologists, and medical/radiation oncologists in pre-operative planning and tumor boards to design comprehensive treatment paths.
Wound & Lymphedema Management: Oversee advanced wound care, complex tissue defect management, skin grafting, and surgical intervention for cancer-related lymphedema.
Inpatient & Post-Operative Care: Lead post-operative flap monitoring, ICU care, and rehabilitative planning to ensure flap survival and optimal functional recovery.
Quality & Accreditation Compliance: Uphold institutional surgical safety checklists, infection control protocols, clinical documentation standards, and NABH guidelines.
Academic & Mentorship Contributions: Train surgical residents, fellows, and specialized nursing staff in basic plastic surgical techniques, wound care, and microvascular monitoring.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Education: MCh or DrNB in Plastic and Reconstructive Surgery following an MBBS and MS in General Surgery.
Experience: Above 5 years of post-qualification experience in Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery, with significant exposure to onco-reconstruction and microvascular techniques in a tertiary care or dedicated cancer hospital.
Technical Expertise: High procedural skill in free flap transfers, pedicled flap harvests, microsurgery, and aesthetic/functional tissue restoration.
Clinical & Soft Skills: Fine manual dexterity, strong clinical decision-making during complex multi-stage procedures, empathetic patient communication, and a strong collaborative mindset across surgical specialties.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Surgical Uro-Oncology: Perform complex open, laparoscopic, and minimally invasive surgical procedures for urological malignancies, including radical prostatectomies, radical cystectomies with urinary diversions, partial/radical nephrectomies, retroperitoneal lymph node dissections (RPLND), and penile/testicular cancer resections.
Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Participation: Lead urological discussion in multidisciplinary tumor boards alongside medical oncologists, radiation oncologists, radiologists, and pathologists to formulate tailored multimodal care plans.
Comprehensive Diagnostic Workup: Conduct specialized diagnostic procedures including flexible/rigid cystoscopy, image-guided prostate biopsies, transurethral resection of bladder tumors (TURBT), and urodynamic evaluations.
OPD & IPD Clinical Management: Provide expert outpatient consultations, manage surgical admissions, oversee perioperative ICU care, and drive recovery pathways for urologic cancer patients.
Complication & Emergency Management: Handle complex urological emergencies, post-operative surgical complications, and oncological issues such as malignant urinary tract obstructions or acute hematuria.
Quality & Accreditation Compliance: Ensure strict adherence to surgical safety protocols, infection control guidelines, electronic medical record documentation, and NABH standards.
Academics & Clinical Research: Guide residents, surgical fellows, and nursing staff in urologic oncology protocols, and participate in clinical trials and institutional research.

Preferred Candidate Profile
Education: MCh In Urology with a dedicated Fellowship in Uro-Oncology (or equivalent focused clinical training in urological cancers).
Experience: Above 5 years of post-qualification experience in Uro-Oncology, preferably within a high-volume tertiary care hospital or dedicated cancer center.
Technical Expertise: Advanced proficiency in laparoscopic and complex open uro-oncological procedures, urinary diversion techniques, and endourological interventions.
Clinical & Soft Skills: Strong surgical judgment, high precision, clear and empathetic communication with patients and families, and a collaborative team-first approach.

Description:
Roles & Responsibilities
Advanced Vascular & Non-Vascular Interventions: Perform a comprehensive range of vascular and non-vascular oncological interventions, including Transarterial Chemoembolization (TACE), Transarterial Radioembolization (TARE), radiofrequency/microwave ablations, central venous access line placements (PICC, Port-a-cath), and complex image-guided biopsies/drainages.
Diagnostic Imaging Expertise: Interpret and report high-resolution CT, MRI, Ultrasound, and Fluoroscopy scans for cancer staging, treatment response evaluation, and post-procedural monitoring.
Multidisciplinary Tumor Boards: Actively participate in weekly oncological tumor boards to collaborate with surgical, medical, and radiation oncologists in formulating personalized, minimally invasive treatment strategies.
Emergency & Critical Interventions: Provide emergency interventional radiology cover for acute oncological complications, including acute gastrointestinal bleeding, biliary tract obstructions, and urinary tract decompressions.
Protocol & Radiation Safety: Maintain strict radiation safety protocols, optimize dose-reduction techniques, and uphold high quality control standards in accordance with AERB, NABH, and institutional guidelines.
Mentorship & Academics: Guide and train junior doctors, radiology residents, fellows, and technologist staff in clinical protocols and advanced procedural techniques.


Preferred Candidate Profile
Education: MBBS, MD in Radiodiagnosis, with a recognized Fellowship in Interventional Radiology (FIVR) or equivalent dedicated training.
Experience: 5+ years of post-qualification experience in Radiodiagnosis and Interventional Radiology, preferably within a tertiary care hospital or dedicated cancer center.
Technical Expertise: Proven competence in high-volume vascular/non-vascular interventional oncology procedures and advanced cross-sectional imaging modalities.
Soft Skills: Exceptional clinical judgment, strong decision-making skills during critical procedures, empathetic patient communication, and a collaborative team mindset.
AboutCompany:
Bagchi Sri Shankara Cancer Centre & Research Institute (BSSCCRI) is a state-of-the-art, non-profit comprehensive cancer hospital and research center located in Info Valley, Bhubaneswar, Odisha.
Established as a collaborative venture between philanthropic leaders Subroto and Susmita Bagchi and the Sri Shankara Cancer Care Foundation (SSCCF), the institute was built with a vision to provide world-class, affordable, and compassionate cancer care to patients across Eastern India.
