Description:
Job Description (JD) Diploma Apprentice Trainee
Position: Diploma Apprentice Trainee - Production/Quality
Department: Production / Manufacturing
Location: Plant Operations
Reporting To: Production Line Manager / Shift In-Charge
Job Purpose
To assist the Production Line Manager in day-to-day manufacturing operations, ensure smooth production flow, support achievement of daily production targets, and develop practical knowledge of manufacturing processes, quality standards, safety practices, and productivity improvement initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
Assist the Line Manager in monitoring and executing daily production activities as per the production plan.
Support achievement of daily, shift-wise, and monthly production targets.
Ensure availability of materials, tools, and components at the production line.
Monitor production processes and report abnormalities, breakdowns, or quality issues to the supervisor.
Maintain production records, reports, and process-related documentation.
Support implementation of 5S, Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Ensure adherence to quality standards and company manufacturing procedures.
Follow all safety guidelines and promote a safe working environment.
Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, Stores, and Production Planning teams for smooth operations.
Assist in reducing line stoppages, rework, rejection, and wastage.
Participate in line balancing, productivity improvement, and cost reduction activities.
Perform any other production-related assignments as directed by the Line Manager.
Educational Qualification
Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Production, Mechatronics, Automobile, or related Engineering Discipline.
Apprenticeship registration as per applicable apprenticeship regulations.
Required Skills
Basic understanding of manufacturing and production processes.
Knowledge of quality concepts and safety practices.
Good communication and teamwork skills.
Basic computer knowledge (MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint).
Strong learning attitude and problem-solving capabilities.
Key Competencies
Discipline and accountability
Attention to detail
Continuous learning mindset
Team collaboration
Time management
Safety consciousness
Learning Outcomes
During the apprenticeship period, the trainee will gain exposure to:
Shop floor operations and manufacturing processes
Production planning and monitoring
Quality management systems
Lean manufacturing and productivity tools
Safety and statutory compliance practices
Cross-functional coordination in a manufacturing environment
Career Path: Successful apprentices may be considered for future opportunities based on performance, business requirements, and available vacancies.

Havells India Limited (Havells), one of Indias largest FMEG (Fast-Moving Electrical Goods) Company & power distribution equipment manufacturer.
Havells is among the few organizations being recognized as a Great Place to Work Certified TM Organization for the fourth consecutive year. We have also been recognized among Indias Best Workplaces in Building a Culture of Innovation by All Top 50.
Havells owns some of the most prestigious brands like Havells, Crabtree, Lloyd, Standard, & Reo offering a wide spectrum of products, including Industrial & Domestic Circuit Protection Devices, Cables & Wires, Motors, Fans, Modular Switches, Home Appliances, Water Heaters & Air Cooler, Grooming Products, Luminaires for Domestic, Commercial and Industrial Applications. With the acquisition of Lloyd in 2017, Havells has made a foray into high-potential consumer durables segments with offerings of Air-conditioners, Televisions, Refrigerators and Washing Machines.
Our global network consists of 7000+ professionals across 35 branches and 15 plants. The company boasts of a strong manufacturing prowess with 15 state-of-the-art manufacturing plants in India located in Haridwar, Baddi, Sahibabad, Faridabad, Alwar, Neemrana, Ghiloth, Tumkur, and Sricity. Currently over 95% of the product offering is energy efficient and manufactured in-house which makes Havells a name synonymous with excellence and expertise in the electrical industry.
Havells, over the years, has embarked on the journey of social change through inclusive growth. Serving Mid-Day Meal to over 70,000 students across 700 schools daily in the Alwar district, building over 4000 eco-friendly bio-toilets in 400 government schools, distributing over 1,90,000 reusable sanitary napkins to girls, and planting over 17 Lakh tree saplings so far, are among few of our CSR initiatives.

Description:
Position: Customer Relationship Executive (CRE)
Gender: Female candidates only
Location: jaipur - mi road , bais godam c scheme
Job Type: Full-time
Department: Client Relations / Customer Support
timings - 10;30-8;00
Role Overview
We are seeking a clear, articulate, and customer-focused Female Customer Relationship Executive (CRE) to join our team. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for our clients, responsible for managing client interactions, addressing queries, building positive long-term relationships, and ensuring a seamless client experience. High proficiency in English communication (both verbal and written) is mandatory.
Key Responsibilities
Client Interaction & Engagement: Act as the main liaison between the company and clients, handling inbound and outbound calls, emails, and meetings.
Relationship Management: Build, maintain, and strengthen trust-based relationships with new and existing clients.
Query & Issue Resolution: Timely respond to client inquiries, provide accurate information, and resolve complaints or issues efficiently.
Client Onboarding & Support: Assist new clients through the onboarding process and guide them on company products/services.
Feedback Collection: Gather client feedback and coordination with internal teams to continuous improve service quality.
Documentation & Reporting: Maintain accurate records of client interactions, correspondence, and feedback in the CRM database.
Key Requirements & Qualifications
Gender: Female candidate required.
Education: Bachelors degree in Business Administration, Communications, Marketing, or a related field.
Experience: [0-2 years / 2+ years] of experience in customer service, client relationship management, or front-desk administration.
Language Skills: Fluency in English (verbal and written) is mandatory. Outstanding tone, grammar, and articulation.
Interpersonal Skills: Warm personality, active listener, empathetic, and strong negotiation/problem-solving abilities.
Technical Skills: Basic knowledge of MS Office (Excel, Word) and familiarity with CRM software is an added advantage.
Key Competencies
Excellent telephone etiquette and professional demeanor.
Strong multitasking and time management capabilities.
Ability to stay calm and composure under pressure or when handling difficult client situations

Description:
Company: Startek

Process: Zomato Blended Process (Voice + Chat)

Department: Customer Support / Operations

About the Role

Startek is hiring enthusiastic and customer-focused individuals for the Zomato Blended Process. The role involves handling customer queries through voice and chat channels while ensuring a smooth and satisfactory customer experience.

Roles & Responsibilities

Handle customer queries and concerns through inbound calls and chat support.
Provide accurate information and effective resolutions to customer issues.
Assist customers with order-related queries, delivery concerns, cancellations, refunds, and other service-related requests.
Maintain professional communication and ensure high customer satisfaction.
Follow company policies, process guidelines, and quality standards.
Manage customer interactions efficiently while meeting performance and productivity targets.
Escalate complex issues to the concerned department whenever required.
Maintain proper documentation and records of customer interactions.

Eligibility Criteria

Undergraduate and graduate candidates are eligible.
Freshers and experienced candidates can apply.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Proficiency in both Hindi and English is mandatory.
Basic computer knowledge and typing skills are required.
Candidates must possess their own laptop and a stable Wi-Fi connection.

Shift & Work Requirements

9-hour rotational shifts.
Rotational week-offs.
Night shifts included.
No leaves permitted during the first 90 days of joining.
Festival leaves are not available.

Benefits

PF and ESIC facilities.
Quarterly performance-based bonus.
Opportunity to work with a reputed organization.
Professional growth and learning opportunities.

Important Note
Startek does not charge any fees or recruitment charges from candidates at any stage of the hiring process.

Interested candidates can join the recruitment group for further interview updates.

Description:
Job Summary
Job Title: Operations Analyst
Corporate Title: Analyst
Location: Jaipur
Responsibilities
The person will be responsible for day-to-day review of voice logs between Client Relationship Managers (RC) and clients where trade details are discussed and agreed. They need to ensure that all key trade-related details are clearly discussed, accurately captured, and documented in the applicable product-specific template. The role requires strong attention to detail, adherence to defined review standards, timely completion of assigned production duties, and appropriate escalation of exceptions, missing information, or first-level queries within the pre-specified timelines. The candidate should also act as a backup for peers when required and share best practices with the team to support consistent quality delivery.
Review voice logs between RCs and clients to validate that trade details have been discussed and agreed as per the required standards.
Listen to and understand client discussions conducted in English and Chinese language (Mandarin and Cantonese) and accurately document the agreed details in English or the prescribed business template, as applicable.
Complete the relevant product-specific voice log review template with accurate details, observations, and outcome of the review.
Identify and highlight missing, incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear trade details and escalate exceptions to the relevant stakeholders within agreed timelines.
Ensure accurate and timely completion of daily production activities in line with defined SLAs, cut-off times, and quality expectations.
Perform quality checks on completed reviews to support consistency, audit readiness, and control effectiveness.
Assist in preparing and reviewing daily control / production reports, including tracking of open items, exceptions, and follow-ups.
Support follow-up with RC / business teams for clarification or resolution of deficiencies noted during voice log review.
Maintain proper documentation and evidence of review outcomes to support internal control, audit, and management reporting requirements.
Coordinate with team members and stakeholders on complex cases, escalations, reporting requirements, and process improvements.
Act as backup for peers during absence and support knowledge sharing, cross-training, and continuous improvement within the team.
Perform other administration, reporting, and control-related tasks as assigned.
Your skills and experience
Minimum educational qualification: University graduate with a Bachelor s Degree.
Chinese Language Proficiency (Mandarin and/or Cantonese): Candidate must be able to understand spoken client conversations, interpret financial and investment terminology, and accurately document agreed trade details in English using prescribed Voice Log Review templates.
Good command of business English for accurate documentation, exception reporting, and stakeholder communication.
Understanding of trade lifecycle, banking / wealth management products, or control review processes will be an added advantage.
Strong listening, comprehension, documentation, and analytical skills with high attention to detail.
Ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies, missing information, and potential control issues from recorded conversations.
Candidates are required to be proficient in Microsoft Office applications, especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
Highly motivated, quality-focused, and able to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team environment.
Ability to multi-task and work under pressure to meet production timelines, cut-off times, and quality standards.
Good communication skills and ability to manage routine queries / first-level escalations professionally.
Proven ability to leverage AI tools to enhance productivity, optimise workflows to solve business problems, while applying critical judgment to ensure responsible and ethical use of data and AI outputs.

About MB Sons Jewellers
MB Sons Jewellers is renowned for exquisite craftsmanship, timeless luxury, and an unyielding commitment to trust and excellence. We pride ourselves on creating memorable luxury shopping experiences and building lifelong relationships with our valued patrons.
Job Summary
We are looking for an eloquent, warm, and sophisticated Client Relationship Executive to join our team. The ideal candidate will serve as the primary ambassador for our brand, focusing exclusively on high-touch client interaction, customer engagement, and relationship management. In this role, you will elevate the showroom experience, maintain personalized engagement with our esteemed clientele, and ensure every patron feels valued and cherished.
Key Responsibilities (Focused on Client Interaction)
High-Touch Client Engagement: Warmly welcome high-net-worth individuals (HNWIs) and walk-in clients, ensuring an inviting, luxurious, and hospitable atmosphere.
Personalized Consultation: Listen actively to clients' preferences, style choices, and occasions (weddings, anniversaries, corporate gifting) to assist them through their high-end jewellery selection process.
Relationship Building & Retention: Maintain a detailed client portfolio; follow up with clients post-purchase, celebrate special occasions (birthdays, anniversaries), and extend exclusive event invitations.
Brand Representation: Communicate the story, heritage, and unique craftsmanship of MB Sons Jewellers with passion, elegance, and in-depth product knowledge.
Client Advisory: Offer tailored advice on custom jewellery inquiries, bespoke orders, and maintenance/care services.
Feedback & Service Excellence: Act as the direct touchpoint for client feedback and ensure any service queries or special requests are addressed with utmost care and promptness.
Qualifications & Requirements
Experience: 13+ years of experience in client-facing roles, high-end retail, hospitality, or luxury customer service (Experience in fine jewellery/luxury lifestyle brands is a strong plus).
Communication Skills: Exceptional verbal communication and interpersonal skills with an articulate, polite, and refined demeanor.
Languages: Proficiency in English and local languages (Hindi/regional language fluency required).
Customer-Centric Mindset: Passionate about delivering exceptional customer service and crafting memorable client journeys.
Grooming & Presentation: Immaculate personal presentation and grooming consistent with a luxury brand environment.

Active Listening & Empathy
Polished Interpersonal & Networking Skills
Warm, Welcoming, and Professional Demeanor
High Emotional Intelligence (EQ) and Tact

Professional growth and long-term career advancement in high-end retail management.
A vibrant, luxurious, and supportive working environment.

Description:
Job Title - HCM Business Partner CB, IB Operations Controls, AVP
Location - Bangalore, Jaipur (India)
Role Description
About Human Resources
As a team, we partner with the business to drive an inclusive and sustainable performance culture. We take fair and transparent people decisions that are in the banks best interest. Our advice and products are focused, fact-based, relevant and improve employee experience in moments that matter. We shape Deutsche Banks working environment to enable our people to be the best they can be for our clients, the bank and society.
Overview
As the HR Business Partner, you will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing the people strategy for Corporate Bank (CB) and Investment Bank (IB) Operations Controls divisions in India, and drive HR initiatives to support business objectives. You will partner closely with senior leadership to provide both strategic and operational HR leadership for the identified divisions in the country.
Core expectations of this role are:
Functional leadership and partnership across HR
Governance, controls, and culture of excellence
Business partnership, ownership and accountability
Team / People leadership
Your key responsibilities
Implementation of HR s people strategy in partnership with Global, Divisional and Regional HR leadership
Provide HR functional leadership by fostering strong partnership, collaboration and engagement with the broader HR function, including regional and global stakeholders across business partner, product, country teams and process owners to deliver relevant HR solutions
Establish strong HR business partnerships by building trusted advisor relationships with regional and local stakeholders, providing independent HR guidance and advice, and taking ownership and accountability for all HR delivery and activities in India
Strengthen leadership effectiveness and build a robust talent pipeline for key senior roles in India
Create a positive and inclusive workplace culture that promotes employee engagement and retention
Drive global HR processes such as year-end compensation and promotion cycles and talent management, ensuring fair and consistent decisions with appropriate business management governance and ownership
Use key qualitative and quantitative metrics to inform decision-making and HR strategies
Implement diversity initiatives to raise awareness and improve gender diversity and inclusion
Participate in senior leadership team meetings, consulting on HR topics including leadership, policies and practices, diversity and inclusion, and talent management
Provide people leadership by fostering an inclusive culture of continuous learning and feedback, sharing best practices, and actively supporting the development of the HR team
Your skills and experience
MBA (HR) with a minimum of 10+ years of HR domain experience, including strong knowledge of HR policies, products and processes
At least 3 5 years of experience within the Banking sector
Excellent stakeholder management, relationship-building and communication skills
Experience working in a complex, multicultural, matrix organisation
Ability to operate independently and objectively to achieve the right people outcomes for the franchise
Solutions-oriented with an innovative mindset
Strong HR background with demonstrable business acumen and commercial understanding
Comfortable presenting to senior management groups, with the ability to produce concise, data-backed presentations and conduct necessary research and inquiry

Job Discription
. Execute, and monitor civil construction activities for retail projects including stores, malls, and warehouses

. Ensure execution as per approved drawings, specifications, BOQs, and project schedules

Support handover, snag closure, and final completion of projects

Competencies
Strong execution and delivery-focused mindset
Ability to manage multiple retail sites simultaneously
Problem-solving and decision-making capability on site.
Effective coordination with internal and external stakeholders.
Commitment to quality, safety, and timelines.

Description:
WHAT YOU WILL DO:

New Business Acquisition
Identify and onboard new B2B clients manufacturers, traders, distributors, and retailers who have regular

PTL freight movement needs.
Run the full sales cycle: prospecting, cold outreach, discovery calls, site visits, commercial proposals, and deal closure.
Focus on accounts with 50500 MT/month PTL potential across (but not restricted to) sectors such as FMCG, Auto-Components, Pharma, and Industrial Goods.

Revenue & Target Ownership
Own a monthly revenue target for your assigned territory and be accountable for delivery against it every billing cycle.
Maintain a healthy pipeline of 34x target coverage using Delhivery's internal CRM tools; update pipeline status weekly.
Track shipment volume, revenue, and yield per client; flag at-risk accounts proactively to your reporting manager.

Client Engagement & Retention
Conduct regular check-ins with newly onboarded clients to ensure smooth ramp-up of freight volumes post-onboarding.
Coordinate with the PTL Operations and Customer Success teams to resolve transit delays, damage claims, or POD issues that affect client experience.
Identify upsell opportunities — such as dedicated lane commitments, cross-dock usage, or value-added services — within the first 90 days of account activation.

Market Intelligence & Reporting
Map the competitive surface freight landscape in your territory — identify accounts held direct competition or regional players.
Share weekly market feedback on competitor pricing, new product launches, or shifts in client freight patterns with the regional BD head.
AboutCompany:
Delhivery is India's largest fully integrated logistics services provider.
With its nationwide network covering over 18,400 pin codes, the company provides a full suite of logistics services such as express parcel transportation, PTL freight, TL freight, cross-border, supply chain, and technology services.
Delhivery has successfully fullled over 1.7 billion shipments since inception and today works with over 28,000 customers, including large & small e-commerce participants, SMEs, and other enterprises & brands.
For more information about Delhivery, please visit www.delhivery.com.
Vision - Our vision is to become the operating system for commerce in India, through a combination of world-class infrastructure, high-quality logistics operations, cutting-edge engineering, and technology capabilities.
Team- Delhivery was founded in 2011 by Sahil Barua, Mohit Tandon, Bhavesh Manglani, Suraj Saharan, and Kapil Bharati and is now 56,000+ people strong.

Job Purpose

To manage and drive sales through distribution in order to attain market leadership in the given territory, through growth in gross numbers and revenues

Good communication skills

Analytical Thinking
Building Team Commitment
Must have technical / professional qualifications

Desired : post - graduation in business management/MBA
work ex: 1 - 4 years
Experience with distribution planning and channel implementation.

Description:
Location: Kolkata/Bangalore/Rajasthan

Job description
Job Title: Business Development Manager/Senior Manager
Employment Type: Full-Time

About the Role
We are seeking a dynamic and execution-focused Business Development Manager to lead market expansion and partnership initiatives in Kolkata/Bangalore/Rajasthan. The role will be responsible for identifying growth opportunities, driving site acquisitions (if retail/F&B), building strategic alliances, and delivering revenue targets in line with the companys regional expansion strategy.
This is a high-ownership role requiring strong commercial acumen, negotiation skills, and on-ground market intelligence.

Key Responsibilities
1 Market Expansion & Strategy
Develop and execute growth strategy aligned with regional objectives.
Identify high-potential micro-markets within Kolkata/Hyderabad/Haryana and secondary cities.
Conduct feasibility analysis including catchment, competition mapping, and revenue projections.
Build pipeline of priority opportunities.
2 Site Identification & Acquisition (Retail / F&B focused)
Source and evaluate high-street and mall locations.
Negotiate commercial terms.
Liaise with landlords, developers, brokers, and mall management.
Coordinate with legal and finance teams for deal closure.
3 Partnerships & Alliances
Develop relationships with local partners, developers, and institutional stakeholders.
Identify potential JV or franchise opportunities (if applicable).
Represent company in networking forums and industry events.
4 Financial & Commercial Analysis
Build unit-level P&L projections.
Evaluate commercial viability including payback for proposed sites/partnerships.
Monitor performance of newly launched units vs projections.
5 Cross-functional Coordination
Work closely with operations, marketing, finance, and legal teams.
Ensure seamless transition from site acquisition to store launch.
Drive project timelines from sourcing to opening.
Key Requirements
Bachelors degree in Business, Finance, Real Estate, or related field.
510 years of experience in Business Development / Real Estate Expansion / Retail Leasing / F&B Expansion.
Strong network within the state and key cities.
Proven experience negotiating leases and commercial agreements.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience expanding brands.
Exposure to mall / Highstreet leasing.
Familiarity with local licensing and regulatory processes.
Experience in multi-unit expansion environment.
What We Offer
Competitive compensation (Base + Performance Bonus).
Leadership exposure in a high-growth market.
Opportunity to build and scale operations.
Regional career progression

Leadership: Strong team-handling capabilities, mentoring skills, and ability to drive numbers through a team.
Knowledge: Deep understanding of mortgages, LAP, loan documentation, KYC, and local market dynamics.
Communication: Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.

Description:
We are looking for a skilled NPD Manager with 4-6 years of experience to lead our plastic and steel kitchenware product development team in Bhiwadi. The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in end-to-end new product development (NPD), from concept to commercialization.
Roles and Responsibilities :
Lead end-to-end New Product Development (NPD) for plastic & steel kitchenware products.
Develop new products based on market trends, customer requirements and competitor benchmarking.
Handle product development from concept design prototype tooling trials testing costing mass production.
Coordinate with Design, Tool Room, Production, Quality, Purchase, Marketing and suppliers.
Develop and manage injection moulds, dies, fixtures and other tooling.
Apply strong knowledge of plastic injection moulding and sheet-metal/steel manufacturing processes.
Develop using materials such as PP, HDPE, ABS, SS, MS and other relevant materials.
Review 2D/3D drawings, BOMs, specifications and product designs.
Drive DFM/DFA, VA/VE and cost-reduction initiatives.
Plan and monitor T0/T1/T2 trials, prototype development and product validation.
Ensure products meet quality, functionality, aesthetics, cost and timeline requirements.
Identify and develop suitable vendors for components, tooling and manufacturing processes.
Ensure smooth transfer of new products from NPD to commercial production.
Candidate must have already executed similar NPD/product development work in plastic & steel kitchenware (or closely related consumer product manufacturing).
Job Requirements :
Minimum 4-6 years of experience in product development / NPD with hands-on exposure across concept-to-mass production.
Strong knowledge of product development principles, including NPD and product design.
Experience working with plastic and steel materials preferred (PP/HDPE/ABS/SS/MS).
Ability to review drawings, BOMs and specifications and drive trials/testing.
Excellent communication and project management skills.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and ability to work cross-functionally.

With a focus on quality, innovation, and operational excellence, Dream Home Plasto Ware caters to diverse customer requirements across domestic and international markets. We strive to build long-term business relationships and create a work environment that encourages professional growth, teamwork, and continuous improvement.

Description:
Job Summary
We are looking for an Oracle Senior Developer who can design, build and tune high-performing Oracle database solutions. You will own database objects end to end, from design through deployment, and keep production systems fast, stable and well documented. You will work closely with data architects, application developers and support teams. The role suits someone who enjoys solving performance problems and writing clean, reusable PL/SQL.
Responsibilities
Design, code, test and deploy database objects, including complex stored procedures, packages, functions, views, materialised views, triggers and sequences.
Translate business and application requirements into efficient, secure database logic.
Build and maintain data load, transformation and batch scripts.
Manage database changes through version control and structured release processes.
Performance tuning: Optimise slow-running SQL queries, PL/SQL blocks and database scripts.
Analyse execution plans using Explain Plan, TKPROF, AWR and similar diagnostic tools.
Apply indexing strategies, optimiser hints, partitioning and query rewrites to improve throughput and response times.
Proactively identify and remove performance risks before they reach production.
Collaborate with data architects to design relational database schemas, tables and constraints.
Apply normalisation, referential integrity and other relational database best practices.
Contribute to logical and physical data models and review them for scalability and maintainability.
Identify, investigate and resolve production bugs, execution exceptions and performance bottlenecks.
Perform root-cause analysis and implement permanent fixes, not just workarounds.
Support incident and problem management within agreed SLAs, including on-call support when required.
Write clean, maintainable and reusable code that follows agreed coding standards.
Conduct peer code reviews and provide constructive feedback to other developers.
Maintain technical specifications, schema documentation and data dictionaries.
Requirements
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
4-6 years of hands-on experience in Oracle database development.

Description:
Job Summary
To support the effective implementation of EHS standards, Life Saving Rules, safe work practices, and risk mitigation measures across the plant. The Safety Officer will be responsible for identifying hazards, preventing unsafe acts and conditions, ensuring compliance with safety requirements, and supporting the organization in achieving its goal of Zero Accidents, Zero Fatalities, and Zero LTI. The Safety Officer shall maintain a strong shop-floor presence and work closely with Production, Maintenance, Engineering, Projects, Contractors, Security, and other functions to ensure that safety requirements are effectively implemented.


Responsibilities
EHS Standards & Life Saving Rules - Implement and monitor applicable EHS standards, procedures, and Life Saving Rules.
Conduct regular field verification of safety standards.
Immediately intervene and Stop the Work if any Life Saving Rule violation, deviation, or serious unsafe condition is observed.
Ensure work resumes only after required controls are implemented and verified.
Promote a strong safety culture across the plant.
Shop-Floor Safety Inspection - Conduct daily shop-floor and workplace safety inspections.
Identify and report Unsafe Acts (UA), Unsafe Conditions (UC), and unsafe behaviors.
Communicate observations to concerned departments and follow up for timely closure.
Monitor repeated violations and escalate critical issues to the EHS Manager.
Risk Assessment - Support preparation and review of HIRA, JSA/JHA, Risk Assessments, and SOPs.
Verify that identified risk controls are implemented at the workplace.
Ensure high-risk activities are not started without appropriate controls.
Participate in risk assessments for new processes, equipment, and activities.
Permit-to-Work System - Verify and support the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system for high-risk activities.
Inspect the workplace before work starts.
Verify required controls such as: LOTO, PPE, Barricading, Gas testing, Fire protection, Working-at-height controls, Rescue arrangements.
Conduct field verification during the work.
Contractor & Vendor Safety - Conduct safety induction for new contractors, vendors, and workers.
Verify required safety documents before deployment.
Monitor contractor work practices and compliance.
Conduct contractor safety inspections and toolbox talks.
Ensure contractor employees use required PPE and follow approved procedures.
Report and escalate serious contractor safety violations.
Machine & Equipment Safety - Conduct inspections of machinery, equipment, guards, interlocks, emergency stops, and safety devices.
Identify machine guarding deficiencies and ensure corrective actions.
Prevent bypassing or tampering with safety devices.
Support pre-commissioning safety inspections for new equipment.
MHE & Material Handling Safety - Monitor safe operation of forklifts, pallet trucks, cranes, hoists, and other MHE.
Verify operator authorization and competency.
Monitor pedestrian segregation and vehicle movement.
Check critical behaviors such as speeding, mobile phone usage, unsafe reversing, overloading, and seat-belt violations.
Support implementation of effective traffic management controls.
LOTO & Energy Isolation - Verify compliance with Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) requirements.
Ensure hazardous energy sources are properly isolated before maintenance or intervention.
Conduct field verification of LOTO practices.
Report any deviation immediately.
PPE Management - Ensure employees and contractors use appropriate PPE.
Conduct regular PPE compliance inspections.
Identify PPE requirements based on workplace risks.
Monitor PPE availability and usage.
Report PPE-related gaps and support procurement requirements.
Safety Training & Awareness - Conduct safety induction and toolbox talks.
Support training programs on: Life Saving Rules, Machine Safety, MHE Safety, Working at Height, Electrical Safety, LOTO, Fire Safety, PPE, Emergency Response.
Maintain training and attendance records.
Ensure employees understand the hazards associated with their work.
Near-Miss & Incident Reporting - Encourage employees to report Near Misses, Unsafe Acts, and Unsafe Conditions.
Participate in incident and near-miss investigations.
Support identification of root causes and corrective actions.
Follow up on action closure and verify effectiveness.
Communicate lessons learned to concerned teams.
Emergency Preparedness - Support emergency preparedness and response activities.
Participate in mock drills and emergency exercises.
Inspect emergency equipment and access routes.
Support the Emergency Response Team during emergencies.
Report deficiencies in fire and emergency preparedness systems.
Safety Audits & Compliance - Conduct routine safety audits and inspections.
Support internal, corporate, customer, and statutory audits.
Maintain inspection records and action trackers.
Follow up on observations until closure.
Ensure compliance with applicable legal and organizational requirements.
SOP & Safety Documentation - Verify availability and accessibility of approved SOPs and work instructions at the workplace.
Ensure operators follow approved procedures.
Report gaps between documented procedures and actual practices.
Support development and revision of safety checklists and SOPs.
Safety Communication - Display and communicate important EHS information across the workplace.
Conduct safety awareness campaigns and toolbox meetings.
Communicate daily safety observations and critical issues during shift handover.
Promote positive safety behavior through employee engagement.
Workplace Safety Measurements - Support workplace monitoring of: Noise, Illumination, Temperature, Humidity, Air quality and other applicable parameters.
Maintain records and communicate abnormal results for corrective action.
Safety Performance Monitoring - Maintain daily/weekly safety inspection data.
Track: Safety observations, Near Misses, Unsafe Acts/Conditions, LSR violations, Training, PTW compliance, Audit observations, Corrective action closure.
Support preparation of monthly EHS reports and dashboards.
Safety Improvement - Identify opportunities for hazard elimination and risk reduction.
Recommend engineering controls wherever practical.
Participate in safety improvement projects.
Share best practices and lessons learned.
Support continuous improvement of the plant's safety culture.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Zero Fatalities
Zero LTI / Major Injuries
100% compliance with applicable Life Saving Rules
Timely closure of critical safety observations

Job Description
Managing the production line/lines in shifts. Ensuring production targets are met with compliance in QSPECS parameters laid down.
Job Responsibilities
Responsible for delivering production as per production plan, ensuring safety, quality within specifications, yields and usages within targets
Responsible for carrying out breakdown maintenance for all equipment within the shortest possible time during the shift, RCA and CAPA implementation to be done for the same
Responsible for manning requisition and allocation of available manpower to various work stations during the shift.
Responsible for verification of CLTI and log books along with rejections in the shift
Responsible for conducting 1hr per equipment on the respective equipment on daily basis by focusing on 5S, CLTI, PM , Abnormality identification and tagging , operator training and safety
Equipment tracking to be maintained in line with CMMS and closure status updated. Total Tag age to be reduced below 7 days by pushing equipment tracking sheet and maintaining spares inventory
Planning, communication and execution of punch list activities during maintenance window
Performing COLA entries and maintaining preform tracking sheet.

Description:
Role & responsibilities
Execute API manufacturing activities as per approved Batch Manufacturing Records (BMRs) and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
Handle chemical reactions, charging, distillation, filtration, drying, centrifugation and material transfer operations.
Operate and monitor reactors, centrifuges, dryers and other production equipment.
Maintain process parameters, yield records, batch documentation and equipment logbooks.
Follow cGMP, EHS, safety procedures and housekeeping standards.
Coordinate with QA, QC, Engineering and Stores departments to ensure smooth production operations.
Report process deviations, equipment issues and safety incidents to the supervisor.

Preferred candidate profile
Qualification: B.Sc. / M.Sc. Chemistry or Diploma / B.Tech in Chemical Engineering.
Experience: 04 years in API manufacturing or pharmaceutical chemical production.
Basic knowledge of chemical reactions, unit operations, GMP documentation and industrial safety.
Ability to work in shifts and handle production activities in a manufacturing plant.
Freshers with relevant qualifications and a willingness to learn may also apply.

Perks and benefits
Competitive salary based on qualifications and experience.
PF, ESI and other statutory benefits as applicable.
Training and career growth opportunities.
Safe and professional working environment.
Shift allowance, overtime and other benefits as per company policy.
Opportunity to develop technical expertise in API manufacturing.

Job Summary:
We are looking for experienced operators to handle Ghee and Paneer processing and automated packing lines. The role involves operating and monitoring automated equipment, ensuring process parameters, quality standards, production targets, and basic troubleshooting are maintained.

Operate and monitor automated Ghee/Panner processing and packing lines.
Monitor process parameters and ensure smooth production operations.

ITI/Diploma/Graduate with relevant experience in Dairy/Food Processing, Ghee, Paneer or automated packing lines. Experience in operating PLC/HMI-based automated machinery.

Description:
Note: Only shortlisted candidates will be invited to attend the hiring drive in Hyderabad on October 30, October 31, and November 1
Primary Purpose of Job:
Stantec is an engineering design and remediation leader in global infrastructure, water resources, buildings, mining, power & dams, and oil & gas sectors. We provide, program management and technology solutions for the environmental, water, wastewater, energy and power markets in North Americas, Europe, Middle East, and Asia Pacific regions. Stantecs Pune, India office is looking for a Civil designer to join our team and work in Water group.
The role is to support project managers/team leaders by providing civil design (CAD/BIM) support to ensure that project outcomes in terms of budget, schedule, technical and quality standards, meet both the client and STANTEC expectations. Design and documentation of projects under the instructions and guidance of a Project Engineer using Civil Engineering techniques utilizing software such as, but not limited to, Autodesk Civil3D, Infraworks and AutoCAD in accordance with Client standards and procedures.
Key Accountabilities:
Preparation of basic site layouts, general arrangement drawings, pipeline longitudinal sections, grading, cut and fill calculations, etc.
To understand design and drafting systems and standards and design development process followed by clients and implement in work
Earthworks, erosion and sediment control design / modelling
Water and wastewater pipeline design / modelling
Travel offshore for training/on-site work: Occasionally
Regularly interact and engage with other members of the discipline
Build and develop professional profile both internally and externally
Adherence to professional standards, ethics and Client quality procedures and standards
Design of projects under the instructions of a PL or Engineer using Civil engineering software such as, but not limited to, Autodesk Civil3D, Infraworks and AutoCAD
Execute project modelling & detailing services
Develop design skills and industry knowledge together with a consistent track record in performance
Assist in development of tools and constant improvement to procedures and standards
Attend project review meetings and ensure the provision of completed and reviewed drawings (self-verification checklists)
Develop a reputation for reliability and consistency
Effective written and verbal communication skills
Person Specifications:
BEng (or equivalent) in Civil Engineering + minimum 12 years of relevant experience or Diploma in Civil Engineering + minimum 10 years of relevant experience
Good hands-on experience of AutoCAD 2D / Civil3D is must.
Civil3D skills like gravity and pressure networks, grading experience, site grading, land development etc. must
Knowledge of MicroStation/ OpenRoads / Infraworks / Revit / 12D will be preferred.
Knowledge of wet infrastructure and networks
Experience of preparing the drawings of pipe fittings, connection details for different material of pipelines
General knowledge of construction techniques and practices
Knowledge and project experience of working and delivering in a BIM environment
Good oral and written communication skills
Ability to lead teams independently and lead tasks and manage work of team
Competent level of client service management, i.e., able to interact with clients and to build and maintain lasting, positive relationships
Capable to analyze complex issues pertaining to projects and support the team lead in mitigating them in advance
Competent level of baseline skills, i.e., professional ethics, confident with the essential, basic business and communication skills that are required for career growth
Rigorous attention to detail, able to understand and adopt workflows and commitment to professional development
Flexible attitude to accepting different work assignments and proactive attitude to execution / delivery
Good interpersonal skills
Willing to work for different regions and willing to learn
Professionally accredited or on the verge of achieving it (ICE UK/ CIWEM)

Description:
SUMMARY
Job Title: Process Mechanic - Coating Concept
Job Location:  Germany
Industry:  Automotive/ Industrial Coating
Employment Type:  Full - Time
Working Hours: 40 hours/week
Starting Salary: 2,400 Euros/Approx. 2.63 lakh INR Gross per Month

Job Description:
We are looking for skilled Painters / Spray Painters from India with an NTC/ITI qualification in Painter (General) for employment with an automotive supplier in Germany. The selected candidates will work in the industrial coating of high-value plastic and composite (CFRP/carbon) components used in the automotive industry. Candidates with practical experience in spray painting, surface preparation, masking, polishing, and finishing of components are encouraged to apply.

Key Responsibilities:
Prepare plastic and composite/carbon components for painting.
Carry out manual sanding and surface preparation.
Perform masking of components before painting.
Prepare, set up, and clean components using appropriate chemical solutions.
Carry out manual spray painting using a spray gun.
Paint plastic and composite/CFRP components according to required quality standards.
Perform polishing and finishing of painted components.
Follow workplace safety, quality, and production procedures.
Perform other general support duties as assigned by the shift supervisor.


Requirements
A minimum of 3 years of practical spray painting/spray gun experience is desirable.
Experience in industrial painting, automotive painting, plastic component painting, or composite/CFRP painting will be an advantage.
Candidates with strong hands-on painting skills and relevant ITI/NTC training may also be considered.
Qualification:
NTC / ITI Painter (General) qualification.
Qualification should preferably be issued under NCVT / DGT.
Candidates with relevant vocational training in industrial painting/coating technology may also be considered.


Benefits
    Family-like working atmosphere, flat hierarchies, young international team
       Safe, modern workplace in a growing company
       Personal and professional development opportunities
       Voluntary additional benefits, special and bonus payments, employer contribution to retirement provision
       Predictable vacation planning through company shutdown periods, additional vacation days
       Free work clothing and safety equipment
       Free cold beverages, discounted hot beverages, free parking

Description:
Location: Sri City
Job Summary
Could you be the full-time Warehouse -Receiving EPU in Sri City? we're looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your warehouse management and operational expertise in a cutting-edge field. You'll work alongside dynamic and collaborative teammates. You'll play a key role in ensuring seamless warehouse operations and production line feeding, contributing to the efficiency and success of our supply chain. Day-to-day, you'll work closely with teams across the business (e.g., Logistics Management, Material Planners, Quality, and Finance), oversee material receiving and kitting processes, and much more. You'll specifically take care of inventory accuracy and timely material availability for production, but also lead and coach your team to drive continuous improvement initiatives.
Responsibilities
Promoting a culture of safety and ensuring compliance with safety regulations
Self-manage the SQCD targets in Daily Work Management (DWM) APSYS board
Maintain On time unloading, GRN, put away activities with 100% accuracy.
Improve sustain the 5S in Warehouse.
Escalate the technical constrains to the internal/external Team members through mail
Identify Transaction errors/missing and update on time after analysis.
Drive Receiving team and maintain discipline punctuality in the warehouse
Maintain 100% accuracy in GSI Transactions
Propose the suggestions in the process for SQCD improvement through SWIP
Maintain good level of inventory accuracy against target.
Conducting training sessions for teams on warehouse processes and lean methodologies
Representing the warehouse during internal and external audits, ensuring zero NCR
Providing regular reports on warehouse activity metrics and performance
Identifying and resolving operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies
Performance Measurement
Adhering the safety norms in the warehouse and follow AZDP rules
Ensure On Time GRN and On Time Put-away targets
Improve 100% accuracy in GSI transactions
Maintain 100% put away and GRN accuracy
Productivity in Receiving Process
Improve 100% Location accuracy of store stock
All about you
We value passion and attitude over experience. Thats why we dont expect you to have every single skill. Instead, we've listed some that we think will help you succeed and grow in this role:
Degree in Engineering or a related field from a reputed institution
3 to 5 years of experience in warehouse operations
Working knowledge in an ERP environment (SAP desirable), including MM, WM, and PP modules
Experience in inventory management material receiving, kitting, and line feeding activities
Strong problem-solving skills and quick reactivity to critical issues
Proficiency in team management and fostering collaboration
Knowledge of lean management and continuous improvement practices
Effective communication and leadership skills
Agility and process-oriented mindset
Things youll enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. Youll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines
Work with new security standards for rail signalling
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues
Contribute to innovative projects
Utilise our agile and inclusive working environment
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning
Progress towards leadership roles or specialized expertise in supply chain management
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension)
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, were an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Description:
Location: Sri City
Company: Alstom
Job Summary
Could you be the full-time Site Buyer for Indirect Sourcing in Sri City were looking for
Your future role
Take on a new challenge and apply your procurement and sourcing expertise in a new cutting-edge field. Youll work alongside collaborative, innovative, and forward-thinking teammates.
You'll play a key role in developing and executing country-specific sourcing strategies for indirect categories, ensuring alignment with global commodity strategies. Day-to-day, youll work closely with teams across the business (finance, legal, operations, project teams, and more), manage supplier relationships, and ensure effective procurement strategies that drive cost savings and support organizational objectives.
You'll specifically take care of sourcing strategies for categories such as Real Estate, Office Interiors, Civil Construction, Production Consumables, MRO, and Capex items, but also focus on supplier management and process improvements.
Well look to you for:
Developing and implementing sourcing strategies for various indirect categories.
Conducting market research to identify potential suppliers and benchmark pricing.
Managing the procurement process from requisition to supplier selection.
Building and maintaining strong supplier relationships to ensure quality, service, and compliance.
Analyzing spend data to identify cost-saving opportunities and monitoring procurement performance metrics.
Collaborating with internal stakeholders to ensure a holistic approach to procurement.
Requirements
Bachelors degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, or a related field (B.E preferred).
Experience in indirect procurement or sourcing (5-7 years preferred).
Proven track record in supplier negotiation and management.
Knowledge of procurement software such as ARIBA, SAP, or BASWARE, and proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite.
A professional certification in procurement (e.g., CIPS, CPSM) is an added advantage.
Strong analytical skills for assessing market trends and identifying cost-saving opportunities.
Excellent negotiation and communication skills with an international mindset.
Proven leadership and ability to work collaboratively across cross-functional teams.
What you will enjoy
Join us on a life-long transformative journey the rail industry is here to stay, so you can grow and develop new skills and experiences throughout your career. Youll also:
Enjoy stability, challenges, and a long-term career free from boring daily routines.
Work with new security standards for rail signalling.
Collaborate with transverse teams and helpful colleagues.
Contribute to innovative projects that have a tangible impact on the future of mobility.
Utilise our inclusive and agile working environment.
Steer your career in whatever direction you choose across functions and countries.
Benefit from our investment in your development, through award-winning learning opportunities.
Progress towards leadership roles in procurement or other functions.
Benefit from a fair and dynamic reward package that recognises your performance and potential, plus comprehensive and competitive social coverage (life, medical, pension).
You dont need to be a train enthusiast to thrive with us. We guarantee that when you step onto one of our trains with your friends or family, youll be proud. If youre up for the challenge, wed love to hear from you!
Important to note
As a global business, were an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates diversity across the 63 countries we operate in. Were committed to creating an inclusive workplace for everyone.

Description:
Job Title: Admin Executive
Department: Administration & Operations
Industry: NBFC (Non-Banking Financial Company)
Reporting To: Admin Manager / Branch Manager / Operations Manager
Job Location: [Vijayawada] Multiple Locations in AP
Job Purpose
To manage day-to-day administrative activities, office infrastructure, vendor coordination, documentation, asset management, and branch support to ensure smooth and efficient functioning of the NBFC office while adhering to company policies and applicable compliance requirements.
Key Responsibilities
1. Office Administration
Manage daily office administration and ensure smooth branch operations.
Maintain office premises, housekeeping, security, utilities, and general facilities.
Monitor office supplies, stationery, printing materials, and other administrative requirements.
Maintain records of office assets, equipment, and inventory.
2. Vendor and Facility Management
Coordinate with vendors for housekeeping, security, maintenance, internet, telephone, and other services.
Obtain quotations, process purchase requests, and follow up on vendor bills and payments.
Monitor vendor performance and ensure timely delivery of services.
Coordinate office repairs, maintenance, and facility-related issues.
3. Documentation and Record Management
Maintain administrative files, registers, invoices, bills, and supporting documents.
Ensure proper filing and secure storage of confidential company records.
Support internal audits and compliance reviews by providing administrative documents.
Maintain records of agreements, AMC contracts, insurance, and other office-related documents.
4. Branch and Operational Support
Coordinate with branch teams, regional offices, and the corporate office for administrative requirements.
Support employee onboarding, ID cards, access cards, seating arrangements, and exit formalities.
Arrange travel, accommodation, meetings, and official events as required.
Coordinate courier services, dispatches, and receipt of official documents.
Assist with branch opening, shifting, closure, and infrastructure-related activities.
5. Cost Control and Expense Management
Track administrative expenses and maintain supporting bills and invoices.
Prepare monthly administrative expense statements and MIS reports.
Monitor stationery, utility, housekeeping, and maintenance costs.
Ensure expenses are incurred within approved budgets and company policies.
6. Compliance and Internal Controls
Follow company policies, approval procedures, and administrative SOPs.
Maintain confidentiality of employee, customer, and business information.
Support internal and statutory audits by maintaining accurate administrative records.
Ensure office safety, security, and proper control of company assets.
Coordinate with relevant teams for document retention and secure disposal as per company policy.
Eligibility Criteria
Education: Graduate in any discipline; a qualification in Business Administration is preferred.
Experience: 13 years of experience in administration, preferably in an NBFC, banking, financial services, or a multi-branch organization.
Computer Skills: Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Word, email, and office documentation.
Communication: Good verbal and written communication skills.
Other Skills: Vendor management, coordination, record keeping, time management, and problem-solving.
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Timely completion of administrative activities.
Cost control and adherence to approved budgets.
Accuracy and timely submission of bills, invoices, and MIS reports.
Timely resolution of facility and vendor-related issues.
Maintenance of accurate asset and inventory records.
Audit readiness and compliance with internal administrative policies.
Satisfaction of branch employees and internal stakeholders.
Preferred Competencies
Strong organizational and coordination skills.
Attention to detail and accuracy.
Professional conduct and integrity.
Ability to manage multiple tasks independently.
Ability to work under deadlines and coordinate with multiple branches.
High level of confidentiality and accountability.
Note: The role may require coordination with multiple branches, regional offices, vendors, and corporate administration teams depending on business requirements.

Description:
About Swiggy:

Swiggy is Indias leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India. From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming Indias leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees

.Role: Sales Manager I

A Sales Manager owns the acquisition and engagement of single-outlet independent restaurants across an assigned city. You are the primary touchpoint for these restaurants learning their business understanding their challenges, and building a partnership where you help the restaurant partner directly drive their growth in orders, visibility, and customer engagement. This role is Consultative & On-Field and requires you to be resourceful, adaptable, and genuinely invested in your partners' success. You'll develop consultative sales skills, learn restaurant operations intimately, and build the foundation for scaling your career.

Job Description:

Own a defined geographic territory: build strong and successful relationships with the assigned restaurant partners
Field-intensive engagement: Conduct in-person visits, walking restaurants through product demos, ROI analysis, and present how working with Swiggy is a mutually beneficial relationship
Consultative selling: Diagnose restaurant needs through questions about their current channels, delivery logistics, marketing spend, and business goals. Position Swiggys products as solutions, not features
Relationship management: Manage the full lifecycle each month, pitching, negotiation, activation, and ongoing support to the restaurant partner
Data-driven problem solving: Track adoption metrics, identify why restaurants aren't growing, troubleshoot issues, and course-correct
Revenue responsibility: Own targets within your territory; track your own pipeline and conversion rates
Excel mastery: all the data related to your day-to-day work will be on the city and central trackers, so you must have advanced knowledge of Excel/Google sheet/WSP
Market research: Stay updated on restaurant trends, competitive landscape, and local market dynamics. Feedback from the field informs product direction 80 to 90 In-person meetings with restaurant partners a month What We're Looking For

Experience & Background:

0-2 years in B2B sales, field sales, or business development (preferably in FMCG, food/beverage, or hotel industry)
Track record of meeting or exceeding targets and managing your own pipeline
Restaurant Business is a round-the-clock business; the role holder has to take ownership of the growth of the assigned portfolio of restaurant partners.
Comfort with data, especially Excel—you should be able to build pivot tables, use VLOOKUP, and create dashboards without help
Post - Graduated preferably in marketing or sales

Description:
Site Head Rooftop Solar Projects (South)
Location: South India (Site-Based)
Business: Tata Power Renewable Energy Limited (TPREL)
Department: EPC / Rooftop Solar Projects
Experience: 7–14 Years
Education: B.E./B.Tech in Electrical & Electronics Engineering or Electrical Engineering
Age: 35–45 Years
Languages: Telugu and Kannada (Preferable)
Role Purpose
The Site Head – Rooftop Solar Projects will be responsible for end-to-end execution and management of rooftop solar projects at site, ensuring timely delivery within approved budget, scope, quality, and safety standards. The incumbent will lead site operations, coordinate with stakeholders, manage vendors and contractors, and drive project completion while ensuring adherence to organizational and regulatory requirements.
Key Responsibilities
Project Execution & Lifecycle Management
Lead the complete project lifecycle from site mobilization to commissioning and project handover.
Ensure successful execution of rooftop solar projects as per approved scope, timelines, quality standards, and budget.
Monitor project progress and implement corrective actions to mitigate delays and project risks.
Drive achievement of project milestones and ensure timely completion.
Site Operations Management
Oversee day-to-day site operations, workforce deployment, and resource utilization.
Conduct regular site reviews and progress assessments.
Planning & Project Controls
Develop detailed project execution plans, schedules, and tracking mechanisms.
Monitor project performance against planned timelines and budgets.
Coordinate material availability, manpower planning, and equipment deployment.
Maintain project documentation and reporting systems.
Quality & Safety Management
Ensure implementation of best-in-class quality standards and construction practices.
Drive compliance with all HSE (Health, Safety & Environment) requirements and statutory regulations.
Conduct safety audits, toolbox talks, and quality inspections.
Promote a strong safety culture across all project sites.
Stakeholder Management
Act as the primary point of contact for customers, consultants, local authorities, and internal stakeholders.
Ensure effective communication and alignment among project teams and business functions.
Manage client expectations and address project-related concerns proactively.
Vendor & Contract Management
Manage contractors, vendors, and subcontractors throughout the project lifecycle.
Monitor vendor performance against contractual obligations, safety, quality, and delivery parameters.
Resolve contractual and execution-related issues to ensure uninterrupted project progress.
Team Leadership
Lead, mentor, and develop site engineering and execution teams.
Foster a high-performance culture focused on safety, quality, and timely project delivery.
Ensure effective coordination among engineering, procurement, and execution teams.
Technical Problem Solving
Identify and troubleshoot technical, operational, and execution challenges.
Drive resolution of site-level issues with minimal impact on project timelines.
Support commissioning, testing, and performance optimization activities.
Desired Candidate Profile
Education
B.E./B.Tech in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or related discipline.
Experience
7–14 years of experience in solar, renewable energy, EPC, power, or infrastructure projects.
Proven experience in rooftop solar project execution and site management.
Strong exposure to project planning, construction management, commissioning, and stakeholder handling.
Technical Skills
Rooftop Solar Project Execution.
Project Planning & Control.
Electrical Systems & Installation.
Site Construction Management.
Quality Assurance & Safety Management.
Contract & Vendor Management.
Risk Assessment & Mitigation.
Project Scheduling Tools (MS Project/Primavera preferred).
Behavioral Competencies
Leadership and team management.
Excellent coordination and communication skills.
Strong stakeholder management capabilities.
Problem-solving and decision-making skills.
Result-oriented approach with ownership mindset.
Other Requirements
Willingness to work from project sites across South India.
Proficiency in Telugu and Kannada is mandatory.
Ability to travel extensively based on project requirements.
Reporting To: Project/Regional Execution Head – Rooftop Solar Business (TPREL)
Team Size: Site Engineers, Supervisors, Contractors & Vendor Workforce (as applicable).

Description:
Job Title: Branch Sales Manager Loan Against Property (LAP)
Company: Muthoot Finance
Department: Sales Loan Against Property (LAP)
Job Location: Eluru, Andhra Pradesh
Employment Type: Full-Time
Experience: 4–8 Years
CTC : Upto 10LPA
Industry: Banking / NBFC / Financial Services

Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced and result-oriented Branch Sales Manager to lead and manage the sales team for our Loan Against Property (LAP) business. The candidate will be responsible for driving branch-level business growth, managing Sales Managers, developing new business opportunities, and ensuring the achievement of monthly and quarterly sales targets.
The ideal candidate should have strong team management, business development, and sales leadership skills, preferably with experience in LAP, mortgage loans, secured lending, or retail asset sales within the banking or NBFC sector.

Key Responsibilities

Lead, manage, and motivate a team of Sales Managers to achieve branch-level business targets and sales objectives.
Drive Loan Against Property (LAP) business growth by implementing effective sales strategies and business development initiatives.
Monitor individual and team performance, productivity, lead conversion, loan disbursements, and target achievement.
Set sales targets for team members, review their performance regularly, and take corrective actions to improve productivity.
Identify new business opportunities, develop untapped markets, and expand the branch's customer base.
Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, referral partners, and other relevant business associates.
Conduct regular market visits and accompany team members to support business development and customer acquisition.
Ensure a consistent pipeline of quality leads and timely conversion of leads into loan disbursements.
Coordinate with Credit, Legal, Technical, Operations, and other internal teams to ensure smooth loan processing and timely disbursement.
Monitor sales reports, business MIS, team productivity, and market performance to achieve business objectives.
Ensure compliance with company policies, lending guidelines, documentation requirements, and established sales processes.
Analyze competitor activities and market trends to identify opportunities for business expansion.
Provide regular business updates and performance reports to senior management.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Graduate in any discipline; an MBA or postgraduate qualification will be an added advantage.
6–10 years of experience in sales within Micro Finance, NBFC, Financial Services.
Prior experience in team handling and managing Sales Managers or a field sales team is essential.
Strong experience in Loan Against Property (LAP), Mortgage Loans, Home Loans, Secured Business Loans is preferred.
Proven track record of achieving sales targets, driving business growth, and improving team productivity.
Strong knowledge of customer acquisition, field sales, market development, and loan sales processes.
Excellent leadership, communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
Ability to manage a team, review performance, and drive business results in a target-oriented environment.
Willingness to travel locally for market visits and business development activities.
Candidates with a good CIBIL score, responsible repayment history, and a strong performance record will be preferred, subject to company policy.

Key Skills
Branch Sales Management | Team Handling | Sales Leadership | Loan Against Property (LAP) | Mortgage Loans | Secured Lending | Business Development | Target Achievement | Sales Team Management | Market Development | Customer Acquisition | Sales Performance Monitoring | NBFC Sales | Banking Sales | Relationship Management | Field Sales
AboutCompany:
The Muthoot Group is a leading business conglomerate that has successfully expanded, in each and every town, across the nation. The Group has 20 diversified business divisions and 5443+ branches with a global presence across USA, UK, UAE, Costa Rica, Sri Lanka and Nepal.
The Group serves over 2.5 lakh customers every single day through its network of branches. Till date, the Group has served over 70 crore customers, including repeat customers. The Muthoot Groups story from humble beginnings to its ever growing stature is built on the firm foundation of 7 fundamental principles of Ethics, Values Reliability, Dependability, Trustworthiness, Integrity and Goodwill. The Group practices an equal opportunity policy wherein people from all sections of the society have equal opportunities to join and be part of the 40,000+ strong Muthoot Family.
Muthoot Finance, the flagship company of The Muthoot Group has been rated India’s No. 1 Most Trusted Financial Services Brand for five consecutive years, from 2016 to 2020 by TRA’s Brand Trust Report. It has been certified as ‘Great Place To Work, 2021-22’ and has been recognised and featured as one of the Top 30 Best Places to Work at in India by Skill Tree Global Knowledge Consortium in the Workplace Excellence Show on CNBC TV-18 in 2016.
The Company offer 30+ Staff Welfare Measures ranging from Fast Track Promotions, Career Development Programs, National Pension Scheme, Foreign Trips, five types of Annual Incentives/Bonuses, Cash Rewards, Contests with prizes, Maternity Benefits, Medical benefits, Employee Insurance etc. to name a few.
Muthoot Finance believes in promoting local hiring from the region. Every 5th employee is a woman and roughly 24% of the workforce comprises of women.
Shri. Amitabh Bachchan Ji is the Brand Ambassador of The Muthoot Group.
The Group takes humble pride in its 800 years of family business legacy and unblemished track record. Over these years, millions of underserved Indians have been served through a bouquet of products and services and have been helped in a big way to move ahead in life.

AboutLenskart
With a mission to give India a vision, Lenskart.com is India's fastest growing eyewear company. Lenskart's products include prescription eyewear, branded contact lenses and sunglasses, all equipped with the customers eye powers.
Aboutthe Role
A Sales Associate is responsible for providing the best customer experience in the stores by providing high standards of selling services to customers. He/she plays a key role in driving the revenue achieved by the store.
Responsibilities
Area
ActivitiesexpectedtobeperformedbyaLenskartSalesAssociate
Customerfocus: Driving Net Promoter Score
Greeting and welcoming all walk-in customers and guiding them toward the clinic to promote the free eye check-up

Understanding the POS system to ensure that the transactions are processed effectively

Product recommendation
Presenting the customer with an optimal selection of products based on customer preferences Understanding the unstated needs of the customer, asking relevant questions, and picking the
right time to pitch the recommended solutions
Achievingsales Vs.Plan&SOP adherence

Storeupkeep& maintenance

Ensuring the security of all Lenskart equipment and that there is no shortage of stock units or damage in the store
Personalattributes&competencies
Minimum qualification: 12th pass; Graduates preferred Ability to build rapport and trusting relationships
Ability to understand unstated needs of the customer and offer solutions Clear communication and active listening skills
Ability to adapt to changing environment and openness to learn
Proactive task ownership, result-orientation, and customer-orientation Ability to multitask and organize activities based on priority
Preferred candidate profile
Perks and benefits

Incentives policy : Daily - weekends incentives - monthly incentives - festival incentives .

Training : After selection u need to travel to Bangalore for training in Lenskart academy for 17Days.

Description:
Title: Presales/Operations Professional | Online Payments (Payment Gateway)

About Paytm Group:
Paytm is Indias leading digital payments and financial services company, focused on driving consumers and merchants to its platform through a wide range of payment use cases. Paytm offers services such as utility bill payments, money transfers, UPI, Wallet, FASTag, Postpaid, and Payment Gateway solutions. For merchants, Paytm provides comprehensive payment acceptance solutions, including QR, Soundbox, EDC, and Payment Gateway, while enabling business growth through commerce and financial services.

About Paytm Payments Services (PPSL):
Paytm Payments Services Limited (PPSL) is the RBI-regulated Payment Aggregator responsible for Paytm's Online Payment Gateway business. PPSL enables thousands of merchants, startups, and enterprises to offer seamless digital payment experiences through multiple payment modes, including UPI, Cards, Net Banking, Wallets, EMI, and BNPL. Our mission is to help businesses accelerate growth through secure, reliable, and scalable payment solutions.

About the Role:
We are looking for a proactive and detail-oriented professional to support the Payment Gateway Sales team across pre-sales activities, client solutioning and sales operations. The role will work closely with Sales, Product, Technology and Operations teams to ensure smooth coordination, effective client engagement and seamless business execution.

Expectations / Requirements:
Generate and qualify enterprise leads through cold calling, outbound prospecting and market research.
Understand prospect requirements, conduct initial discussions and build a strong pipeline for the Enterprise Sales/KAM team.
Maintain lead pipeline, follow-ups and accurate updates in CRM/internal systems.
Coordinate with Product, Technology, Integration, Risk and Operations teams for smooth merchant onboarding and integration.
Act as a SPOC for merchant queries, issues and grievances, ensuring timely resolution and closure.
Track merchant onboarding, integration and operational issues, identify bottlenecks and drive timely resolution.
Prepare MIS, reports and dashboards covering leads, onboarding, integrations and operational metrics.
Support Sales with operational activities, documentation, approvals and internal coordination.
Leverage AI tools and automation to improve productivity, prospect research, reporting and operational efficiency.
Identify process gaps and drive improvements in TAT, operational efficiency and merchant experience.

Qualifications & Skills:
2+ years of experience in Pre-Sales, Inside Sales, Sales Support, Merchant Operations or similar roles.
Strong experience in B2B/Enterprise lead generation, cold calling and lead qualification.
Prior experience in Fintech, Payments, Banking or Technology preferred.
Exposure to merchant onboarding, payment integration or merchant support is an added advantage.
Strong communication, stakeholder management and interpersonal skills with the ability to engage effectively with prospects, merchants and internal teams.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and execution skills with proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM/reporting tools.
Hands-on experience with AI tools to improve prospecting, research, reporting, productivity and day-to-day execution is mandatory.
Strong ownership, customer focus and ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
Superpowers / Skills that will help you succeed:
Proven ability in cold calling, lead generation & lead qualification
Strong B2B/Enterprise sales orientation
Excellent stakeholder management & coordination
Customer-centric approach with strong problem-solving skills
Good analytical and reporting skills
Ability to multitask and work in a fast-paced environment
Strong ownership, follow-through and execution mindset
Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint and CRM tools

Location:
Noida | Mumbai | Bengaluru
Why Join Us:
At Paytm Payments Services, you'll work on one of India's largest digital payment platforms, solving complex business challenges for leading enterprises.
